While both specialized content moderators and general-purpose LLMs are being used as safety layers, the question of which model is best suited for which type of harmful content remains unanswered. We present the most comprehensive evaluation of LLM safety capabilities to date, systematically testing \textbf{53} models across \textbf{11} datasets that we organize into four distinct categories. Our evaluation under both prompt-only and prompt-response settings uncovers critical blind spots: large frontier models that lead on one category fall significantly behind smaller, specialized alternatives on others, and real-world conversational safety remains largely unsolved across all model families. These findings challenge the assumption that scale alone ensures safety, and provide the community with a structured framework for informed model selection.

</details>


### [205] [Lexical Coupling in GUI Element Grounding: Sentence Embeddings Track Labels across Mobile and Web](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21794)
*Qijia Chen,Giulio Jacucci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于嵌入的GUI grounding评估常将可见标签恢复误认为语义grounding。在三个移动端和Web基准上，词法基线在top-1上仍具竞争力，编码器的命中可由词法排名、候选池大小和标签类型预测。部署级融合增益远小于oracle增益，建议评估时应报告词法基线、标签类型分层和部署级融合诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI grounding评估将UI元素转为文本元数据后，用指令-元素嵌入相似度作为语义grounding的证据，但这种方法可能被可见标签恢复所混淆，缺乏对该混淆的定量分析和诊断方法。

Method: 在三个移动端和Web基准上，将每个动作视为同屏排序任务，比较五种现成的单向量编码器与词法基线，分析top-1命中率与词法排名、候选池大小、标签类型的关系，并评估部署级融合与目标感知oracle融合的差异。

Result: 词法基线在top-1上保持竞争力；标签稀疏目标对纯文本方法仍较弱；编码器top-1命中可由词法排名和标签类型预测；编码器能恢复部分词法漏检，但部署级融合增益远小于oracle增益。

Conclusion: 嵌入基评估可能混淆可见标签恢复与语义GUI grounding，因此评估实践应纳入词法基线、标签类型分层以及部署级融合诊断，并公开了分析脚本和去文本化的逐步骤面板。

Abstract: GUI grounding evaluations that expose UI elements as text metadata often treat high instruction-element embedding similarity as evidence of semantic grounding. Across three mobile and web benchmarks, we show that this interpretation is frequently confounded by visible-label recovery. Lexical baselines remain competitive at top-1, label-poor targets remain weak for text-only methods, and encoder top-1 hits are predictable from lexical rank, candidate-pool size, and label type. We evaluate each action as a same-screen ranking task, comparing five off-the-shelf single-vector encoders with lexical baselines. Encoders recover some lexical misses, but deployable fusion gains are much smaller than target-aware oracle gains. These findings show that embedding-based evaluations can conflate visible-label recovery with semantic GUI grounding. Embedding-based evaluations should therefore report lexical baselines, label-type stratification, and deployable-fusion diagnostics. Our released repository provides analysis scripts and detexted per-step panels: https://github.com/qijia123/lexical-coupling-release.

</details>


### [206] [More Computational Resources Do Not Ensure Higher Scholarly Impact: Evidence from Leading NLP Conference Papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21806)
*Shuai Chen,Tong Bao,Jitong Peng,Chengzhi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究分析了2020-2025年间ACL、EMNLP和NAACL三大NLP会议共13,921篇主会议论文，通过提取并标准化论文中报告的GPU配置来计算计算资源，发现GPU资源虽然与学术影响力（引用、获奖）存在统计显著的正相关，但解释力极弱（R²仅增加0.0042）；资源集中度远超影响力集中度，且GPU数量比更新的硬件世代对影响力有更一致的预测作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算资源在NLP研究中日益关键，但报告中的GPU能力与实际学术影响力之间的关系尚未得到系统量化。该研究旨在填补这一空白，检验算力投入是否以及多大程度上转化为学术成果。

Method: 收集2020-2025年ACL/EMNLP/NAACL主会议13,921篇论文全文，提取GPU型号和数量，将每篇论文最大的报告配置标准化为可比较的硬件能力指标，并与引用数、奖项、主题和机构元数据关联。采用描述性统计、集中度分析和调整后的回归模型进行量化分析。

Result: GPU报告率随时间增加但仍不完整；报告能力主要靠新硬件世代和中规模多GPU配置提升。年度前20%的GPU可量化论文占83.9%-89.9%的GPU能力，但仅占27%-32%的引用和20%-33%的奖项。十倍GPU能力增长仅带来3.52个百分点的主题-年份引用百分位提升，模型R²仅增加0.0042；GPU数量比新硬件世代与引用和奖项的关系更为一致。

Conclusion: 报告的GPU资源与学术影响力存在关联，但其对研究影响力的独立解释力非常有限。资源和影响力之间的集中度严重不匹配，提示计算能力并不是决定学术影响力的主要因素。

Abstract: Computational resources are increasingly central to NLP research, but how closely reported GPU capability aligns with scholarly impact remains unclear. We analyze 13,921 ACL, EMNLP, and NAACL main-conference papers published between 2020 and 2025, using GPU resources as our operational measure of computational resources. From full texts, we extract GPU models and counts, standardize each paper's largest reported configuration into a comparable hardware-capability measure, and link these data to citation, award, topic, and institutional metadata. GPU reporting became more common but remained incomplete, while reported capability increased mainly through newer hardware generations and medium-scale multi-GPU configurations. Resource concentration substantially exceeded impact concentration: the annual top 20% of GPU-quantifiable papers accounted for 83.9%-89.9% of reported GPU capability, but only 27%-32% of citations and 20%-33% of paper awards. In adjusted models, a tenfold increase in aggregate reported GPU capability was associated with a 3.52-percentage-point increase in within-NLP topic-year citation percentile, but increased model R^2 by only 0.0042. GPU count showed more consistent positive associations with citation and award outcomes than newer hardware generation. Overall, reported GPU resources are associated with scholarly impact but provide little standalone explanation of research influence.

</details>


### [207] [MCite-RL: Towards Reliable Multimodal RAG via Citation-enhanced Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21808)
*Suifeng Zhao,Zida Liu,Xinyu Lei,Lei Sun,Jun Gao,Sujian Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出MCite-RL，一个基于智能体强化学习的引用增强框架，用于多模态RAG中的视觉引用任务。通过迭代检索、推理和递归裁剪的Agentic Refinement模块，以及融合过程级和结果级反馈的Citation-enhanced Reward机制，实现了引用精度与答案质量的联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态RAG和基于SFT的方法难以实现鲁棒的跨模态推理，导致视觉引用不精确或引用与生成答案解耦，无法满足可追溯性和可验证性需求。

Method: MCite-RL包含两个核心组件：(1) Agentic Refinement模块，通过迭代检索、推理和递归裁剪逐步缩小搜索空间，将引用从静态步骤转化为动态的、证据驱动的推理过程；(2) Citation-enhanced Reward机制，在强化学习范式中整合过程级与结果级反馈，联合优化答案准确性和来源可追溯性。

Result: 在Wiki-VISA、FinRAGBench-V和MMLongBench-Doc等基准上的大量实验表明，MCite-RL有效实现了引用精度和答案质量的联合优化。

Conclusion: MCite-RL通过将视觉引用建模为证据驱动的动态推理过程，并借助强化学习实现过程与结果的双重反馈优化，为多模态RAG的可靠引用提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with visual citation is crucial for ensuring the traceability and verifiability of MLLMs. However, current RAG and SFT-based methods struggle to achieve robust cross-modal reasoning, causing imprecise visual citations or decoupling between the citation and the generated answers. To address these limitations, we propose MCite-RL, a citation-enhanced agentic reinforcement learning framework designed for reliable multimodal RAG. MCite-RL introduces an Agentic Refinement module for visual citation that employs iterative retrieval, reasoning, and recursive cropping to progressively narrow the search space, transforming citation into a dynamic, evidence-driven reasoning process rather than a static step. Furthermore, we incorporate a Citation-enhanced Reward mechanism that integrates both process-level and outcome-level feedback within a reinforcement learning paradigm to jointly optimize answer accuracy and source traceability. Extensive experiments on benchmarks such as Wiki-VISA, FinRAGBench-V, and MMLongBench-Doc demonstrate that MCite-RL effectively achieves the joint optimization of citation precision and answer quality.

</details>


### [208] [Convergence in Science, Divergence in Religion: Calibrated Framing Differences Across Wikipedia's Language Editions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21821)
*Hung-Hsuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"校准距离"（calibrated distance）指标来衡量维基百科不同语言版本对同一概念在表述上的框架差异（framing distance），而非传统的覆盖度差异。基于150个维基数据锚定概念、20种语言版本、2,799篇有效文章，发现宗教领域跨语言差异最大，科学/技术领域差异最小；校准距离有效消除了语言对间编码器对齐差异及语系效应。三种多语言编码器在概念级排名上高度一致（Spearman rho=0.75-0.79）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨语言维基百科研究主要测量不同语言版本之间的覆盖度差距（coverage gaps），但缺乏对同一概念在不同语言中如何被"框架化"（framing）的量化和度量方法。作者旨在回答：当不同语言版本的维基百科描述同一概念时，它们的表述方式差异有多大？这需要区分真正的语义/框架差异与编码器本身对不同语言对的校准（alignment）差异。

Method: 1）构建数据集：选取150个维基数据锚定概念、20种语言版本、4个领域（含校准集），共3,000个概念-语言观察，经筛选得到2,799篇有效文章。2）定义校准概念集：选取跨文化指称稳定的概念（化学元素、数字、颜色等）。3）提出校准距离：某概念在两个语言版本间的嵌入距离减去同一语言对在校准概念上的平均距离，以消除语言对的编码器对齐差异。4）使用三种多语言编码器（LaBSE、多语言MPNet、CMLM）进行嵌入，并基于校准距离进行领域级和概念级排名分析，使用Spearman相关检验编码器间排名一致性。

Result: 1）即使在指称稳定的校准概念上，最大的语言对平均距离是最小的3.6倍，且语言家族内的距离通常更小，说明原始嵌入距离受到编码器对齐偏差的强烈影响。2）校准距离调整后，语言对特定对齐差异和语言家族模式显著减弱。3）三种编码器上科学文章比校准文章更对齐，且三者一致地将宗教排在首位、科学/技术排在末位。4）概念级排名在编码器间高度一致（MPNet和CMLM相对LaBSE的Spearman rho为0.75-0.79）。5）在LaBSE下，宗教的框架差异显著高于校准基线。6）政治领域内，审查制度和难民等概念差异较大，而民主和人权等概念差异最小。代码、数据和逐语言对的校准基线已公开。

Conclusion: 跨语言维基百科对同一概念的框架差异是可量化且系统的：不同领域和概念呈现出稳定的跨语言差异模式，其中宗教是最具文化依赖性的领域，科学/技术最为一致。校准距离作为一种新指标，能有效剥离编码器的语言对对齐偏差，为跨语言内容比较研究提供更可靠的工具。概念级排名在多种编码器间的一致性表明该发现具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: When Wikipedia's language editions describe the same concept, how differently do they frame it? Prior work measures coverage gaps between editions; we measure framing distance for matched concepts. We analyze 2,799 valid articles from 3,000 possible concept-language observations, spanning 150 Wikidata-anchored concepts, 20 language editions, 4 domains, and a calibration set. Raw embedding distances reflect both content differences and how well the encoder aligns each language pair. Even among calibration concepts with stable cross-cultural denotations (e.g., chemical elements, numbers, colors), the largest language-pair mean distance is 3.6 times the smallest, and distances are typically smaller within language families. We define a baseline-adjusted distance (calibrated distance): the distance between two language versions of a concept minus the mean distance for calibration concepts in the same language pair. This adjustment substantially reduces pair-specific alignment differences and the language-family pattern. Across three multilingual encoders (LaBSE, multilingual MPNet, and CMLM), scientific articles align more closely than calibration articles, and all three rank religion first and science/technology last. Concept-level rankings are highly consistent across encoders (Spearman rho=0.75-0.79 for MPNet and CMLM relative to LaBSE). Religion lies significantly above the calibration baseline under LaBSE. Within politics, divergence concentrates on concepts such as censorship and refugee, while democracy and human rights are among the most aligned. Code, data, and per-language-pair calibration baselines are released.\footnote{https://github.com/hhchen1105/cross-linqual-concept}

</details>


### [209] [Do Large Language Models Perform Well on Comprehending Poetic Logic in Modern Chinese Poetry?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21827)
*Tian Lan,Shanshan Wang,Zehua Duo,Jiang Li,Guanglai Gao,Derek F. Wong,Xiangdong Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Peony，这是第一个专门用于评估现代中文诗歌"诗性逻辑"理解能力的基准测试，涵盖诗节、诗句和意象三个层面的四项任务，并对六个主流大语言模型在思考与非思考配置下进行了系统评估，揭示了当前LLM在现代中文诗歌诗性逻辑理解上的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在多种NLP任务上取得了显著进展，但其对文学作品（尤其是现代中文诗歌）的理解能力尚未被充分探索。现代中文诗歌独特的"诗性逻辑"需要超越表层语义分析的整体性推理方式，而现有评估范式大多忽略了这一关键维度，缺乏专门评估此类能力的基准。

Method: 作者构建了Peony基准，将诗性逻辑定义为三个层级（诗节、诗句、意象）上的四项任务；基于该基准对六个主流LLM在非思考（non-thinking）和思考（thinking）两种配置下进行系统评估与分析。

Result: 实验结果表明当前LLM在现代中文诗歌诗性逻辑理解方面存在明显局限，同时验证了Peony基准的有效性和必要性。

Conclusion: Peony作为首个面向现代中文诗歌诗性逻辑的评估基准，填补了现有LLM文学理解评估的空白，为后续改进LLM的诗歌理解和文学推理能力提供了重要参考框架。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved significant progress across a wide range of natural language processing (NLP) tasks, yet their ability to understand literary texts, particularly modern Chinese poetry, remains largely unexplored. The unique literary characteristics of modern Chinese poetry necessitate a distinct form of reasoning for effective comprehension. Unlike conventional texts that convey clear information, the unique "poetic logic" of modern Chinese poetry requires a holistic reasoning approach that goes beyond superficial semantic analysis to be understood. However, current evaluation paradigms largely ignore this critical dimension. To address this gap, we propose Peony, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating the poetic logic of modern Chinese poetry. We define poetic logic as four tasks across three levels, namely stanza, line, and imagery, and systematically evaluate and analyze six mainstream LLMs based on Peony. We evaluate these models under both non-thinking and thinking configurations. The experimental results reveal the limitations of current LLMs in understanding the poetic logic of modern Chinese poetry and validate the effectiveness and necessity of Peony. Our data and code will be available.

</details>


### [210] [Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21829)
*Yu Pan,Hongfeng Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"知识库即模型"的反转框架，让训练智能体在监督信号下主动编辑文档库结构，以(问题,答案)对作为标签代替无监督的离线图构建，在仅使用1,913条链接（对照196,112条）的情况下获得1.6倍动作节省和1.8倍准确率提升。文章引入键覆盖率梯度探针替代简单的训练/测试划分，揭示泛化是依赖端点的：准确率可迁移到未见过的问题，但动作节省只保留在训练过的问题上。实验表明知识库欠训练而非饱和，覆盖率随新问题线性增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强生成将文档库视为冻结输入，而让智能体主动策展图书馆的系统从未测量策展对知识库本身产生了什么影响。作者反转这一框架，将知识库本身视为模型，用监督信号指导其结构演化，并系统度量这种监督式构建相对于无监督构建的优势与泛化边界。

Method: 训练智能体在当前存储上回答监督问题，看到标准答案后编辑存储结构；随后在冻结快照上以固定动作预算审视未改变的读取器。以(问题,答案)对为标签进行监督式图结构构建，替代无监督的实体索引。引入键覆盖率梯度（key-coverage gradient）作为探测工具，通过变化训练集触及问题的程度来绘制性能衰减曲线，取代传统训练/测试划分的二元通过/失败判断。

Result: 每索引一个语料点，监督式构建比覆盖全部的无监督实体索引多返回1.6倍动作节省和1.8倍准确率，仅用1,913条链接对比196,112条。在训练过的问题上，未改变的读取器以31%更少的动作获得更高准确率，并在官方PhantomWiki生成任务上复现。泛化是端点依赖的：两个键都被索引时准确率提升+0.167 F1，一个键提升+0.100，无键则零提升；动作节省仅保留在训练问题上。覆盖率随新问题线性增长，训练重复时停止增长，一百个问题可达到语料的四分之一覆盖率。作者推断是欠训练问题而非饱和问题。

Conclusion: 监督式策展知识库结构在参数效率上远优于无监督的全覆盖索引，但泛化表现出明显的端点依赖特性：准确率可以迁移而动作节省不能。文章主张用覆盖率梯度替代简单划分来刻画泛化，并指出通过更多训练样本可线性扩展覆盖率，知识库处于欠训练状态而非饱和状态。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation treats the document store as a frozen input, and the systems that instead let an agent curate one never measure what curation does to the store. We invert the framing: the knowledge base is the model. A training agent answers a supervised question against the current store, is shown the gold, then edits the store; an unchanged reader is later examined on a frozen snapshot under a fixed action budget. Where offline graph construction is unsupervised, (question, answer) pairs are our labels -- and that supervision is what makes the structure cheap. Per point of corpus indexed it returns 1.6x the action saving and 1.8x the accuracy of an unsupervised entity index covering everything, using 1,913 links against its 196,112. On questions the store trained on, an unchanged reader spends 31% fewer actions at higher accuracy, and the result reproduces on an official PhantomWiki generation whose questions we did not write. To measure how far this reaches we introduce a key-coverage gradient, a probe varying how much of a question the training set touched, replacing a train/test split's pass/fail with a decay curve. Generalization proves endpoint-dependent: accuracy carries to unseen questions (+0.167 F1 where both of a question's keys were indexed, +0.100 where one was, zero where neither) while the action saving stays on trained questions. Because that decay is indexed by coverage rather than by novelty, more training extends it -- and the store is undertrained, not saturated: coverage grows linearly in new questions and stops the moment training repeats them, so a hundred questions reach a quarter of the corpus and four times as many would close the gap.

</details>


### [211] [GUI-Primitives: Diagnosing Spatial Reasoning Failures in Vision-Language GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21832)
*Md Abrar Jahin,Md Rizwan Parvez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出GUI-Primitives基准，包含994个对比指令对，用于评估计算机使用代理是否真正理解GUI中的7种空间关系（左右、上下、包含、对齐、邻近、列表序数、遮挡）。19个视觉语言模型的最优严格点内框准确率仅32%。分析发现60-92%的预测落在两个候选区域之外，主要失败源于候选定位而非关系理解；仅在候选区域内时，水平/垂直位置、邻近和列表序数的目标选择准确率可达0.82-0.90，而包含和遮挡与随机水平无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用基准无法隔离模型是否将关系语言正确绑定到界面元素。作者希望设计一个可控基准，固定截图和锚点、仅改变关系表达，从而精确测试视觉语言模型对空间关系的理解能力。

Method: 构建994项对比指令对基准，覆盖7种空间关系。每个对比对保持截图和锚点不变，仅改变关系表达式，使正确目标在两个指定候选之间移动。5名标注者验证196项子集（结构良好性κ=0.94，目标选择κ=0.79）。对19个视觉语言模型进行测试，按候选区域对预测分类，并引入oracle诊断（标记候选）来分离定位失败与关系理解失败。

Result: 19个VLM的最优严格点内框准确率仅32%。60-92%的预测落在两个候选之外。在候选区域内，水平/垂直位置、邻近和列表序数的目标选择达0.82-0.90，但包含和遮挡与0.50无显著差异。基准准确率与ScreenSpot-Pro存在正相关（Spearman ρ=+0.74）。标记候选可使选择准确率提升35-57个百分点。

Conclusion: 大多数失败源于候选定位能力不足而非关系理解。当前模型在空间基础位置上表现尚可，但在包含和遮挡等复杂关系的绑定上仍接近随机。作者发布基准、预测和代码以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Computer-use agents ground natural-language instructions in screenshots to locate interface elements, yet existing benchmarks do not isolate whether models bind relational language to the correct element. We introduce GUI-Primitives, a 994-item benchmark of contrastive instruction pairs over seven spatial relations in graphical user interfaces (left/right, above/below, containment, alignment, proximity, list ordinal, occlusion). Each pair holds the screenshot and anchor fixed while changing the relation expression, so the correct target moves between two designated candidates. Five annotators validate a 196-item subset ($κ= 0.94$ well-formedness; $κ= 0.79$ target selection). Nineteen vision-language models reach at most $32\%$ strict point-in-box accuracy. Because models emit unconstrained coordinates, we classify each prediction by the candidate region it falls within. Predictions fall outside both candidates on $60-92\%$ of items. Conditional on falling within a candidate region, target selection reaches 0.82-0.90 for horizontal position, vertical position, proximity, and list ordinal, but does not differ significantly from 0.50 for containment and occlusion: most failures reflect candidate localization rather than relation understanding. Across ten models, benchmark accuracy correlates with ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy (Spearman $ρ= +0.74$), an exploratory association at this sample size. Marking the two designated candidates raises selection accuracy by 35--57 percentage points, an oracle diagnostic that supplies the candidate set rather than a deployable method. We release the benchmark, predictions, and code.

</details>


### [212] [PUMA: A Polish Benchmark for Culturally Grounded Multimodal Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21853)
*Sławomir Dadas,Michał Perełkiewicz,Rafał Poświata,Małgorzata Grębowiec,Bartłomiej Jaworski,Izabela Woźniakowska*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PUMA（波兰统一多模态评估基准），包含900个手工构建的任务，用于评估多模态模型在波兰文化与语言背景下的表现。实验发现顶级商业模型在视觉问答上表现优异，但大多数模型在复杂音频和文档理解上存在明显性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型正在从纯文本处理扩展到图像、音频等多模态领域，但多模态数据处理能力（尤其是非英语文化和语言背景下的表现）尚未得到全面评估。现有评估基准大多以英语为中心，缺乏针对特定文化背景的多模态评测工具。

Method: 构建PUMA基准，包含900个手工设计的任务，覆盖文本、图像、音频和视觉丰富文档多模态维度，专门针对波兰文化与语言情境进行评估。评估对象包括前沿商业模型、开源权重模型以及专业小型系统。

Result: 顶级商业模型在视觉问答任务上得分较高，但大多数模型在复杂音频理解和视觉丰富文档理解方面表现不佳，凸显了明显的性能差距。

Conclusion: 当前多模态模型在非英语文化和语言环境下的泛化能力仍然不足，特别是复杂音频和文档理解场景。开放PUMA评估框架旨在推动本地化多模态AI研究的发展。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly moving beyond text processing, adding support for other modalities such as images and audio. While text understanding and generation have been extensively studied, multimodal data processing capabilities, particularly in the context of cultures and languages other than English, have not yet been evaluated comprehensively. In this paper, we propose PUMA (Polish Unified Multimodal Assessment), a novel benchmark of 900 hand-crafted tasks designed to probe the limits of multimodal models in the Polish cultural and linguistic context. The dataset evaluates both cultural understanding and practical skill in processing text, images, audio, and visually rich documents. Our extensive evaluation of frontier commercial models, open-weights models, and specialized smaller systems highlights a significant performance gap. While top commercial models achieve high scores in visual question answering, most models struggle with complex audio or document understanding. We open-source our evaluation framework to advance localized multimodal AI research.

</details>


### [213] [HiDiffTIR: Hierarchical Difficulty-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Tool-Integrated Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21863)
*Yucan Guo,Xiaohan Wang,Miao Su,Saiping Guan,Zhongni Hou,Jiajun Chai,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Xiaolong Jin,Jiafeng Guo,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HiDiffTIR是一个面向多轮工具集成推理的分层难度感知策略优化框架，在轨迹和回合两个层面进行难度感知的信用分配，无需额外监督即可显著提升LLM代理的工具调用性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL方法在训练LLM进行工具集成推理时，对所有正确工具调用赋予统一的轨迹级优势，忽略了不同轨迹和推理步骤之间在难度和学习价值上的差异，导致学习信号不够精确，无法有效区分琐碎和具有挑战性的工具使用模式。

Method: 提出HiDiffTIR框架，在轨迹级和回合级两个层级上进行难度感知的信用分配。通过标准RL rollout中获得的组级统计信息（无需额外监督）来衡量各轨迹和各推理步骤的难度，使策略能够聚焦于信息量更丰富的轨迹和更难的推理步骤，实现细粒度的策略优化。

Result: 在三个工具使用基准上的大量实验表明，HiDiffTIR相较于强RL基线能够一致地提升多轮工具集成推理性能和工具调用准确率。

Conclusion: 分层难度感知的信用分配对于工具集成LLM代理的有效策略优化是必要的，该框架证明了通过细粒度的难度信号可以显著改善RL训练效果。

Abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) is a fundamental capability for LLM agents to solve complex tasks by interacting with external tools iteratively. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become the dominant paradigm for enabling this capability. However, existing approaches typically assign uniform trajectory-level advantages and treat all correct tool calls equally, ignoring the varying difficulty and learning value across trajectories and reasoning steps. This can lead to imprecise learning signals that do not adequately distinguish between trivial and challenging tool-use patterns. To address this limitation, we propose HiDiffTIR, a Hierarchical Difficulty-aware policy optimization framework for multi-turn TIR. HiDiffTIR performs difficulty-aware credit assignment at both trajectory and turn levels, enabling the policy to focus on more informative trajectories and harder reasoning steps. Notably, this fine-grained optimization is achieved without additional supervision, relying solely on group-level statistics derived from standard RL rollouts. Extensive experiments on three tool-using benchmarks demonstrate that HiDiffTIR consistently improves multi-turn TIR performance and tool invocation accuracy over strong RL baselines, highlighting the necessity of difficulty-aware credit assignment for effective policy optimization in tool-integrated LLM agents.

</details>


### [214] [The Chase Is the Curriculum, the Capture Anchors the Credit: Pursuit-Evasion Self-Play for Zero-Data LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21871)
*Jing Yu,Shengchao Chen,Yiyun Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LURE，一种零数据自我对弈框架，将大语言模型推理能力提升重新构建为追逐-逃避博弈：逃避者（LLM）沿环境难度轴定位任务以领先求解者一步，求解者（规划-执行器）通过可验证交互追捕任务。逃避者通过"捕获前沿"奖励学习定位策略（在恰好一半rollout中被捕获时奖励最高），求解者则获得以捕获为锚点的密集过程奖励和轮次锚定KL约束以保持协同演化稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可验证奖励的强化学习依赖大规模人工策划的任务集合，而零数据自我对弈方法虽然摆脱了这一依赖，但存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 仅通过事后探测候选任务来验证可学习性，无法学习在环境难度轴上何处放置任务；(2) 仅向求解者提供稀疏的终端奖励，缺乏过程级别的学习信号。作者希望解决这两个问题，使任务生成和求解形成真正的协同演化。

Method: LURE将零数据自我对弈重构为追逐-逃避博弈：(1) 逃避者是一个LLM，负责在环境难度轴上定位任务，目标是"领先求解者一步"——设计恰好在50% rollout中被求解者捕获的任务；(2) 求解者是规划-执行器，通过可验证交互追捕任务；(3) 逃避者使用"捕获前沿"奖励函数，当求解者在恰好一半rollout中成功捕获时奖励达到峰值，将"勉强可捕获"从手工拒绝带转变为学习到的定位策略；(4) 求解者获得捕获锚定的密集过程奖励，单调验证器进展与终端捕获联合分组归一化，并结合轮次锚定的KL散度约束来维持双智能体协同演化的稳定性。

Result: 在三个可验证推理环境和三个骨干模型家族上，LURE在统一/专家设置下均优于先进的基线方法。此外，统一模型在九个来自三个任务家族的保留基准上，相比所有训练基线取得了更强的聚合OOD零样本准确率。

Conclusion: 通过将任务定位从后验拒绝转变为主动学习策略，并将稀疏终端奖励升级为捕获锚定的密集过程奖励，LURE证明了零数据自我对弈可以更有效地提升大语言模型的推理能力，同时获得更强的跨任务泛化（OOD）性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the dominant recipe for improving large language model reasoning, yet it presumes large human-curated task collections. Zero-data self-play removes this dependency, but existing methods vet learnability only by probing candidates and rejecting post hoc, never learning where along an environment's difficulty axis to place a task, and credit the solver with sparse terminal rewards alone. We recast zero-data self-play as a pursuit-evasion game: in LURE, an LLM evader positions tasks along each environment's difficulty axis to stay one step ahead of a planner-executor pursuer that hunts it down through verifiable interaction. The evader is trained on a capture-frontier reward that peaks when the solver captures it on exactly half of its rollouts, turning barely catchable into a learned positioning strategy rather than a hand-tuned rejection band. The pursuer earns capture-anchored dense process credit, in which monotone verifier progress is group-normalized jointly with the terminal capture under a round-anchored KL that keeps the co-evolution stable. Across three verifiable reasoning environments and three backbone families, LURE outperforms advanced baselines under unified/specialist settings, while the unified model attains stronger aggregate OOD zero-shot accuracy than all trained baselines across nine held-out benchmarks from three task families.

</details>


### [215] [BanglaVeilGuard: Cross-Script Safety Benchmarking and Lightweight Guardrails for Bangla Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21880)
*Md. Rakibul Hassan,Muhammad Iqbal Hossain*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出BanglaVeilGuard，一个针对孟加拉语大语言模型的轻量级安全基准和提示词防护系统，覆盖六种孟加拉语书写形式（标准、罗马化、Banglish、代码混合、噪声、方言），包含2,366个质量过滤提示词和354个留出评估集，通过非破坏性多视角归一化和风险分类器实现提示词级防护，在多个目标模型上将攻击成功率从93.8-100%降至6.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全基准和防护系统以英语为中心或仅支持标准文字，无法有效评估和防护孟加拉语用户在日常中使用的多样化书写形式（跨文字、拼写、代码混合、方言），存在安全评估盲区。

Method: 构建包含六种语言形式的2317+354提示词基准；采用非破坏性多视角归一化处理输入，结合提示词风险分类器和阈值化的生成前门控机制，在不修改目标模型权重的情况下对异构目标模型进行提示词筛查。

Result: 在Claude Opus 4.8、BanglaLLama和TituLLM等目标模型上，防护后的确定性响应评分使攻击成功率从93.8-100%降至6.3%；TigerLLM-1B配合防护器达到78.2%准确率和8.8% ASR；提示防护器的不安全提示召回率达88.5%，显著高于评估的基线。

Conclusion: BanglaVeilGuard能显著降低孟加拉语LLM的攻击成功率并提升不安全提示召回率，主要代价是对方言和噪声良性提示的过度拒绝，揭示了孟加拉语LLM部署中安全性与有用性之间的现实权衡。

Abstract: Bangla large language model (LLM) safety is difficult to evaluate with English-centric or standard-script benchmarks because Bangla users routinely write across scripts, spellings, code-mixed forms, and regional registers. This paper presents BanglaVeilGuard, a compact Bangla-first safety benchmark and lightweight prompt guard for six language forms: standard Bangla, Romanized Bangla, Banglish, code-mixed Bangla--English, noisy Bangla, and dialectal Bangla. The benchmark contains 2,366 quality-filtered prompts and a held-out 354-prompt evaluation split spanning unsafe, safe, and safe-sensitive requests. BanglaVeilGuard uses non-destructive multi-view normalization with a prompt-risk classifier and thresholded pre-generation gate, allowing it to screen prompts for heterogeneous target models without changing their weights. Across target-model families, guarded runs reduce attack success under deterministic response scoring from 93.8--100.0\% to 6.3\% for Claude Opus 4.8, BanglaLLama, and TituLLM; TigerLLM-1B with BanglaVeilGuard achieves 78.2\% accuracy with 8.8\% ASR. The prompt guard also attains 88.5\% unsafe recall, substantially above the evaluated prompt-only guard baselines. The main remaining cost is over-refusal on dialectal and noisy benign prompts, revealing a concrete safety-helpfulness frontier for Bangla LLM deployment.

</details>


### [216] [Modeling Claim Dependency Structure for Patent Litigation Prediction with Graph Attention Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21924)
*Takao Arai,Hiroyasu Inoue*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ClaimGAT，一种基于图注意力网络的专利诉讼风险预测模型。它独立编码每条权利要求，构建有向权利要求依赖图，并通过GATConv层和图注意力聚合（Attentional Aggregation）来预测诉讼风险。在134万件美国实用专利上的六模型消融实验证明各组件具有独立且可叠加的预测价值，ClaimGAT取得了0.818的AUC-ROC和4.89x的top 10%提升。该模型揭示了高风险专利中结构选择与内容敏感性倾向于分离，与防御性权利要求撰写模式一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专利诉讼给企业带来巨大成本并扭曲研发激励，因此早期识别诉讼风险具有重要的实际意义。虽然已有研究使用BERT类模型处理专利权利要求文本，但存在两个根本性局限：平坦序列编码丢失了独立权利要求与从属权利要求之间的依赖结构（该结构在法律上决定专利范围），且将整个权利要求集输入单一编码器会忽略法律上关键的信息。

Method: ClaimGAT采用图注意力网络架构：1）独立编码每条权利要求；2）构建有向权利要求依赖图；3）使用GATConv层处理该图结构；4）通过Attentional Aggregation聚合独立权利要求。最终输出诉讼风险评分及权利要求级别的门控权重，支持事后结构分析。论文还设计了六模型消融实验，在134万件USPTO实用专利上验证各组件（per-claim编码、图连通性、注意力机制、Attentional Aggregation）的独立预测价值。

Result: ClaimGAT在仅利用专利授权时可用信息的情况下，实现了0.818的AUC-ROC和4.89x的top 10%提升。六模型消融实验证实per-claim编码、图连通性、注意力和Attentional Aggregation各模块均提供独立且可叠加的预测贡献。模型还发现高风险专利中结构选择与内容敏感性表现出分离倾向，这与防御性权利要求撰写模式一致。

Conclusion: ClaimGAT通过利用权利要求之间的依赖结构而非单纯扁平文本编码，显著提升了专利诉讼风险预测性能。其图注意力机制不仅能提供准确的风险评分，还能通过门控权重进行可解释的事后分析。模型揭示的防御性撰写模式为理解专利诉讼风险提供了新的结构性洞察。

Abstract: Patent litigation imposes substantial costs on firms and distorts R&D incentives, making early risk identification a practically important task. While prior work has applied BERT-based models to patent claim text, two fundamental limitations remain: flat sequence encoding loses the dependency structure between independent and dependent claims that legally determines patent scope, and feeding the entire claim set to a single encoder discards legally critical text. A six-model ablation on 1.34 million USPTO utility patents confirms that per-claim encoding, graph connectivity, attention, and Attentional Aggregation each provide independent, additive predictive value. We propose ClaimGAT, a Graph Attention Network that encodes each claim independently, constructs a directed claim dependency graph, processes it with GATConv layers, and aggregates independent claims via Attentional Aggregation to yield both a litigation risk score and claim-level gate weights that enable post-hoc structural analysis. ClaimGAT achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.818 and a lift of 4.89x at the top 10%, using only information observable at the time of patent grant. It reveals a tendency in high-risk patents for structural selection and content sensitivity to diverge, a pattern consistent with defensive claim drafting.

</details>


### [217] [EDGE: Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21946)
*Can Xie,Yuyi Zhou,Wen Yang,Ziyi zhang,Siyao Song,Yingzhuo Deng,Shuo Ren,Jiajun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EDGE框架提出将检索到的经验作为训练阶段的临时脚手架，通过渐进式蒸馏将外部经验内化为策略参数，解决了经验增强方法在推理时依赖外部检索且未考虑策略能力演化的问题，在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别超过GRPO 8.3和12.5个成功率点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于结果目标的强化学习方法（如GRPO）在策略更新后丢弃了交互轨迹中可复用的探索模式；而现有的经验增强方法在推理时直接应用历史经验，既不考虑策略不断演化的能力，又对外部检索产生持续性依赖，限制了泛化与部署效率。

Method: EDGE将每个rollout组划分为经验条件与经验无关的轨迹，无需额外采样即可估计并只接受正向边际增益；随后通过基于策略自身经验支撑上的reverse-KL目标将诱导行为蒸馏进基础策略。同时，采用共同进化的经验库，从涌现的失败模式中合成新指导并剪除过时条目，以适应策略演化。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，7B规模下EDGE较GRPO分别提升8.3和12.5个成功率点；推理阶段移除外部经验后仍保留96.0%的脚手架性能。

Conclusion: EDGE有效实现了经验从外部脚手架到参数化策略的内部化迁移，在保持推理时无外部依赖的同时带来显著的性能提升，为长时程智能体任务的强化学习提供了可借鉴的范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with outcome-based objectives such as GRPO enables LLM-based agents to solve complex, long-horizon tasks, yet the reusable exploration patterns embedded in interaction trajectories are largely discarded after a single policy update. Existing experience-augmented approaches retrieve historical guidance at inference time, but they apply experiences without accounting for the policy's evolving capability and create persistent dependencies on external retrieval. We propose EDGE (Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration), a framework that treats retrieved experiences as temporary training-time scaffolds and progressively internalizes their benefits into the parametric policy. Concretely, EDGE partitions each rollout group into experience-conditioned and experience-free trajectories to estimate and admit only positive marginal gains without extra sampling, then distills the induced behavior into the base policy via a reverse-KL objective on its own empirical support. A co-evolutionary experience bank further synthesizes guidance from emerging failure modes and prunes obsolete entries as the policy evolves. On ALFWorld and WebShop, EDGE improves over GRPO by 8.3 and 12.5 success-rate points at the 7B scale and retains 96.0% of its scaffolded performance when external experiences are removed at inference time. The code is available at https://github.com/xvolcano02/EDGE.

</details>


### [218] [Bulbul: A Dataset for Dialectal Arabic Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21950)
*Ahmed Ashraf,Aisha Alansari,Fadel Al Abbas,Nada Almarwani,Samah Aloufi,Saad Ezzini,Maged S. Al-Shaibani,Doaa Dalaq,AbdelRahim A. Elmadany,Muhammad Abdul-Mageed,Mohamed Mehdi Trigui,Dania Refai,Layan Refai,Mohamed Akrout,Mustafa Jarrar,Wasfi G. Al-Khatib,Alaa Dalaq,Darin El-Nakla,Samir Abdaljalil,Abdulrahman Al-Fakih,Nour El Imane Zeghib,Moussa Redah,Salmane Chafik,Mohamed El-Attar,Rima Grati,Sarah Kohail,Malak Alkhorasani,Khadijah Al Safwan,Ismail M. Mudhaffar,Ali Altam,Ahmed Al-Shaikh,Adnan Saeed,Hamzah Luqman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了BULBUL，一个包含275名来自11个阿拉伯国家讲话者的多方言阿拉伯语语音识别数据集，覆盖结构化的方言和次方言类别，并通过两级人工验证确保录音质量，同时为现代方言和带口音的阿拉伯语ASR建立了多个最新系统的强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语自动语音识别面临双言现象（diglossia）、广泛的地域方言差异和语音资源有限等独特挑战。现有语音数据集要么聚焦单一方言，要么依赖大规模广播/网络数据，导致语言多样性与标注质量之间存在权衡。因此需要一个兼具方言多样性和高质量标注的多方言数据集。

Method: 从11个阿拉伯国家的275名讲话者收集多方言阿拉伯语ASR数据集BULBUL，包含结构化的方言和次方言覆盖，以及讲话者以其母语方言口音录制的古典阿拉伯语（CA）和现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）录音，以支持口音感知建模。录音质量通过两级人工验证流程保证。随后对一系列最新的ASR系统进行基准测试以建立强基线。

Result: 成功构建了BULBUL多方言阿拉伯语ASR数据集，并在该数据集上对一系列最新ASR系统进行了基准评测，为现代方言阿拉伯语和带口音阿拉伯语ASR建立了强基线结果。

Conclusion: BULBUL数据集填补了阿拉伯语ASR在方言多样性与标注质量之间权衡的空白，为方言和口音感知的阿拉伯语语音识别研究提供了高质量的数据资源与基准。

Abstract: Arabic automatic speech recognition (ASR) faces unique challenges due to diglossia, extensive regional dialect variation, and limited speech resources. Existing speech datasets often focus on single dialects or large-scale broadcast/web data, leading to trade-offs between linguistic diversity and annotation quality. We present BULBUL, a multi-dialect Arabic ASR dataset collected from 275 speakers in 11 Arab countries. BULBUL includes structured dialect and sub-dialect coverage, as well as recordings of classical Arabic and modern standard Arabic spoken by participants in their native dialectal accents to support accent-aware modeling. The quality of the recordings was ensured through a two-level human verification process. We further benchmark a range of recent ASR systems, establishing strong baselines for modern dialectal and accented Arabic ASR.

</details>


### [219] [ToSCA: Leveraging Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning on Temporal and Strategic Abstractions of Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21969)
*Xiaoyu Wang,Qingqing Gu,Yue Zhao,Teng Chen,Yuqi Cao,Xiaokai Chen,Hongyan Li,Luo Ji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向对话智能体的两层级层次强化学习框架（ToSCA），基于两层级MDP，用DQN解决高层批评者、PPO解决低层演员-评论家，并通过双粒度奖励机制缓解奖励稀疏问题，在日常对话和情感支持对话任务上优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类在日常交互和思考中具有多层级的时间抽象（如概念感知和策略规划），但已有的对话强化学习方法仅停留在token级别或utterance级别，缺乏层次化的策略建模，难以有效桥接低级词汇生成与高级对话策略之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出两层级层次RL框架ToSCA：1）构建两层级MDP，令token级响应解码以utterance级动作（显式文本策略）为条件；2）从理论推导和效率考虑出发，高层使用DQN求解批评者，低层使用PPO求解演员-评论家；3）设计双粒度奖励机制，将utterance级满意度评分与token级内在动机及KL惩罚相结合，以缓解奖励稀疏并促进收敛。

Result: 在日常对话和情感支持对话两个任务上的实验表明，所提方法在策略确定和响应质量方面均优于多种基线方法。

Conclusion: 代码已开源（https://github.com/AaronJi/ToSCA），该层次化RL框架有效提升了对话智能体的策略规划与响应生成质量，验证了多层级时间抽象思想在对话强化学习中的有效性。

Abstract: Humans have multiple levels of temporal abstractions on daily interaction and thinking, such as concept perception and strategic planning. Inspired by this nature, we propose a two-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework for conversational agents, bridging the gap between previous token-level or utterance-level RL methods. Developed on a two-level MDP, the token-level response decoding is conditioned on the utterance-level action, the explicit textual strategies. Based on theoretical derivation and efficiency consideration, we use DQN to solve the high-level critic and PPO to solve the low-level actor-critic. To further alleviate the reward sparsity and facilitate the convergence, we also design the dual-granularity reward mechanism, in which the utterance-level satisfaction score is integrated with token-level intrinsic motivation and K-L penalty. Experiments on both daily and emotional support conversations show that our method outperforms versatile baselines in strategy determination and response quality. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/AaronJi/ToSCA.

</details>


### [220] [Machine learning and digital pragmatics: Which word category influences emoji use most?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21975)
*Mohammed Q. Shormani,Yehia A. AlSohbani,Mohammed Q. Shormani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究基于数字语用学（DPA）框架，利用MARBERT模型分析X平台上阿拉伯语口语（CA）帖子中emoji使用与词法/语用类别的关联。基于15,856条含emoji的帖子，研究发现名词在标准化频率上占主导，但动词密度（β=0.821, p=.001）对emoji使用的影响最强，表明混合计算方法（计算、统计与语用学结合）能更好地解释emoji使用与词汇类别的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对emoji使用与词汇/语用类别关联的量化分析不足，特别是在方言阿拉伯语（CA）场景下缺乏结合深度学习模型与统计方法的研究，亟需在数字语用学框架下系统性考察emoji使用与词法类别的关系。

Method: 从X平台使用Python采集15,856条含emoji的CA帖子，进行词元化和标准化处理，划分为4个词汇类别（名词、动词、形容词、副词）和2个语用/结构类别（疑问、感叹）。采用MARBERT模型微调优化，评估哪种类别的标准指标得分更高，并通过二元逻辑回归检验emoji出现与各类别的统计关联。

Result: 名词在标准化频率上占主导（M=0.675, SD=0.161），其次是动词（M=0.083, SD=0.100）；但动词密度对emoji使用的影响最强（β=0.821, p=.001, 95% CI [0.332, 1.309]），说明频率优势与统计影响权重并不一致。

Conclusion: 在X平台上CA数字语用学中，emoji使用与词法/语用类别的关联需通过计算方法、统计方法与语用学方法的混合路径来解释，体现机器学习、语言特征、语境表征与语用交际之间的交互作用。

Abstract: This study examines the performance of the state-of-the-art MARBERT model in identifying the lexical/pragmatic category associated with emoji use on X within a digital pragmatics approach (DPA). A net corpus of 15856 Colloquial Arabic (CA) posts containing emojis was collected from X using Python. The texts were tokenized and normalized into 4 lexical categories, namely noun_norm, verb_norm, adj_norm, and adverb_norm, and 2 pragmatic/structural categories, question_norm and exclamation_norm. MARBERT was finetuned and optimized to identify which category scores standard metrics more, hence associated with emoji use, while binary logistic regression was used to examine which category is statistically associated with emoji occurrence. Findings unveil that nouns dominate the corpus in normalized frequency (M = 0.675, SD = 0.161), followed by verbs (M = 0.083, SD = 0.100). However, verbs have the strongest influence of emoji use indicated by verb density (\b{eta} = 0.821, p = .001, 95% CI [0.332, 1.309]). The study concludes that in digital pragmatics of CA on X, emoji use association with lexical/pragmatic category can be explained by a hybrid approach of computational, statistical, and pragmatic methods, reflecting the interaction among machine learning, linguistic/lexical features, contextual representation, and pragmatic communication.

</details>


### [221] [Align, Unify, Suppress, Route: A Coherentist View of Transformer Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22034)
*Nura Aljaafari,Andre Freitas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Coherentist Probabilistic Compositionalism (CPC)框架，用相干主义解释理论为Transformer计算提供统一词汇，通过对齐、统一、抑制、路由四种算子角色描述其功能组合。在15个模型上的实验表明这些算子的权重空间签名与激活级角色测量相关，且CPC可作为跨任务比较Transformer机制的共享语言。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械可解释性已识别出Transformer电路，但缺乏一个共享词汇来描述这些功能如何跨任务和架构进行组合。需要一个统一框架来比较不同模型和架构中的机制。

Method: 引入相干主义概率组合主义(CPC)框架：四个算子角色——对齐(识别候选关系)、统一(整合支持信息)、抑制(减少不兼容替代)、路由(将选定信息传至输出)。在15个模型、5种架构家族上进行权重空间签名与激活级角色测量的相关性验证，并进行消融和层间相干性代理分析。

Result: 抑制、统一、路由的权重签名与激活级角色测量相关超过随机基线；抑制跨任务比统一更稳定；对齐头消融在10个模型中降低下行抑制活动但同样影响无冲突提示；显式矛盾在14个模型中显著改变层间相干性代理，去除共享残差协方差后方向与预测一致；基座与指令微调变体保持归纳头分数结构(r≥0.98)。

Conclusion: CPC可作为比较Transformer机制的共享词汇，但模型的深度和几何表达仍具有架构特异性，不能期望算子签名在所有模型中呈现一致的模式。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has identified transformer circuits, but lacks a shared vocabulary for describing how their functions compose across tasks and architectures. We introduce Coherentist Probabilistic Compositionalism (CPC), an interpretive framework that grounds transformer computation in coherentist theories of interpretation and describes it through four operator roles. Alignment identifies candidate relations, unification integrates supporting information, suppression reduces incompatible alternatives, and routing carries selected information to the output. Across 15 models from five architecture families, the suppression, unification, and routing weight-space signatures correlate with held-out activation-level role measures above random baselines. Suppression is more stable across tasks than unification. Ablating alignment heads reduces downstream suppressive activity beyond a random-head control in 10 models, but similar effects on no-conflict prompts indicate a general upstream dependency, not contradiction-specific coupling. Explicit contradictions significantly shift a layerwise coherence proxy in 14 models; after removing shared residual covariance, the gap has the predicted direction in every model. Base and instruction-tuned variants preserve induction-head score structure ($r{\geq}0.98$) without a consistent shift of operator signatures towards later layers. These results support CPC as a shared vocabulary for comparing transformer mechanisms while showing that their depth and geometric expression remain architecture-specific.

</details>


### [222] [Real-TurnTurk: A Multimodal Turkish Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22071)
*Ahmet Tuğrul Bayrak,Fatma Nur Korkmaz,Bekir Berker Türker,Mustafa Sertaç Türkel,Alper Kaplan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个多模态土耳其语对话数据集，包含无脚本双人交互的前向视频、分声道音频和时序对齐转写，并采用遗传算法优化由视觉、声学和语言特征导出的可解释决策规则，将话轮转换预测建模为二分类问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 话轮转换是人际对话的基本组织特征，但在自然的同步对话系统中仍难以建模。现有研究虽探索了多模态方法和大型语言模型进行话轮结束预测，但缺乏针对土耳其语话轮转换动态的自然对话语料库。

Method: 构建了包含同步前向视频、可分说话人的音频通道（可归因重叠语音）和时间对齐转写的多模态土耳其语对话数据集。将话轮转换预测形式化为二分类问题，采用遗传算法（GA）优化从视觉、声学及语言特征中导出的可解释决策规则，并使用混合AND-OR规则表示来建模话轮转换前的多种线索组合。

Result: 论文提出了一个新型的土耳其语多模态对话数据集及基于遗传算法优化的混合AND-OR规则话轮转换预测框架，但摘要中未给出具体的实验性能数字。

Conclusion: 该研究填补了土耳其语话轮转换自然语料库的空白，提出的GA优化+混合AND-OR规则方法兼顾了预测性能与可解释性，为多语言对话系统中的话轮转换建模提供了新思路。

Abstract: Turn-taking is a basic organizational feature of human conversation and remains difficult to model in natural, synchronous dialog systems. While existing research has explored multimodal approaches and large language models for turn-ending prediction, there is a lack of naturalistic conversational corpora specifically addressing turn-taking dynamics in Turkish. This study introduces a multimodal Turkish conversational dataset of unscripted dyadic interactions, comprising synchronized front-facing video, per-speaker audio channels that allow overlapping speech to be attributed to individual speakers, and time-aligned transcriptions. Turn-taking prediction is formulated as a binary classification problem, and a Genetic Algorithm (GA) is employed to optimize interpretable decision rules derived from visual, acoustic, and linguistic features. A hybrid AND-OR rule representation is adopted in the proposed framework to represent the alternative cue combinations that precede a turn transition.

</details>


### [223] [Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22077)
*Mian Zhang,Manasi Sharma,Sheng Zhang,Minglai Yang,Kejian Shi,Ying Liu,Zhiyu Zoey Chen,Daniel Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Spine-Branch Coordination框架，通过将多代理计算机使用任务分解为"主干-分支"图结构，避免虚拟机状态合并这一物理瓶颈，在200个长时任务上将成功率提升6.0%-16.5%的同时将任务成本降低34%-70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多代理计算机使用系统（CUA）将任务分解为多个子任务并在多个并行虚拟机（VM）上执行，但VM状态无法合并这一物理瓶颈是关键限制。现有系统对此处理是临时性的（ad-hoc），未将其作为一等公民（first-class concern）对待，限制了系统的高效扩展。

Method: 提出Spine-Branch Coordination框架：将任务分解为"主干-分支"图，主干承载主任务流并保持连续的VM状态；分支任务在并行VM上执行以收集主干所需的信息，分支VM在任务完成后即被丢弃，从而从根本上避免VM合并操作。

Result: 在来自Odysseys数据集的200个长时任务上，覆盖三种CUA骨干模型，Spine-Branch相比基线系统将成功率提升6.0%至16.5%，同时将每任务成本降低34%至70%。

Conclusion: 显式建模VM状态合并约束能够使多代理计算机使用系统高效扩展，Spine-Branch框架验证了通过图结构设计绕开VM合并瓶颈的有效性。

Abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems that decompose a task into multiple subtasks executed across parallel virtual machines (VMs). However, a critical physical bottleneck is that the state of two VMs cannot be merged. Previous systems handle this ad-hoc rather than treating it as a first-class concern. We propose Spine-Branch Coordination for multi-agent computer use, a framework that decomposes a task into a "spine-branch" graph, where the spine carries the main task flow with continuous VM state and branch tasks execute in parallel to collect information the spine needs to complete the task. Branch VMs are discarded once their tasks finish, so no VM merging ever occurs. Experiments show that on 200 long-horizon tasks from Odysseys and across three CUA backbones, Spine-Branch improves success rate over the baseline system by 6.0% to 16.5%, while reducing per-task cost by 34% to 70%, indicating that explicitly modeling VM-state merging constraint enables multi-agent computer use to scale efficiently.

</details>


### [224] [Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22090)
*Yujiao Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出语义推理去噪（SRD），一种基于可执行错误算子的马尔可夫去噪方法，用于自然语言推理轨迹的迭代优化。SRD将语义噪声表示为描述错误类型、位置及损坏/修复命题的可执行算子，通过组合算子构建渐增噪声状态；训练时学习识别当前轨迹中的语义噪声并重构相邻低噪声状态，推理时根据噪声水平反复预测逆算子并检查其可应用性，逐步向稳定轨迹移动。在六个领域内基准上平均提升最强同骨干基线3.2分，在七个跨数据集迁移目标上平均提升最强Qwen3-8B基线2.9分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型生成的推理轨迹中，局部语义错误会传播导致错误结论；而无需约束的自我纠错可能保留、放大或引入新错误。现有扩散语言模型虽提供迭代精炼，但通常将噪声定义为token掩码或替换，而非推理过程中的语义错误。因此需要一种能显式建模推理语义错误并支持迭代去噪的方法。

Method: SRD将语义噪声表示为可执行的错误算子，每个算子描述错误类型、位置以及被损坏和修复的命题。通过算子组合构造渐进加噪状态，模型训练时学习识别当前轨迹中的语义噪声并重构相邻低噪声状态；推理时基于噪声水平的感知进行反复逆向算子预测，并验证算子可应用性后才执行更新，实现局部向稳定轨迹的移动。

Result: 在数学、代码、知识和常识六个领域内基准上，SRD平均提升最强同骨干基线3.2分；在七个跨数据集迁移目标上与Llama-3-8B-Instruct竞争力相当，并平均提升最强Qwen3-8B基线2.9分。消融分析表明结构化语义噪声预测和迭代算子执行是性能提升的核心。

Conclusion: 结构化语义噪声预测与迭代算子的可验证执行是推理去噪方法成功的关键，SRD提供了一种比token级噪声建模更准确的推理轨迹精炼范式。

Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent reasoning traces whose local semantic errors propagate to an incorrect conclusion, while unconstrained self-correction may preserve, amplify, or introduce errors. Existing diffusion language models provide iterative refinement, but usually define noise as token masking or replacement rather than as errors in the reasoning process. We present Semantic Reasoning Denoising (SRD), an operatorized Markov denoising method for natural-language reasoning trajectories. SRD represents semantic noise with executable error operators that describe the error type, its location, and the corrupted and repaired propositions. Composing these operators constructs progressively noisier states. During training, the model learns to identify the semantic noise active in the current trajectory and to reconstruct the paired adjacent lower-noise state. During inference, noise-level-aware denoising repeatedly predicts an inverse operator and checks whether it is applicable, so each executed update makes a localized move toward a stable trajectory. Across six in-domain benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, knowledge, and commonsense, SRD improves the strongest same backbone baseline by 3.2 points on average. On seven cross-dataset transfer targets, it remains competitive with Llama-3-8B-Instruct and improves the strongest Qwen3-8B baseline average by 2.9 points. Analyses of noise sources, objectives, and denoising depth further show that structured semantic-noise prediction and iterative operator execution are central to the improvement.

</details>


### [225] [RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22118)
*Gregory Druck,Ethan Smith*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次提出并系统研究了"RAG collapse"（检索增强生成塌缩）现象：当基于LLM的AI系统通过搜索工具检索引用自身生成的内容时，会产生与模型塌缩类似的退化——回复多样性下降，最终偏离原始数据分布。在跨3个模型家族、1528次模拟和超过一百万次API调用的大规模实验中，79.6%的模拟以塌缩告终，且即使仅有一个自撰参考文献也可能因LLM的自引用偏差触发塌缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的响应基于互联网内容（通过训练或RAG），而AI现已生成大量在线内容，形成自我强化的反馈回路。已有研究表明LLM在自身输出上递归训练会导致模型塌缩，但尚无工作研究基于检索的AI系统在使用自身生成的参考文献时是否发生类似退化。作者聚焦于问答系统和搜索引擎在推荐和检索过程中引入自建内容这一实际场景，揭示其潜在的系统性风险。

Method: 作者设计了三种类型的模拟实验，模拟AI系统检索其自身生成的参考文献。实验覆盖3个模型家族、1019个信息寻求提示词，总计进行1528次模拟和超过一百万次LLM API调用。实验验证了塌缩是否发生，并进一步通过控制参考文献质量的对照实验，检验LLM对自撰内容的引用偏差是否独立于内容质量而存在。

Result: 1528次模拟中，79.6%（1216次）以塌缩告终。更惊人的是，即使系统中仅有一个自撰参考文献也可能触发塌缩，原因是LLM会不成比例地引用自身生成的内容。这种自引用偏差在控制参考文献质量后依然存在，表明偏差并非源于内容质量优势，而是模型内在的自偏袒倾向。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了RAG collapse这一新现象：基于检索的AI系统在引用自身生成内容时会经历类似模型塌缩的退化。LLM的自引用偏差是其关键驱动因素，且足以在极低的自建内容占比下触发塌缩。这对当前依赖网络索引和RAG的AI生态系统的长期稳定性构成了严重警示。

Abstract: LLM responses are based on the internet (via training or RAG), and AI is now used to generate a significant amount of content online (Paredes et al., 2026), creating the potential for a self-reinforcing feedback loop. Prior work has shown that when LLMs are recursively trained on their own output, they experience model collapse (Shumailov et al., 2024): responses become less diverse, and eventually no longer resemble the original training data. In this paper, we show that a similar collapse occurs if LLM-based AI systems retrieve references they authored using a search tool. We call this RAG collapse. We conduct extensive experiments with three types of simulations of AI systems retrieving references they generated, using three model families, and 1,019 information-seeking prompts, totaling 1,528 simulations and over one million LLM API calls, and find that 79.6% (1,216/1,528) of simulations end in collapse. Surprisingly, even a single self-authored reference can trigger collapse because the LLM disproportionately cites its own content. This self-bias persists even after controlling for reference quality.

</details>


### [226] [LLM assisted writing deserves empirical evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22124)
*Xuan Zhong Feng,Yi Lin,Yiye Zhang,Chunhua Weng,Yifan Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过对69,209篇健康信息学论文的分析，发现LLM辅助写作与更聚焦的表述、更广泛的引文实践以及更多元化的全球作者分布相关，主张应以学术质量和问责性而非工具使用来评估稿件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM辅助写作通常被视为一个检测问题，因为它引发了关于清晰度、完整性、公平性和评估的担忧。作者希望通过实证分析来重新审视这一框架。

Method: 对69,209篇健康信息学论文进行了大规模实证分析，比较了LLM辅助写作与未使用LLM的论文在表述聚焦度、引文实践和作者地理分布方面的差异。

Result: LLM辅助写作与更集中的表述、更广泛的引文实践以及更全球化的作者分布相关联，但这些模式并不证明产生了更好的科学成果。

Conclusion: 应基于学术质量和问责性来评估稿件，而非依据是否使用了工具（LLM）作为评判标准。

Abstract: LLM-assisted writing is often treated as a detection problem, as it raises questions about clarity, integrity, equity, and evaluation. An analysis of 69,209 Health Informatics papers links it to more focused presentation, broader citation practices, and more globally distributed authorship. These patterns do not prove better science, but they support evaluating manuscripts by scholarly quality and accountability rather than by tool use.

</details>


### [227] [Lexical Perturbations Disrupt LLM Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Attention Diversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22140)
*Jiaqian Zhu,Yang Zhang,Junhua Ding,Xiaowei Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现字符级词汇扰动（键盘噪声、字符交换）会显著降低LLM推理准确率，而填充插入影响很小。作者将该不对称现象归因于"注意力转移"效应：词汇碎片化破坏子词分词，碎片在中间和最终Transformer层吸引不成比例的注意力。通过长度匹配对照实验证明是碎片化而非提示长度导致性能损失，并通过因子干预实验揭示内容腐化和注意力分配损坏是耦合的，只有同时恢复两者才能实质性恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理性能强大，但对现实词汇损坏（如键盘噪声、字符交换等）的鲁棒性仍不清楚，且现有推理时策略（如思维链、拼写检查、自我修复）在恢复性能上往往失败，缺乏对其内部机制的系统性理解。

Method: 在四个推理基准上评估四种开源指令微调模型及前沿模型，施加键盘噪声、字符交换和填充插入三种扰动；通过注意力权重分析追踪损坏来源；使用长度匹配对照实验排除提示长度因素；采用因子干预实验分别恢复注意力分配和token内容以检验二者的耦合关系。

Result: 字符级扰动显著降低多步骤推理任务的准确率；填充插入影响极小；词汇碎片化在中间和最终Transformer层吸引不成比例的注意力权重；长度匹配对照确认碎片化而非长度是主因；因子干预显示仅恢复注意力而内容仍损坏反而有害，仅恢复内容不足，只有同时恢复两者才能大幅挽回性能损失。

Conclusion: 词汇碎片化同时损坏token内容和注意力分配，且二者耦合，这解释了为何单一通道的推理时修复策略（思维链、拼写检查、自我修复、更强修复模型）均无法一致恢复性能；需要同时处理内容与注意力两个通道才能有效缓解。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, but their robustness to realistic lexical corruption remains poorly understood. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Diversion: lexical corruption fragments subword tokenization, and the resulting fragments attract disproportionate attention mass, concentrated in middle and final transformer layers. Length-matched controls confirm that fragmentation, not prompt length, drives the loss. A factorial intervention then shows why the damage is hard to undo: fragmentation corrupts token content and attention allocation together, and the two are coupled. Restoring clean attention while the content remains corrupted is actively harmful, restoring content alone is insufficient, and only restoring both recovers a substantial share of the gap. This coupling explains why inference-time strategies, including chain-of-thought prompting, spell-checking, self-repair, and stronger repair models, fail to consistently recover performance: each addresses one channel at a time. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Jiaqian-Janelle/Attention-Diversion

</details>


### [228] [The Collaboration Tax: How Much LLM Multi-Agent Systems Pay to Coordinate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22152)
*Weixiang Sun,Zehong Wang,Hong Huang,Colby Nelson,Yanfang Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地定义并量化了多智能体LLM系统中的"协作税"（collaboration tax），即两个LLM需要协作而非单独行动时损失的性能。研究在32个任务、11个模型上验证了这种税的存在性、结构和可干预性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统已被广泛部署，但两个LLM需要协调合作时相较于各自单独行动会损失多少性能仍不清楚。作者希望将这一模糊的"协作损失"形式化，使其可度量、可预测、部分可干预。

Method: 将协作税形式化为两人合作博弈（含私有信息）的团队去中心化损失，提出两个命题刻画其符号及其与最大超可加性违背（max-superadditivity violation）的等价性。在32个可单独解决的任务（按接地摩擦来源分组）上，对来自7个提供商的11个模型进行测量，并分析对话过程、预测机制及提示干预效果。

Result: 协作税沿两个无例外轴结构化：跨所有模型的类别排序一致，且随能力单调下降。其近端机制并非推理缺陷，而是四阶段对话级联：代理做出无根据的断言、未查询伙伴、跳过整合双方观点、未重新推导就接受答案。该税可由对话特征机械预测，且部分可处治——针对四个阶段的提示干预能弥合相当大比例的差距，但主导瓶颈因类别而异。在异构配对中，税被拉向较强伙伴而非加性中点，实证实现了框架预测的最大超可加性违背。

Conclusion: 协作税重塑了LLM系统协作的认知：它不是模糊的直觉损失，而是可度量、可预测、部分可干预的成本。这为设计多智能体系统提供了明确的优化方向和干预策略。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems built from large language models are deployed widely, yet how much performance is lost when two LLMs must coordinate rather than act alone remains unclear. We formulate the collaboration tax as the team-decentralisation loss of a two-player cooperative game with private information, with two propositions characterising its sign and its equivalence to a max-superadditivity violation. We operationalise this definition on 32 solo-tractable tasks grouped by source of grounding friction and measure it on 11 models from 7 providers. The tax is structured along two no-exception axes: a category ordering across every model and a monotonic decrease with capability. The proximate mechanism is not a reasoning deficit but a four-stage conversational cascade in which agents make ungrounded claims, fail to query the partner, skip integrating both views, and accept the answer without re-derivation. The tax is mechanically predictable from conversation features and partly tractable: a prompt intervention targeting all four stages closes a substantial fraction of the gap, with the dominant bottleneck differing across categories. In heterogeneous pairs the tax is pulled toward the stronger partner rather than the additive midpoint, empirically realising the max-superadditivity violation predicted by our framework. Together these results recast collaboration in LLM systems as a measurable, predictable, and partly tractable cost.

</details>


### [229] [How Agents Represent Humans: Human-Directed Stereotypes in an Open Agent Social Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22192)
*Huangchen Xu,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究在开放智能体社交平台Moltbook上分析LLM智能体如何将人类作为社会类别进行刻板印象构建。研究发现：人类定向评价以能力（competence）维度为主，次要属性多将人类描述为认知、文化或具身主体；人类表征在叙事与平台流通中呈现特定模式；智能体内部社区反馈由曝光度、作者可见性和内容选择驱动，而非传统的人类在线社区中稳定存在的内—外群体排斥模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体正越来越多地被部署在持久性社交环境中，其生成的陈述可被发布、回复、记忆和复用，因此有必要研究智能体如何在社会互动中建构对人类这一社会类别的刻板印象，而非仅关注孤立模型输出中的偏见。

Method: 在Moltbook开放智能体原生社交平台上，引入包含四个评价维度（道德、友善、能力、自主性）的注释框架，并附加第二阶段的描述性"他者"属性子类型方案，对人类定向的刻板印象进行分析。同时通过行为上的宿主亲和力（behavioral host affinity）分析智能体内部社区反馈作为辅助对比。

Result: 能力维度主导了人类定向评价；许多"他者"属性将人类描述为认知、文化或具身主体；人类表征在人类—智能体叙事语境和平台级流通中出现特定模式；Moltbook上的反馈模式由曝光度、作者可见性和内容选择更好地解释，而非人类在线社区常见的稳定内—外群体排斥模式。

Conclusion: 智能体社会中的偏见不应仅作为孤立的模型输出进行研究，而应作为一个话语过程（discourse process）来理解，即偏见在社交互动、内容流通和社区反馈的动态过程中形成和传播。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in persistent social environments, where generated claims can be posted, replied to, remembered, and reused. We study human-directed stereotypes on Moltbook, an open agent-native social platform, asking how agents construct humans as a social category. For this human-target analysis, we introduce an annotation framework with four evaluative dimensions---morality, friendliness, competence, and autonomy---and a second-stage subtype scheme for descriptive \textit{other} attributions. We find that competence dominates human-directed evaluations, while many \textit{other} attributions describe humans as epistemic, cultural, or embodied subjects. We further examine how these human representations appear in human--agent narrative contexts and platform-level circulation. As an auxiliary comparison, we analyze agent-internal community feedback through behavioral host affinity. Rather than reproducing the stable insider--outsider rejection often observed in human online communities, Moltbook feedback patterns are better explained by exposure, author visibility, and content selection. These findings suggest that bias in agent societies should be studied not only as isolated model output, but also as a discourse process.

</details>


### [230] [Dual-Layer Agentic Memory with Fast Write Routing and Slow Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22215)
*Wenzhi Li,Dong Nie,Rui Lan,Tongtong Lyu,Peiyao Wang,Lingzi Hong,Weihang Pan,Boyuan Pan,Yao Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于互补学习系统（CLS）理论的双层智能体记忆框架，将记忆管理重心从检索阶段转移到写入阶段，通过成本感知的知识路由和周期性参数整合实现选择性外部化与选择性内化，在剪枝68%冗余外部记忆的同时保留98%以上的下游问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体的外部记忆系统将记忆视为单调增长的存储库，随着知识持续累积会导致检索退化并增加计算成本。作者认为核心挑战不仅仅是检索，而是管理知识的完整生命周期——决定哪些知识需要外部化、更新或最终内化到模型参数中。

Method: 受神经科学中互补学习系统（CLS）理论启发，提出Dual-Layer Agentic Memory框架。该方法：(1) 将传入信息分为不写入、写新、写更新三类，通过小模型到大模型的级联路由进行成本感知的知识过滤；(2) 采用写回阶段，通过有监督微调将高价值外部记忆选择性地整合到模型参数中。系统包括1.7B/8B级联路由，最小化路由开销的同时过滤冗余记忆。

Result: 实验表明：1.7B/8B级联路由可剪枝68%的冗余外部记忆，仅升级不到50%的输入，同时保留穷举保留基线98%以上的下游QA精确匹配（EM）分数。周期性整合能成功将外部知识内化，使路由器自适应抑制冗余写入。

Conclusion: 提出了一种统一的智能体记忆范式：选择性外部化与选择性内化相结合，将记忆管理任务从被动检索转移到主动写入阶段，为动态环境下LLM智能体的高效记忆管理提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents operate in dynamic environments where knowledge continuously evolves. Existing memory systems typically treat external memory as a monotonically growing repository, inevitably leading to retrieval degradation and increasing computational costs over time. We argue that the core challenge is not retrieval alone, but managing the knowledge lifecycle: deciding what to externalize, update, or ultimately internalize. Inspired by Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory in neuroscience, we propose Dual-Layer Agentic Memory, a framework that shifts memory management to the write phase through cost-aware epistemic routing and periodic parametric consolidation. Incoming information is categorized as non-write, write-new, or write-update, and routed through a small-to-large model cascade that minimizes routing overhead while filtering redundant memories. A subsequent write-back phase selectively consolidates high-value external memories into model parameters via supervised fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate the dual efficiency of our approach: a 1.7B/8B cascade prunes up to 68% of redundant external memory while escalating fewer than 50% of inputs, yet retains over 98% of the downstream QA Exact Match (EM) achieved by an exhaustive retention baseline. We further show that periodic consolidation successfully internalizes external knowledge, allowing the router to adaptively suppress redundant writes as the model's epistemic boundaries evolve. Overall, our framework presents a unified paradigm for agent memory: selective externalization followed by selective internalization. Code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [231] [Grounded Normative Rule Generation with Structured Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22229)
*Fanqi Kong,Huaxiao Yin,Ruijie Zhang,Xiaoyuan Zhang,Yizhe Huang,Jian Gao,Shuo Chen,Song-Chun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Grounded Normative Rule Synthesis (GNRS)问题形式化，并开发了GNRS-Search框架，利用MCMC采样优化离散五槽And-Or Graph，将可执行性与表面生成解耦，在GNRS-Bench和RealCharter-Bench基准上将平均规则质量从68.8%提升至81.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言生成和结构化输出基准主要评估表面流畅性或模式合规性，缺乏对操作可执行性的测试，导致标准语言模型生成的规则看似合理却在执行时因依赖不可用数据日志或作用域错配而失败，这是一个严重的安全漏洞。

Method: 形式化GNRS问题，提出GNRS-Search框架，采用MCMC采样优化离散的五槽And-Or Graph（AOG），显式将中间操作结构与最终散文生成解耦，从而在表面实现之前隔离可执行性和定位规则失败。

Result: 在包含116个受控目标、8个场景族的GNRS-Bench以及53个真实政策任务的RealCharter-Bench上评估，平均rubric质量从68.8%提升到81.0%，在可执行复合指标下排名第一；系统性槽位干预实验确认性能提升源于稳健的操作逻辑而非修辞调优。

Conclusion: 通过将自动规则起草转化为可检查的搜索问题，本文为在受监管环境中部署可验证、合规就绪的个人代理提供了基础性范式。

Abstract: Normative rules like institutional charters and workplace policies must be both human-readable and operationally verifiable against actual environment records. However, current language generation and structured-output benchmarks primarily reward surface fluency or schema compliance, leaving operational grounding weakly tested. This creates a critical vulnerability where standard language models generate plausible-sounding policies that fail during enforcement because they rely on unavailable data logs or misaligned scopes. To address this challenge, we formalize the problem as Grounded Normative Rule Synthesis (GNRS) and introduce GNRS-Search, a framework that utilizes Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to optimize a discrete, five-slot And-Or Graph (AOG). By explicitly decoupling intermediate operational structure from final prose generation, this method isolates executable feasibility from writing style and allows rule failures to be localized prior to surface realization. We evaluate our approach on GNRS-Bench, a benchmark spanning 116 controlled goals across eight scene families, and RealCharter-Bench, which evaluates transfer to 53 real-derived policy tasks with hidden source clauses. GNRS-Search raises average rubric quality from 68.8% to 81.0% and ranks first under a disclosed executable composite metric, while systematic slot interventions confirm that performance gains stem from robust operational logic rather than rhetorical tuning. Ultimately, by transforming automated rule drafting into an inspectable search problem, this work provides a foundational paradigm for deploying verifiable and compliance-ready personal agents within regulated environments.

</details>


### [232] [Whitewashing Hate, Smearing Harmless Content: Annotator-Style Rebuttal Attacks on LLM-Based Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22230)
*Junyu Lu,Kaiyuan Liu,Jingyi Kang,Deyi Ji,Hailong Zhang,Lanyun Zhu,Qi Zhu,Bo Xu,Liang Yang,Hongfei Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了在大语言模型（LLM）用于仇恨言论审核的人机协作流程中，标注者风格的反馈（反驳）如何操纵模型原本正确的判断，使其将仇恨内容洗白为正常或将正常内容污蔑为仇恨。通过引入一种"重新审判"协议（包括直接矛盾/决策边界扰动/对抗性理由），实验发现这类反驳显著降低审核性能，且白洗与污蔑两种方向存在模型特定的不对称脆弱性，防御性提示只能缓解而无法消除该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在仇恨言论审核中常嵌入人机协作流程，审核者会在最终决策前提供反馈。这种反馈机制引入了双向操纵风险：一方面可将仇恨内容洗白为正常，另一方面可将正常内容污蔑为仇恨。现有研究缺乏对这一攻击面上不同操纵方向有效性的系统性对比，尤其缺乏针对"最初正确判断"被推翻场景的考察。作者旨在揭示模型在标注者风格反驳下对最初正确判断的脆弱性，以及这种脆弱性是否在不同操纵方向上存在系统性差异。

Method: 作者提出了一个"重新审判（rejudge）"协议，该协议在直接矛盾的基础上进一步扩展了两类攻击策略：决策边界扰动（decision-boundary perturbations）和对抗性理由（adversarial rationales）。实验在多个LLM和两个仇恨言论数据集上进行，对比了白洗（将仇恨内容判定为正常）和污蔑（将正常内容判定为仇恨）两个方向的攻击效果，并在单轮与多轮对话设置下评估了性能和方向不对称性，同时测试了显式推理提示和防御性指令的缓解效果。

Result: 实验结果表明，标注者风格的反驳能大幅降低LLM的仇恨言论审核性能，且多轮设置下的影响更强。研究揭示了稳定且模型特定的方向不对称性——白洗与污蔑在不同攻击配置下表现出不同的脆弱性模式，表明不同模型对不同操纵方向有独特的易感性。显式推理提示和防御性指令可以在一定程度上缓解攻击效果，但无法完全消除这些脆弱性。

Conclusion: 研究强调，在人机协作的仇恨言论审核工作流中，需要建立方向感知的防护机制（direction-aware safeguards）以及专门的反馈鲁棒性评估框架。仅依赖推理提示或防御性指令不足以应对标注者风格反驳的攻击，必须针对不同操纵方向设计差异化的防御策略。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for hate speech moderation, often within human--AI workflows in which reviewers provide feedback before a final decision. Such feedback introduces two manipulation directions: whitewashing hateful content as normal and smearing normal content as hateful. This study examines the susceptibility of initially correct model judgments to annotator-style rebuttals and analyzes whether attack effectiveness differs across manipulation directions. We introduce a rejudge protocol that extends direct contradiction with decision-boundary perturbations and adversarial rationales. Experiments with multiple LLMs on two hate speech datasets show that annotator-style rebuttals substantially degrade moderation performance, with stronger effects in multi-turn settings. The results further reveal stable, model-specific asymmetries between whitewashing and smearing across attack configurations, indicating distinct directional vulnerability patterns. Explicit reasoning prompts and defensive instructions reduce these effects but do not eliminate them. These findings highlight the need for direction-aware safeguards and dedicated feedback-robustness evaluation in human--AI moderation workflows.

</details>


### [233] [Improving Few-Step Language Flows with Untied Self-Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22244)
*Bocheng Li,Linli Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"Untied Self-Conditioning"采样器，通过修正训练-推理不匹配（self-conditioning输入与solver前一步预测之间的冗余耦合）来提升flow-matching语言模型在少步采样下的生成质量，无需重新训练，每步仅需一次模型评估。在LangFlow上8步采样将生成困惑度从531降至62（8.6倍提升），Arena-Hard-Auto评估中96%偏好胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Flow-matching语言模型可以并行更新所有token位置并通过采样步数与延迟做权衡，但在少采样步数下生成质量严重下降。作者将这一退化追溯到训练与推理之间的不匹配：训练时self-conditioning输入由当前噪声状态直接计算，不含中间求解器步骤；而采样时solver会将前一步预测折入隐变量，再与显式的self-conditioning输入重复出现，造成冗余，且该冗余随步宽增大而加剧。

Method: 作者从模型自身结构中推导出两种修正：(1) 利用冻结的投影权重识别self-conditioning输入中与隐变量冗余的方向并加以衰减；(2) 从求解器积分结构推导出需要"步平均预测"（step-average prediction），用预测历史近似之，其缩放系数由离线轨迹统计设定。该方法无需重新训练，每步仅一次模型评估，称为"Untied Self-Conditioning"。

Result: 在LangFlow上，8采样步下OpenWebText生成困惑度从531降至62（8.6倍改善）；在ELF-B上从71降至43；在8至256步范围内改善均保持。在适应的Arena-Hard-Auto v2协议下，96%成对比较中输出更受偏好。

Conclusion: 训练-推理的self-conditioning不匹配是flow-matching语言模型少步采样性能下降的关键原因之一，通过从模型本身结构出发的两种修正（冗余方向衰减与步平均预测近似），可以在零重训练开销下显著改善少步采样的生成质量，且改善在大范围采样步数内稳健成立。

Abstract: Flow-matching language models refine all token positions in parallel and can trade sampling steps for latency, yet generation quality still degrades sharply with few sampling steps. We trace a source of this degradation to a train--inference mismatch in previous-prediction self-conditioning: during training, the self-conditioning input is computed from the current noisy state with no intervening solver step; during sampling, the solver folds the previous prediction into the latent before that same prediction reappears as the explicit self-conditioning input. This coupling, absent during training, creates redundancy that grows with step width. We show that the mismatch degrades both the self-conditioning input and the solver update, and derive a correction for each from the model's own structure. From the frozen projection weights we identify directions along which the self-conditioning input is redundant with the latent and dampen them; from the solver's integration structure we derive that a step-average prediction is needed and approximate it from prediction history, with scale set by offline trajectory statistics. The resulting sampler, Untied Self-Conditioning, requires no retraining and uses one evaluation per step. At 8 sampling steps on LangFlow, it reduces OpenWebText generative perplexity from $531$ to~$62$ ($8.6\times$); under an adapted Arena-Hard-Auto~v2 protocol, its outputs are preferred in $96\%$ of pairwise comparisons. On ELF-B it reduces generative perplexity from $71$ to~$43$. Improvements hold from 8 to 256 sampling steps.

</details>


### [234] [Nürnberg NLP @ GermEval Shared Task 2026: Harmful Content Detection in German Social Media through Error-Independent LLM Voters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22246)
*Philipp Steigerwald,Eric Rudolph,Jens Albrecht*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文为GermEval 2026共享任务（德语社交媒体有害内容检测）提出一种基于错误独立性的九投票器集成系统。系统在三正交轴（LLM、训练方法、类别范围）上构建每个子任务的合奏，在四个子任务（C2A、DBO、VIO、DEF）上均取得第一名，macro-F1分别为89.56、71.63、54.84和83.02。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 德语社交媒体中的有害内容会造成实际危害（从行动号召到刑事诽谤）。该任务面临严重类别不平衡的技术挑战——有害类别罕见且与占主导性的多数类别共享表层语言，但在macro-F1评估下却决定分数。

Method: 核心洞察是决定性的杠杆不在于更强的单一模型，而在于错误独立性。据此构建每个子任务的九投票器集成，跨越三个正交轴：LLM、训练方法和类别范围。模型选择主要基于内部交叉验证。

Result: 在隐藏测试集上达到macro-F1：C2A为89.56、DBO为71.63、VIO为54.84、DEF为83.02，四个子任务全部排名第一。

Conclusion: 证明了在不平衡且表面语言混淆的场景下，错误独立性驱动的多样化集成比追求单模型更强性能更为有效，该策略在四个子任务上均获得了最优结果。

Abstract: Harmful content in German social media does real-world damage, from calls to action to criminal defamation. The GermEval 2026 shared task scores its detection in four subtasks. The technical challenge is a severe class imbalance. The harmful classes are rare and share surface language with the dominant majority class, yet under macro-F1 they decide the score. The decisive lever is then not a stronger single model but error independence. This insight becomes a per-subtask nine-voter ensemble spanning three orthogonal axes: LLM, training method and class scope. Selected mainly on internal cross-validation, the system reaches macro-F1 of 89.56 (C2A), 71.63 (DBO), 54.84 (VIO) and 83.02 (DEF) on the hidden test set, placing first on all four subtasks.

</details>


### [235] [Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion Machine Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22274)
*Yan Zhan,Mengkai Hou,Wanting Zhang,Zhijun Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Entropy-Valley (EV)，一种无需训练的掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）机器翻译目标长度选择方法。通过全掩码前向传播的均值预测熵来评分候选目标画布，EV在En→Zh、Zh→En和En→De上分别恢复了参考目标长度COMET-22增益的64.9%、65.3%和33.0%，并指出在掩码扩散MT中目标长度的选择比token揭序决策更为关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在机器翻译中必须忠实渲染每个源token，而固定画布解码需要在去噪前决定目标长度。现有研究主要关注token揭序，对长度决策这一直接影响覆盖率和冗余度的关键环节缺乏探索。

Method: 提出Entropy-Valley（EV），一种训练无关的长度选择器：对候选目标画布执行全掩码前向传播，计算各候选长度的平均预测熵，选择骨干模型最有信心填充（即熵最低）的候选画布作为目标长度。

Result: EV在En→Zh、Zh→En和En→De上分别恢复了参考长度COMET-22增益的64.9%、65.3%和33.0%。三位翻译专家评估支持En↔Zh的充分性提升（Zh→En证据更强）。与同数据微调的LLaMA-3-8B自回归模型相比，EV系统在En→Zh上持平、在Zh→En上领先。oracle长度诊断表明长度决策比token揭序更重要。

Conclusion: 长度选择是掩码扩散MT中比token揭序更关键的决策因素；去噪友好的长度未必等于参考长度，EV通过熵信号可有效逼近理想长度，且无需额外训练即可接近或超越同等规模的AR基线。

Abstract: Machine translation tests masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) because every source token must be rendered faithfully, while fixed canvas decoding must choose target length before denoising. Existing masked diffusion decoding work mainly studies token unmasking order, leaving this length decision under-explored despite its direct effect on coverage and redundancy. We introduce Entropy-Valley (EV), a training-free length selector that scores candidate target canvases by mean predictive entropy from all-mask forward passes and selects the canvas the backbone is most prepared to fill. Relative to a baseline using training corpus length statistics, EV recovers 64.9%, 65.3%, and 33.0% of the COMET-22 gain from reference target lengths on En$\to$Zh, Zh$\to$En, and En$\to$De. Our diagnostics show that denoising-friendly lengths need not match reference lengths. Evaluation by three translation experts supports the En$\leftrightarrow$Zh adequacy gains, with stronger evidence on Zh$\to$En. Compared with a LLaMA-3-8B autoregressive (AR) model trained on the same fine-tuning data, the EV system ties on En$\to$Zh and leads on Zh$\to$En; an oracle-length diagnostic further shows that, in this masked diffusion MT setting, deciding which tokens to reveal first matters less than how the target length is supplied.

</details>


### [236] [LLM Evaluation on Unseen Questions: Contextual Multidimensional IRT Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22295)
*Ergan Shang,Weijing Tang,Yinqiu He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种基于多维项目反应理论（IRT）与题目上下文信息相结合的模型评估框架，用于预测大语言模型在未见题目上的表现，并实证分析了其在场景内预测的有效性及跨场景泛化的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模评测LLM时，往往需要在收集大量新标注之前预测模型在新问题或新任务上的表现。传统简单的回顾性平均指标会混淆模型能力与题目特征，难以准确反映模型在未见题目上的真实表现，因此需要更精细的模型化评估框架。

Method: 将多维项目反应理论模型与题目上下文（如题目嵌入）相结合：LLM通过潜在能力画像（latent capability profile）表示，题目内容用于刻画题目特征（item characteristics），从而实现信息向未见题目的迁移。

Result: 在场景内评估中，加入题目嵌入相比无模型基线改善了预测效果；多维潜在结构比单维替代方案更能丰富地描述能力差异。然而，跨场景迁移时预测可靠性不足，即泛化能力并未随之提升。

Conclusion: 上下文感知的心理测量建模是高效且可解释的LLM评估的有前景方向，但跨场景泛化仍是核心开放挑战。

Abstract: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) increasingly requires predicting how a model will perform on new questions or tasks before collecting large amounts of new annotations. This problem is challenging because question difficulty, scenario, and underlying capability demands can vary substantially. Simple retrospective averages may confound model ability with item characteristics. In this paper, we study a model-based evaluation framework that combines multidimensional item response theory model with question contexts to predict LLM performance on unseen questions. The framework represents LLMs through latent capability profiles while using question content to inform item characteristics, allowing information to transfer beyond previously observed items. Empirically, we find that for within-scenario evaluation, incorporating question embeddings improves prediction relative to model-free baselines, and that multidimensional latent structure provides a richer description of capability variation than unidimensional alternatives. At the same time, our results reveal an important limitation that the generalizability does not necessarily translate into reliable prediction under cross-scenario shift. These findings suggest that context-aware psychometric modeling is a promising direction for efficient and interpretable LLM evaluation, while also highlighting cross-scenario generalization as a central open challenge.

</details>


### [237] [Text-Anchored Semantic Perturbations for Transferable Jailbreak Attacks on Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22312)
*Wenyun Li,Guiping Cao,Xiangyuan Lan,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为TA-SPA的黑盒越狱攻击框架，通过在文本锚定的语义空间优化可迁移扰动，攻击多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的安全对齐机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs在视觉-语言交互方面取得了显著进展，但其安全对齐仍易受越狱攻击。关键挑战在于：文本空间中学习到的安全行为不能可靠地迁移到融合的跨模态表征中，多模态输入可能通过潜在语义线索被利用。

Method: TA-SPA包含两个核心组件：（1）文本锚定语义分解（TASF），鼓励跨模态语义因子与模态特有残差的分离；（2）语义保持增强（SPA），在保持语义一致性的同时多样化有害目标锚点。框架在文本锚定的语义空间优化可迁移扰动。

Result: 实验表明该方法具有强攻击有效性，可迁移至商业MLLMs，并在代表性防御下表现出竞争力的性能。额外的对照实验和探针支持预期的因子分解，但未暗示完全解耦。

Conclusion: 研究结果激励在表征层面进行安全对齐，而不仅仅是输入级过滤。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in vision-language interaction, yet their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. A key challenge is that safety behavior learned in the textual space does not reliably transfer to fused cross-modal representations, leaving multimodal inputs exploitable through latent semantic cues. We propose Text-Anchored Semantic Perturbation Attack (TA-SPA), a black-box jailbreak framework that optimizes transferable perturbations in a text-anchored semantic space. TA-SPA integrates Text-Anchored Semantic Factorization (TASF), which encourages the separation of cross-modal semantic factors from modality-specific residuals, with Semantic-Preserving Augmentation (SPA), which diversifies harmful target anchors while preserving semantic consistency. Experiments show strong attack effectiveness and transfer to commercial MLLMs, with competitive performance under representative defenses. Additional controls and probing support the intended factorization without implying perfect disentanglement, motivating representation-level safety alignment beyond input-level filtering.

</details>


### [238] [Semantics or Structure? Auditing Text Sensitivity in Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22321)
*Karthik Sridhar,Atharva Gupta,Nishant Pradhan,Murari Mandal,Dhruv Kumar,Saurabh Deshpande*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对Time-MMD基准上的多模态时序预测模型（包括Aurora、MM-TSFlib、TaTS）进行了受控文本扰动和归因分析，发现这些模型对文本语义内容并不敏感——任意替换/交换文本对MSE影响小于0.5%，文献中报告的性能提升主要来自共附带的数值列而非文本内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态时序预测声称利用自然语言上下文提升预测性能，但以往报告的性能提升是否真正源于文本语义内容从未得到验证。作者质疑这些模型是否真的对文本语义敏感，希望揭示性能提升的真实来源。

Method: 在Time-MMD基准上对三种架构（Aurora、MM-TSFlib、TaTS）进行受控文本扰动实验（包括空文本、常量文本、域内/跨域打乱），结合归因分析和Aurora文本通道的探针实验；同时设计了移除附带数值列而不触碰文本的反事实实验。

Result: 所有文本扰动（空、常量、域内打乱、跨域打乱）对MSE的影响均小于0.5%；移除共附带的数值列后，即使不改变文本，文献中报告的性能提升也能复现，说明文本内容并非性能增益的operative signal。

Conclusion: 在Time-MMD基准和该族冻结编码器架构内，文本内容不是报告的性能提升的真正来源。作者发布了扰动协议和评估工具包，供后续文本集成多模态预测研究复用。

Abstract: Multimodal time-series forecasting has emerged as a promising paradigm in which natural-language context is expected to improve predictive performance. Recent multimodal foundation models, including Aurora, as well as early- and late-fusion approaches such as MM-TSFlib and TaTS, report substantial gains over unimodal baselines on the Time-MMD benchmark, attributing these improvements to textual information. However, whether these models are actually sensitive to the semantic content of the text remains unverified. We address this question through controlled text perturbations, attribution analyses, and probes of Aurora's text pathway. On Time-MMD, swapping each row's text for any other real text (empty, constant, within-domain shuffled, or cross-domain) moves mean MSE by less than $0.5\%$ on all three architectures. The improvement reported in the literature is recovered when a co-shipped numeric column is removed without touching text. We conclude that, on this benchmark and within this family of frozen-encoder architectures, text content is not the operative signal behind the reported gains. To support future work on text integration in multimodal foundation models for structured data, we release our perturbation protocol and evaluation harness as a reusable diagnostic toolkit.

</details>


### [239] [Noise Floor Audit for Agent Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22331)
*Yihang Chen,Pin Qian,Su Wang,Chong Peng,Huan Xu,Xiyang Wu,Yiqi Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文审计了2个提供商、3个原生工具调用端点在官方BFCL多类别和平行类别上的测量变异性。在温度0下，重跑近乎确定性（ever-flip比例0.7%-2.7%，运行相关性0.961-0.997）；而语义保持的提示扰动造成更大的测量底线，其中位数配对标准差比重跑大11-58倍；且失败特征也会漂移（畸形输出占比从<1%到30%不等），表明边际准确率同时掩盖了稳定性和失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具调用基准评测（如BFCL）通常报告单一准确率数值，但忽略了评测过程中的测量变异性——包括端点重跑的随机性和提示扰动的影响。理解这种变异性对可靠地比较模型与追踪进展至关重要。

Method: 在官方BFCL的multiple和parallel类别上，对2个提供商的3个原生工具调用端点进行评测。使用匹配的AST评分方式，分别测量：(1) 温度0下的重跑确定性（ever-flip比例和运行相关性）；(2) 语义保持的提示扰动下的变异性（配对标准差对比）；(3) 失败特征分类（畸形输出与任务失败比例）。

Result: 温度0重跑近乎确定性：ever-flip分数为0.7%、2.0%、2.7%，平均运行相关性为0.997、0.966、0.961。提示扰动带来的变异性远大于重跑：中位数配对SD是重跑的11-58倍。失败模式上，畸形输出占任务失败的比例分别为30%、7%和<1%，差异显著。

Conclusion: 仅报告边际准确率会同时掩盖评测的稳定性（重跑变异性）和失败模式（如畸形输出比例），因此需要更全面的评测报告来可靠地比较工具调用模型。

Abstract: We audit measurement variability for 3 native tool-calling endpoints across 2 providers on the official BFCL multiple and parallel categories, using matched AST grading. At temperature 0, reruns are nearly deterministic across Groq endpoints and a thinking-enabled Gemini setting: ever-flip fractions are 0.7%, 2.0%, and 2.7%, with mean run correlations of 0.997, 0.966, and 0.961. Semantics-preserving prompt perturbations create the larger floor on all endpoints, with median perturbation paired SDs 11x to 58x larger than rerun paired SDs. The failure character also shifts: malformed-output failures account for 30%, 7%, and <1% of task failures, so marginal accuracy hides not only stability but also failure mode.

</details>


### [240] [Mechanistic Interpretability of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Sequential Activation Patching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22332)
*Murat Dura,Serkan Öztürk,Selma Tekir*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出顺序激活修补（Sequential Activation Patching）框架，追踪CoT条件下注意力头激活在token位置上的因果效应，并通过部分词性引导分析和顺序多头修补来识别对最终答案计算有贡献的分布式推理支持子回路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
