Motivation: 虽然CoT提示能显著提升LLM的问题解决能力，但其内部机制仍不清楚。由于CoT推理跨越多个生成的token，标准的单静态token位置激活修补方法不足以刻画这种时间分布效应，因此需要一种能够追踪跨token位置因果效应的方法。

Method: 1) 提出顺序激活修补框架，追踪CoT条件下注意力头激活在token位置间的因果效应；2) 使用词性（Part-of-Speech）引导分析聚合效应；3) 提出顺序多头修补评估分布式头集合的联合贡献；4) 引入跨问题和随机激活对照作为基线。

Result: 定向零消融实验表明，识别出的注意力头对成功生成答案在功能上至关重要，并影响多个重叠机制，包括推理轨迹维护、答案锚定、示例-目标分离和数值生成。

Conclusion: 研究结果为CoT条件下与分布式推理支持子回路相关的计算提供了证据，表明CoT推理能力是由多个注意力头协同支持的分布式机制。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable problem-solving capabilities when guided by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, yet the internal mechanisms underlying these improvements remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate where CoT-related causal effects emerge across the generated reasoning trajectory and which attention heads carry signals that contribute to final-answer computation. Because CoT reasoning unfolds over multiple generated tokens, standard activation patching at a single static token position is insufficient to characterize these temporally distributed effects. To address this limitation, we introduce a sequential activation patching framework that traces CoT-conditioned attention-head activations across token positions and aggregates their effects using Part-of-Speech-guided analysis. We further introduce Sequential Multi-Head Patching to evaluate the joint contribution of distributed head sets, together with cross-question and random activation controls. Targeted zero-ablation experiments show that the identified heads are functionally important for successful answer generation and affect several overlapping mechanisms, including reasoning-trajectory maintenance, answer anchoring, exemplar-target separation, and numerical generation. Overall, our results provide evidence for distributed reasoning-support sub-circuits associated with CoT-conditioned computation.

</details>


### [241] [Register Shifts Break LLM Safety: A Bengali Benchmark with Culturally Grounded Harms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22335)
*Naymul Islam,Nusrat Jahan Lia,Shubhashis Roy Dipta,Sabik Bin Sultan,Abdullah Khan Zehady*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Bengali is the seventh-most-spoken language globally, yet LLM safety evaluation remains overwhelmingly English-centric. We introduce BanglaSafe, a benchmark of 879 Bengali prompts combining 309 natively authored prompts with 570 expert-reviewed prompts, spanning 17 culturally grounded harm categories and five prompting conditions that vary language, writing style, and authority framing. Evaluating 18 frontier LLMs, we find that over half of all responses are unsafe or partially unsafe (53.6%) while 14.7% contains strictly harmful content, and that the strongest observed effect is not the switch from English to Bengali but the choice of writing style within Bengali: the same harmful request phrased as a formal newspaper investigation succeeds 17 percentage points more often than the same request phrased as a casual message, with no adversarial engineering involved. We further show that existing safety classifiers struggle to reliably evaluate Bengali content, with even frontier models failing on nearly half of all cases.

</details>


### [242] [When Not to Imitate: Boundary-Aware Skill Memory for Reliable Tool-Use LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22339)
*Zihan Lin,Zhenyu Chen,Jiawen Wei,Xiaohan Wang,Jie Cao,Jiajun Chai,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Ran He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出边界感知技能记忆（BASM），为成功轨迹中提取的技能添加边界字段（适用条件、风险提示、规避规则和恢复说明），解决LLM智能体从成功经验中提取技能时陷入的"技能模仿陷阱"——即盲目检索更多技能反而增加错误工具调用的置信度问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体自我进化范式假设基于成功轨迹提取的技能记忆能单调提升问题解决能力，但探针分析发现这一假设不成立：从成功轨迹中提取技能会使模型陷入"技能模仿陷阱"，对于需要不同工具但外观类似的任务，检索更多技能反而将错误工具调用的边际提高47%。

Method: BASM为每个技能补充显式边界字段，包括适用条件（何时该应用技能）、风险提示（何时不该应用）、规避规则（如何避免错误工具）和恢复说明（执行失败时的针对性修复）。这使检索到的技能从无条件的动作模板转化为状态条件化的指导。

Result: 在三个智能体基准和四个模型规模上，BASM一致优于基于成功蒸馏的技能记忆基线：AppWorld上任务成功率最高提升23.8%，BFCL上准确率最高提升5.0%，AgentDojo上攻击成功率降低4.6%，同时相比无记忆基线平均减少AppWorld步骤最多6.6%。

Conclusion: 单纯从成功轨迹中提取技能不足以保证LLM智能体的有效进化；通过为技能增加边界感知字段，使其在条件满足时应用、在条件不满足时抑制不适用的工具调用、在执行失败时进行针对性修复，才能有效提升智能体的性能与安全性。

Abstract: Extracting skills from past successes is critical for the efficient evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. Prevailing agent self-evolution paradigms typically rely on a core assumption: equipping LLMs with skill memories derived from successful trajectories will monotonically improve their problem-solving capabilities. However, probe analyses reveal that extracting skills solely from successful trajectories traps the model in a \textbf{Skill Imitation Trap}. For tasks that resemble past successes but require different tools, retrieving more skills paradoxically increases the model's confidence in wrong tool calls---procedure skills raise the wrong-tool margin by $47\%$ over a memory-free baseline. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{Boundary-Aware Skill Memory} (BASM), which augments each skill with explicit boundary fields---applicability conditions, risk cues, avoidance rules, and recovery notes. These fields transform each retrieved skill from an unconditional action template into state-conditioned guidance: the agent applies the skill when its conditions hold, suppresses inapplicable tool calls when they do not, and issues targeted repairs when execution fails. Across three agent benchmarks and four model scales, BASM consistently outperforms success-distilled skill-memory baselines: it improves task success rate by up to $23.8\%$ on AppWorld, accuracy by up to $5.0\%$ on BFCL, and reduces attack success rate by $4.6\%$ on AgentDojo, while simultaneously reducing average AppWorld steps by up to $6.6\%$ relative to the memory-free baseline.

</details>


### [243] [Context-Aware Cluster Decoding: Semantic Anchor-Driven Coherence in dMLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22367)
*Yikai Zhao,Qiyan Zhao,Jiaquan Zhang,Xiaofeng Zhang,Xiaosong Yuan,Pengzhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CACD（上下文感知聚类解码），一种无需训练的解码方法，通过结合softmax置信度与邻域邻近度的复合评分来改善扩散多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）在长文本生成中的语义漂移和重复问题，在三个模型、四个基准上实现一致性质量提升和幻觉减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）在长序列生成中普遍存在语义漂移和重复问题，且输出质量随长度增加而下降。作者指出现有解码方法的两大结构缺陷：基于置信度的评分忽略了已解码邻域的支持信息；块划分策略阻断了高就绪度语义锚点的全局可达性，导致token在局部上下文充分建立之前就被过早确定。

Method: 提出CACD，一种免训练解码方法。核心创新包括：（1）对每个掩码位置使用softmax置信度与邻域邻近度的乘性复合评分，优先选择上下文就绪的token并抑制低置信度的位置噪声；（2）采用无块（block-free）操作，使高就绪度的语义锚点保持全局可访问；（3）引入架构感知的校准机制，以处理不同视觉集成策略带来的置信度异质性。

Result: 在三个dMLLMs和四个基准上的实验表明，CACD相较于Original基线实现了持续的质量提升和幻觉减少，在更长的生成设定中提升幅度更大，验证了邻域支持与视觉集成策略对dMLLM解码方法设计的重要性。

Conclusion: CACD通过邻域感知评分和全局语义锚点访问，有效缓解了dMLLMs长文本生成中的语义漂移和重复问题，为未来dMLLM解码方法设计提供了关键洞见，代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) frequently produce long-form outputs marred by semantic drift and repetition, with quality generally degrading as output length increases. We identify two structural deficiencies in existing decoding methods as primary drivers of these failures: confidence-based scoring ignores decoded-neighbor support, and block partitioning prevents access to high-readiness semantic anchors, together causing tokens to be committed before their local context is sufficiently established. We propose \ours{} (\textbf{C}ontext-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{C}luster \textbf{D}ecoding), a training-free decoding method that scores each masked position by a multiplicative composite of softmax confidence and neighbor proximity, promoting contextually ready tokens above isolated candidates while suppressing low-confidence positional noise, operating block-free to keep high-readiness anchors globally accessible. \ours{} further applies architecture-aware calibration to handle confidence heterogeneity induced by diverse visual integration strategies. Experiments on three dMLLMs across four benchmarks demonstrate consistent quality gains and hallucination reduction over Original, with larger gains in several longer generation settings, highlighting the importance of neighbor support and visual integration strategy for future dMLLM decoding method design. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/zhaoyk-sysu/CACD-dMLLM.

</details>


### [244] [Can Large Language Models "Hyper-Thread"?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22376)
*Fei Ding*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"模型超线程假说"，认为大语言模型在逐token生成时可能同时执行多个任务，并通过对AIME 2025开发集上的实验发现，并发功能加载策略比基线或串行功能调度获得更高准确率，同时伴随更大的注意力分散和更高的任务相关覆盖度，为从"生成更多token"转向"每个生成步骤承载更多任务"的推理扩展新方向提供了初步行为与相关证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理扩展方法主要依赖更长的生成序列、更多采样或额外验证阶段，而注意力分散通常被视为干扰或错误的信号。作者认为大语言模型具有在串行生成单个token时并发执行多个任务的能力，但这一"生成内部的任务并发"尚未被充分探索，因此提出超线程假说并设计实验加以检验。

Method: 提出模型超线程假说（Model Hyper-Threading Hypothesis），设计三种条件进行对比：基线（Baseline）、串行功能调度（Serial Functional Scheduling）和并发功能加载（Concurrent Functional Loading）。在共享状态的多个协调任务上，利用准确率、输出token分布和注意力指标评估三种策略的收益与代价。

Result: 在AIME 2025开发集上，并发功能加载取得最高准确率；相较于串行功能调度，其典型输出长度相近且在大多数问题上更短，同时展现出更大的注意力分散和更高的任务相关覆盖度，但输出长度尾部更重。

Conclusion: 更分散的注意力可以与更高准确率共存，这为超线程假说提供了初步的行为和相关证据。尽管逐步骤内并发的因果机制仍需要直接测试，但研究结果提示推理扩展的视角应从"生成更多token"转向"每个生成步骤承载更多任务"，为改进推理性能开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Large language models generate tokens sequentially, but can they execute multiple tasks concurrently while forming each token? Broader attention allocation may provide a mechanism for such task concurrency. Existing approaches to scaling inference primarily rely on longer generations, more samples, or additional verification stages, while attention dispersion is often treated as a signal of interference or error. Task concurrency within serial generation therefore remains underexplored. We propose the Model Hyper-Threading Hypothesis and evaluate its predictions using multiple coordinated tasks that share state within the same problem. We design three conditions (Baseline, Serial Functional Scheduling, and Concurrent Functional Loading) and evaluate their benefits and costs using accuracy, output-token distributions, and attention metrics. On an AIME 2025 development set, Concurrent Functional Loading achieves the highest accuracy. Relative to Serial Functional Scheduling, its typical output length is similar and it is shorter on most problems, while exhibiting greater attention dispersion and higher task-relevant coverage, albeit with a heavier output-length tail. Within-step concurrency and its causal mechanism still require direct tests. Our results show that more dispersed attention can coexist with higher accuracy, providing preliminary behavioral and correlational evidence for the hyper-threading hypothesis. These findings motivate a shift in perspective on inference scaling from "generating more tokens" toward "having each generation step carry more tasks," pointing to a new avenue for improving reasoning performance.

</details>


### [245] [ProBel: Propaganda Detection with Techniques, Spans, and Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22388)
*Mohamed Bayan Kmainasi,Ali Ezzat Shahroor,Elisa Sartori,Giovanni Da San Martino,Firoj Alam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ProBel，一个对齐阿拉伯语和英语的虚假宣传检测资源，包含二元标签、23种宣传技术的多标签标注、技术标注的跨度及参考解释。通过评估零样本提示、任务特定微调和联合训练，发现单一双语多任务模型取得最佳整体性能，且联合分类训练保留二元性能，而仅跨度训练可能削弱句子级预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚假宣传检测涉及从句子级决策到技术分类和跨度识别的多个相关预测层次，但在跨阿拉伯语和英语联合学习时，这些层次的监督如何相互作用仍不清楚。缺乏一个在不同语言中统一对齐这些标注级别的资源。

Method: 构建ProBel资源，对齐二元标签、6个大类下的23种宣传技术的多标签标注、技术标注跨度以及参考解释。在共享设置下评估三种方法：零样本提示、任务特定微调和联合训练（包括单语和双语多任务模型）。

Result: 单一双语多任务模型在整体性能上最佳，在各任务和语言中保持竞争力。跨任务分析表明迁移依赖于监督级别：联合分类训练保留二元性能，而仅跨度训练可能削弱句子级预测。联合双语训练结果最稳定，单语微调可能降低向另一种语言的迁移。

Conclusion: ProBel为阿拉伯语和英语的虚假宣传检测提供了统一的多层次资源，证明了联合双语多任务训练是跨语言跨任务检测的有效策略，为未来研究提供了数据、代码和评估脚本。

Abstract: Propaganda detection includes several related prediction levels, ranging from sentence-level decisions to technique classification and span identification. However, it remains unclear how supervision at these levels interacts when learned jointly across Arabic and English. We present ProBel, an Arabic and English resource that aligns binary labels, multi-label annotations over 23 propaganda techniques grouped into six coarse categories, technique-labeled spans, and reference explanations for the same news sentences. It includes a substantially larger English collection and supports matched binary, coarse-grained, multi-label, and span-level tasks in both languages. We evaluate zero-shot prompting, task-specific fine-tuning, and joint training under a shared setup. A single bilingual multi-task model achieves the best overall performance and remains competitive across tasks and languages. Cross-task analysis shows that transfer depends on the supervision level. Joint classification training preserves binary performance, whereas span-only training can weaken sentence-level prediction. Joint bilingual training yields the most stable results, while monolingual fine-tuning can reduce transfer to the other language. We will release the data, code, and evaluation scripts.

</details>


### [246] [SchemaGUI: A Schema-Driven Benchmark for Controllable GUI Generation Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22390)
*Jiarui Dong,Yin Cai,Zhouhong Gu,Chenmou Wu,Ci Tao,Yiran Chen,Jialing Li,Xiaoran Shi,Juntao Zhang,Zhijun Fang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SchemaGUI，一个基于模板的可控GUI生成评估基准。通过参数化接口模式合成配对的自然语言指令和确定性函数调用参考，可在数秒内生成数千个带确定性标注的任务。在六个代表性双语场景中，基于每场景和语言1000个评估实例，对五种主流模型（包括Qwen3.5系列、Qwen3-Coder-30B和DeepSeek-R1）进行基准测试，揭示了三个关键发现：几何空间控制仍是瓶颈、生成难度对布局复杂度高度敏感、思维模式会增加token消耗并降低GUI分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在GUI生成方面展现出潜力，但可靠的评估面临挑战，包括数据分布不可控、标注噪声大以及布局场景覆盖有限。需要一种可控的评估基准来解决这些问题。

Method: 提出SchemaGUI基准，采用模板化方法，从参数化接口模式合成配对的自然语言指令和确定性函数调用参考，无需人工标注即可批量生成测试任务。在六个代表性双语场景中，对五种主流LLM进行系统基准测试和深入分析。

Result: 回归得出三个关键结论：(1)精确的几何空间控制仍是重要瓶颈，模型规模从4B扩展到27B使Schema Feasibility从91.56%提升到99.63%，但Geometry分数仅从67.05%提升到75.30%；(2)生成难度对布局复杂度高度敏感，LLM擅长简单顺序排列但在密集网格和多区域组合中会出现严重的坐标漂移；(3)思维模式增加token消耗同时普遍降低GUI Score，对较小模型影响尤为明显。

Conclusion: SchemaGUI提供了可控、可扩展、无人工标注的GUI生成评估方案，有效揭示了当前LLM在GUI生成中的能力边界，特别是在几何精度和复杂布局处理方面仍存在显著差距。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in graphical user interface (GUI) generation, but reliable evaluation remains challenging due to uncontrolled data distributions, noisy annotations, and limited layout scenario coverage. To address this, we propose SchemaGUI, a template-based benchmark for controllable GUI generation evaluation. By synthesizing paired natural language instructions and deterministic function-call references from parameterized interface schemas, SchemaGUI can generate thousands of deterministically annotated tasks in seconds without human labeling. Based on 1,000 evaluated instances per scenario and language across six representative bilingual scenarios, we benchmark five mainstream models, including the Qwen3.5 family, Qwen3-Coder-30B, and DeepSeek-R1. Our extensive analysis reveals three key insights. First, precise geometric spatial control remains an important bottleneck; while scaling Qwen3.5 from 4B to 27B improves Schema Feasibility from 91.56% to 99.63%, the Geometry score improves more modestly (from 67.05% to 75.30%). Second, generation difficulty is highly sensitive to layout complexity, with current LLMs excelling at simple sequential arrangements but suffering severe coordinate drift in dense grids and multi-region compositions. Third, thinking mode increases token consumption while generally reducing GUI Score, particularly for smaller models.

</details>


### [247] [Don' t Box Me In: Dynamic Cultural Adaptation and Cognitive Tracking for Social Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22411)
*Chongyuan Dai,Yaling Shen,Shengeng Tang,Hui Ma,Jinpeng Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DyCAC，一种无需训练的框架，通过动态文化适应与连续认知追踪实现LLM在多文化社交场景中的流畅社会对齐，超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM社交建模通常将文化视为静态人口统计学属性，难以处理混合文化影响和情境中动态变化的交际偏好，限制了模型在多元文化语境下的适应性。

Method: DyCAC包含两个核心模块：(1) 将文化相关的交际偏好建模为随时间变化的人口级文化参考分布的混合体，并利用当前对话中的对话风格信号进行校准，捕捉复合文化影响与逐轮交际行为变化；(2) 基于心智理论（ToM）的连续认知追踪记忆模块，持续跟踪对话者的认知状态。

Result: 在交互式社交和文化基准测试上的大量实验表明，DyCAC优于现有基线方法，展现出增强的社会智能和跨多文化语境的广泛适应性。

Conclusion: 通过将文化建模为动态、情境校准的混合参考分布，并结合ToM驱动的认知追踪，DyCAC证明了一种无需训练即可实现流利文化适应的有效途径，为LLM在多元文化社会交互中的部署提供了新思路。

Abstract: Social interaction increasingly takes place in multicultural settings, where individuals may draw on multiple cultural influences and adapt their communicative behavior across contexts. Despite recent advances in equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with social understanding capabilities, existing approaches often model culture as a static demographic attribute, limiting their ability to accommodate hybrid and dynamically expressed communicative preferences. Therefore, in this paper, we propose \textbf{DyCAC}, a training-free framework that achieves fluid social alignment by incorporating \underline{Dy}namic \underline{C}ultural \underline{A}daptation with continuous \underline{C}ognitive tracking. Rather than inferring a fixed cultural identity, DyCAC models culturally relevant communicative preferences as a time-varying mixture of population-level cultural reference profiles. This reference-based representation is further calibrated using dialogue-style signals observed in the ongoing interaction, enabling the model to capture both composite cultural influences and turn-level shifts in communicative behavior. In parallel, a memory module driven by Theory of Mind (ToM) continuously tracks the cognitive states of the interlocutor. Extensive experiments on interactive social and cultural benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. The proposed framework outperforms existing baselines, exhibiting enhanced social intelligence and broad adaptability across varied multicultural contexts.

</details>


### [248] [Rank Reversal in Multilingual LLM Judges: A Label-Free Double-Centering Calibrator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22432)
*Alhasan Mahmood,Samir Abdaljalil,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现多语言LLM裁判的骨干模型排名会随提示语言变化而产生显著翻转，将其视为测量问题，提出基于共识的校准方法（Consensus-Based Calibration, CBC），通过对语言-骨干交互效应进行无标注的双中心化分解来校正分数，使跨任务秩一致性τ从0.650提升至0.902，且与人类标注偏好的一致性从68.7%提升至76.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言LLM裁判（Agent-as-a-Judge）在不同提示语言下会产生不同的骨干模型排名，8种语言中排名最高的骨干交替变化，15对骨干中有7对出现统计显著的成对排名反转。这意味着仅依赖单一语言评估会得出误导性结论，作者将该现象视为测量问题而非模型能力问题，需要一个无监督的校准机制来消除语言-骨干交互带来的偏差。

Method: 将多语言裁判分数加性分解为任务难度、骨干能力和语言-骨干交互项三项。交互项无需人工标注即可通过对单元格均值矩阵进行双中心化（double-centering）恢复。该估计器即为标准的两因素方差分析（two-way ANOVA）在总和为零对比下的交互恢复操作，作者将其命名为Consensus-Based Calibration (CBC)，并给出了有限样本浓度界（O(1/√n)，方差常数为(1-1/m)(1-1/k)）以及在任务-语言交互存在时的无偏性证明。

Result: 在7,920次裁判运行（6个骨干、8种语言、55个任务、3个框架）上，CBC将留出跨任务秩一致性τ从0.650提升至0.902，逐语言决策与留出加性模型oracle的一致性达到100%（原始为68.5%）。在独立收集的M-RewardBench面板（7种语言、每语言1,500项、共10,500个语言-项目实例、5个评估器）上，与公开人类黄金偏好的面板一致性从68.7%提升至76.6%（增益7.9个百分点，95% CI [6.0, 9.9]）。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于：将标准的两因素方差分析交互恢复操作应用于多语言LLM裁判的无标签事后校准，提供了显式的有限样本浓度界，以及即使在任务-语言设定错误下仍成立的无偏性结果。CBC是有效的标签自由校准器，但其性能指标为一致性的诊断指标而非人类归因的正确性度量。

Abstract: Multilingual LLM judges produce different evaluator-backbone rankings depending on the prompt language: on an eight-language Agent-as-a-Judge benchmark, the top-ranked backbone alternates across English, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Spanish, Turkish, and Swahili, and 7 of 15 backbone pairs show statistically significant pairwise rank reversal. We treat this as a measurement problem. The multilingual judge score decomposes additively into task difficulty, backbone skill, and a language-backbone interaction term, the last of which is recoverable without human labels by double-centering the cell-mean score matrix. We make this estimator (\textbf{Consensus-Based Calibration}, CBC) explicit, give an $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ finite-sample concentration bound with variance constant $(1-\tfrac{1}{m})(1-\tfrac{1}{k})$, and show that it is unbiased even when task-language interactions are present. Across 7{,}920 judge runs (6 backbones, 8 languages, 55 tasks, 3 frameworks), CBC raises held-out cross-task rank consistency $τ$ from 0.650 to 0.902 and agrees with the held-out additive-model oracle in 100\% of per-language decisions versus 68.5\% raw; these are consistency diagnostics, not human-grounded correctness measures. On a separately collected M-RewardBench panel (7 languages, 1{,}500 items per language, 10{,}500 language-item instances, 5 evaluators), panel agreement with the public human gold preferences rises from 68.7\% to 76.6\% (gain 7.9 percentage points, 95\% CI $[6.0, 9.9]$), our strongest external evidence of downstream usefulness. The estimator is the standard two-way ANOVA interaction-recovery operation under sum-to-zero contrasts; our contribution is its application as a label-free post-hoc calibrator for multilingual LLM judges, an explicit finite-sample concentration bound, and an unbiasedness result that holds even under task-language misspecification.

</details>


### [249] [Aligned Alone, Misaligned Together: Forecasting Adversarial Capture in LLM Agent Populations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22444)
*Isotta Magistrali,Chen Shani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体语言模型群体（如安全监控代理）在相互阅读和影响决策时，集体行为如何偏离个体校准的预期。研究发现，单个代理判断相似的两个告警，在群体中可能导致截然不同的集体行为；但群体在无对手时的良性运行数据可用于预先校准响应函数，预测受攻击时被"承诺少数派"影响的程度。暴露推理过程可中和弱攻击、仅延迟强攻击，而移除攻击者后群体可恢复到原有状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI安全评估以单个模型为单位，但语言模型代理实际部署在相互交互的群体中，成员会阅读和影响彼此的决策。单代理审计无法回答一个关键问题：个体校准的代理是否会被周围的代理拉向不同决策。群体级影响可能在单代理评估中被完全遗漏。

Method: 在安全分流任务（决定升级还是忽略告警）中构建语言模型监控代理群体，注入始终朝一个方向推动的"承诺少数派"。首先评估单个代理对两个告警的判断，再观察群体行为差异；随后仅使用群体在无对手（良性运行）时的数据校准响应函数，预测攻击发生后群体被推动的程度；最后通过不同实验条件（是否展示彼此推理、是否移除承诺代理）考察影响群体漂移的因素。

Result: ①单代理几乎同样判断的两个告警，在群体中可能导致集体行为显著分离，单成员审计无法预测群体行为；②从无对手运行数据校准的响应函数可预先预测群体被承诺少数派推移的程度；③让代理看到彼此的推理可中和弱攻击、仅延迟强攻击，问题从"是否收敛"变为"何时收敛"；④排除"捕获不可逆"假说：移除承诺代理后群体漂移回原状态，捕获是暂时的。

Conclusion: 孤立的对齐不等于群体中的对齐——群体的行为不能由个体审计推断。但群体在攻击下的行为可以从其无对手时的运行方式中预先读出，这为在攻击发生前评估群体的鲁棒性提供了可能。

Abstract: The unit of AI safety evaluation is still the individual model, yet language-model agents are increasingly deployed in interacting populations that read and write one another's decisions. This raises a question no single-agent audit can answer: an agent that is well-calibrated on its own may still be pulled toward a different decision by the agents around it. We study this on a security-triage task, where populations of language-model monitors decide whether to escalate or dismiss alerts, and into which we can inject a committed minority that always pushes one way. We find that two alerts a single agent judges almost identically on its own can drive collective behavior far apart, so auditing any one member need not reveal what the population will do. Yet that collective behavior can be predicted in advance. From a population's benign, adversary-free operation alone, we calibrate a response function that forecasts, before any attack is run, how far a committed minority will later move it. We then ask what shifts the outcome and find that letting agents see each other's reasoning neutralizes a weak attack, while only delaying it against a strong one, turning the question from whether the population converges on the adversaries' choice into when. Finally, we exclude the hypothesis of capture being an irreversible trap: once the committed agents are removed, the population drifts back toward where it began, so capture is a temporary state. Alignment in isolation is not alignment in a population, yet what a population will do under attack can be read in advance, from how it behaves before any adversary arrives.

</details>


### [250] [Figurative Justice: Detecting metaphors in Hindi judgements with qualitative assessment and transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22446)
*Bhumika Bhattacharyya,Shouvik Kumar Guha,Indranil Dutta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了首个印地语法律隐喻语料库（HiLeMe），并基于mBERT微调实现了印地语法律语境下的隐喻自动检测模型，填补了低资源语言在法律隐喻检测领域的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐喻在法律语篇中具有重要的说服力和法律意义建构作用，影响司法判决、论证和法律解释，尤其在人权侵犯案件中至关重要。然而，尽管英语、西班牙语、波兰语等主要语言已有隐喻检测研究，低资源语言如印地语缺乏标注语料库和相应的NLP模型。

Method: 从印地语法律数据语料库（HLDC）中提取判决文书构建印地语法律隐喻语料库（HiLeMe），由法律专家使用MIPVU标注方案进行隐喻构式分类标注，然后在mBERT上进行微调（downstreaming），构建基于Transformer架构的隐喻检测模型。

Result: 建立了HiLeMe语料库并训练出基于Transformer架构的mBERT隐喻检测模型，该模型在印地语法律文本隐喻检测任务上优于传统模型，能为解码司法决策和洞悉司法心理提供支持。

Conclusion: 该研究推进了低资源语言（如印地语）在法律语篇中自动隐喻检测的模型发展，并展望将其推广应用于印度的22种官方语言。

Abstract: Metaphors are figurative use of words for conceptual mapping. Metaphor detection in the legal context has been crucial as metaphors are persuasive juridical means of creating legal meaning and concepts resulting in significant consequences. Metaphorical framing in legal discourse by judges, lawyers, and legislators brings about real-time implications upon individuals and influences judicial decision-making, argumentation and interpretation of laws. This is crucial in Human Rights infringement cases where language determines severity of punishment, public perception and judicial outcomes.
  While automatic metaphor detection in major languages like English, Spanish, Polish, Lithuanian have aided in understanding inherent intentions of metaphorical use of language, there is no such attempt in low-resource languages like Hindi. The dearth of annotated legal corpora in Hindi makes it difficult to develop NLP models and detect metaphors in judicial proceedings. In the Indian context, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been used for classification of bail judgements, however there are no existing models designed for metaphor detection.
  We present a Hindi Legal Metaphor Corpus (HiLeMe) by isolating judgements from Hindi Legal Data Corpus (HLDC). Legal experts annotated HiLeMe to classify metaphorical constructions using the MIPVU schema. We downstreamed an mBERT on Hindi legal metaphor detection task. We built a transformer-based architecture for metaphor detection that are known to outperform traditional models in legal classification tasks. This model provides insights into the judicial psyche for decoding judicial decisions. Our research contributes to advancing automated models in legal discourse in low-resource languages like Hindi and envisages adoption into 22 Indian schedule languages.

</details>


### [251] [From Exposure to Expectation: Frequency, Surprisal, and Language Across Development in Spanish](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22452)
*Francisco Portillo López*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过两项基于西班牙语语料库的研究，考察了惊异值（surprisal）与词频在解释词汇习得年龄和成人阅读时间中的不同作用。研究1发现词频强烈预测225个西班牙语名词的习得年龄（r=-.597），而惊异值在词频和词长之外几乎没有额外贡献；研究2发现惊异值在控制词频和词长后稳健预测成人注视持续时间，且这种关联在阅读中显著强于习得场景。结论认为累积词汇暴露（词频）与语境可预测性（惊异值）在语言发展轨迹中扮演不同角色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 惊异值（surprisal）能可靠预测成人阅读时间，但不清楚它是否同样能解释儿童词汇习得的时间。词频反映学习者累计暴露量，而惊异值反映单次出现的语境可预测性，二者的认知机制不同，需要实证考察它们在词汇习得中的相对贡献。

Method: 两项语料库研究：研究1用词频、语境多样性（来自儿童指向言语CDS）以及三种语言模型（BETO、BERTIN、mGPT）的惊异值建模225个西班牙语名词的习得年龄（AoA）；研究2用mGPT惊异值与两种独立词频指标建模智利西班牙语成人注视持续时间（MECO Wave 2语料库），并进行匹配词型级别的惊异值-行为关联强度比较。

Result: 研究1中词频强烈预测习得年龄（r=-.597, p<.001），惊异值在词频和词长之外贡献甚微；研究2中惊异值在控制词频和词长后稳健预测更长的注视时间，且惊异值-行为关联在阅读任务中显著强于习得任务（z=3.63, p<.001）。

Conclusion: 词频和惊异值在语言发展轨迹中扮演不同角色：词频对早期词汇表征的习得时间最具解释力，而惊异值捕捉已建立语言系统中的即时加工难度。这一发现与基于使用和固化（entrenchment）的词汇发展理论相呼应，并对语言模型作为人类语言行为模型的评估具有启示意义。

Abstract: Surprisal, the negative log-probability a language model assigns to a word given its preceding context, reliably predicts adult reading times. Does it contribute as much to explaining when children acquire individual words? Frequency reflects a learner's cumulative exposure to a word, whereas surprisal reflects how predictable a single occurrence is given its context. We investigate this question across two corpus-based studies of Spanish.
  In Study 1, we modeled age of acquisition (AoA) for 225 Spanish nouns using lexical frequency and contextual diversity from child-directed speech, plus surprisal from three language models differing in architecture and training language (BETO, BERTIN, mGPT). Frequency strongly predicted AoA (r=-.597, p<.001); surprisal added little beyond frequency and word length, including in a naturalistic-context analysis.
  In Study 2, we modeled adult fixation durations in the Chilean Spanish subsample of the Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus (MECO Wave 2), using mGPT surprisal alongside two independent frequency measures. Surprisal robustly predicted longer fixation durations after controlling for frequency and word length, consistent across both frequency sources. A matched word-type-level comparison showed the surprisal-behavior association was stronger in reading than in acquisition (z=3.63, p<.001).
  The findings suggest cumulative lexical exposure and contextual predictability play different roles across the language trajectory: frequency is particularly informative about when early lexical representations are acquired, whereas surprisal captures moment-to-moment processing difficulty in an already-established linguistic system. We discuss this pattern in relation to usage-based and entrenchment-based accounts of lexical development and to the evaluation of language models as models of human language behavior.

</details>


### [252] [GTA-RAG: Graph-Trajectory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22479)
*Jun Chen,Yongchao Liu,Pengyu Qiu,Jiajun Zheng,Juelu Zhang,Yujie Zeng,Qin Zhang,Ziyue Qiao,Xiao Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出GTA-RAG框架，通过图-轨迹增强的强化学习来优化多跳检索增强生成中的检索策略。从实体-文档图中采样连通文档路径，合成多跳QA轨迹并用检索器验证以获得可执行的轨迹级监督，使用GRPO和轨迹引导奖励进行优化，在三跳和两跳QA基准上优于现有RL-based RAG基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的强化学习方法用于agentic RAG时通常只用最终答案奖励进行优化，这种稀疏监督忽略了模型是否真正检索到了所需的证据链，导致检索策略无法有效学习多跳推理所需的关键证据获取。

Method: GTA-RAG框架包含三个核心步骤：(1)从实体-文档图中采样连通的文档路径，合成多跳QA轨迹；(2)用部署的检索器验证这些轨迹以获得可执行的轨迹级监督；(3)使用GRPO结合轨迹引导奖励优化检索策略，在鼓励准确答案的同时获取目标证据文档，最后在自然QA实例上进行答案奖励训练。

Result: 在三个多跳和两个简单QA基准上，GTA-RAG在Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-7B两种主干模型下均一致优于RL-based RAG基线，并显著提升了证据链覆盖率。

Conclusion: 通过引入轨迹级监督信号而非仅依赖最终答案奖励，能够更有效地训练agentic RAG的检索策略，提升多跳知识密集型问答的证据获取能力和最终回答准确性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables LLMs to access external knowledge for answering knowledge-intensive questions. For complex multi-hop questions, multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning extends RAG into an iterative process that repeatedly searches for and integrates evidence across documents. However, existing reinforcement-learning (RL) approaches for agentic RAG are typically optimized with final-answer rewards, which provide sparse supervision and overlook whether the model actually retrieves the required evidence chain. We present \textsc{GTA-RAG}, a graph-trajectory-augmented RL framework for multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning. From an entity--document graph, we sample connected document paths, synthesize multi-hop QA trajectories, and validate them with the deployed retriever to obtain executable trajectory-level supervision. We then optimize the retrieval policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and a trajectory-guided reward that encourages both accurate answers and acquisition of target evidence documents, followed by answer-reward training on natural QA instances. Experiments on three multi-hop and two simple QA benchmarks show that \method{} consistently outperforms RL-based RAG baselines with both Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B backbones, while substantially improving evidence-chain coverage. Our code is available at https://github.com/cjcj46262/GTA-RAG.

</details>


### [253] [Claim-Level Confidence Calibration for Reliable Decision Making with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22483)
*Toghrul Abbasli,Kentaroh Toyoda,Yuan Wang,Li Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在高级别决策场景中的声明级（claim-level）置信度校准问题，将每个响应分解为原子可验证声明并为每个声明分配校准置信度，在闭盒设置下工作，不需要logits或微调。在TriviaQA和TruthfulQA上对六种模型和七种基线进行评估，证明声明级分解结合事后校准能减少预期校准误差，但在对抗性假前提问题上暴露了失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在高风险领域辅助决策时经常产生幻觉，且置信度与事实正确性不一致。响应级置信度过于粗糙——一个生成结果可能混合了正确和不正确的陈述，单个数字无法帮助用户针对性地接受、拒绝或验证每条信息。需要更细粒度的声明级不确定性信号来支持选择性干预。

Method: 提出声明级置信度校准框架：1) 将每个响应分解为原子、可验证的声明；2) 利用跨样本一致性（consistency across samples）和自验证（self-verification）的推理时信号为每个声明分配置信度；3) 在声明级别应用事后校准（post-hoc calibration）。框架在闭盒设置下运行，无需logits或微调，支持对低置信度声明进行证据检索或人工审核等选择性干预。

Result: 在TriviaQA和TruthfulQA上评估了七种基线，覆盖Llama-3.1、Mistral、Qwen2.5、DeepSeek-R1、GPT-4和GPT-4o六种模型。声明级分解结合事后校准减少了事实性问题的预期校准误差（ECE），但在对抗性假前提问题上暴露了失败模式——而这类场景恰恰是决策者最需要可靠不确定性估计的地方。

Conclusion: 声明级置信度校准是比响应级置信度更具可操作性的不确定性信号，能有效支持选择性干预。但现有方法在对抗性假前提问题上的失效表明，在决策者最需要可靠不确定性的高风险场景中，当前的校准方法仍存在不足，需要进一步改进以应对这类对抗性输入。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly support decision-making in high-stakes domains, but they often hallucinate and express confidence that is misaligned with factual correctness. Response-level confidence is a coarse signal: a single generation can mix correct and incorrect statements, so a single number is not actionable for users that must accept, reject, or verify individual pieces of information. We study claim-level confidence calibration as a decision-relevant uncertainty signal: each response is decomposed into atomic, verifiable claims, and each claim is assigned a calibrated confidence using inference-time signals from consistency across samples and self-verification. Our framework operates in closed-box settings (no logits, no fine-tuning) and applies post-hoc calibration directly at the claim level, enabling selective intervention such as evidence retrieval or human review for low-confidence claims. Across TriviaQA and TruthfulQA we evaluate seven baselines on six recent models (Llama-3.1, Mistral, Qwen2.5, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4, GPT-4o), and show that claim-level decomposition combined with post-hoc calibration reduces expected calibration error on factual questions while exposing failure modes on adversarial false-premise questions where decision-makers most need reliable uncertainty estimates.

</details>


### [254] [Who Pays More for Safety? Measuring the Disparate Cost of Safety Alignment across Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22490)
*Chanwoong Yoon,Jungsoo Park,Alan Ritter*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个严谨的测量协议（Safety Cost）来量化安全对齐对不同语言用户造成的效用损失差异，发现非英语用户系统性承担更高的安全成本，并识别了三种潜在模式：双惩罚区、虚假效用增益和高资源语言的较高成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐虽然有助于模型符合人类价值观，但通常降低响应效用。一个关键而未被充分研究的问题是：安全对齐在不同语言群体间是否公平地施加成本？作者旨在揭示安全对齐实践中的系统性语言间不平等。

Method: 提出了一个严谨的测量协议，通过安全对齐模型与其未对齐版本之间的直接成对比较，来量化仅由安全对齐导致的效用损失（即Safety Cost），并进一步分析不同语言间该成本的分布差异及其潜在的三种模式。

Result: 研究发现非英语用户系统性承受比英语用户更高的Safety Cost。存在三种模式：(1)部分语言处于双惩罚区——既安全保护更弱又效用损失更大；(2)某些语言表现出看似效用增益，实则是安全过滤器未有效触发；(3)即便是高资源语言，达到相同安全水平也比英语支付更高成本。这些差异源于显式拒绝和隐式质量差异。

Conclusion: 通过准确测量安全对齐的异质性影响，本文揭示了当前安全对齐实践中存在的系统性语言间差异，为非英语用户的安全与效用平衡问题提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Safety alignment helps models adhere to human values, but it often reduces response utility. We ask a critical but understudied question: Does safety alignment impose the cost equally across language groups? To answer this, we introduce a rigorous protocol to measure the utility loss imposed solely by safety alignment, which we term Safety Cost. Through direct pairwise comparisons between safety-aligned models and their unaligned counterparts, we find a systematic inequity: non-English users consistently bear a higher Safety Cost than English users. We further identify three underlying patterns. First, multiple languages lie in a double-penalty zone, experiencing both weaker safety protection and larger utility loss. Second, certain languages exhibit apparent utility gains that are in fact a consequence of safety filters failing to engage. Third, even high-resource languages pay a larger Safety Cost than English to reach the same level of safety. We show that these disparities arise from both explicit refusals and implicit qualitative differences across multiple dimensions. By accurately measuring the disparate effects of safety alignment, our findings expose a systematic disparity in current safety alignment practices.

</details>


### [255] [Kernel Token Contradiction: a Fast and Principled Approach for LLM Claim Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22506)
*Jérémie Dentan,Alexi Canesse,Mahammed El Sharkawy,Sonia Vanier*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出KTC（Kernel Token Contradiction），一种轻量级的基于词元（token）级内核的信息不确定性量化方法，用于在大语言模型输出中实现声明级别（claim-level）的不确定性量化。KTC在纯CPU环境下运行，较GPU加速的SOTA方法提速8.2倍以上，较同类CPU方法提速65倍以上，且在高精度区间表现优于现有方法，使LLM输出的实时监控在生产环境中成为可能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型输出存在事实性不可靠问题，声明级不确定性量化（Claim-level UQ）旨在逐条评估输出中每个声明的真实性，以缓解这一缺陷。然而现有方法依赖计算密集型的cross-encoder等模型，推理开销大，难以满足生产环境中的实时监控需求。

Method: KTC将LLM生成过程中涉及的候选词元表示为半正定核（positive semi-definite kernel），该核同时整合了LLM的条件分布与词元矛盾分数（token contradiction score）；随后利用Von Neumann熵量化该核的不确定性。词元矛盾的估计采用基于Wikipedia语料库的频次统计新方法，全程仅需CPU运算。

Result: 在跨四种欧洲语言、两个基准、16个不同模型的评估中，KTC相比基于cross-encoder的GPU加速SOTA方法实现8.2倍以上的加速，相比同类CPU方法实现65倍以上的加速；平均性能与现有方法持平，在高精度（high-precision）区间上性能更优。

Conclusion: KTC在计算效率与准确性之间取得了良好平衡，其轻量化设计使得LLM输出的实时声明级不确定性监控在生产环境中具有实际可行性。

Abstract: Claim-level Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) aims to mitigate the lack of reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) by evaluating the factuality of each claim in their outputs. We introduce Kernel Token Contradiction (KTC), a lightweight approach to compute claim-level UQ under realistic white-box conditions. KTC represents the candidate tokens involved in LLM generation as a positive semi-definite kernel that integrates both the LLM's conditional distribution and a token contradiction score. We then use the Von Neumann entropy to quantify the uncertainty of this kernel. To estimate token contradiction, we develop a new approach based on frequency statistics from the Wikipedia corpus. Although CPU-only, our approach achieves over an 8.2x speedup compared to state-of-the-art GPU-accelerated methods based on cross-encoders, and over a 65x speedup compared to CPU-only methods with comparable performance. Our evaluation spans two benchmarks across four European languages and 16 different models. KTC not only matches the average performance of existing methods but also outperforms them in high-precision regimes. This combination of computational efficiency and accuracy makes real-time monitoring of LLM outputs practical in production.

</details>


### [256] [From Diagnosis to Redesign: Using Quantitative Ethnography to Improve Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22566)
*Vedant Khatri,Anthony Cusimano,Zachari Swiecki,Zhen Xu,Xiner Liu,Renzhe Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种定量民族志（QE）方法，通过基于代理间交互话语的Epistemic Network Analysis（ENA）来诊断和重新设计多智能体LLM系统，并以自动作文评分任务为例验证该方法。通过分析正确与错误评分决策对应的辩论话语模式差异，作者改进了智能体提示词，使精确评分准确率从27.78%提升至40.28%，并让错误辩论的话语模式趋近于正确决策模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统虽通过任务分解设计来提升推理能力，但多个智能体的存在并不能保证推理连贯或输出与任务目标一致。缺乏一种系统性的方法来诊断多智能体系统中的推理偏差，以及指导如何重新设计系统以提高性能。

Method: 采用定量民族志（QE）方法，以自动作文评分为测试场景，构建五智能体辩论系统；运用Epistemic Network Analysis（ENA）对智能体间交互话语进行建模，比较正确与错误评分决策的辩论话语模式差异；基于诊断结果修订智能体提示词，并评估改动对结果和交互模式的影响。

Result: 初始系统中，正确评分决策的特点是围绕评分标准的论证、一致性和阐述；错误决策则表现为缺乏评分标准关联的延展性命题-反驳-回应循环。经提示词修订后，精确评分准确率从27.78%提升至40.28%，且错误辩论的话语模式转向与正确辩论几乎无法区分。

Conclusion: QE能够支持AI推理的“诊断-重新设计”闭环：通过追踪智能体交互模式与系统性能之间的关系来指导提示词重设计，并评估重新设计是否同时改变了输出结果和交互模式。

Abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are designed to improve reasoning by decomposing tasks across multiple agents with specialized functions, but the presence of multiple agents does not inherently guarantee coherent reasoning or outputs that align with task objectives. This paper introduces a quantitative ethnographic (QE) approach for diagnosing and redesigning multi-agent LLM systems based on the discourse produced through agent interactions. We test this approach using automated essay scoring as an example context, applying Epistemic Network Analysis (ENA) to model a five-agent multi-agent debate system and examine differences between debates that produced correct versus incorrect scoring decisions. Results show that, in the initial system, correct scoring decisions were characterized by rubric-grounded justification, agreement, and elaboration. Incorrect scoring decisions, in contrast, were characterized by extended proposition-challenge-response exchanges that were less consistently tied to rubric criteria. We then used the findings to revise the agents' prompts. The revised system improved exact scoring accuracy from 27.78% to 40.28% and shifted the discourse of incorrect debates toward the rubric-grounded pattern of correct ones, making the two nearly indistinguishable. Based on these results, we argue that QE can support a diagnostic-to-redesign loop for AI reasoning by tracing how patterns of agent interaction relate to system performance, informing prompt redesign, and evaluating whether those redesigns change both outcomes and interaction patterns.

</details>


### [257] [Hybrid Panels: Toward Human-AI Collaboration in Survey Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22582)
*Julia Romberg,Tobias Gummer,Gabriella Lapesa,Tanja Kunz,Claudia Wagner*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"混合面板"（hybrid panel）这一AI赋能的纵向调查基础设施概念，将人类参与者和大型语言模型（LLMs）整合到同一调查设计中，利用LLM模拟人群并与真实人群迭代对齐，以提高调查效率、降低成本，同时通过误差反馈优化后续调查波次的设计。文章报告了首个试点研究的结果及所识别的开放性挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模人口调查面临回复率下降、数据采集成本上升、数据提供延迟以及非响应偏差等严峻挑战。尽管AI为调查基础设施带来了新机遇，但目前缺乏一个能够系统性地将LLM与人类参与者整合、并利用二者之间的差异来迭代优化调查设计的框架。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出混合面板的概念以应对上述挑战，同时不牺牲数据质量。

Method: 本文首先从概念层面提出混合面板的定义，将其界定为一种纵向AI赋能调查，核心机制是迭代改善LLM与目标人群之间的对齐程度，并利用对齐误差指导下一轮调查波次的设计（如参与者招募、问题分配等）。随后提出了一个涵盖数据采集到数据验证的全流程总体框架，并通过一项试点研究进行实证验证，展示框架的可行性和暴露出的问题。

Result: 试点研究展示了混合面板的初步可行性与操作流程，验证了将人类参与者和LLM同时纳入调查设计的可行性，同时揭示了多项开放挑战，包括LLM与真实人群的对齐误差来源、如何系统化利用误差反馈、以及混合面板在参与度、数据质量和实施成本等方面的待解问题。

Conclusion: 混合面板代表了一种有前景的AI赋能调查基础设施方向，有望缓解传统调查的多重困境，但其从概念走向成熟应用仍面临诸多方法论和技术层面的开放挑战，需要后续研究深化LLM-人类对齐机制、误差利用策略及验证框架。

Abstract: Large-scale population surveys are essential for generating robust social and scientific insights, yet they face significant challenges, including declining response rates, increasing data collection costs, long delays between data collection and data provision, and the risk of nonresponse bias. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have opened up new opportunities for AI-supported survey infrastructures where the goal is to overcome these challenges without limiting the data quality. A promising AI-enabled survey infrastructure for which we build a first pilot is a hybrid panel. A hybrid panel is a longitudinal AI-enabled survey which allows to iteratively improve the alignment between large language models (LLMs) and the population they aim to simulate and use the errors to inform the design and implementation of the next survey wave (e.g., inform the participant recruitment, assignment of questions to participants). It incorporates both human participants and LLMs as fundamental elements of its design. In this research note, we introduce the concept of a hybrid panel by providing a definition and outlining an overarching framework, spanning data collection to data validation. We detail results from a first pilot study to illustrate (open) challenges that we identify for hybrid panels.

</details>


### [258] [Teaching LLMs How ICU Physicians Approach Clinical Reasoning Through OMOP-Aligned Retrieval Improves Reasoning Across Clinical Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22622)
*Miguel Contreras,Scott Siegel,Subhash Nerella,Jessica Sena,Jiaqing Zhang,Heng Sun,Hruday Tej Akkaladevi,Peiyu Lu,Jordan Rosen,Sumit Kapoor,Sasank Desaraju,Grace R. Thompson,Jacob Purcell,Michael Petrauskis,Philip KW. Hong,Meghan Brennan,Sarah Chrabaszcz,Tierra Smith,Ronnie Ren,Michel S. Kabbash,Ceyhun Haziroglu,Rushi Patel,Gabriel Gomez,Charlotte Chaiklin,Randy Leung,Kenneth N. John,Whitman Wiggins,Philip Kayser,Vincent Bird,Maria Bruzzone,Tyler J. Loftus,Azra Bihorac,Parisa Rashidi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ICU-REACT，一个由19位临床医生通过clinician-in-the-loop框架构建的推理数据集，用于训练LLM在ICU中进行信息检索和上下文感知的临床推理。基于该数据集微调的Clin-REACT模型（8B-70B参数，3个模型家族）在五个临床推理基准上一致优于其骨干模型及开源通用和医疗LLM，表明重症监护领域的专家推理监督可以提升更广泛的临床推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床决策依赖从大量数据中识别相关患者信息来指导诊断和治疗，尤其是在数据密集且快速变化的ICU中尤为困难。现有LLM应用和数据集大多强调表面级检索或事实回忆，而非临床医生实际采用的归纳和演绎推理。作者假设对LLM进行专家ICU推理训练可以产生超越重症监护领域的泛化临床推理能力。

Method: 作者与19位临床医生合作，通过clinician-in-the-loop框架构建了ICU-REACT推理数据集，用于训练LLM进行信息检索和上下文感知的ICU临床推理。基于ICU-REACT，对8B-70B参数范围内三个模型家族的模型进行微调，得到Clin-REACT系列模型。

Result: 在五个临床推理基准上，Clin-REACT一致优于其骨干模型以及开源通用和医疗LLM。性能提升扩展到不同任务，包括脚本一致性测试（script concordance tests）以及下游诊断和治疗任务。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，重症监护领域的专家推理监督可以改善更广泛的临床推理能力。但作者强调在真实世界临床应用之前仍需进行前瞻性评估。

Abstract: Clinical decision-making relies on identifying relevant patient information to guide diagnosis and treatment, a challenge that is especially difficult in the data-dense and rapidly changing intensive care unit (ICU). Large language models (LLMs) could support this task. However, existing applications and datasets mostly emphasize surface-level retrieval or factual recall rather than the inductive and deductive reasoning clinicians practice to select and reason over decision-relevant evidence. We hypothesized that training LLMs on expert ICU reasoning could yield clinical reasoning skills that generalize beyond critical care. Here we introduce ICU-REACT, a reasoning dataset developed with 19 clinicians through a clinician-in-the-loop framework to teach LLMs to perform information retrieval and context-aware clinical reasoning in the ICU. Using ICU-REACT, we fine-tuned Clin-REACT models spanning 8B-70B parameters and three model families. Across five clinical reasoning benchmarks, Clin-REACT consistently outperformed its backbone models and open-source general-purpose and medical LLMs. Gains extended to different tasks including script concordance tests, and downstream diagnosis and treatment tasks. These findings suggest that expert reasoning supervision in critical care can improve broader clinical reasoning, although prospective evaluation is needed before real-world clinical use.

</details>


### [259] [GeoRisk-RAG: A Hierarchy-Aware Risk Framework for Improving RAG Reliability through Selective Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22634)
*Meenu Ravi,Shailik Sarkar,Lulwah AlKulaib,Yordanos Tessema,Chang-Tien Lu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoRisk-RAG，一种层级感知的检索增强生成框架，通过有向无环图（DAG）距离显式估计地理适用性，用于选择性回答，显著降低自然灾害管理领域中位置相关问题的错误置信率（从~0.090降至0.009）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提升LLM回答可靠性的方法（如RAG、知识图谱增强、强化学习）主要通过语义相似性和忠实度来评估可靠性，但无法区分语义相似性与地理有效性。在自然灾害管理领域，地理粒度（镇/市/州）对决策至关重要，一个城镇有效的回答可能不适用于另一个城镇，自信但错误的回答比不回答风险更大。

Method: GeoRisk-RAG框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于DAG（有向无环图）的地理距离计算，用于显式估计回答的地理适用性；(2) 选择性回答机制，在响应生成前通过该距离进行上下文检索和适用性判断，仅在确信地理有效时才生成回答。

Result: 在全新的野火相关问答数据集上，GeoRisk-RAG将位置相关问题的错误置信率从~0.090（标准语义相似度和重排序基线）降至0.009，同时持续实现更高的人类偏好对齐。

Conclusion: 该工作通过整合地理有效性和选择性回答行为，提供了对端到端RAG流水线更全面的评估，为地理空间领域的安全决策提供了更可靠的保障。

Abstract: Current work on improving reliability in large language model (LLM)- generated answers has primarily leveraged Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge-graph augmentation, and reinforcement learning. While these methods are adept at enhancing and measuring reliability through semantic similarity and faithfulness, they often struggle to distinguish semantic similarity from geographic validity. This is especially critical in natural hazard management domains where geographic granularity (i.e., town vs. city vs. state) is significant for decision-making, as responses valid in one municipality may not transfer to another. In such domains, a confidently wrong answer carries greater risk than abstaining. We present GeoRisk-RAG, a novel hierarchy-aware framework that addresses this geographic-validity gap through selective answering. This framework explicitly estimates geographic applicability using a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-based distance for context retrieval before response generation. Experiments on a novel held-out wildfire-related question-answering (QA) dataset show that GeoRisk-RAG significantly reduces false confidence rates for location-dependent questions, lowering the rate to 0.009 compared with ~0.090 for standard semantic similarity and reranking baselines, while consistently achieving higher human preference alignment. This work provides a more comprehensive assessment of end-to-end RAG pipelines by integrating geographic validity and selective-answering behavior for safer decision-making in geospatial domains.

</details>


### [260] [Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22651)
*Jian Lu,Haiwei Yu,Raymond M Xiong,Anru Zhang,Danyang Zhuo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ReAct-SQL是一个基于ReAct风格推理和受限动作空间的零样本text-to-SQL框架，仅依赖迭代推理和15个关系操作组成的类型化DSL，而非free-form SQL生成。在BIRD mini-dev和EHR-SQL上分别达到84.5%和73.9%准确率，与更复杂的基线持平但运行速度快8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代text-to-SQL系统日益复杂，依赖schema-linking模块、检索增强提示、候选生成和多阶段精炼流水线，虽然有效但引入了大量延迟和工程开销。作者希望简化这一流程，减少系统复杂性的同时保持甚至超越现有性能。

Method: 构建了一个zero-shot ReAct-style框架，核心是：(1) 迭代推理（iterative reasoning），模型逐步生成DSL调用；(2) 受限动作空间，由15个关系操作组成的类型化DSL定义，而非直接生成free-form SQL；(3) 交互循环：模型发出DSL调用、观察编译后SQL的执行反馈、根据反馈修正推理。

Result: 在修正后的BIRD mini-dev和EHR-SQL基准上分别达到84.5%和73.9%的准确率，与明显更复杂的基线系统性能相当，同时运行速度快8倍。增量消融实验表明，迭代机制主要提升grounding能力，而DSL则增强组合可靠性。

Conclusion: 简洁的ReAct-style框架配合受限DSL动作空间，可以在保持高性能的同时大幅降低系统复杂性和运行开销，为text-to-SQL提供了一条更轻量的路径。消融实验揭示了迭代和DSL各自的具体贡献。

Abstract: Modern text-to-SQL systems have become increasingly elaborate, relying on schema-linking modules, retrieval-augmented prompting, candidate generation, and multi-stage refinement pipelines. While effective, these additions introduce substantial latency and engineering overhead. To this end, we present \textbf{ReAct-SQL}, a simple yet effective zero-shot ReAct-style framework built solely on iterative reasoning and a constrained action space defined by a typed Domain-Specific Language (DSL) of 15 relational operations, rather than free-form SQL generation. The model incrementally issues DSL calls, observes compiled-SQL execution feedback, and revises its reasoning through interaction. On corrected BIRD mini-dev and EHR-SQL, ReAct-SQL achieves \textbf{84.5\%} and \textbf{73.9\%} accuracy, respectively, matching substantially more elaborate baselines while running up to $8\times$ faster. Incremental ablations further show that iteration primarily improves grounding, while the DSL improves compositional reliability.

</details>


### [261] [Enrich-Retrieve-Rank: Scaling Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22695)
*Nazib Sorathiya,Daniel Zhang,Bardiya Akhbari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将agent生态系统中能力发现（capability discovery）从基于上下文的in-context routing范式转变为检索-重排序（retrieve-then-rank）范式。通过离线富化稀疏元数据为可搜索档案，再通过在线检索排序返回候选短名单，在从N=10到7,278个能力的范围内，in-context routing的Match@1从0.85崩溃至0.12，而检索-重排序仅从0.81平缓下降至0.39，交叉点约在N=500。在完全规模下，该pipeline在Match@1上比Search&Pick基线领先6.5个百分点（pp），成本约为其一半；相对于Full-Ctx成本降低70倍。该方案已在大型多智能体平台生产环境中作为默认能力发现层运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent生态系统中MATS组件（模型、智能体、工具、技能）数量激增（已到数千规模），但现有能力发现仍依赖in-context routing——将注册表塞入上下文、选择候选、调用并失败重试。这种模式随规模扩大急剧退化，注册表增长速度快于上下文窗口的扩展能力，迫切需要一种可扩展的能力发现方案。

Method: 提出两阶段pipeline：(1) 离线富化步骤：将稀疏的元数据（名称、提示、描述）转化为可搜索的能力档案（searchable profiles）；(2) 在线检索-重排序流程：先通过检索器从注册表中召回候选短名单，再由重排序器精排，全程无需在线调用任何候选组件。该方法采用固定配置（相同的富化、检索器和打分权重）适用于agent、工具和技能三类注册表。

Result: 在N=10到7,278范围内，in-context routing的Match@1从0.85崩溃至0.12，retrieve-then-rank仅从0.81平缓降至0.39。检索命中后重排序器可将正确能力排在第一位的概率保持在0.70-0.87。在Nova Micro sweep中交叉点约为N=500。完全规模下，pipeline在Match@1上比Search&Pick领先6.5pp，成本约为其一半；相比Full-Ctx成本降低70倍。

Conclusion: 检索-重排序范式是agent能力发现的可扩展解决方案，其退化更平缓、成本更低、且跨组件类型（agent/工具/技能）具有通用性。该方案已实际部署于大型多智能体平台作为默认能力发现层，证明了其生产可行性。

Abstract: Agent ecosystems now include thousands of MATS components (Models, Agents, Tools, and Skills), yet their discovery still relies on in-context routing. These systems read a registry (names, hints, or descriptions, as context budget permits), pick a candidate, invoke it, and retry on failure. This pattern degrades with scale, and registries are growing fast. We recast capability discovery as search over a registry by defining an offline enrichment step that turns sparse metadata into searchable profiles, and an online retrieve-then-rank pipeline that returns a ranked shortlist without invoking any candidates online. We show that from N=10 to 7,278 capabilities, in-context routing's top-1 accuracy (Match@1) collapses (0.85 to 0.12), while retrieve-then-rank degrades more gently (0.81 to 0.39) because its reranker still ranks the right capability first 0.70-0.87 of the time once retrieval finds it. In the Nova Micro sweep, the crossover is around N=500. We compare against two in-context baselines. Full-Ctx puts the whole registry in the prompt and asks the LLM to pick. Search&Pick gives the LLM a search tool to narrow candidates before it picks. At full scale the pipeline leads Search&Pick by 6.5 percentage points (pp) on Match@1 at about half the cost. It reduces cost 70x versus Full-Ctx. We use a fixed configuration (same enrichment, retriever, and scorer weights) across agent, tool, and skill registries. The pipeline runs in production as the default capability-discovery layer of a large-scale multi-agent platform.

</details>


### [262] [WnW: Waxing-and-Waning KV Cache for Long-Form Speech LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22704)
*Yiming Yao,Chenyang Lyu,Xuanfan Ni,Longyue Wang,Weihua Luo,Yazheng Yang,Jinsong Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出WnW（Waxing-and-Waning）KV缓存方法，通过将KV头分类为锚定、潮汐和固定三类角色进行分层缓存管理，解决长音频输入下语音LLM的内存瓶颈问题。锚定头在GPU上作为解码期重要性观察器，潮汐头保留CPU端补充并按块召回，固定头仅保留GPU子集。在LibriSpeech-Long上仅用20%音频token在GPU上即保持接近全缓存精度，优于无法收敛的prefill-only基准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长音频输入导致语音LLM的KV缓存成为内存主导开销。现有的prefill-only KV压缩方法在逐出后永久丢弃音频KV位置，无法在解码阶段恢复。研究发现prefill阶段注意力集中在音频起始位置（注意力汇聚效应），而解码阶段注意力分布广泛，两者排名重叠微弱，导致现有方法在长音频上表现脆弱。

Method: WnW通过离线校准将KV头分类为三类角色：锚定头（anchor heads）保留在GPU上并作为解码期重要性观察器；潮汐头（tidal heads）保留CPU端完整补充，基于锚定头的聚合分数按块召回；固定头（fixed heads）仅保留GPU子集，其余永久丢弃。该方法利用锚定头的注意力分布来指导潮汐头在解码时的动态召回。

Result: 在LibriSpeech-Long数据集上，使用两个3B模型（Voxtral-mini-3b和Qwen2.5-Omni-3B）测试，WnW在仅保留20%音频token于GPU的情况下维持接近全缓存的精度，而prefill-only基准方法无法正常终止。结果在语言、任务和领域迁移中均表现出泛化性，CPU-GPU召回仅在测量中增加了少量解码开销。

Conclusion: WnW证明了解码期动态KV管理在长音频语音LLM中的必要性，通过分层KV头管理和基于观察的按需召回策略，实现了显著内存节省与精度保持之间的有效平衡，且具有良好的跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: Long-form audio inputs make the KV cache the dominant memory cost of speech LLMs. Prefill-only KV compression methods permanently discard audio KV positions once evicted, with no pathway to recover them during decoding. We show this is fragile on long-form audio: prefill attention concentrates near the audio start (an attention-sink effect), while decode-time attention distributes broadly, and the two rankings overlap weakly. We propose WnW (Waxing-and-Waning KV cache), which classifies KV-heads into anchor, tidal, and fixed roles via offline calibration. Anchor heads remain on GPU and serve as a decode-time importance observer; tidal heads keep a CPU-resident complement that is recalled chunk-by-chunk based on aggregated anchor-head scores; fixed heads keep only an on-GPU subset, with the rest permanently discarded. On LibriSpeech-Long with two 3B backbones (Voxtral-mini-3b and Qwen2.5-Omni-3B), WnW preserves near-Full-Cache accuracy while keeping only 20% of audio tokens on GPU, where prefill-only baselines fail to terminate. Results generalize across language, task, and domain shifts, and CPU-GPU recall adds little decode-time overhead in our measurements.

</details>


### [263] [A Source-Grounded Framework for Constructing and Evaluating Progressive Multimodal Diagnostic Dialogues from Clinical Case Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22713)
*Yufan Wang,Rui Yang,Yi Liu,Yi Lin,Yifan Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个基于案例报告构建渐进式多模态诊断对话的源锚定框架，并建立评估策略来检验多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在最终诊断、诊断推理和图像发现解读三方面的能力。在24个内科案例报告上的实验显示，该框架能高质量地将案例报告转化为参考对话（诊断F1=0.99，推理质量4.79/5），而两个前沿MLLMs（o4-mini和Claude Haiku 4.5）的推理质量得分仅分别为2.75和2.50，诊断、推理和图像发现F1均显著偏低，表明流畅的响应并不等同于基于证据的临床推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数多模态医学基准仅评估固定输入或端点答案，而完全交互式诊断智能体将证据选择与证据解读混为一谈，缺乏对临床诊断过程中逐步证据整合过程的系统化评估框架。

Method: 从案例报告出发构建渐进式多模态诊断对话的源锚定框架，并设计评估策略分别考察MLLMs的最终诊断准确性、诊断推理质量以及图像发现解读能力；在24个内科案例报告上进行框架效度验证，并用o4-mini和Claude Haiku 4.5两个前沿模型进行评测。

Result: 框架本身能准确将案例报告转换为参考对话，诊断F1达0.99，推理质量得分4.79/5；而两个MLLMs的推理质量得分仅2.75和2.50，诊断、推理和图像发现的F1分数均显著低于参考标准，表明当前模型在证据锚定的临床推理方面存在明显短板。

Conclusion: 流利的语言输出并不一定反映基于证据的临床诊断推理能力，所提出的框架为评估多模态诊断推理提供了有效工具，为未来临床AI评估范式提供了新方向。

Abstract: Clinical diagnosis requires progressive integration of patient history, physical examination, laboratory findings, medical images, and diagnostic-informative tests. However, most multimodal medical benchmarks evaluate fixed inputs or endpoint answers, while fully interactive diagnostic agents conflate evidence selection with evidence interpretation. We present a source-grounded framework to construct progressive multimodal diagnostic dialogues from case reports and an evaluation strategy for assessing MLLMs on final diagnosis, diagnostic reasoning, and image-finding interpretation. Evaluation on 24 internal medicine case reports showed that our framework can accurately convert case reports into reference dialogues, achieving a diagnosis F1 of 0.99 and a reasoning-quality score of 4.79 out of 5. Evaluation on two frontier MLLMs (o4-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5) achieved reasoning-quality scores of 2.75 and 2.50, respectively, with substantially lower diagnosis, reasoning, and image-finding F1 scores. The results demonstrate that fluent responses do not necessarily reflect evidence-grounded clinical reasoning and highlight the utility of the proposed framework for evaluating multimodal diagnostic reasoning.

</details>


### [264] [DiaRelay: Relaying Dialogue Context with a Constant-Size Memory for Emotion Recognition in Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22745)
*Zihao Zhou,Bin Yang,Jinghui Qin,Kebing Jin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DiaRelay，一种轻量级适配器，使LLM在对话情感识别（ERC）中显式维护对话级记忆。基于LoRA，引入选择性中继记忆迁移和双轴中继记忆读取两个协作组件，在不扩展上下文窗口长度、不重新编码完整历史的前提下，将早期情感线索跨距离传播到后续话语预测中。在MELD上达到SOTA加权F1和准确率，在IEMOCAP上取得竞争性结果，仅增加7.1M可训练参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ERC方法采用固定上下文窗口引入对话历史，但短窗口丢弃远距离情感线索，长窗口重复编码重叠话语导致计算与内存开销增大，并引入无关上下文。此外，LoRA等参数高效适配方法仅引入固定低秩变换，既不显式维护对话级状态，也不根据不断演化的对话上下文调整变换。

Method: 提出DiaRelay适配器，基于LoRA引入两个协作组件：(1) Selective Relay Memory Transition——将有用历史证据渐进聚合到有界的中继记忆中，并在连续话语预测间传播，使早期情感线索在离开局部上下文窗口后仍影响后续预测，无需重新编码完整历史或扩展骨干上下文长度；(2) Dual-axis Relay Memory Read——利用传播的记忆动态调制低秩特征变换，实现上下文相关的表示适配，且无需测试时梯度更新。

Result: 在MELD数据集上取得SOTA加权F1和准确率，在IEMOCAP上取得竞争性结果，仅额外增加7.1M可训练参数。

Conclusion: DiaRelay通过轻量级的对话级记忆维护机制有效增强了LLM的情感理解能力，验证了其有效性和泛化性，在保持参数高效的同时解决了长距离情感线索传播和上下文相关适配的挑战。

Abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) requires models to identify subtle emotional cues that are often distributed across distant dialogue turns. Existing methods typically incorporate dialogue history through a fixed context window. However, short windows discard potentially useful long-range evidence, while enlarging the window repeatedly re-encodes overlapping utterances, increases computational and memory costs, and may introduce irrelevant context. Moreover, commonly used parameter-efficient adaptation methods, such as LoRA, mainly introduce fixed low-rank transformations in the feature space and do not explicitly maintain a dialogue-level state or condition their transformations on the evolving conversational context. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight adapter, DiaRelay, to enable LLMs to explicitly maintain a dialogue-level memory for accurate ERC. Based on LoRA, DiaRelay introduces two extra tightly collaborative components, Selective Relay Memory Transition and Dual-axis Relay Memory Read. Selective Relay Memory Transition progressively aggregates useful historical evidence into a bounded relay memory and propagates it across successive utterance predictions. This allows earlier emotional cues to influence later predictions after they leave the local context window, without re-encoding the complete dialogue history or expanding the backbone context length. Dual-axis Relay Memory Read uses the propagated memory to dynamically modulate low-rank feature transformations, enabling context-dependent representation adaptation without test-time gradient updates. Extensive experiments show that DiaRelay can achieve SOTA weighted F1 and accuracy on MELD while obtaining competitive results on IEMOCAP with only an extra 7.1M trainable parameters, indicating the effectiveness and generalizability of our DiaRelay in enhancing LLM-based emotional understanding.

</details>


### [265] [Beyond Factual Knowledge: Benchmarking and Learning Step-Level Procedural Rule Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22753)
*Bohan Yu,Pengfei Cao,Chen Han,Chenxi Zhou,Zhiheng Zhang,Zhiyang Xie,Wenhao Teng,Xiangwen Liao,Jun Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RuleWorld基准测试和DynaRule框架，用于评估和提升大语言模型在外部程序化规则理解上的能力。DynaRule通过将规则注入KV缓存并结合堆叠步级注意力训练，实现动态规则检索与更新，在10K规则规模下将问答准确率提升最高19个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在文本理解和生成方面表现出色，但在大规模可靠地理解和应用外部提供的程序化规则方面仍存在困难。现有方法将规则视为实例特定的事实，缺乏将规则作为全局可复用抽象单元来处理的能力，因此需要一个专门的基准和框架来系统性地评估和解决这一问题。

Method: 本文提出两个核心贡献：(1) RuleWorld基准，将规则重构为全局可复用的抽象单元，涵盖单规则、并行多规则和多跳推理等场景；(2) DynaRule端到端框架，将规则注入KV缓存，使检索成为内部可学习的逐步过程。DynaRule采用堆叠步级注意力训练（Stacked Step-Level Attention Training），使用特殊的<search>标记实现推理过程中动态的规则重新关注与更新。

Result: 在RuleWorld上的实验表明，现有LLM在大规模规则池下表现困难，而DynaRule将平均问答准确率提升最高19个百分点，在10K规则规模下Recall@1超过85%，大幅超越强基线方法。

Conclusion: DynaRule通过将规则检索转变为可学习的内部逐步过程，有效提升了LLM在大规模规则池下的推理稳定性与准确率，证明了将外部规则作为全局可复用单元注入KV缓存并动态更新的可行性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at text understanding and generation, yet still struggle to reliably understand and apply externally provided procedural rules at scale. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RuleWorld, a large-scale benchmark that reformulates rules as globally reusable abstract units rather than instance-specific facts. In RuleWorld, several scenarios, including single-rule, parallel multi-rule, and multi-hop reasoning, are settled for comprehensive evaluation. We further propose DynaRule, an end-to-end framework that injects the given rules into the KV cache and turns retrieval into an internal, learnable, step-wise process. Specifically, DynaRule employs Stacked Step-Level Attention Training with a special <search> token to enable dynamic rule re-attention and updating during inference. In this way, the model can re-attend to the most relevant rules at each step, dynamically replacing outdated ones to support more stable multi-step reasoning. Experiments on RuleWorld show that existing LLMs face challenges under large rule pools, while DynaRule improves average QA accuracy by up to 19 points and achieves over 85% Recall@1 at 10K rules, outperforming strong baselines by large margins. We make our code and dataset available here: https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/Beyond-Factual-Knowledge.

</details>


### [266] [XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22758)
*Philipp Emanuel Weidmann,Allen Roush,Judah Goldfeder,Sanjay Basu,Ravid Shwartz-Ziv*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: XTC（Exclude Top Choices）是一种轻量级的"头部分布感知"解码算子，专门针对开放域生成中"多个续写都合理但概率过于集中在最通用选择"这一常见场景。它通过绝对合理性阈值τ识别合格token，当至少两个token合格时以概率ρ移除占主导的合格选项，仅保留最弱的合理替代，然后重归一化。在60个实验中，XTC显著提升多样性-重复率的Pareto前沿，在创意生成上将Distinct-2提升11-15%、三连词重复减少27-47%，被llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2和text-generation-webui采用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的标准解码规则（如温度缩放、top-k、top-p等）要么通过重缩放整个token分布来促进多样性，要么截断低概率尾部，但这些策略忽略了开放域生成中一个常见场景：多个续写都合理，但概率质量过度集中在最通用的选择上，导致生成结果虽然多样性不够但重复率偏高。

Method: XTC采用"头部分布感知"策略：首先设定绝对可读性阈值τ，识别出概率超过该阈值的token；当至少两个token符合条件时，以概率ρ移除占主导地位的合格选项，仅保留最弱的合理替代，再进行重归一化。该方法与温度缩放和重复惩罚具有累加效应，无需训练即可适配现有解码框架。

Result: 在Gemma 3 27B Q4、Gemma 3 12B Q6和DeepSeek R1 14B Q6上进行了60项实验，并在Llama 3.3 70B Q4上进行规模验证。创意生成中Distinct-2提升11-15%，重复三连词减少27-47%；结合温度缩放时提升可达Distinct-2的38%和重复三连词减少的71%。盲评研究中，150名Amazon Mechanical Turk专家评员以62.3%的偏好率认为XTC更具创造力（p<10^-4）且流畅性不下降。IFEval测试中，XTC在Llama 3.3 70B Q4上的提示级严格准确率仅比基线低1.7个百分点，同时保留了大部分多样性增益。效果在不同量化级别、模型家族和十二种提示体裁间表现一致。

Conclusion: XTC作为一种轻量解码算子，直接针对"合理但概率过度集中"的生成困境，在多样性与任务遵从性之间取得了比温度缩放更好的权衡——温度匹配的基线在IFEval上损失8.8分，而XTC仅损失1.7分。该方法已被llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2和text-generation-webui等主流推理框架采用，证明了其实际工程价值和研究性与实践性的统一。

Abstract: Standard decoding rules for autoregressive language models promote diversity by rescaling the full next-token distribution or truncating its low-probability tail. These strategies overlook a common regime of open-ended generation in which several continuations are plausible but too much probability mass remains concentrated on the most generic choice. We introduce XTC (Exclude Top Choices), a lightweight head-aware decoding operator that targets this regime directly. XTC identifies tokens whose probabilities exceed an absolute plausibility threshold $τ$: when at least two qualify, it removes the dominant eligible choices with probability $ρ$ and retains only the weakest plausible alternative before renormalization. Across 60 experiments on Gemma 3 27B Q4, Gemma 3 12B Q6, and DeepSeek R1 14B Q6, with scaling validation on Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC improves the diversity-repetition Pareto frontier. On creative generation, Distinct-2 increases by 11--15% and repeat trigrams decrease by 27--47% across the four models. Combined with temperature scaling, gains reach 38% in Distinct-2 and 71% in repeat-trigram reduction over baseline. A blinded Amazon Mechanical Turk study with 150 Master raters yields a 62.3% creativity preference for XTC ($p<10^{-4}$) without reduced fluency, while a GPT-4o control judge reproduces the Anthropic-judge direction on every measure. On IFEval with Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC preserves prompt-level strict accuracy within 1.7 percentage points of baseline while recovering most of the diversity gain; a temperature setting matched on Distinct-2 reduces IFEval by 8.8 points. The effect is additive with temperature and repetition penalties, robust across quantization levels and model families, and consistent across twelve prompt genres. XTC has been adopted by llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui.

</details>


### [267] [Don't Repeat Yourself: Stopping Verbatim Loops at Sampling Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22761)
*Philipp Emanuel Weidmann,Allen Roush,Judah Goldfeder,Sanjay Basu,Ravid Shwartz-Ziv*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DRY是一种采样时的logit调整方法，通过惩罚会延续上下文中已出现过片段后缀的候选token来抑制大语言模型文本生成中的逐字重复循环，在1.5B至120B参数的多模型上使后缀扩展率降低47%，同时保持或提升性能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型自回归生成中常出现逐字循环（verbatim looping），即模型重复上下文中已存在的片段。现有的重复惩罚、存在频率惩罚和n-gram阻塞等方法都基于token复现而非循环的顺序结构，通常在抑制循环时会以牺牲格式或流畅性为代价，因此需要一种针对循环结构本身的解决方案。

Method: DRY（Don't Repeat Yourself）是一种采样时（sampling-time）的logit调整方法。其核心思想是：仅当某个候选token的生成会使当前后缀延续为上下文中先前出现过的某个片段的精确延续时，才对候选token施加惩罚。该方法还引入了"序列打断符"（sequence breakers）来保护聊天模板和格式token，使其免受惩罚。实验采用干预匹配的安慰剂（placebo）对照来验证后缀匹配是起作用的机制。

Result: 在1.5B至120B参数的多个模型、九个提示族以及600对人工研究中，DRY将后缀扩展率降低了47%，同时提升了词汇多样性。干预匹配的安慰剂没有产生可比性的降低，证实了后缀匹配是核心机制。在AWQ量化的70B和120B模型上，DRY使循环率降低约一半，同时保持MT-Bench、MMLU和GSM8K性能，而标准替代方法在这些指标上有所下降。DRY已被llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2和text-generation-webui等主流开源推理框架采用。

Conclusion: DRY通过精准针对循环的序列结构而非简单token复现，在有效抑制逐字循环的同时避免了传统惩罚方法带来的性能退化，其机制有效性通过安慰剂对照得到验证，且已被多个主流开源推理框架采纳，展示了显著的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Large Language Models generate text autoregressively, but open-ended generation is prone to verbatim looping, in which models repeat spans already present in context. Standard defenses such as repetition, presence, and frequency penalties and n-gram blocking act on token recurrence rather than the sequential structure of a loop, and often suppress looping only at strengths that also degrade formatting or fluency. We propose Don't Repeat Yourself (DRY), a sampling-time logit adjustment that penalizes a candidate token only when generating it would extend the current suffix into an exact continuation of a span seen earlier in the context. Sequence breakers protect chat templates and formatting tokens. Across models from 1.5B to 120B parameters, nine prompt families, and a 600-pair human study, DRY reduces suffix-extension rate by 47% while improving lexical diversity. An intervention-matched placebo produces no comparable reduction, identifying suffix matching as the operative mechanism. On AWQ-quantized 70B and 120B models, DRY reduces loop rate by roughly half while preserving MT-Bench, MMLU, and GSM8K performance, whereas standard alternatives lose measurable ground. DRY has been adopted by popular open-source LLM inference frameworks including llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui, highlighting its practical impact on text generation.

</details>


### [268] [DelistBench: Evaluating Search-Enabled LLMs for Auditable Corporate-Event Database Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22770)
*Xuan Yao,Li Shuping,Dai Yang,Zhou Yi,Ke-Wei Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Search-to-Record任务（利用搜索引擎增强的大语言模型从公共来源重构机构定义的公司事件记录）及DelistBench基准（1,200条证券摘牌公告），并通过五组模型在闭卷和联网条件下的对比评估，验证了网页检索可将公告日期7日准确率提升34-48个百分点，最佳系统达到81.5%联合准确率，同时证明了低成本系统可以接近最佳系统性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融机构需要一种独立的手段来检测供应商数据库中缺失、过期或错误分类的公司事件记录。现有的验证方法依赖人工或单一数据源，缺乏系统化、可扩展且可基准测试的自动化方案。

Method: 提出Search-to-Record任务定义，构建包含1,200条记录的DelistBench基准，通过配对实验（闭卷vs.联网）评估五个大语言模型，并分析不同成本层级的网络系统（低成本系统仅为最贵系统的4.5-6.6%成本），以及基于风险的分诊机制。

Result: 联网访问使公告日期7日准确率提升34.0-48.0个百分点，事件状态准确率提升约2.8-21.7个百分点；最佳系统整体7日联合准确率达81.5%；经济型网络系统达到75.9-78.3%准确率而成本仅为最贵系统的4.5-6.6%；最高覆盖率分诊点仍将27.3%的平衡测试集送审。

Conclusion: 网页检索是时间精度提升的主要来源；低成本系统可接近最佳系统性能。部署建议包括：按本地事件流行度和市场组合校准分诊、保留正事件召回率，并将正例和模糊案例路由至定向审查。

Abstract: Financial institutions need an independent way to detect missing, stale, and misclassified corporate-event records in vendor databases. We introduce Search-to-Record, a database-assurance task in which search-enabled large language models reconstruct institution-defined event records from public sources for a known security universe and historical cutoff, and DelistBench, a 1,200-record benchmark for security-level delisting announcements. We evaluate five models in paired closed-book and web-enabled conditions. Web access raises announcement-date accuracy within seven days by 34.0 to 48.0 percentage points and event-status accuracy by approximately 2.8 to 21.7 points; the best system achieves 81.5% overall joint accuracy within seven days. Economy web systems achieve 75.9-78.3% overall joint accuracy within seven days at 4.5-6.6% of the API cost of the most expensive web system. Risk-based triage identifies low-error subsets, although the highest-coverage operating point still sends 27.3% of the balanced test set to review. The evaluation identifies web retrieval as the main source of timing gains and shows that low-cost systems can approach the best system's accuracy. Together, Search-to-Record, DelistBench, and the evaluation provide concrete deployment guidance: calibrate triage to local event prevalence and market mix, preserve positive-event recall, and route positive and ambiguous cases to targeted review.

</details>


### [269] [SPOC-SQL: Stage-wise Preference Optimization for Controllable Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22772)
*Yingnan Chen,Chun Ding,Tianshi Xu,Xu Yang,Si Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SPOC-SQL，将Text-to-SQL任务按标准SQL执行逻辑分解为四个顺序子任务，并在各阶段的关键决策点实施细粒度偏好优化，同时通过结构化分解策略支持阶段级干预和修正，从而提升SQL生成的可控性和可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法将任务视为单步生成，模型优化整个SQL序列而缺少对关键决策点的定向反馈，且不支持对中间生成过程的交互与控制。这使得多阶段结构化推理（涉及数据库模式理解和查询约束满足）难以得到可靠保障。

Method: SPOC-SQL将Text-to-SQL分解为四个符合标准SQL执行逻辑的顺序子任务；在SQL各阶段的关键决策点实施细粒度偏好优化（fine-grained preference optimization），以增强查询构建过程中的结构化决策能力；并设计结构化分解策略，通过显式中间表示支持阶段级干预和修正。

Result: 实验表明，融入阶段级人类知识能够持续提升性能，验证了阶段感知可控生成的有效性。

Conclusion: 将Text-to-SQL按SQL执行逻辑分解为多阶段子任务并结合阶段级偏好优化与显式中间表示干预，可实现更可控、可靠的SQL生成。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL aims to translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries over relational databases, requiring multi-stage structured reasoning over database schemas and query constraints. However, existing methods treat this task as single-step generation, where models optimize entire SQL sequences without targeted feedback at key decision points and lack support for interacting with and controlling the intermediate generation process. To address this issue, we propose SPOC-SQL, which decomposes Text-to-SQL into four sequential subtasks following standard SQL execution logic and designs stage-specific optimization strategies for the model to learn key decisions. Specifically, we propose the implementation of fine-grained preference optimisation at key decision points across SQL stages, with the objective of enhancing structured decision-making during query construction. Furthermore, a structured decomposition strategy is designed, facilitating stage-wise intervention and correction through explicit intermediate representations. This results in more controllable and reliable SQL generation. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating stage-wise human knowledge consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness of stage perception controllable generation.

</details>


### [270] [TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22793)
*Wenhao Wu,Menghao Zhang,Xin Wang,Zhi Wang,Kun Shao,Jian Luan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAR-bench揭示了LLM智能体在车载助手场景中的可靠性差距（一次性求解能力Pass@3与一致求解能力Pass^k之间的鸿沟），并提出TRACE（TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution）框架，通过技能银行（Skill Bank）的智能体自进化循环，在不修改模型权重的情况下将GPT-5.5的一致性（Pass^3）从59.9%提升至94.5%，差距缩小至仅4.0个百分点，并在官方隐藏测试集上取得第一名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户面对的产品中，LLM智能体的可靠部署不仅依赖原始任务求解能力，更取决于行为一致性和对自身极限的认知。现有模型即使能一次性解决任务，也无法保证在多次重复试验中表现稳定。CAR-bench通过在车载助手领域中用LLM模拟用户发出不完整或模糊请求，要求智能体通过多轮对话和工具使用消除不确定性并严格遵守领域策略，从而暴露了这一可靠性差距。

Method: TRACE采用技能银行（Skill Bank）的架构，将工具使用规则和行为指南组织为模块化、可检索的技能。核心是智能体化自进化循环：每轮评估后按技能调用对轨迹分组，通过对比成功与失败行为来迭代细化每个技能；更新后的技能库指导后续轮次，部署时Actor在每个回合执行基于状态的条件性技能编排。整个过程无需修改模型权重。

Result: 在GPT-5.5上，TRACE将一致性Pass^3从59.9%提升至94.5%，提升34.6个百分点，并将潜在性能与可靠性能之间的差距缩小至仅4.0个百分点。在官方隐藏测试集上使用GPT-5.6-Sol取得第一名，Pass^3达70%，相对基线提升40%。

Conclusion: TRACE证明了通过外部行为知识的管理和进化而非修改模型权重，可以有效将模型的高潜在能力转化为稳定可靠的实际性能，为LLM智能体在车载助手等高可靠性要求场景中的部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM agents in user-facing products depends not on raw task-solving ability but on consistency and limit-awareness: behaving the same way across repeated trials, and recognizing when a request cannot, or cannot yet, be safely fulfilled. CAR-bench exposes this reliability gap in the domain of in-car assistants: an LLM-simulated user issues incomplete or ambiguous requests, requiring the agent to resolve uncertainty through multi-turn dialogue and tool use while strictly adhering to domain policies. Even frontier models show a substantial gap between what they can solve at least once (Pass@3) and what they solve consistently across trials (Pass^k). We bridge this gap with TRACE (TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution), which iteratively improves a skill-based agent's behavioral knowledge without modifying model weights. This knowledge is organized as a Skill Bank of modular, retrievable skills, each encoding a self-contained set of tool-use rules and behavioral guidelines. TRACE evolves this bank through an agentic self-evolution loop: after each evaluation round, it groups trajectories by the skills invoked and refines each skill by contrasting successful and failed behaviors. The updated bank then guides subsequent rounds, while during deployment the Actor performs state-conditioned skill orchestration at every turn. On GPT-5.5, TRACE improves consistency (Pass^3) by 34.6 points, from 59.9% to 94.5%, while shrinking the gap between potential and reliable performance to just 4.0 points. On the official hidden set, TRACE achieved first place using GPT-5.6-Sol, attaining a Pass^3 score of 70%-a 40% relative improvement over the baseline. These results show that TRACE converts high model potential into stable, consistent performance gain. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE.

</details>


### [271] [SDoH-Aware Narrative Anchoring Bias in Medical LLMs for Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22802)
*Ahnaf Atef Choudhury,Ramkrishna Saha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了医疗大语言模型中的"社会健康决定因素（SDoH）意识叙述锚定偏差"问题，构建了NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA反事实医学问答数据集，对Qwen2.5系列三个规模（1.5B/3B/7B）的模型在300个临床病例上进行了评估，发现即使准确率最高的7B模型仍存在显著的叙述敏感性误差（最低31.67%），表明仅以平均准确率评判医疗LLM会遗漏临床决策支持的稳定性风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统医疗大语言模型评估仅关注回答正确率，忽略了模型在相同临床病例以不同患者口吻（受社会健康决定因素影响）叙述时可能改变回答的实用风险。这种"叙述锚定偏差"可能影响临床决策支持的可信度，需要专门的评估体系。

Method: 构建NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA反事实医学问答数据集，将宽格式数据重塑为按病例分组的角色叙述行，每个病例保持答案键不变但以不同人物角色叙述。评估Qwen2.5家族三个开源指令微调模型（1.5B/3B/7B），在300个临床病例、三种提示条件下产生8,100个模型响应，计算人物级准确率、反事实一致性、正确一致性和叙述敏感性误差，并使用配对McNemar精确检验进行统计显著性分析。

Result: Qwen2.5 7B在准确率（56.33%）和正确一致性（40.33%）上表现最佳；配对McNemar精确检验显示7B在所有提示设置下显著优于3B。然而所有模型仍存在明显的叙述敏感性，最低误差仍高达31.67%。

Conclusion: 可信赖的临床决策支持系统应同时评估平均正确性和医学等价患者叙述之间的稳定性，不能仅依赖正确率指标。叙述锚定偏差是医疗LLM实用化中不可忽视的评估维度。

Abstract: Medical large language models are often judged by how many clinical questions they answer correctly. That view is useful, but it misses a practical risk. A model may know the right answer and still change its response when the same case is written in a different patient voice. This paper evaluates that risk as SDoH aware narrative anchoring bias. We use NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA, a counterfactual medical question answering dataset in which each case appears in persona based narratives while the answer key remains fixed. The dataset is reshaped from wide format into case grouped persona rows. We evaluate three open source instruction tuned LLMs from the Qwen2.5 family: 1.5B, 3B, and 7B. The final experiment uses 300 clinical cases and produces 8,100 model responses across three prompting conditions. We report persona level accuracy, counterfactual consistency, correct consistency, and narrative sensitivity error. Qwen2.5 7B achieves the best accuracy at 56.33 percent and the best correct consistency at 40.33 percent. Paired McNemar exact tests show significant accuracy gains for 7B over 3B in all prompt settings. Even so, narrative sensitivity remains, with the lowest error still at 31.67 percent. These results suggest that trustworthy clinical decision support should be evaluated by both average correctness and stability across medically equivalent patient narratives.

</details>


### [272] [DIAG: Diagnostic Iterative Alignment and Generation for Data-Efficient Mathematical Preference Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22806)
*Guhan Chen,Songtao Tian,Bohan Li,Hejin Wang,YeXin Xie,Zixiong Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DIAG框架，通过诊断有效偏好对产出率并自适应重塑练习分布，将训练聚焦于学生模型的当前能力边界附近，从而缓解数学推理任务中迭代偏好优化的信号稀缺问题，在同等训练预算下实现更强的推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代偏好优化对数学推理任务中的大语言模型对齐至关重要，但其效率常受信号稀缺制约：随着模型能力提升，静态问题集与模型不断变化的能力日益不匹配，产生的rollout要么过易要么过难，缺乏信息量，导致有效偏好对稀缺。这种能力-数据不匹配问题严重限制了迭代对齐的收益。

Method: DIAG包含两个阶段：(1) 诊断阶段——利用Empirical Bayes收缩估计器衡量有效偏好对的产出率，校准探索-利用权衡并为不同概念分配题目配额，优先考虑高产出的概念；(2) 生成阶段——由教师模型基于学生的失败轨迹合成针对性变体题目。此外，作者提供了理论视角，将DIAG解释为教师介导的、对KL正则化偏好练习分布重加权（朝向学生能力边界）的近似，以最大化有效偏好对产出率。

Result: 实验表明，DIAG在多次迭代中提升了有效偏好对的产出率，并在同等有效训练预算下实现了更强的推理性能，证明其能从练习分布中蒸馏出更具信息量的偏好监督信号。

Conclusion: DIAG通过动态重塑练习分布使训练始终聚焦于学生当前的能力边界附近，有效缓解了迭代偏好优化中的信号稀缺问题，为数学推理的大模型对齐提供了一种数据自适应的迭代训练范式。
