Abstract: Iterative preference optimization is essential for aligning Large Language Models on mathematical reasoning tasks, yet its efficiency is often throttled by signal scarcity: as the model improves, static problem sets become increasingly mismatched to the model's evolving competence, producing rollouts that are either too easy or too hard and therefore non-informative, which leads to a scarcity of valid preference pairs. We propose DIAG, a Diagnostic Iterative Alignment and Generation framework that adaptively reshapes the practice distribution to increase informative supervision and focus training near the student's current competence boundary. DIAG consists of two phases: (1) diagnosing valid preference-pair yield to calibrate the exploration-exploitation trade-off and allocate topic quotas via an Empirical Bayes shrinkage estimator, thereby prioritizing high-yield concepts; and (2) generating targeted practice, where a teacher synthesizes variants from the student's failure traces. We further provide a theoretical view interpreting DIAG as a teacher-mediated approximation to KL-regularized reweighting of the practice distribution toward the student's competence boundary, where valid preference-pair yield is maximized. Experiments show that DIAG boosts yield across iterations and delivers stronger reasoning performance under an iso-effective training budget, demonstrating that it can distill more informative preference supervision for mathematical reasoning.

</details>


### [273] [Industrial-Instruction: An End-to-End Framework for Building Instruction-Tuning and Benchmark Datasets from Industrial Technical Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22817)
*Parsa Bakhtiari,Hassan Bashiri,Alireza Khalilipour,Masoud Nasiripour,Moharram Challenger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Industrial-Instruction，一个从真实工业技术报告（906份Panasonic文档，7,525页）自动构建的QA数据集及端到端流水线。通过布局感知提取、语义检索索引和基于证据的MCQA合成，生成约13.6k个QA对。微调小规模开源LLM（<10B参数）在Panasonic基准上将Set-Match Accuracy从28.5%提升至42.0%，F1从46.6%提升至63.5%。论文还对比了开源（Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct）与闭源（Claude-Opus-4.6）模型生成数据的质量差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业技术报告蕴含高价值的维护、故障排除和产品工程知识，但其异构结构（密集文本、规格说明、表格）使标准检索和QA管道难以索引和推理，且缺乏基于此类文档的公开指令微调或基准数据集。

Method: 端到端流水线包括：(1)布局感知提取，从906份公开Panasonic文档中提取内容；(2)构建语义检索索引；(3)在五种查询-文档关系下（不相关检索、单/多文档支持、单/多文档回答）合成基于检索证据的MCQA数据；(4)过滤后各数据集保留约13.6k个QA对及独立基准测试集。使用Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct和Claude-Opus-4.6两种模型并行生成数据。

Result: 微调<10B参数的小规模开源LLM后，Set-Match Accuracy从28.5%提升到42.0%，F1从46.6%提升到63.5%。Claude-Opus-4.6生成的数据产生更干净的原始语料和更大的微调增益，但成本高约两个数量级。MMLU评估显示Claude-Opus-4.6数据训练的模型几乎完全保留通用知识，而Qwen生成的数据有少量可测的遗忘效应。

Conclusion: Industrial-Instruction提供了从真实工业文档构建可扩展工业基准和训练数据的实用、可复现路径。两个并行版本的发布支持开源与前沿模型数据生成质量的直接对比，为工业领域的RAG和指令微调研究提供了重要资源。

Abstract: Industrial technical reports contain high-value knowledge for maintenance, troubleshooting, and product engineering, but their heterogeneous structure (dense prose, specifications, tables) makes them difficult to index and reason over with standard retrieval and QA pipelines, and no public instruction-tuning or benchmark datasets are built from such documents. We address this gap with Industrial-Instruction, contributing (i) two open QA datasets built from real industrial technical reports and (ii) the end-to-end pipeline that produces them. Using 906 public Panasonic documents (7,525 pages), we apply layout-aware extraction, build a semantic retrieval index, and synthesize multiple-choice QA grounded in retrieved evidence under five query-document relationships (irrelevant retrieval, single-/multi-document support, single-/multi-document answer). After filtering an initial 23.9k generated samples, each dataset provides approximately 13.6k QA pairs with source documents and a held-out benchmark split. Fine-tuning small open LLMs (under 10B parameters) improves Set-Match Accuracy from 28.5% to 42.0% and F1 from 46.6% to 63.5% on the Panasonic benchmark. We release two parallel versions built by the same pipeline: one generated with the open-weight Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct model and one with the closed, API-based Claude-Opus-4.6 model, enabling a direct comparison of open- versus frontier-model data generation. The Claude-Opus-4.6 dataset yields a cleaner raw corpus and larger fine-tuning gains, at roughly two orders of magnitude higher cost. MMLU evaluation shows models trained on the Claude-Opus-4.6 data retain essentially all general knowledge, versus a small but measurable forgetting effect for the Qwen-generated data. Together, these datasets and pipeline offer a practical, reproducible path toward scalable industrial benchmarks and training data from real-world documentation.

</details>


### [274] [SAVER: Selective Auditing of Verbal Evidence for Error Recovery in VLM Change Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22857)
*Youdi Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SAVER是一种轻量级、基于规则的错误恢复方法，通过解析VLM输出中的显式语言证据（如物体名称、颜色、空间位置）并在证据缺失或不一致时触发结构化重新提示，从而显著提升视觉变化推理任务的准确性，在CLEVR-Change上最高提升+25.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉变化推理任务中经常失败，但问题往往不在于视觉编码器缺乏信息，而在于模型无法在输出中表达所见内容。正确的VLM输出通常包含支持其论断的显式语言证据（物体名称、颜色、空间位置），而错误输出往往缺乏这些证据。作者希望利用这一可观察的规律来驱动错误检测和恢复。

Method: SAVER包含两个核心组件：（1）一种轻量级、基于规则的证据门控（evidence gate），用于解析VLM响应中是否存在支持其主张的显式语言证据，并判断证据是否缺失或不一致；（2）当证据缺失或不一致时，触发结构化重新提示（structured reprompting）引导模型修正输出。证据模式也可由LLM单次调用生成，替代手工设计的门控规则。通过消融实验验证证据门控本身（而非仅重新提示）是改进的关键驱动因素。

Result: 在三个变化检测基准和四个VLM上，SAVER显著提升了因表达失败（expression failures）导致错误的任务的准确性，在CLEVR-Change上最高获得+25.8%的提升。LLM生成的证据模式与手工调优的门控在CLEVR-Change上表现相当。消融实验确认证据门控而非重新提示本身驱动了性能提升。

Conclusion: VLM在变化推理中的许多错误源于其未能用语言表达所看到的内容（表达失败），而非视觉编码器信息不足。通过基于证据的语言解析门控选择性地触发重新提示，可以有效恢复此类错误。该方法是轻量级的、与模型无关的，且证据模式可自动化生成，为VLM错误恢复提供了一种低成本有效的方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) frequently fail at visual change reasoning, even when their vision encoders contain sufficient information. We observe that correct VLM outputs tend to contain explicit verbal evidence (object names, colors, spatial locations) that supports the claimed change, while incorrect outputs often lack such evidence. We propose SAVER (Selective Auditing of Verbal Evidence for Error Recovery), a lightweight, rule-based method that parses VLM responses for this evidence and triggers structured reprompting only when evidence is missing or inconsistent. Across three change detection benchmarks and four VLMs, SAVER significantly improves accuracy on tasks where errors stem from the model failing to articulate what it saw (expression failures), with gains up to +25.8% on CLEVR-Change. The evidence patterns can also be generated by an LLM in a single call, matching the hand-tuned gate on CLEVR-Change. Ablation experiments confirm that the evidence gate, not reprompting alone, drives the improvement.

</details>


### [275] [Better Retrieval, Worse Robustness:How Multi-hop RAG Amplifies Upstream ASR Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22872)
*Zhenghua Bao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文实证研究了ASR错误在语音驱动的多跳RAG系统中的传播与放大效应，发现实体图链接和迭代改写等结构化增强虽能保持较高绝对F1，但会放大ASR错误（与干净文本的F1差距比朴素稠密检索放大36-67%），且主导失败模式是查询实体损坏（占退化案例的87-96%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音应用先将口语查询通过ASR转化为文本，ASR错误作为固定的上游约束进入后续检索管道。现有RAG扩展（如实体图链接、迭代改写）在干净文本上表现优异，但其对ASR错误的鲁棒性尚未被系统验证，作者希望厘清结构化RAG扩展是吸收还是放大这些上游错误。

Method: 使用神经TTS合成四种英语口音，在三个多跳QA基准（HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue）上评估四种RAG配置，以干净文本为oracle。四种配置包括朴素稠密检索以及结合实体图链接和迭代改写两种扩展的组合。通过对比各配置在ASR输入与干净文本间的F1差距来量化误差传播；并对退化案例进行细粒度错误模式分析，测试两种轻量表层缓解手段。

Result: 结构化更强的RAG配置在保持更高绝对F1的同时系统性放大了ASR错误：在全部三个基准上，结合两种扩展的配置其干净文本到最高WER口音的F1差距比朴素稠密检索大36-67%。查询实体损坏是主导失败模式，占2WikiMultiHopQA上所有四种方法退化案例的87-96%。两种轻量表层缓解手段对剩余差距影响甚微。

Conclusion: 下游检索结构（实体图链接与迭代改写）会放大未被表面形式缓解消除的实体级ASR错误。这意味着针对语音查询的RAG系统设计需要将ASR错误视为结构性约束，而非简单地依赖更强的检索架构来弥补。作者已公开代码和数据以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Speech-based applications pass spoken queries through automatic speech recognition (ASR) before any retrieval module, so ASR errors enter the pipeline as a fixed upstream constraint. We empirically test whether two extensions to standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), entity-graph linking and iterative reformulation, absorb or amplify these errors. Using four English accents synthesized through neural TTS, we evaluate four RAG configurations on three multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue) against a clean-text oracle. Although the structurally richer configurations generally retain higher absolute F1 under ASR input, both extensions amplify the error: the F1 gap from clean text to the highest-WER accent is 36-67% larger under their combination than under naive dense retrieval, on all three benchmarks. The dominant failure mode is corruption of one or more query entities, accounting for 87-96% of degradation cases on 2WikiMultiHopQA across all four methods. Two lightweight surface-form mitigations leave most of the gap intact, indicating that downstream retrieval structure amplifies remaining entity errors. We release code and data at https://github.com/ZhenghuaBao/spoken-multihop-rag .

</details>


### [276] [AraDetox: A Multi-Dialect Arabic Detoxification Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22894)
*Mo El-Haj*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出AraDetox，一个多方言阿拉伯语去毒化数据集，包含10,500条有害社交媒体帖子和84,000条去毒化改写，由GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Flash生成，覆盖现代标准阿拉伯语、海湾、黎凡特和埃及方言。通过人工评估和自动分析验证，结果表明去毒化主要是一种保留语义的重写任务，并发现两种互补的净化方法：最小编辑词汇替换和保留语义的改写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语有害语言检测已得到广泛研究，但阿拉伯语文本去毒化（detoxification）仍未被充分探索，缺乏多方言的去毒化数据集和相关资源。

Method: 使用GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Flash对10,500条有害帖子生成84,000条去毒化改写，覆盖四种阿拉伯语方言（现代标准阿拉伯语、海湾、黎凡特和埃及）。通过人工评估、词汇变化、语义保持、情感和方言风格等自动分析进行质量验证。

Result: 去毒化本质上是保留语义的重写任务：大量词汇和结构重组伴随高语义相似度。人工评估确认了有害语言的有效去除和原义的保留。方言分析显示生成变体与参考阿拉伯语方言语料库具有可测量的文体对齐。与现有资源比较揭示了两种互补方法：最小编辑词汇替换与保留语义的改写。

Conclusion: 通过LLM辅助生成和人工验证可以构建大规模阿拉伯语去毒化资源，数据集已公开以支持阿拉伯语去毒化、安全文本生成和多方言阿拉伯语NLP的未来研究。

Abstract: Arabic harmful-language detection has received considerable attention, yet Arabic text detoxification remains underexplored. We introduce AraDetox, a multi-dialect Arabic detoxification dataset comprising 10,500 harmful social-media posts and 84,000 detoxified rewrites generated using GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash across Modern Standard Arabic, Gulf, Levantine, and Egyptian Arabic. The generated outputs were assessed through human evaluation and automatic analyses of lexical change, semantic preservation, sentiment, and dialectal style. Results show that detoxification is primarily a meaning-preserving rewriting task: substantial lexical and structural reformulation is accompanied by consistently high semantic similarity. Human evaluation confirms successful harmful-language removal while largely preserving the original meaning. Dialectal analyses further indicate that the generated variants exhibit measurable stylistic alignment with reference Arabic dialect corpora. Comparison with existing resources highlights two complementary approaches to detoxification: minimal-edit lexical substitution and meaning-preserving reformulation. Our findings demonstrate that large-scale Arabic detoxification resources can be constructed through LLM-assisted generation and human verification. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/ArabicNLP-UK/AraDetox to support future research on Arabic detoxification, safe text generation, and multi-dialect Arabic NLP.

</details>


### [277] [SelFusion: Self-distillation for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22898)
*Hyeongsoo Lim,Jinyoung Kim,Eunseo Seo,Minho Jang,Jiwon Yoon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SelFusion，一种针对扩散语言模型(DLM)的自蒸馏框架，通过双模式（硬模式与易模式）双向知识蒸馏，无需外部教师模型即可提升DLM生成质量，在指令遵循任务上优于使用外部LLM/DLM教师的蒸馏方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型能缓解自回归大语言模型的延迟瓶颈，但生成质量较差。知识蒸馏是提升性能的潜在方向，但实证发现朴素KD收效甚微甚至降低质量，因此需要一种无需外部教师模型的高效蒸馏方法。

Method: SelFusion采用自蒸馏框架：用不同掩码概率进行两次前向传播（掩码概率大的为硬模式，小的为易模式），在两个模式之间进行双向知识蒸馏，根据词元级别的正确性动态决定蒸馏方向，避免易模式在错误词元上过度自信的问题。

Result: 在指令遵循任务上，SelFusion显著优于其他使用外部LLM和DLM教师的蒸馏方法；在多数配置下，用SelFusion训练的学生模型甚至超越了LLM教师的性能。

Conclusion: SelFusion提供了一种无需外部教师模型即可有效提升DLM生成质量的实用路径，为扩散语言模型的性能改进提供了新方向。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) alleviate the inherent latency bottleneck of autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs), but their degraded generation quality limits practical applicability. Although knowledge distillation (KD) can be a promising direction for improving performance, we empirically find that naively applying conventional KD yields only marginal gains, or even degrades generation quality. Based on these observations, we propose a novel self-distillation framework for DLMs, namely SelFusion. To enable effective KD without an external teacher model, SelFusion performs two forward passes with different masking levels, defining the hard mode with a larger masking probability and the easy mode with a smaller masking probability. However, the easy mode is not always more accurate than the hard mode and can be overconfident on incorrect tokens. Thus, we introduce bidirectional KD between the two modes, which can dynamically determine the distillation direction based on token-level correctness. Experimental results on instruction-following tasks show that the proposed self-distillation substantially outperforms other KD methods with external LLM and DLM teachers. In many configurations, the student trained with SelFusion even surpasses the performance of the LLM teacher, providing a practical path toward improving DLM generation quality. Source code can be found at https://github.com/scai-research/SelFusion_official

</details>


### [278] [Do Spoken Language Models Hear Speech as They Read Text? Bridging Structural Gaps Between Speech and Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22908)
*Hyeonyu Kim,Hwayeon Kim,Youngwon Choi,Myeongkyun Cho,Huu-Kim Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个简单框架，通过解耦长度不匹配与语义对齐问题，鼓励语音与文本表示之间更紧密的对应关系，从而提升语音语言模型（SLM）的指令遵循能力和跨任务泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLM在指令遵循行为和跨任务泛化能力上弱于文本语言模型。分析发现，尽管下游性能强劲，当前SLM中语音与文本表示之间的对齐仍然较弱，结构性差异（连续、时变的语音与离散文本）尚未被充分解决。

Method: 提出一个简单框架，将长度不匹配（length mismatch）与语义对齐（semantic alignment）解耦，并鼓励语音与文本表示之间更紧密的对应关系。

Result: 在多个基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在强基线上取得了具有竞争力的性能，验证了在SLM训练中显式解决语音与文本结构差异的重要性。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了当前SLM中语音与文本表示对齐不足的问题，并提出解耦长度与语义对齐的策略来改善SLM的指令遵循和泛化能力，强调了显式处理模态结构差异在SLM训练中的关键作用。

Abstract: Spoken Language Models (SLMs) generate textual responses directly from speech, offering an alternative to cascaded systems. Despite recent advances, existing SLMs still exhibit weaker instruction-following behavior and limited generalization across diverse tasks compared to text-based language models. Our analysis shows that speech and text representations in current SLMs remain weakly aligned despite strong downstream performance, indicating that structural differences between continuous, temporally varying speech and discrete text remain insufficiently addressed. To address this, we propose a simple framework that decouples length mismatch from semantic alignment and encourages closer correspondence between speech and text representations. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against strong baselines, underscoring the importance of explicitly addressing structural differences between speech and text in SLM training. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jaykim9870/Do_SLMs_Hear_Speech_as_They_Read_Text.

</details>


### [279] [Exploring Dowker Homology for Sentence Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22909)
*Marius Huber,Juri Opitz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究Dowker同调能否捕捉句对相似度信息。通过将句子中token的嵌入视为成对点云，使用经/未经句相似度微调的Transformer模型，发现Dowker同调确实能捕捉句子相似度信息，并可用于相似度数据的可视化检查。作者还从Dowker同调中推导出单值摘要指标，这些指标表现合理但未超越基于标准池化方法的句子相似度度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索拓扑工具Dowker同调是否能够捕获句子对之间的语义相似度信息，为句子相似度分析提供新的拓扑视角，并使其易于实际应用。

Method: 将句子对的token嵌入视为公共潜在空间中的一对点云，使用经过和未经过句相似度微调的Transformer模型，通过将Dowker同调特征回归到真实相似度分数来评估其信息捕获能力；同时从Dowker同调中推导单数值摘要作为直接的相似度度量。

Result: Dowker同调能够捕获句子相似度信息（通过回归实验验证），可用于相似度数据和模型的可视化检查；单值摘要指标表现合理，但未能超越基于标准池化方法的相似度度量。

Conclusion: Dowker同调提供了捕捉句子相似度信息的拓扑方法，并具有可视化分析的附加价值，但作为直接相似度度量的单值摘要指标在性能上尚不优于传统池化方法。

Abstract: Dowker homology is a topological tool that may be used to analyze the relative position of two point clouds living in a common space. We investigate whether Dowker homology captures sentence similarity information by treating the embeddings of the tokens that constitute a sentence pair as a pair of point clouds in the latent space of a transformer model, using both models that have and have not been fine-tuned for sentence similarity. We find that Dowker homology captures sentence similarity information, as measured by regressing Dowker homology features onto ground-truth similarity scores, and that it can be used for visual inspection of similarity data and models. In an attempt to make Dowker homology readily applicable, we derive from it single-number summaries that we expect to capture sentence similarity directly. These turn out to work reasonably well, but without outperforming standard sentence similarity measures based on established pooling methods.

</details>


### [280] [Knowing Isn't Always Saying: When Do Spatial Encodings Reach Answers in Vision-Language Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22916)
*Zeyu Wang,Xinming Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过方向修补（direction patching）这一类别条件因果干预方法，系统研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）中空间编码信息何时何地影响答案输出，发现因果影响仅在中深层出现，文本思维链抑制即时运输而视觉接地提示保持开放，并将"编码-接地"差距重新定义为VLM中的条件运输问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管VLM已知会在隐状态中编码空间信息，但往往在回答时无法有效利用这些信息。此前研究不清楚编码的信息究竟在哪些层、哪些位置、哪些条件下才能最终影响答案。

Method: 提出方向修补（direction patching）方法，这是一种类别条件因果干预技术，应用于不同的层、token位置和提示格式。使用基于先前编码证据构建的空间ID方向（spatial-ID directions）进行干预分析，并在十个VLM上进行系统实验，辅以跨数据集、属性和编码振幅的补充实验。

Result: 发现因果影响仅在中间至深层深度出现；文本思维链（CoT）抑制大多数模型中即时对象词argmax级信息运输，而视觉接地提示保持运输通道开放；正向目标logit增益可能低于argmax阈值，运输可能在最终前缀token或更深层的答案步骤中重新出现。

Conclusion: 空间编码信息对答案的影响是有条件的、局部化的过程，研究者将"编码-接地"差距重新定义为VLM中的条件运输（conditional transport）问题，为理解和改进VLM空间推理提供了新的分析框架。

Abstract: Vision-language models are known to encode spatial information in their hidden states, yet often fail to use it when answering. However, it remains unclear when and where this encoded information reaches the answer. We address this with direction patching, a class-conditioned causal intervention applied across layers, token positions, and prompt formats. Using spatial-ID directions constructed following prior encoding evidence, we find that causal influence on answer logits emerges only at mid-to-deep depths. Text chain-of-thought suppresses immediate object-word argmax-level transport in most models, while visually grounded prompts keep it open. Positive target-logit gain can remain below the argmax threshold, and transport can re-emerge at the final prefix token or at the answer step in deeper layers. Across the ten VLMs we study, these local effects form descriptive transport patterns. Complementary experiments characterize how these patterns shift across datasets, attributes, and encoding amplitudes. Together, these results reframe the encoding-grounding gap as a problem of conditional transport in VLMs.

</details>


### [281] [TSWAP: A Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Thai Wellness Advisor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22917)
*Pornthep Ukosaramig,Kobkrit Viriyayudhakorn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍TSWAP，一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的多语言（8种语言）会话式健康顾问系统，它通过混合稠密-稀疏检索器和交叉编码器重排序，将未修改的开源大语言模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）锚定在基于泰国传统医学和认证健康服务提供者的约3.06万块知识库上。系统包含首轮查询分类器（强制工具检索）、规则安全层（医学范围控制与泰国紧急路由）、以及先翻译后检索的零样本多语言服务。作者发布泰国传统医学检索基准（50问，Recall@5=0.88）、生产QA日志（259例中91.1%测试-重测通过）和71问前沿无检索探针，并报告两个可迁移部署发现：英文校准的4-bit AWQ量化破坏泰语声调符号，以及强制检索路由对可靠锚定至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向多语言会话健康顾问场景，确保大语言模型在医疗领域提供可信、可验证、有循证依据的回答，同时覆盖泰国传统医学这一专业知识领域，并克服医疗大模型常见的幻觉与超范围应答问题。

Method: 采用RAG架构：以Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（vLLM部署）为后端模型，配合混合稠密-稀疏检索器与交叉编码器重排序；首轮查询分类器实现基于工具的强制实体查找路由；规则安全层限制医学范围并处理泰国紧急路由；八种语言通过先翻译后检索实现零样本服务。通过发布基准与探针实验系统评估各锚定组件（安全提示、知识库）的贡献。

Result: 检索基准Recall@5为0.88；生产QA日志测试-重测通过率91.1%（259例）；无检索探针实验显示：缺少安全提示时后端模型家族会给出完整药物剂量方案并遵从超范围请求，缺少知识库时产生零条可验证的服务提供者推荐；还发现英文校准的4-bit AWQ量化会破坏泰语声调符号。

Conclusion: TSWAP在实际部署中验证了RAG结合强制检索路由与规则安全层能够有效锚定医疗健康领域的多语言LLM系统，同时揭示了量化对低资源语言字符的破坏性影响以及检索路由对可靠锚定的关键必要性。

Abstract: We present TSWAP, a deployed eight-language conversational wellness advisor grounded, via retrieval-augmented generation, in a verified knowledge base of Thai traditional medicine and certified wellness providers. An unmodified open-weight LLM (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on vLLM) is grounded on a ~30.6K-chunk Thai index by a hybrid dense-sparse retriever with cross-encoder reranking; a first-turn query classifier forces tool-based retrieval for entity lookups; a rule-based safety layer enforces medical scope and Thai emergency routing; and all eight languages are served zero-shot with translate-then-retrieve. We release the first Thai traditional-medicine/wellness retrieval benchmark (50 questions with gold document IDs; Recall@5 = 0.88), production QA logs (91.1% test-retest pass over 259 cases), and a 71-question frontier no-retrieval probe showing what each grounding pillar contributes: without the safety prompt the backend model family produced a full drug-dosing schedule and complied with out-of-scope requests, and without the knowledge base it produced zero verifiable provider recommendations. We further report two transferable deployment findings: English-calibrated 4-bit AWQ quantization corrupts Thai tone marks, and forced-retrieval routing is necessary for reliable grounding.

</details>


### [282] [HelaBERT: Enhancing Sinhala Language Understanding with Dual Pooling Classification Head](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22922)
*Thisen Ekanayake,Nisansa de Silva*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出HelaBERT，一组基于BERT的僧伽罗语掩码语言模型（HelaBERT-Small约23.3M参数/6层，HelaBERT-Large约110M参数/12层），在约10亿token的僧伽罗语文本上从头预训练，采用针对僧伽罗语黏着形态和复杂文字定制的SentencePiece Unigram分词器（词表32,000）。在四个下游文本分类任务上评估，并提出了一种双池化分类头，在情感分析任务上取得了一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 僧伽罗语作为低资源语言，缺乏专门预训练的语言模型，现有的多语言模型在僧伽罗语上性能有限。作者旨在从头构建首个专门针对僧伽罗语的BERT模型，以更有效地处理其黏着语形态和复杂文字系统，推动该语言的NLP研究发展。

Method: 1）从MADLAD-400、CulturaX及自定义语料（新闻文章、僧伽罗语维基百科、网络爬取数据）收集约10亿token的僧伽罗语文本；2）设计两个规模的BERT模型：Small（6层，23.3M参数）和Large（12层，110M参数）；3）使用针对僧伽罗语形态定制的SentencePiece Unigram分词器（词表32,000）；4）提出双池化（dual pooling）分类头；5）在四个下游任务（新闻类别分类、新闻来源分类、情感分析、写作风格分类）上以5次独立随机种子实验、80/20分层训练/测试划分进行全面评估。

Result: 双池化分类头在情感分析任务上取得一致改进，在HelaBERT-Small的新闻类别分类上获得中度提升；而标准[CLS]-线性头在新闻来源分类（短平均输入长度的标题级任务）上仍具竞争力。模型已开源发布。

Conclusion: HelaBERT为僧伽罗语NLP提供了首个专用预训练模型系列，验证了定制分词器和双池化分类头在低资源语种上的有效性。两个模型均已开源以支持后续研究，为该语言社区提供了基础资源。

Abstract: We present HelaBERT, a family of two BERT-based masked language models pre-trained from scratch on approximately 1 billion tokens of Sinhala text sourced from MADLAD-400, CulturaX, and a custom corpus comprising news articles, Sinhala Wikipedia, and web crawl data. HelaBERT-Small (~23.3M parameters, 6 layers) and HelaBERT-Large (~110M parameters, 12 layers) both use a SentencePiece Unigram tokenizer (vocabulary size 32,000) tailored to Sinhala's agglutinative morphology and complex script. We evaluate both models on four downstream Sinhala text classification tasks: news category classification, news source classification, sentiment analysis, and writing style classification, using 5 independent seed runs with stratified 80/20 train/test splits. We additionally propose a dual pooling classification head and evaluate it systematically across all four tasks, finding consistent improvements on sentiment analysis and a moderate gain on news category classification for HelaBERT-Small, while the standard [CLS]-linear head remains competitive on news source classification, a headline-level task with short average input length. We release both models to support further research in Sinhala NLP.

</details>


### [283] [What Proves You Wrong: Benchmarking Language Models on Falsifiable Research Ideation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22948)
*Ziyue Wang,Aomufei Yuan,Yiran Yao,Linli Yao,Hongyao Zuo,Ziwen Gong,Yuanxin Liu,Shicheng Li,Yishuo Cai,Tong Yang,Xu Sun,Xiaohui Li,Haoli Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Lit2Test基准，通过六字段契约和证伪性观察使研究提案质量可判定而非仅可争论，并基于200篇真实论文邻域对四个前沿模型进行1,200次双盲成对比较，在所有10,000次自助法重采样中稳定恢复严格排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于提出研究想法，但现有的评判方式缺乏共享的决策规则：自由形式的评判受风格和位置影响，而对照后续论文评分则只奖励恢复某一条已实现轨迹。作者希望建立一个使研究提案质量"可判定"而非"可争论"的基准。

Method: Lit2Test基准围绕六字段契约设计，以证伪性观察为核心，使每个提案预先承诺能证明其错误的观察结果。基准前瞻性地从200个真实论文邻域构建，从四个前沿模型获取提案，并通过1,200次双向盲审的成对比较进行评估。协议通过诊断性对照和有界人工校准来审计自身可靠性，三名标注者在明确声明的可靠性范围内佐证结论。

Result: Lit2Test在所有10,000次自助法重采样中恢复了四个模型的严格排序，且这种区分源自所提出测试与指标的质量而非表面流畅性。

Conclusion: 作者发布了该基准、构建流水线及审计工件供公众使用，表明基于证伪性契约的评判框架可以可靠地区分LLM提出的研究想法质量。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to propose research ideas, yet the prevailing ways of judging such ideas supply no shared decision rule: free-form judging sways with style and position, and scoring against a later paper rewards recovery of one realized trajectory. We introduce a benchmark that carries a proposal from Literature to Test: the Lit2Test benchmark centers on a six-field contract organized around a falsifying outcome, so that every proposal precommits the observation that would prove it wrong, making its quality decidable in the first place rather than merely arguable. Built prospectively from 200 real-paper neighborhoods, Lit2Test elicits proposals from four frontier models and compares them through 1,200 pairwise comparisons judged blind in both presentation orders. The protocol audits its own reliability through diagnostic controls and bounded human calibration, with three annotators corroborating the conclusions within explicitly stated reliability bounds. Lit2Test recovers a strict ranking of the four models in all 10,000 bootstrap replicates, and the separation comes from the quality of the proposed tests and metrics rather than from surface fluency. We release the benchmark, construction pipeline, and audit artifacts for public use.

</details>


### [284] [The Illusion of Control: Why Bare Classifier Inversion Silently Fails in Concept-Bottleneck Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22956)
*Qi Bing,Xiaowei Shao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究概念瓶颈文本生成在多轴组合泛化下的推理时代码获取问题，比较了分类器反演、参考文本编码和后验标签条件先验三种方案，发现所有反演变体均不如简单的后验先验方法，且裸反演会因偏离流形而静默退化为随机猜测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念瓶颈可控生成在部署时需要从目标属性配置合成低维概念代码，但概念代码无法直接施加语言模型流畅性约束，反演正则化需将代码约束向编码器的训练分布。如何在推理时可靠地获取概念代码，特别是在多轴组合泛化场景下，是一个尚未解决的问题。

Method: 在概念瓶颈文本生成框架下，比较三种推理时代码获取方式：针对编码器头的分类器反演、参考文本编码、以及后验标签条件先验。对反演方法测试裸形式和三种正则化变体：标签无关与标签条件的马氏距离惩罚，以及条件归一化流密度基线。

Result: 在跨越1.24亿到80亿参数的三个骨干家族上，所有反演变体的性能均不及在相同检查点上对每组合编码器均值拟合的简单后验先验。裸分类器反演会静默塌缩至随机猜测，可通过直接测量的离流形代码追溯到原因。

Conclusion: 反演方法在概念瓶颈文本生成中不可靠，后验标签条件先验是更优的推理时代码获取策略；并在真实基准和外部评估下验证了诊断结果，支持与已有基线进行公平比较。

Abstract: Concept-bottleneck controllable generation routes multi-attribute control through a low-dimensional concept code that, at deployment, must be synthesised from a target attribute configuration. We study this problem in concept-bottleneck text generation under multi-axis compositional generalisation, comparing three ways to obtain the inference-time code: classifier inversion against the encoder heads, reference-text encoding, and a post-hoc label-conditioned prior. Since a concept code admits no direct LM-fluency term, regularising inversion must instead constrain the code toward the encoder's training distribution. We therefore test bare inversion and three regularised variants: label-agnostic and label-conditioned Mahalanobis penalties, and a conditional normalising-flow density baseline. Every inversion variant we test underperforms a simple post-hoc prior fitted to per-combination encoder means on the same checkpoints, across three backbone families spanning $124$M to $8$B parameters. The bare form of classifier inversion also silently collapses to chance, traceable to a directly measured off-manifold code. We validate this diagnosis on real-world benchmarks and under external evaluators, enabling fair comparison with published baselines.

</details>


### [285] [Closed-Loop Bayesian Molecular Inverse Design with Semantic LLM Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22967)
*Yaoyao Xu,Xinjian Zhao,Xiaozhuang Song,Lei Bai,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出MolQA，一种闭环分子反设计框架，将预训练大语言模型作为替代模型，直接在原始文本形式（任务指令、SMILES优化历史、oracle反馈）上进行推理，输出结构化的决策信号（参考分子选择+可选引导句）来指导冻结的分子生成器完成候选池富集，在有限oracle预算下提升目标性质匹配率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际分子反设计通常是闭环候选池富集问题，而非一次性生成问题。标准高斯过程贝叶斯优化在压缩连续嵌入空间中操作，丢弃了化学家依赖的子结构信息和参考相似性信号，无法有效指导"下一步该看哪里"。

Method: 提出MolQA框架，将设计选择的焦点从生成器转移到替代模型。具体而言：使用冻结的大语言模型直接对任务指令、SMILES级优化历史和oracle反馈的原始文本形式进行推理；每次迭代输出结构化决策信号（在探索-利用原则下选择信息量大的参考分子，可选附上简明引导句）；该信号转化为下一轮生成器的条件文本，形成自然语言可检查的优化轨迹。

Result: 在MolQA药物设计和材料设计任务上的实验表明：该方法优于一次性提示方法，与基于GP的BO基线相当或更强；同时揭示了领域相关的接口差异——对二元药物靶标，仅参考分子迁移效果最好；对连续材料性质，添加简明替代模型摘要更有益。

Conclusion: 大语言模型替代模型驱动的闭环分子反设计框架是可行的，且替代模型与生成器的交互接口设计（参考迁移vs摘要引导）具有领域依赖性，为分子设计中的LLM应用提供了新的设计维度。

Abstract: Practical molecular inverse design is rarely a one-shot generation problem; it often takes the form of closed-loop candidate-pool enrichment, where under a limited oracle budget the goal is to \emph{increase the fraction of generated molecules that match a desired property profile}. Bayesian optimization (BO) offers a natural framework for this setting, yet standard Gaussian-process surrogates typically operate in compressed continuous embeddings, which discard the substructural and reference-similarity signals that chemists naturally use to decide where to look next. We propose \textbf{\method}, a closed-loop framework in which the surrogate, rather than the generator, is treated as the locus of design choice, and instantiate it with a frozen large language model that reasons directly over the task instruction, SMILES-level optimization history, and oracle feedback in their native textual form. At each iteration, the surrogate returns a structured decision signal that selects informative reference molecules under an exploration and exploitation principle, optionally with a concise guidance sentence. This signal is converted into next-round conditioning text for a frozen molecular generator, yielding an inspectable optimization trace in natural language. Experiments on MolQA drug and material design tasks show that \method improves over one-shot prompting, is competitive with or stronger than GP-based BO baselines, and reveals a domain-dependent interface: reference-only transfer works best for binary drug targets, while adding a concise surrogate summary is more beneficial for continuous material

</details>


### [286] [What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22985)
*Zhiwei Gao,Shaowen Peng,Shoko Wakamiya,Eiji Aramaki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文引入跨编码转向评估（Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation）方法，揭示激活转向（activation steering）方法的效果可能并非反映预期的语义判断，而更可能是对答案提取索引（如A/B/C等标号）的跟随。在NormBank数据集上，对比激活加法（CAA）在不同答案重新编码后主要跟随提取索引而非语义标签，该效应主要出现在较深层，且一个仅占15.4%平方范数的低秩输出敏感成分保留了96.3%的效果。ITI风格方法同样表现出此倾向，但不同数据集（MNLI和SC101）表现不同，多选题与开放式评估可能得出不同的行为结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活转向评估仅在构造方向时使用的同一答案编码下进行，导致报告的性能提升可能源于干预对答案标识符（如A/B/C）的兼容性，而非对语义判断的真实控制。为了区分"真正的语义跟随"与"提取索引跟随"，需要一种能在冻结干预的同时重新编码答案的评估方法。

Method: 提出Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation方法：冻结干预方向，将相同保留集项目上的答案重新编码（如改变标识符映射、词汇表或行序），比较目标与源答案的得分变化。在NormBank、MNLI、Social Chemistry 101三个数据集上，对CAA和ITI两类转向方法进行跨层、跨编码的系统评估，并引入低秩输出敏感成分分析。

Result: 在NormBank上，CAA在标识符（A/B/C↔X/Y/Z↔1/2/3）重新分配后，提取索引引起的得分变化大于语义标签；效应随行列顺序变化不大，主要出现在深层；低秩成分（15.4%平方范数）保留96.3%效应。ITI方法同样表现出提取索引偏向。MNLI偏向提取索引跟随，SC101偏向语义标签跟随，多选题与开放题评价结论不一致。

Conclusion: 激活转向在特定答案编码下报告的性能提升不足以证明干预真正控制了预期的语义判断，需要跨编码评估来识别干预的实际受控对象，否则可能高估或误判转向方法的能力。

Abstract: Activation steering is often evaluated under the answer encoding used to construct the direction. A reported gain may reflect the intended judgment or compatibility with answer identifiers seen during construction. We introduce Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation, which freezes an intervention while re-encoding answers to the same held-out items. On NormBank, after A/B/C identifiers are reassigned, contrastive activation addition (CAA) induces larger target-versus-source score changes for the extraction indices than for the semantic labels under the new mapping. We call this extraction-index following. Varying identifier vocabulary (A/B/C, X/Y/Z, or 1/2/3) and row order shows that the effect tracks extraction index rather than row position. After matching direction norms across layers, extraction-index following emerges mainly at later depths. A low-rank output-sensitive component containing 15.4% of the direction's squared norm retains 96.3% of this effect. An Inference-Time Intervention (ITI)-style method also favors extraction-index over semantic-label following on NormBank in three models. In aggregate, MNLI favors extraction-index following, whereas Social Chemistry 101 (SC101) favors semantic-label following. Multiple-choice and open-ended evaluations can yield different behavioral conclusions. Thus, a steering gain under one answer encoding does not by itself identify what the intervention controls.

</details>


### [287] [LLM Pedagogical Behavior in AI Tutoring Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22993)
*Suhyeon Lee,Juneha Baek,Jaehyeong Park,Donghyuk Shin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个五级脚手架水平量表来衡量LLM作为辅导教师时提供直接帮助的程度，并将其应用于203名大学生在AI课程中的14,637条LLM响应。研究发现超过95%的响应被归类为"解释"或"解决"等高帮助级别，脚手架水平与学生后续对话行为系统相关，但对三次考试成绩的预测能力有限（不优于先前成绩和对话行为）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学生越来越多地使用LLM作为辅导教师，但对LLM在真实学习交互中提供的帮助程度知之甚少。辅导响应在帮助学生完成任务方面的直接程度差异很大，而缺乏系统性的测量框架来量化这种差异，因此需要开发一个有效的度量工具来建立经验基线。

Method: 研究者将辅导帮助的直接程度操作化为"脚手架水平"（scaffolding level），开发了一个五级量表，并通过人类标注验证其有效性。随后将该量表应用于从203名大学AI课程学生收集的14,637条LLM响应，分析脚手架水平的分布情况，并考察其与学生对话行为及后续三次考试成绩的关联。

Result: 响应高度集中在高帮助级别，超过95%被分类为"解释"或"解决"级别。脚手架水平与学生后续对话行为存在系统性关联，但对三次考试成绩的预测几乎不提供超出先前成绩和对话行为之外的新增信息。

Conclusion: 研究为LLM在辅导交互中的帮助程度建立了经验基线，提供了一个测量框架，可用来评估替代性辅导设计如何改变LLM提供的帮助水平。同时提示脚手架水平对学业成绩的直接预测价值有限，可能需要在教学设计中综合考虑其他因素。

Abstract: Students increasingly use LLMs as tutors for coursework and problem solving. Little is known about the level of assistance LLMs provide when students use them as tutors in authentic learning interactions. This matters because tutoring responses can differ substantially in how directly they help students complete a task. We operationalize this dimension as scaffolding level and develop a five-level scale, validated against human annotations, that characterizes responses according to the degree of direct assistance they provide. We apply the scale to 14,637 LLM responses from 203 students in a university AI course. Responses are overwhelmingly concentrated at high levels of assistance, with more than 95% classified as either Explaining or Solving. Scaffolding level is systematically associated with students' subsequent conversational behavior, but provides little additional predictive information about performance on three subsequent exams beyond prior achievement and dialogue behavior. These findings provide an empirical baseline for LLM assistance in tutoring interactions and a measurement framework for evaluating how alternative tutoring designs change that assistance.

</details>


### [288] [Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23020)
*Xunlei Chen,Qirui Ye,Yuang Li,Yi Gong,Zhaokun Wang,Wenyi Li,Shiyao Guo,Jinyu Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ADU是一种基于训练的细粒度遗忘框架，通过解耦上下文注意力路径而非消除token，在TOFU和WMDP基准上取得了最佳综合性能，同时保留了87-98%的模型效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型需要有效的遗忘机制以应对隐私法规和安全问题。现有基于序列和token级别的方法只惩罚目标输出，没有对其依赖上下文的检索路径进行建模，可能导致语言结构被破坏或误伤良性知识。

Method: ADU将遗忘从token擦除转变为上下文注意力路径解耦。它利用局部和全局注意力头的功能差异，识别出检索敏感锚点的预规划位置，并在原模型下固定候选路径；随后训练注意力投影适配器来抑制这些路径上的注意力集中度，同时保留局部注意力结构和保留集语言建模。训练后通过激活交换测试来验证修改后的注意力输出模块是否有效传递了学习到的遗忘效果。

Result: 在TOFU和WMDP基准上，ADU在评估基线中取得了最强的综合性能，TOFU上遗忘质量为0.93；保留了87-98%的模型效用（平均92.9%，基线为81.9%），同时减少了良性上下文中的副作用。

Conclusion: ADU通过细粒度的注意力路径解耦实现了精准遗忘与通用能力保持的良好平衡，为LLM遗忘提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require effective unlearning to address privacy regulations and safety concerns. However, achieving precise forgetting without compromising general utility remains challenging. Existing sequence- and token-level methods penalize target outputs without modeling their context-dependent retrieval paths, which can disrupt linguistic structure or suppress benign knowledge. We present ADU, a fine-grained, training-based framework that shifts unlearning from token erasure to contextual attention-pathway decoupling. Exploiting the functional distinction between local and global attention heads, ADU identifies preplan positions that retrieve persistent sensitive anchors and fixes their candidate paths under the original model. It then trains attention-projection adapters to suppress attention mass along these paths while preserving local-attention structure and retain-set language modeling. Post-training activation exchange tests whether the modified attention-output module transmits the learned forgetting effect. ADU achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated baselines on the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks, including a Forget Quality of (0.93) on TOFU. It preserves 87--98% of model utility (92.9% on average versus 81.9% for baselines) while reducing side effects in benign contexts.

</details>


### [289] [Most of the LLM routing gap is task type](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23023)
*Janghoon Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文质疑LLM路由器（LLM router）的实际价值。通过对14个模型、294道题、7种任务类型和3种语言的完整矩阵实验（两次运行），发现5.37%的模型-问题对存在运行间评分波动。在要求两次运行都答对的严格标准下，只有29道题可通过路由优化，其中21道可通过简单静态的任务类型-模型映射解决，按语言拆分可再多解决2道，仅剩6道需要学习型路由器。静态路由表以更低成本（3.33 vs 7.69美元/次）胜过最佳单一模型，且文章认为此前报道的路由器收益可能只是运行噪声的假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作表明各种LLM路由器方法性能相近且远低于理论上限，甚至学习型路由器常无法胜过简单调用最强模型。作者想探究这些被路由错过的问题有何共性，并质疑已报道的路由性能提升是否只是实验噪声。

Method: 设置14个模型回答294道题（7种任务类型×3种语言：韩语、英语、印地语），将整个矩阵完整运行两次且不改变任何设置。采用"两次运行均答对才算正确"的更严格评分标准，对比单模型最优、静态任务类型映射路由、按语言拆分映射路由以及学习型路由器的效果。

Result: 两次运行间有5.37%的模型-问题对评分不一致（正常噪声水平）。在严格标准下仅29道题可被路由优化；其中21道可通过任务类型静态映射解决，再按语言拆分可解决23道，仅剩6/294道需要学习型路由器。这些可优化问题数少于运行间噪声。静态路由表以3.33美元/次回答262/294道题，优于最佳单模型的245道、7.69美元/次。

Conclusion: 路由器的收益空间远小于以往研究假设，且以往报道的小幅提升很可能被运行噪声所解释。简单静态规则即可接近路由上限，学习型路由器的额外价值微乎其微。作者同时指出所有评估都在同一294道题上拟合和打分，无留出集，结果需谨慎解读。

Abstract: An LLM router picks which model should answer each query. The appeal is that models fail on different questions. Whatever single model is best overall still gets some wrong, and another model in the pool gets many of those right. Getting that choice right every time is the ceiling, and a router is an attempt to approach it.
  However, recent work reports that routers do not get close. Across 21 routing methods on five benchmarks, sharply different designs land within a fraction of a point of each other, and all of them stay far below that ceiling. Learned routers often fail to beat simply always calling the strongest model.
  We ask what those missed questions have in common. We set fourteen models to answer all 294 questions, with 7 task types across 3 languages: Korean, English and Hindi. We ran the whole matrix twice, changing nothing, but 5.37% of the 4,116 model-question pairs came out scored differently anyway. Run-to-run movement like that is normal, and we argue that a small win does not show that routing did anything, ours or anyone else's.
  Counting an answer correct only when the model got it right in both runs, 29 questions on this matrix can be improved with routing. Every correct-answer count here is on that rule. Task type accounts for most of them: assigning each task type one model in advance, chosen once and never updated, improves 21 of the 29. Splitting each task type by language improves 2 more and leaves 6 of 294 unoptimized. That handful is what a learned router would have been built for, and it is smaller than the run-to-run movement above, which is a share of pairs rather than of questions. The static table we adopted answers 262 of 294 questions at $3.33 per run, against the best single model's 245 at $7.69.
  All of this is fitted and scored on the same 294 questions with no holdout.

</details>


### [290] [Beyond Surface Cues: Disentangling Sociocultural Signals in Multilingual LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23026)
*Yuanjun Feng,Tanzhou Liu,Stefan Feuerriegel,Yash Raj Shrestha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种人类验证的多智能体审计框架，用于分离多语言LLM输出中的三类问题：社会偏见再现、身份群体差异表征、跨文化模式。通过对12个LLM在英语、法语、中文三种语言下89,253个输出的分析，发现偏见表征随语言和任务系统性变化，且文化语境信号的真实性需要经过翻译和掩码姓名等控制手段来验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言LLM的输出在不同社会文化语境中可能存在差异，但现有的文化接地（cultural grounding）证据可能是误导性的——显式或间接文本线索可被用于推断身份标签，而姓名和措辞可能泄露源语言。将这些表层信号误当作文化接地证据会掩盖潜在偏见，因此需要一种方法将这些捷径与有意义的文化模式区分开来。

Method: 提出一个人工验证的多智能体审计框架，区分三个独立问题：（1）输出是否再现社会偏见；（2）身份群体是否被差异化表征；（3）输出是否反映跨文化模式。研究覆盖12个LLM、3种语言（英语、法语、中文）、18种职业和3种任务条件，共分析89,253个输出。通过翻译和掩码姓名等控制手段，结合自动评分与人类评分的一致性验证。

Result: 消除直接身份线索后，英语和中文的身份标签预测能力显著下降，但法语下降幅度小得多。在所有语言-体裁组合中，源语言关联的文化语境获得最高平均相关性评分，自动与人类评分中度一致。然而，翻译后源语言识别能力大幅下降，掩码姓名后进一步下降。这表明无控制的审计可能将表层线索误认为文化理解。

Conclusion: 多语言审计中若无翻译和掩码姓名等控制手段，可能会将表层线索（如姓名和措辞）误认为文化理解，导致关于跨文化差异和偏见的误导性结论。该审计框架为区分这些捷径与更有意义的跨文化模式提供了实用方法。

Abstract: Multilingual LLM outputs can vary across sociocultural contexts. However, evidence of cultural grounding can be misleading: identity labels may be inferred from explicit or indirect textual cues, while names and wording can reveal the source language. Treating all these signals as evidence of cultural grounding may obscure potential biases. We present a human-validated, multi-agent audit that separates three questions: whether outputs reproduce social biases, whether identity groups are represented differently, and whether outputs reflect cross-cultural patterns. The study analyzes 89,253 outputs from 12 LLMs in English, French, and Chinese, spanning 18 occupations and three task conditions.
  We find that bias representation varies systematically across languages and tasks. Removing direct identity cues sharply reduces identity-label prediction in English and Chinese, but has a much smaller effect in French. Across all language-genre settings, the cultural context associated with the source language receives the highest average relevance score, with moderate agreement between automated and human ratings. However, the ability to identify the source language drops substantially after translation and again after masking names. Without these controls, multilingual audits may mistake surface cues for cultural understanding, leading to misleading conclusions about cross-cultural variation and bias. Our audit offers a practical framework for separating such shortcuts from more meaningful cross-cultural patterns.

</details>


### [291] [Meta-Moderator: Empowering Multi-Agent Debate with Meta-Cognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23029)
*Wentao Hu,Zhuoyue Wan,Jinhao Shen,Chen Jason Zhang,Xiaoyong Wei,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Meta-Moderator，一个可学习的元认知框架，通过监督辩论效用、控制辩论进程并裁决最终答案，动态调节多智能体辩论过程。它独立于辩论者进行训练，采用结果驱动的策略优化，使辩论调节成为显式能力而非提示的副产品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体辩论能通过激发多样假设和批评来提升大语言模型推理能力，但现有管线常受限于弱调节机制——固定预算、基于一致性的停止或未经训练的裁判，导致冗余辩论和不可靠的证据聚合。作者旨在将调节视为元认知过程，解决现有调节方式效率低、泛化差的问题。

Method: 引入Meta-Moderator，一个可学习框架，包含三个核心功能：监测辩论效用（monitoring）、控制辩论过程（controlling）、裁决最终答案（adjudicating）。它通过结果驱动的策略优化训练，且训练过程独立于参与辩论的模型，使辩论调节成为一项显式习得的能力。

Result: 在5个基准测试中，Meta-Moderator优于广泛使用的决策层（如固定预算、一致停止、未经训练的裁判），并能跨任务和系统配置迁移。进一步分析显示，它能更具选择性地分配辩论资源，并在信息丰富假设出现后减少错误聚合。

Conclusion: 将辩论调节从启发式规则提升为可学习的元认知能力，能够显著改善多智能体辩论的效率与可靠性，且具有良好的跨任务和跨配置泛化能力。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate can improve large language model reasoning by eliciting diverse hypotheses and critiques, yet its performance is often constrained by weak moderation. Common pipelines rely on fixed budgets, agreement-based stopping, or untrained judges, leading to redundant deliberation and unreliable evidence aggregation. We cast moderation as a meta-cognitive process, monitoring debate utility, controlling deliberation, and adjudicating a final answer, and introduce Meta-Moderator, a learnable framework that dynamically regulates debate and decides when to finalize an answer. Meta-Moderator is trained independently of the debaters via outcome-driven policy optimization, making debate regulation an explicit capability rather than an incidental effect of prompting. Across five benchmarks, Meta-Moderator outperforms widely used decision layers and transfers across tasks and system configurations. Further analyses show that it allocates debate more selectively and reduces mis-aggregation after informative hypotheses appear.

</details>


### [292] [The Multilingual FrameNet Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23037)
*Beatrice Fiumanò,Nicolas Lazzari,Simone Paolo Ponzetto,Valentina Presutti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了多语言FrameNet语料库(mFNC)，通过整合九种语言的现有语料库扩展了英语Berkeley FrameNet，训练的多语言框架语义解析器在多项任务中超越了现有最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Frame Semantic Parsing工作主要集中在英语上，缺乏多语言数据资源，限制了框架语义解析在多语言场景下的性能。作者希望通过构建多语言语料库来弥补这一空白。

Method: 作者构建了mFNC语料库，将英语Berkeley FrameNet语料库与九种语言（巴西葡萄牙语、中文、荷兰语、法语、德语、意大利语、韩语、拉脱维亚语和瑞典语）的现有语言专属语料库进行收集和整合。并在该语料库上训练了采用不同架构的框架语义解析模型。

Result: 在mFNC上训练的模型在多语言和跨语言设置下均一致性地超越了现有的最先进框架语义解析器，验证了多语言训练数据的重要性。

Conclusion: 多语言训练数据对提升框架语义解析性能具有显著价值，mFNC作为开源资源（提供于GitHub）将推动该领域的进一步研究。

Abstract: This paper introduces the Multilingual FrameNet Corpus (mFNC), a novel resource that extends the English Berkeley FrameNet corpus by collecting and harmonizing existing language-specific corpora across nine additional languages: Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Korean, Latvian and Swedish. By training models that rely on different architectures on the mFNC, we consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art Frame Semantic Parsers in both multilingual and cross-lingual settings, underscoring the importance of multilingual training data. The mFNC and our trained FSP models are openly available at https://github.com/beatrice-f/mFNC.

</details>


### [293] [Beyond Verdicts: A Graph-Based Analysis of Human and LLM Reasoning in Scientific Fact-Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23047)
*Abdul Ghafoor,Muhammad Arslan Manzoor,Yufang Hou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于图的可推理框架（类型化推理图），用于在科学事实核查中比较人类专家与大语言模型（LLM）的推理路径。通过将解释建模为连接虚假主张与研究发现、谬误支持前提及谬误标签的推理图，实现人类与LLM在谬误子图层面的一对一对齐。在MISSCIPLUS数据集上评估GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.7和Qwen3-32B，发现三个模型各有优劣：Qwen3-32B判错率最低、GPT-5人类对齐性最高、Claude Opus 4.7在成功案例中推理有效但判定预测较弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动事实核查系统虽然能判断错误主张并生成解释，但无法说明模型是否遵循与人类专家相同的推理路径，还是通过其他有效但不同的路径得出结论。这限制了核查系统的可信度和可解释性。

Method: 引入类型化推理图框架，将每条解释建模为从虚假主张到研究背景、研究发现、谬误支持前提和谬误标签的推理图，支持在谬误特定子图层面进行人类与LLM的一对一对齐。对于未人类对齐的LLM推理路径，进一步验证其在引用研究中的基础性、与主张的相关性以及对判定结论的充分性。使用MISSCIPLUS中84条虚假主张，在多种提示词和证据设置下评估三个LLM。

Result: 三个模型在不同维度表现各异：Qwen3-32B的判定失败率最低；GPT-5的人类推理对齐性最高；Claude Opus 4.7的判定预测能力较弱，但在成功判定案例中往往呈现有效的推理路径。

Conclusion: 该图框架能够揭示不同LLM在事实核查中的推理行为差异，表明"正确判定"与"人类对齐的推理"是两个独立且重要的评估维度，为LLM在科学事实核查中的可信度提供了更细粒度的分析手段。

Abstract: Misinformation that cites legitimate papers can be especially harmful when it distorts what those studies actually report. While existing automatic fact-checking systems based on large language models (LLMs) can assess whether a model assigns an Incorrect verdict and can gen- erate explanations for that decision, they typi- cally do not indicate whether the model follows the same reasoning path as human experts or arrives at the verdict through a different but still valid path. In this work, we introduce a graph- based framework (typed reasoning graph) for comparing human and LLM reasoning paths in scientific fact-checking. Building on prior work on fallacious reasoning in biomedical misinformation, MISSCIPLUS (Glockner et al., 2025), we model each explanation as a rea- soning graph that links the false claim to the relevant study context, study findings, fallacy- supporting premises, and fallacy labels. This representation enables one-to-one alignment of human and LLM reasoning at the level of fallacy-specific sub-graphs. For non-human- aligned LLM paths, we validate grounding in the cited study, relevance to the claim, and suf- ficiency for the verdict. Using 84 false claims from MISSCIPLUS, we evaluate GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Qwen3-32B across prompt and evidence settings. Results show distinct perfor- mance dimensions: Qwen3-32B has the lowest verdict failure rate, GPT-5 the highest human alignment, and Claude Opus 4.7 weak verdict prediction but often valid reasoning in success- ful cases

</details>


### [294] [Signal or Noise? A Benchmark Study of Agent Skills in Web Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23067)
*Ziyue Yang,Fan Ding*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出WebDev-Skills-Bench基准，通过对31个Web开发技能、50个项目和1000个有序任务的受控实证研究，发现注入Agent Skill平均会降低Pass@2达1.3%-4.2%、增加72%-394%的token成本，并区分了"长度干扰"和"内容误导"两种失败模式，表明Skill应被视为特定"技能-项目-模型"三元组的假设而非便携资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent Skills作为可复用的过程模块正被广泛注入到编码代理会话中，但每次注入都会膨胀每次查询的提示词。现有基准只评估代理能否解决任务，却未回答更关键的问题：该Skill是否应该被注入。因此需要一个能区分Skill真实效果与提示长度伪影的基准。

Method: 构建WebDev-Skills-Bench基准，包含31个公开Web开发Skill、50个Web-Bench项目和1000个有序任务。设计了四种匹配条件（含长度匹配的无关对照组和留一法组件消融），仅将SKILL.md放入提示词而将辅助文件挂载到工作区以隔离Skill效果与提示长度伪影，在四个模型上系统评估。

Result: 目标Skill注入使平均Pass@2降低1.3%-4.2%，降低任务完成深度，并将token成本增加72%-394%，仅在17%-36%的技能-项目对中带来收益。长度匹配对照组揭示两种失败模式：长度干扰型模型因等长无关Skill产生大部分损失；内容误导型模型中提示长度中性但Skill内容仍使Pass@2降低1.1%-1.4%。损失集中在简单早期任务，Skill排名跨模型迁移性弱，反模式规则优于示例密集型内容。

Conclusion: 匹配的Skill本质上是关于特定"技能-项目-模型"三元组的假设而非可移植资产，应将注入视为每次部署的路由决策。长度匹配对照和逐模型审计应成为Agent Skill评估的最低标准。

Abstract: Agent Skills are reusable procedural modules that are increasingly injected into coding-agent sessions to encode framework conventions, anti-patterns, and reusable tools. However, because each injected Skill expands the prompt of every query, an effective Skill benchmark must determine not only whether an agent can solve a task, but whether the Skill should have been injected at all. We introduce WebDev-Skills-Bench and use it for a controlled empirical study of 31 public WebDev Skills on 50 Web-Bench projects and 1,000 ordered tasks. The benchmark compares four matched conditions, including a length-matched irrelevant control and leave-one-out component ablations. To isolate Skill effects from prompt-length artifacts, we place only SKILL.md in the prompt while mounting auxiliary files into the agent workspace. Across four models, target Skill injection reduces mean Pass@2 by 1.3% to 4.2%, lowers task completion depth, and increases token cost by 72% to 394%, with gains in only 17% to 36% of Skill-project pairs. Length-matched controls reveal two failure modes: some models are length-distracted, where an equally long irrelevant Skill reproduces most of the loss, while others are content-misled, where prompt length is neutral but Skill content still lowers Pass@2 by 1.1% to 1.4%. Further analysis shows that losses concentrate on easy early tasks, Skill rankings transfer weakly across models, and anti-pattern rules outperform example-heavy content within helpful Skills. These findings recast a matched Skill as a hypothesis about a particular Skill-project-model triple rather than a portable asset, reframing injection as a per-deployment routing decision and making length-matched controls and per-model audits a minimum standard for Agent-Skill evaluation.

</details>


### [295] [Definitional Sensitivity in Media Bias Detection: A Multi-Definition Dataset and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23095)
*Martin Wessel,Timo Spinde,Jürgen Pfeffer,Gianluca Demartini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了媒体偏见检测中定义选择如何影响人工和LLM的标注行为。通过对354名参与者和4个LLM进行被试间实验，测试多种概念框架和阐述详细程度的定义对6篇新闻文章、4个偏见类别标注的影响，发现定义的概念框架（而非阐述详细度）显著改变人工标注，且对LLM的影响更强。论文发布了MUDD数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有媒体偏见检测依赖特定数据集中的定义和示例，但相同偏见类别在不同数据集中的定义往往不一致或隐含不明，导致训练出的模型所学到的可能并非同一概念。这一问题在先前工作中被广泛忽视，需要系统性探究定义选择对偏见标注结果的影响。

Method: 采用被试间实验设计，354名人类参与者和4个LLM分别对6篇新闻文章在4个偏见类别下进行标注。定义在概念框架（conceptual framing）和阐述详细度（elaboration）两个维度上变化。累计收集8,496条人类标注和28,800条LLM标注，对比不同定义条件下标注的差异。

Result: 概念框架（conceptual target）是驱动标注分歧的关键因素，而保留概念本身的阐述详细度不会显著改变标注结果。概念框架的变换对人工标注有显著影响，对LLM标注的影响更为强烈。

Conclusion: 定义的概念框架选择在偏见标注协议和基于提示的测量中至关重要，定义敏感性可能向下游传播影响偏见分类任务。论文发布MUDD（Multi-Definition Bias Detection Dataset）数据集以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Media bias detection relies on definitions and examples that specify what counts as bias, yet these specifications often vary across datasets or remain implicit, even when given the same name. Such variation makes it unclear whether models trained for the same bias category learn the same construct or different phenomena, a problem largely overlooked in prior work. We examine how definition choice affects bias annotation in a between-subjects experiment with 354 participants and a parallel evaluation with four LLMs. Participants and models rate six news articles across four bias categories using definitions that vary in conceptual framing and elaboration. Across 8,496 human and 28,800 LLM ratings, we find that the conceptual target of a definition drives annotation divergence, while construct-preserving elaboration does not: conceptual framing significantly shifts annotations for humans and does so even more strongly for LLMs. We discuss implications for construct specification in annotation protocols and prompt-based measurement, and consider how definitional sensitivity may propagate to downstream classification beyond media bias. We also release MUDD, the Multi-Definition Bias Detection Dataset.

</details>


### [296] [Molecular LLM Agents: From Architectural Design to Scientific Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23104)
*Jiatong Li,Wengyu Zhang,Weida Wang,Yuxuan Ren,Wei Liu,Chenyang Mao,Yuqiang Li,Yatao Bian,Changmeng Zheng,Xiaoyong Wei,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对分子科学领域中LLM智能体的概念框架，从架构视角（分子表示与感知、智能体框架、领域工具箱、学习与优化）和科学自主性阶梯视角（L1辅助/固定工作流到L4科学议程智能体）两个互补维度，系统性地比较现有分子LLM智能体，识别能力缺口与部署风险，并为未来分子发现工作流中的智能体设计、评估和部署提供指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子科学是LLM智能体的重要前沿领域，但与主要在自然语言、代码或网页环境中运作的通用智能体不同，分子LLM智能体需要在符号字符串、分子图、3D构象、光谱、模拟和湿实验测量等多种化学对象上进行感知、推理和操作。目前缺乏一个系统性的框架来理解和组织这一领域，因此需要从架构设计和科学自主性两个角度建立统一的概念框架。

Method: 本文采用概念框架构建方法，从两个互补视角展开：1）架构视角——涵盖分子表示与感知、LLM中心智能体框架、领域专用工具箱（工具接地）、学习与优化四个核心组件；2）科学自主性阶梯视角——借鉴工程系统的阶段性自主化思想，将分子LLM智能体分为四个层级：L1辅助/固定工作流、L2自适应计算智能体、L3反馈感知的物理实验智能体、L4科学议程智能体。

Result: 建立了两个互补视角的分子LLM智能体概念框架：架构视角明确了智能体设计的四个关键维度，自主性阶梯视角定义了四个递进的自主性层级。该框架能够用于比较现有分子LLM智能体、识别缺失能力和部署风险，并为未来分子发现工作流中的智能体设计、评估和部署提供指导。

Conclusion: 两个视角共同构成评估和设计分子LLM智能体的综合框架：架构视角回答"如何构建"的问题，自主性阶梯回答"智能体能达到多自主"的问题。该框架可用于系统比较现有系统、发现能力短板和部署风险，并指导分子发现工作流中未来智能体的开发与评估。

Abstract: Molecular science represents an important frontier for LLM-based agents. Unlike general agents that mainly operate over natural language, code, or web environments, molecular LLM agents must perceive, reason about, and act upon chemical objects across symbolic strings, molecular graphs, 3D conformations, spectra, simulations, and wet-lab measurements. Their capabilities depend on chemically faithful molecular perception, an LLM-centered agent framework, domain-specific tool grounding, and computational or experimental feedback, in addition to planning and tool use. This work develops a conceptual framework for molecular LLM agents from two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce an architectural view of molecular-agent design, covering molecular representation and perception, the agent framework, domain-specific toolboxes, and learning and optimization. Second, we propose a scientific autonomy ladder inspired by staged autonomy in engineering systems, categorizing agents into four levels: L1 assistive or fixed workflows, L2 adaptive computational agents, L3 feedback-aware physical experiment agents, and L4 scientific-agenda agents. Together, these two perspectives establish a comprehensive framework for comparing existing molecular LLM agents, identifying missing capabilities and deployment risks, and guiding the design, evaluation, and deployment of future agents in molecular discovery workflows.

</details>


### [297] [Statistical Machine Translation Systems of English-Pnar Language Pair : Some Insights of the Emperical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23120)
*Edawanbiang Dhar Surmila Thokchom,Thoudam Doren Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次为英语和Pnar语（梅加拉亚邦Jaintia Hills地区约40万人使用的南亚语系语言）构建了机器翻译系统。利用Wyrta报纸收集的10,234句平行语料，基于Moses、GIZA++和KenLM训练了三种配置的短语统计机器翻译（SMT）模型，在371句测试集上最好的Pnar到英语系统达到BLEU 14.97，英语到Pnar系统达到BLEU 11.16，建立了该语言对的第一个定量基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pnar是一种低资源语言，缺乏数字语料库和NLP资源。该研究旨在为这一濒危与低资源语言建立首个机器翻译系统和定量基准，填补该语言对在NLP领域的研究空白。

Method: 构建了包含10,234个句子的平行语料库，使用其中9,563个句对训练短语统计机器翻译系统。采用Moses工具包、GIZA++词对齐和KenLM语言模型，在两个方向上分别配置三种系统（变化词汇化重排序和MERT调优），在371句的测试集上评估。

Result: 最佳系统在Pnar到英语方向达到BLEU 14.97（chrF2: 33.42, TER: 77.60），英语到Pnar方向达到BLEU 11.16（chrF2: 31.38, TER: 93.51）。词汇化重排序在Pnar到英语方向上提升3.73个BLEU点，而MERT调优在低资源条件下反而降低了BLEU性能。

Conclusion: 词汇化重排序有效应对了从Pnar语SOV语序到英语SVO语序的结构性转换，而MERT调优在低资源条件下有害。剩余的翻译错误主要来自形态学上的OOV词汇、长距离重排序和Khasi语代码混合，未来工作将朝神经网络和多语言机器翻译方向发展。

Abstract: Pnar, an Austroasiatic language spoken by approximately 0.4 million people in the Jaintia Hills of Meghalaya, lacks the digital corpora and natural language processing (NLP) resources. This paper presents the first machine translation study for the English and Pnar language pair. Using articles collected from the Wyrta newspaper, we built a parallel corpus comprising of 10,234 sentences and trained phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) systems the models using 9,563 parallel corpora under three configurations for each direction using Moses, GIZA++ , KenLM, varying lexicalized reordering and minimum error rate training (MERT) tuning. The models are evaluated on a held out test set of 371 sentences, the best performing system achieves a BLEU score of 14.97 (chrF2: 33.42, TER: 77.60) for Pnar to English and 11.16 (chrF2: 31.38, TER: 93.51) for English to Pnar, establishing the first quantitative benchmark for this language pair. Lexicalized reordering improves translation quality by 3.73 BLEU points for Pnar to English, reflecting the structural shift from the source language's SOV word order to the target language's SVO order, whereas MERT tuning degrades BLEU performance under low resource conditions. Finally, we analyze the remaining translation errors, including morphological out of vocabulary (OOV) words, long-distance reordering and Khasi code mixing and discuss future directions toward neural and multilingual machine translation for Pnar.

</details>


### [298] [LITERARYBIGFIVE: Author-Personalized Text Generation in a Unified Interpretable Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23124)
*Jinghui Zhang,Lang Gao,Ao Li,Mingzhe Li,Ruihong Zeng,Zirui Song,Kentaro Inui,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LiteraryBigFive框架，借鉴大五人格模型将作者写作风格重构为统一可解释的五维连续坐标系，通过激活空间对比提取风格维度，并利用可解释的引导机制实现作者个性化文本生成，在提升作者表达性的同时保持语义保真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有作者建模与个性化方法通常将写作行为表示为独立的离散标签，需要为每位作者或风格类别进行大规模语料收集或模型微调，成本高昂、难以解释且跨作者泛化能力差。这限制了自适应性写作助手、创意支持工具和计算文学分析等应用的发展。

Method: LiteraryBigFive受大五人格维度化视角启发，将作者写作特征定义为统一可解释空间中的坐标。每个可解释轴（如古典主义、情感性）通过对作者书写文本与中性文本之间的激活空间对比推导得到，形成独特风格维度。此外，引入可解释的引导机制，自适应地引导文本生成朝向目标坐标，实现作者个性化写作。

Result: 实验表明LiteraryBigFive在提升作者表达性的同时保持了语义保真度。推导出的作者各轴得分与真实文学共识高度相关，为作者特定生成行为提供了透明可解释的说明。

Conclusion: LiteraryBigFive通过维度化风格空间替代离散标签建模，为作者个性化生成提供了更具解释性、更泛化的框架，并已开源相关代码以供社区使用。

Abstract: Personalized text generation for authors and literary writing is essential for applications such as adaptive writing assistants, creative support tools, and computational literary analysis. However, existing approaches to author modeling and personalization often represent writing behavior as independent labels, requiring large-scale corpus collection or fine-tuning for each author or stylistic category. Such formulations are costly, difficult to interpret, and poorly suited for generalizing across authors. Inspired by the Big Five model's dimensional view of personality, we propose LiteraryBigFive, a framework that reframes authorial writing characteristics as coordinates within a unified and interpretable space. In this space, we derive each interpretable axis (e.g., Classicism, Emotionality) from activation-space contrasts between author-written and neutral passages, yielding distinct stylistic dimensions that allow texts or authors to be positioned within a five-dimensional system. Beyond localizing different authors, we further introduce an interpretable steering mechanism, which adaptively guides text generation toward target coordinates to perform author-personalized writing. Experimental results show that LiteraryBigFive improves authorial expressiveness while preserving semantic fidelity. The derived author per-axis scores strongly correlate with real-world literary consensus, offering transparent and interpretable explanations of author-specific generation behavior: https://github.com/Znull-1220/LiteraryBigFive.

</details>


### [299] [Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23149)
*Seungyoon Lee,Minhyuk Kim,Jungseob Lee,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CRPO（跨语言排序偏好优化）框架，利用英语中的偏好知识促进目标语言的偏好对齐，通过层级结构联合优化语言内和语言间的偏好，在五种语言的实验中持续优于标准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的对齐高度依赖以英语为中心的优质偏好数据，这导致模型在其他语言上的表现欠佳。现有方法缺乏有效利用英语偏好知识来提升目标语言对齐效果的机制。

Method: 提出CRPO框架：在目标语言和英语之间构建平行偏好对，设计层级结构以联合优化语言内（intra-lingual）和语言间（inter-lingual）的偏好；基于LambdaLoss框架，超越二元比较，提供多个候选响应间的相对排序信号。

Result: 在五种资源规模不同的语言上，CRPO在指令跟随和知识利用能力上持续优于标准方法；在不同加权方案下均表现出稳健的性能提升；显著改善了奖励边际和理想响应的对数概率，形成更稳定的跨语言对齐偏好流形。

Conclusion: CRPO通过跨语言偏好知识迁移和层级排序优化，有效提升了多语言环境下的偏好对齐质量，为跨语言LLM对齐提供了可行且稳健的框架。

Abstract: The alignment of Large Language Models heavily relies on English-centric high-quality preference data, which often leads to suboptimal performance in other languages. In this paper, we propose Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization (CRPO), a novel framework that leverages robust preference knowledge from English to facilitate preference alignment in the target language. We design a hierarchical structure within parallel preference pairs across the target language and English to jointly optimize intra- and inter-lingual preferences, thereby enhancing language adaptation and output quality. Building on the LambdaLoss framework, CRPO goes beyond the binary comparison based optimization by providing a relative ranking signal across multiple candidate responses. Our experiments across five languages with varying resource scales demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms standard approaches in both instruction-following and knowledge utilization capability. Notably, the robust performance gains observed across various weighting schemes further validate the empirical effectiveness of our hierarchical design in a multilingual setup. Furthermore, our findings highlight that CRPO significantly improves both reward margins and the log-probability of desirable responses, contributing to a more stable preference manifold for cross-lingual alignment.

</details>


### [300] [Counter with Evidence! A Multi-Agent Memory Efficient Reasoning Framework for Hate Category Informed Counterspeech Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23152)
*Sujoy Nath,Aswini Kumar,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FIRE框架，将仇恨言论分解为五类特定形态，映射到针对性的反驳策略，并在新数据集FactualCS上训练验证，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动生成反驳言论的研究过度强调风格控制，将仇恨言论视为同质化的输入，忽视了不同形式的虐待行为需要根本不同的反驳策略这一关键问题。

Method: FIRE（Factuality Informed Multi-Agent Reasoning Framework）首先将仇恨言论分类为五种类型（错误信息、刻板印象、阴谋论、非人化、非事实），然后映射到针对性的反驳风格。配套构建FactualCS数据集，包含4,784条带仇恨类别、推理轨迹和证据映射标注的实例。

Result: 在28个基线配置的综合评估中，FIRE在事实准确性和类别准确性上分别提升约12%和11%，毒性降低约11%，且仅使用<2B参数的紧凑智能体；人工评估显示FIRE生成的回复显著优于最强基线。

Conclusion: 分解仇恨言论的潜在意图是生成安全、有效且上下文精确的反驳言论的关键，这一思路对实际部署具有重要意义。

Abstract: Counterspeech effectively neutralizes the impact of online hate. Although prior work explores automated counterspeech generation, it largely emphasizes stylistic control while treating hate speech as homogeneous, overlooking that distinct forms of abuse require fundamentally different counterspeech strategies. To address this gap, we introduce FIRE (Factuality Informed Multi-Agent Reasoning Framework) that first decomposes hate speech into one of the five distinct categories (misinformation, stereotype, conspiracy, dehumanizing, non-factual), and then maps it to a targeted counterspeech style. To facilitate FIRE, we curate FactualCS, a novel dataset of $4,784$ instances that provides the annotations regarding hate categories, reasoning traces, and evidence mappings, which are critical elements for grounded generation that are missing in prior work. A comprehensive evaluation across $28$ baseline configurations demonstrates that FIRE significantly surpasses existing methods, despite using compact agents ($<$2B). FIRE achieves a $\sim$ $12 \%$ and $\sim$ $11 \%$ improvements in factual and category-specific accuracy respectively, while simultaneously reducing toxicity by $\sim$ $11 \%$ relative to the strongest baselines. Further human evaluation confirms that responses generated by FIRE are significantly preferred over the strongest baselines, underscoring its effectiveness for real-world deployment. These findings show that decomposing the underlying intent of hate speech is essential for generating safe, effective, and contextually precise counterspeech.

</details>


### [301] [Accelerating Diffusion Language Models via Structured Suffix Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23167)
*Zifeng Cheng,Keda Li,Zhiwei Jiang,Cong Wang,Fei Shen,Qing Gu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结构化后缀建模方法（SSM），用于高效扩散语言模型推理。该方法将后缀划分为局部、中间和尾部三个区域，根据各区域结构角色保留不同数量的后缀token，并将上一步解码结果融入当前步骤的后缀表示中。该方法无需训练，可与其他加速技术正交组合，在长序列推理中最高实现72.81倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）具有并行解码能力，但每一步生成都需要与所有后缀token交互，导致大量计算开销。现有方法通常仅保留局部后缀窗口以减少成本，但忽略了后缀区域之间的结构异质性，且在每个时间步用相同表示重新初始化后缀token，缺乏跨步骤的演化信息传递。

Method: 1) 将后缀划分为局部（local）、中间（middle）和尾部（tail）三个区域，根据各区域在生成中的结构角色保留不同数量的后缀token；2) 将上一步解码结果融入当前步骤的后缀token表示中，使其携带跨生成步骤的演化去噪信息；3) 该方法无需训练，与并行解码策略和KV cache等现有加速技术正交兼容。

Result: 在三个DLM上的多个基准测试中，该方法能进一步加速DLM推理，且在大多数情况下提升生成性能。在与其他加速技术结合时，长序列推理最高达到72.81倍加速。

Conclusion: 该工作通过结构化感知的后缀建模，有效解决了DLM推理中后缀计算的冗余问题，同时改善了token表示的信息传递，在加速推理的同时保持甚至提升生成质量，为高效DLM推理提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) exhibit strong parallel decoding capabilities by denoising multiple tokens in a single generation step. However, this parallelism comes with substantial computational overhead, as each step requires interactions with all suffix tokens. Existing methods typically reduce this cost by retaining only a local suffix window as a substitute for the full suffix. Despite their effectiveness, these methods overlook the structural heterogeneity across suffix regions and re-initialize suffix tokens with identical representations at each timestep. To this end, we propose a structured suffix modeling method for efficient DLM inference. Specifically, we divide the suffix into three regions, i.e., the local, middle, and tail regions, and retain different numbers of suffix tokens in each region according to their structural roles. Moreover, we incorporate the decoding results from the previous step into the suffix token representations at the current step, allowing them to carry evolving denoising information across generation steps. Notably, our method is training-free and orthogonal to several existing acceleration techniques, such as parallel decoding strategies and KV cache. Empirical results across multiple benchmarks on three DLMs demonstrate that our method can further accelerate DLM inference and improve performance in most cases. In particular, in long-sequence inference, our method achieves up to a \(72.81\times\) speedup when combined with other acceleration techniques. Our code is available at https://github.com/zifengcheng/SSM.

</details>


### [302] [CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23172)
*Abhilash Nandy,Rahul Seetharaman,Aman Bansal,Rounak Saha,Manav Nitin Kapadnis,Millon Madhur Das,Pawan Goyal,Niloy Ganguly*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CaRGo-T（因果推理思维图），一种将多模态幽默中的因果和上下文关系表示为轻量级图结构并序列化为代码的推理框架，通过VLM生成和解读，在四个数据集上相较基线方法在幽默理解和幽默检测任务上分别提升约1-20%和1-3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在多模态任务中表现优异，但幽默理解仍然困难，因为幽默常依赖实体、事件、上下文和跨模态隐含关系之间的微妙交互，涉及复杂推理链，传统提示或线性思维链推理难以捕捉这些关系。

Method: CaRGo-T将多模态幽默背后的因果和上下文关系表示为轻量级图结构，由VLM生成代码形式的序列化表示，再交由同一或不同VLM解释以产生最终预测，支持零样本和上下文学习两种设置。

Result: 在四个覆盖讽刺、嘲弄和梗图等多样喜剧形式的数据集上，CaRGo-T一致优于现有推理基线方法，幽默理解任务提升约1-20%，幽默检测任务提升约1-3%。互信息分析表明CaRGo-T生成的推理表示包含比基线方法更多与目标输出相关的信息。

Conclusion: CaRGo-T通过图结构化的因果推理有效提升了VLM的幽默理解能力，其推理表示为后续分析提供了更丰富的信息，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, understanding humor remains challenging because humorous content often depends on subtle interactions among entities, events, context, and implicit relationships across image and text modalities. These interactions can involve complex chains of reasoning that are difficult to capture through conventional prompting or linear chain-of-thought reasoning. In this work, we propose CaRGo-T (Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought), a reasoning framework that represents the causal and contextual relationships underlying multimodal humor as a lightweight graph-based reasoning structure. The graph is serialized into a code-based representation generated by a VLM, which can subsequently be interpreted by the same or a different VLM to produce the final prediction in zero-shot or in-context learning settings. We evaluate CaRGo-T on humor understanding and humor detection across four datasets spanning diverse forms of comedic content, including satire, sarcasm, and memes. Experiments with state-of-the-art commercial and open-source VLMs show that CaRGo-T consistently improves performance over existing reasoning-based baselines, achieving gains of approximately 1-20% on humor understanding and 1-3% on humor detection. Further analysis using mutual information indicates that the reasoning representations produced by CaRGo-T contain more information relevant to the target output than those generated by baseline reasoning approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/abhi1nandy2/CaRGo-T.

</details>


### [303] [LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23200)
*Xiao Zhang,Qumeng Sun,Jihao Li,Yiming Ren,Xiang Liu,Haoyang Zhang,Junjie Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoMap方法，将验证器确认的执行轨迹外部化为结构化Gene（基因）并复用，同时引入包含778个机器可验证任务的长工作流基准LongWoF-Bench。实验显示，进化得到的EvoMap Gene在7个模型上相较Skill方法提升8.7-15.5个百分点，且仅参考蒸馏得到的Gene无此优势，说明验证经验来源是Gene效用关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在执行复杂长工作流时，成功执行的经验在单次运行后即丢失，后续模型需要从零开始重新发现策略和失败模式，导致重复成本高昂。现有方法未能有效外部化和复用这些经验。

Method: 提出EvoMap框架，将经过验证器确认的执行轨迹整合为结构化Gene；引入LongWoF-Bench基准，覆盖代码生成、智能体环境合成、数学推理和规则遵循四类共778个机器可验证任务；通过进化方式生成Gene，并与参考蒸馏Gene进行对比以考察验证经验来源的影响。

Result: 在252个具有验证确认Opus轨迹的任务上，进化得到的EvoMap Gene在全部7个评估模型上比Skill方法提升8.7-15.5个百分点，跨模型家族的消费者模型同样受益；参考蒸馏Gene无此优势；Claude Opus上Gene复用比Skill多完成39个任务，同时降低9.9%的求解token消耗。

Conclusion: 验证过的执行经验可以作为可复用的外部资源被保留和共享，使模型无需重复支付经验发现的全部成本即可提升长工作流完成能力；Gene的效用与验证经验来源密切相关，紧凑表示本身并不足以带来优势。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly expected to execute complex workflows whose success depends on maintaining interdependent constraints and producing artifacts that satisfy strict end-to-end verification. Yet successful execution experience is typically lost after a single run, forcing subsequent models to rediscover strategies and failure modes from scratch. We study whether such experience can instead be externalized and reused through EvoMap, where verifier-confirmed execution trajectories are consolidated into structured Gene. To evaluate this setting, we introduce the Long-Workflow Benchmark (LongWoF-Bench), comprising 778 machine-verifiable tasks across code generation, agent-environment synthesis, mathematical reasoning, and rule following. On the 252 tasks with verifier-confirmed Opus trajectories, evolved EvoMap Gene outperform Skill across all seven evaluated models by 8.7-15.5 percentage points, with the gains extending to consumer models from different model families. In contrast, reference-distilled Gene do not exhibit the same advantage, indicating that compact representation alone is insufficient and that Gene utility is closely associated with verified experience provenance. For Claude Opus, Gene reuse also completes 39 more tasks than Skill while reducing solve-time token consumption by 9.9%. Together, these results show that verified execution experience can be retained and shared as a reusable external resource, enabling models to improve long-workflow completion without repeatedly paying the full cost of experience discovery.

</details>


### [304] [Aligning Biomedical Texts and Knowledge Graphs: A Systematic Comparison of Lightweight Alignment Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23214)
*Artem Bisliouk,Elizaveta Nosova,Heiko Paulheim,Andreea Iana,Rita T. Sousa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，系统研究将生物医学文本与知识图谱（KG）对齐的设计选择。通过冻结文本编码器和KG嵌入模型，仅用对比学习目标训练轻量级投影层，在六个设计维度上公平比较。构建了CTD-Align数据集（包含22K+化学-基因相互作用的三元组-文档对），发现三元组组成和训练方向影响最大，简单选择（线性头+拼接嵌入投影到KG空间）表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学知识以非结构化文献和结构化知识图谱两种互补但不同的形式存在，对齐它们对知识接地、证据检索和KG补全至关重要。然而现有方法未能显式地将自由文本证据与KG三元组对齐，缺乏系统研究设计选择的统一框架。

Method: 采用冻结的文本编码器和KG嵌入模型，仅通过对比学习目标学习两者空间之间的轻量级投影。在六个设计维度上进行比较：文本编码器、KG嵌入模型、投影头、三元组组成、训练方向和困难负样本采样。构建CTD-Align语料库，包含22K+一对一的化学-基因相互作用三元组-文档对，并在文档到三元组和三元组到文档两种检索设置下评估。

Result: 三元组组成和训练方向（即共享检索空间）影响最大，而文本编码器和困难负样本采样影响甚微。简单方案胜出：使用线性头将文本投影到KG空间，对主语、谓语和宾语嵌入进行拼接，效果最佳。

Conclusion: 轻量级对比对齐是连接生物医学文本和知识图谱的有效且实用的基础方法，简单设计选择即可达到最佳效果，为后续相关工作提供了基准。

Abstract: Biomedical knowledge exists in two complementary but distinct forms: unstructured scientific literature and structured knowledge graphs (KGs). Aligning them is essential for knowledge grounding, evidence retrieval, and KG completion, yet existing methods do not explicitly align free-text evidence with KG triples. We present a unified framework for systematically studying design choices for aligning biomedical text and KGs. With a text encoder and a KG embedding model both frozen, we learn only a lightweight projection between their spaces via a contrastive objective. This enables a fair comparison across six design dimensions: text encoder, KG embedding model, projection head, triple composition, training direction, and hard-negatives sampling. We construct CTD-Align, a corpus of over 22K one-to-one tripledocument pairs linking chemical-gene interactions from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database to supporting PubMed passages. We evaluate alignment on it in two retrieval settings: document-to-triple and triple-to-document. We find that the triple composition and the training direction (i.e., shared retrieval space) have the greatest impact, whereas the text encoder and hard-negatives sampling matter little. Overall, simple choices win: projecting text into the KG space with a linear head over concatenated subject, predicate, and object embeddings performs best. These findings establish lightweight contrastive alignment as an effective, practical foundation for bridging biomedical text and KGs.

</details>


### [305] [A Multi-Domain and Multi-Task Generative Framework with Explicit Task and Domain Conditioning for Cross-Domain Event Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23235)
*Siting Liang,Omar Adjali,Daniel Sonntag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的多域、多任务事件抽取训练框架，通过领域条件信号与任务特定提示相结合，在单个模型中建模异构事件模式，支持流水线与端到端两种抽取设置，在多个基准上实现竞争性能、强跨域泛化能力和实际可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件抽取模型在领域内性能优异，但跨域泛化仍是挑战。现有统一和多任务方法虽提升领域内准确率，但对未见领域适应性有限；基于大语言模型的方法即使提供完整事件本体，性能也常逊于小型微调模型。

Method: 提出统一的多域、多任务训练框架，核心创新在于：(1) 引入领域条件信号（domain conditioning signals）动态适应数据集特定模式；(2) 与任务特定提示（task-specific prompts）联合使用；(3) 在单一模型中建模异构事件模式，无需在推理时提供完整事件标签集；(4) 同时支持流水线和端到端两种抽取设置，便于任务级和领域级迁移。

Result: 在多样化事件抽取基准上的实验表明，该方法取得了具有竞争力的性能，展现出强跨域泛化能力和实际可扩展性，同时保持了领域特定的精度。

Conclusion: 该框架通过领域条件信号与任务提示的结合，在不依赖完整事件本体输入的情况下实现了跨域、跨任务的动态适应，为多域事件抽取提供了一种高效且可扩展的统一方案。

Abstract: Event extraction aims to identify event triggers, classify event types, and extract arguments to construct structured event representations. Despite strong in-domain performance, developing models that generalize robustly across domains remains challenging due to variations in contextual expressions and event schemas. Prior unified and multi-task approaches improve in-domain accuracy but exhibit limited flexibility when applied to unseen domains. Even large language model-based methods that provide full event ontologies at inference time often underperform compared to smaller, task-specific fine-tuned models. We propose a unified multi-domain and multi-task training framework that models heterogeneous event schemas within a single model. Our approach introduces domain conditioning signals, jointly with task-specific prompts, enabling dynamic adaptation to dataset-specific schemas without requiring complete event label sets at inference time. The framework supports both pipeline and end-to-end extraction settings, facilitating efficient task- and domain-level transfer. Experiments on diverse event extraction benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance, strong cross-domain generalization, and practical scalability, while preserving domain-specific precision.

</details>


### [306] [Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23244)
*Shireen Kudukkil Manchingal,Sofiia Nikolenko,Fabio Cuzzolin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs)，通过LoRA适配器集成诱导credal set，以概率下界/上界暴露LLM不确定性，而非折叠成单一softmax分布。从该表示中推导出两个互补的承诺分数（CTC和SCC），在幻觉检测、校准、选择性预测和推理任务上优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准LLM通常产生流畅但错误的答案并带有不当置信度，其核心限制在于通过单一预测分布表示不确定性，将认知无知（epistemic ignorance）与真实歧义（genuine ambiguity）混淆。这种表示方式无法区分模型"不知道"和"答案本身模糊"的情况，导致过高的置信度和不可靠的幻觉输出。

Method: 该方法采用三个主要技术步骤：(1) 使用LoRA适配器的集成构建credal set，通过下/上概率（lower/upper probabilities）暴露合理预测分布的扩展范围；(2) 推导Credal Token Commitment (CTC)——基于下界支持、credal宽度和交叉熵的token级不确定性分数，无需额外生成；(3) 提出Semantic Commitment Consistency (SCC)——通过采样补全将承诺扩展到语义空间，并用SCC-Gap衡量token级与语义级支持之间的不匹配。

Result: CLLM在OpenBookQA、CoQA、TriviaQA和ARC-Challenge上使用Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B进行评测。CLLM在QA准确率上是最优方法且期望校准误差具有竞争力；CTC在大多数设置中幻觉检测AUROC优于最先进基线1.5个百分点以内且无需额外生成；选择性预测80%覆盖率下，CLLM+SCC在OpenBookQA达99.0%准确率；ARC-Challenge上CLLM+Csem置信度在三个基座模型上ECE不超过0.6%。

Conclusion: CLLM通过credal set表示有效解决了LLM不确定性量化的核心问题，在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著提升了校准性和幻觉检测能力。基于credal set的承诺分数（CTC和SCC）在token级和语义级提供了互补的不确定性信号，展示了该方法在大规模语言模型不确定性建模中的有效性和泛化性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but incorrect answers with unwarranted confidence. A central limitation is that standard LLMs represent uncertainty through a single predictive distribution, conflating epistemic ignorance with genuine ambiguity. We introduce Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs): an ensemble of LoRA adapters induces a credal set whose lower and upper probabilities expose the spread of plausible predictive distributions rather than collapsing to a single softmax output. From this representation we derive two complementary commitment scores. Credal Token Commitment (CTC) is a token-space score that combines lower-bound support, credal width, and intersection entropy, computed without additional generation. Semantic Commitment Consistency (SCC) extends commitment to semantic space using sampled completions, with SCC-Gap measuring the mismatch between token-level and semantic-level support.
