The empirical evidence supports an architectural claim: when an LLM forward pass is wrapped in an ontology-mediated negative-trail apparatus, the structural pattern-vs-path gap can be partially scaffolded. The XKG functions as the missing memory, and the warrant axis as an epistemic firewall.

</details>


### [504] [Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23373)
*Seyed Mohammad Hossein Hashemi,Mohsen Hooshmand,Parvin Razzaghi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Dual-Stream Attention (DSA)多模态深度学习框架，融合数值流行病学信号与文本新闻标题，对12周前瞻的流感样疾病(ILI)活动进行预测，在Time-MMD健康数据集上以0.416的中位测试MSE大幅优于多个基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期ILI预测对公共卫生准备至关重要，但公开监测数据集的数值信号与文本信息往往噪声大、结构松散、与近期趋势仅间接相关且存在滞后，将两者融合需要精心设计。

Method: DSA采用双流结构：基于Transformer的数值编码器和领域适应的标题编码器分别编码两种模态，通过双向跨模态注意力(CMA)机制使文本与数值相互条件约束，输出再送入因果时序模型进行预测。

Result: 在十个随机种子下，DSA中位测试MSE为0.416，对比iTransformer(0.668)、TaTS(0.607)和GPT4MTS(0.851)，平均误差降低54.95%、37.29%和67.23%；在100%的bootstrap抽样中排名第一；在外部地理数据集上同样在九个基线中排名第一。消融实验表明优势不依赖文本编码器选择或语言模型微调，双向注意力优于任一单向；扰动忠实性分析显示CMA具有功能性信息。

Conclusion: 双向跨模态注意力机制是提升ILI长期预测性能的关键，DSA框架在数值-文本多模态融合中展现出显著的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Forecasting long-range influenza-like illness (ILI) matters for public health readiness. Publicly available surveillance datasets typically pair numeric epidemiological signals with textual information that is noisy, loosely structured, only indirectly related to near-term trends, and often lagged relative to the numeric signal. Fusing the two therefore requires careful design. We propose Dual-Stream Attention (DSA), a multimodal deep learning framework that forecasts 12-week-ahead ILI activity from a 36-week multimodal history by letting the numerical and textual streams condition each other. Using the Time-MMD health-domain dataset, DSA separately encodes the two modalities with a Transformer-based numerical encoder and a domain-adapted headline encoder, then couples them through a bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) mechanism: the text (news headlines) conditions the interpretation of the numeric signal and vice versa. The CMA output then passes to a causal temporal model for forecasting. Evaluated across ten random seeds, DSA achieves a median test MSE of 0.416, versus 0.668, 0.607, and 0.851 for iTransformer, TaTS, and GPT4MTS, corresponding to mean-error reductions of 54.95%, 37.29%, and 67.23%, with paired Cohen's d of 0.555, 0.337, and 0.345, respectively, and ranks first in 100% of bootstrap draws. It also has substantially lower worst-window error than all baselines. On an external-geography dataset, DSA again ranks first among nine evaluated baselines. Ablations show the advantage does not depend on text-encoder choice or language-model fine-tuning, and that bidirectional attention outperforms either direction alone. Finally, perturbation-based faithfulness analysis shows the learned CMA is functionally informative under targeted masking, with a stronger effect in the text-to-numerical direction.

</details>


### [505] [MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23397)
*Ruoyu Wu,Shenfu Xie,Yinqian Sun,Haibo Tong,Feifei Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MediSkill-Evo 是一个无需微调骨干网络的临床智能体，通过四类经验库（临床技能、流程规则、符号模式、测量流程）和流程约束偏好机制，在部分可观测条件下提升诊断准确率和治疗意图覆盖率，同时降低关键失败率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式临床智能体必须在部分可观测条件下收集决定性证据并将其转化为有依据的行动。然而，仅凭正确的最终诊断并不能证明智能体遵循了证据和护理流程约束，因此需要一种能够确保过程合规性的智能体架构。

Method: MediSkill-Evo 将经验分为四类带类型的经验库（临床技能、流程规则、符号模式、测量流程），通过来源追踪、支持、回放和控制器定义的安全检查来管理对冻结测试时快照的发布。其流程约束偏好机制将证据绑定到来源，拒绝控制器无效的候选方案，并使用以安全优先的临床流程评审对行动进行排序，全程无需骨干网络微调。

Result: 在300次持有的Qwen交互中，诊断准确率从61.33%提升至69.00%，治疗意图覆盖率从33.62%提升至66.44%，自动评分的关键失败率从31.00%降至16.33%。在180个硬隔离条件下，目标恢复率达93.61%（患者行为压力）、100.00%（时间性证据）和92.22%（分诊红旗）。探索性100例MedSAM对比验证了请求门控工具接口的可行性。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了固定评估套件上完整系统的描述性端到端证据，而非单个经验库的因果证据或自动评审器的临床验证，表明该框架在过程合规性驱动的临床决策中具有潜力。

Abstract: Interactive clinical agents must gather decisive evidence and convert it into grounded actions under partial observability. A correct final diagnosis alone does not show that an agent respected evidence and care-process constraints. We introduce MediSkill-Evo, a clinical agent that evolves governed process knowledge without backbone fine-tuning. It separates experience into four typed banks for clinical skills, process rules, symbolic schemas, and measurement procedures. Provenance, support, replay, and controller-defined safety checks govern publication to a frozen test-time snapshot. A Process-Constrained Preference Harness binds evidence to its source, rejects controller-invalid candidates, and ranks actions with a safety-prioritized Clinical Process Critic. We evaluate complete agent systems across two backbone endpoints and six controlled stress dimensions under the same Doctor-turn limit. On 300 held-out Qwen encounters, MediSkill-Evo improves diagnosis accuracy from 61.33 percent to 69.00 percent and treatment-intent coverage from 33.62 percent to 66.44 percent, while reducing automatically scored critical failures from 31.00 percent to 16.33 percent relative to AgentClinic. On 180 hard-isolation conditions derived from 30 cases, target recovery reaches 93.61 percent under patient-behavior pressure, 100.00 percent for temporal evidence, and 92.22 percent for triage red flags. An exploratory 100-case MedSAM comparison evaluates request-gated tool-interface feasibility. These results provide descriptive end-to-end evidence for the complete system on fixed evaluation suites, not causal evidence for an individual bank or clinical validation of the automatic judge.

</details>


### [506] [SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23417)
*Hengjun Wang,Shuyue Wei,Boyi Liu,Jun Yang,Yongxin Tong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillAlchemy框架，用于从开放世界材料中创建智能体技能，在87个任务上相比无技能执行提升19.9个百分点，相比最强自动基线提升8.6个百分点，达到与人工策划技能相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体技能创建依赖人工编写、模型先验或执行轨迹，这些来源在陌生任务中往往不可用，因此需要从开放世界材料（如文档、代码等）中自动发现和提炼技能。

Method: SkillAlchemy是一个以"准入"（admission）为核心的框架，包括三个关键步骤：(1) 通过对比证据识别技能简报中隐含的需求；(2) 基于证据支持的范围准入候选程序；(3) 将准入内容编译为语法引导的技能包。

Result: 在SkillsBench v1.1的87个任务上，SkillAlchemy相比无技能执行将通过率提升19.9个百分点，相比最强的自动化基线提升8.6个百分点，性能与人工策划的技能相当。

Conclusion: SkillAlchemy验证了从来源材料中系统化创建可靠技能的可行性，为缺乏人工标注和先验轨迹的陌生任务提供了一条自动化技能构建的有效路径。

Abstract: Agent skills are reusable procedural artifacts that extend language agents with specialized workflows, tool conventions, and domain behaviors at inference time. However, creating reliable skills still depends largely on human authorship, model priors, or execution traces. These sources are often unavailable for unfamiliar tasks, suggesting the need to create skills from open-world materials. In this paper, we study open-world skill creation: given an underspecified skill brief and a source-access specification, a creator must discover behavior-relevant requirements omitted by the brief and determine how broadly each source-derived procedure is justified. We propose SkillAlchemy, an admission-centered framework for source-grounded skill creation. SkillAlchemy identifies implicit requirements through contrastive evidence, admits candidate procedures based on evidence-supported scope, and compiles the admitted content into a grammar-guided skill package. Extensive experiments across 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks demonstrate that SkillAlchemy improves pass rate over no-skill execution by 19.9 percentage points and the strongest automated baseline by 8.6 percentage points, while achieving performance comparable to human-curated skills.

</details>


### [507] [Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23446)
*Contet Clément,Umberto Grandi,Jérôme Mengin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究锦标赛规则下"候选者为何落选"的形式化解释问题，通过识别使得候选者在任何补全方式下都必然失败的极小子锦标赛（称为"破坏性最小支持"），为六种常见锦标赛规则提供必要性落败者与可能获胜者的刻画、最小破坏性支持的大小，以及多项式时间计算算法（Borda规则怀疑为NP完全）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在锦标赛（tournament）场景中，当一个候选者输掉比赛时，人们往往想知道"为什么"他会输。作者希望用形式化可解释人工智能（XAI）中的溯因解释框架，从子锦标赛的角度给出可验证的落败原因，从而回答"败者为何落败"这一核心问题。

Method: 定义破坏性最小支持（destructive minimal supports）——最小的子锦标赛，使得候选者在该子锦标赛中必然失败，无论其余锦标赛如何补全。针对六种锦标赛规则（maximin、uncovered set及其加权变体、top-cycle、Copeland和Borda），分别刻画"必要败者"与"可能胜者"的条件，分析最小破坏性支持的大小，并设计相应的计算算法；对Borda规则推测其为NP完全问题。

Result: 对六种锦标赛规则分别给出了必要败者/可能胜者的完整特征刻画，确定了最小破坏性支持的尺寸，并为除Borda以外的所有规则提供了多项式时间算法；Borda规则下的计算复杂性被怀疑为NP完全。

Conclusion: 该工作将形式化XAI的溯因解释框架引入锦标赛领域，系统性地解答了"候选者为何落选"的问题，为不同锦标赛规则下的解释计算提供了理论基础与算法支撑，同时指出了Borda规则下潜在的算法挑战。

Abstract: We study the problem of formally explaining why a candidate was not selected by a given tournament rule, by identifying sub-tournaments in which the candidate loses independently of how the rest of the tournament is completed. We define destructive minimal supports as any minimal sub-tournaments satisfying this property, which in formal explainable artificial intelligence correspond to abductive explanations for the question "Why does the loser lose the tournament?". For six common tournament solutions (maximin, uncovered set and its weighted variant, top-cycle, Copeland, and Borda) we provide characterizations of when a candidate is either a necessary loser or a possible winner, we determine the size of the smallest destructive minimal supports, complemented by polynomial-time algorithms for their computation except for the case of the Borda rule which is suspected to be NP-complete.

</details>


### [508] [StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23475)
*Jinghan Tan,Yuanzheng Wang,Lu Chen,Zijun Chen,Yuqian Wang,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出StrategyBench基准，用于评估大语言模型从少量示例中归纳任务策略（strategy induction）并应用于新实例的能力，从策略质量和下游实用性两个维度进行度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接使用少量示例进行上下文学习（ICL）对示例构建高度敏感，因为未显式抽象任务规则；而人类学习者通常先总结规则再应用。现有工作缺乏对这一"策略归纳"能力的系统性评估。

Method: 从BIG-Bench中选取可归纳策略的任务，构建参考策略，定义策略质量与下游实用性两个评估维度；并从任务类别差异、生成器-执行器选择、演示设计、SFT适应设置等角度分析策略归纳。

Result: 实验表明：显式策略的实用性在不同任务类别间差异显著，且依赖于策略生成和执行的双方条件。

Conclusion: 策略归纳是关键但未被充分研究的LLM能力，StrategyBench为此提供系统评估框架，揭示策略生成与执行环节对下游性能的共同影响。

Abstract: As large language models are increasingly used in data-scarce and evolving task scenarios, few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has become a key paradigm for task adaptation. However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose StrategyBench, which selects strategy-inducible tasks from BIG-Bench, constructs reference strategies, and defines evaluation metrics along two dimensions: strategy quality and downstream utility. We further analyze strategy induction from three perspectives: task variation, model configuration, and adaptation setting, covering category-wise differences, generator-executor choices, demonstration design, and SFT-based adaptation. Experiments show that explicit strategy utility differs substantially across task categories and depends on both strategy generation and execution conditions. The benchmark is released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StrategyBench-D53C.

</details>


### [509] [Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23484)
*Naman Garg,Sarika Jain,George Fazekas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Team Semiintelligencn参加ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData挑战赛的解决方案——一个面向对话式音乐推荐的多模态个性化推荐系统。系统采用三阶段流水线：多模态检索（七个稠密嵌入空间的衰减加权质心、BM25词汇检索和艺术家子串匹配，经加权RRF融合）、轻量级重排序和基于GPT-4o-mini的个性化响应生成。系统在Blind B上获得0.3213的复合评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式音乐推荐需要同时理解多模态信息（文本、音频、视觉）和用户个性化偏好，现有方法在跨模态信息融合和对话场景下表现不足。作者希望通过参赛构建一个有效的多模态个性化对话推荐系统，并探索不同组件在真实盲测环境中的效果。

Method: 系统采用三阶段流水线：(1) 多模态检索阶段，构建7个稠密嵌入空间的衰减加权质心（包括track/user级CF-BPR、Qwen3元数据/歌词/属性、CLAP音频、SigLIP视觉），辅以BM25词汇检索和艺术家子串匹配，通过加权RRF融合并用差分进化优化权重；(2) 轻量级重排序，包含历史过滤、流行度平滑和目录多样性惩罚；(3) 基于GPT-4o-mini的个性化多样化响应生成。开发阶段还实验了LLM引导艺术家注入、专辑延续信号、XGBoost LambdaMART和GPT-4.1响应提示等组件。

Result: 差分进化优化RRF权重使MRR提升19.5%。在Blind A上，无约束LLM注入导致nDCG显著下降(-18.9%)，而保守注入（仅9个会话）获得最佳Blind A nDCG。提交系统在Blind B上获得0.3213的复合评分。

Conclusion: 多模态检索融合与权重优化对话式音乐推荐有效，但LLM引导的艺术家注入需要谨慎约束，过度注入可能导致严重的性能回退。成本与复杂度约束使得部分理论上更优的组件（如GPT-4.1提示）未能部署到实际提交中。

Abstract: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.

</details>


### [510] [SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23493)
*Jialong Liu,Yuling Shi,Ning Yang,Xiaodong Gu,Zuchao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO) 框架，让 LLM 在训练中自我反思生成"反思补丁"，并将反思条件化的教师分数作为密集 token 级训练信号，将稀疏终端反馈转化为密集监督，无需外部评判器或奖励模型，在数学推理和长程智能体任务上达到 SOTA 并显著提升数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我反思是人类学习中高效的信用分配机制，能将稀疏的结果反馈转化为可操作指导。然而其在事后训练 LLM 中的潜力尚未被充分探索，现有方法往往依赖外部评判器、独立奖励模型或更大的教师模型，成本高昂且信号稀疏。

Method: SRPO 使 LLM 分析自身完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的"反思补丁"，并利用反思条件化的教师分数对学生在线策略回滚生成密集的 token 级训练信号。这一过程将稀疏的终端监督转化为密集、token 级的训练信号，且无需外部评判器、独立奖励模型或更大的教师模型。

Result: SRPO 在数学推理和长程智能体基准上达到 SOTA。使用 Qwen3-8B 基础模型，在 AIME'24 上取得 73.3% 的成绩，仅用扩展监督微调所需训练 FLOPs 的 8%（0.08x）；WebShop、ALFWorld 和 SWE-Bench-Lite 成功率分别提升至 64.7%、76.8% 和 31.2%。

Conclusion: SRPO 证明将自我反思内化为训练机制能够高效地将稀疏监督转化为密集学习信号，在数据效率和性能上均具显著优势，为 LLM 事后训练提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

</details>


### [511] [Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23497)
*Yipeng Zhao,Qishun Yang,Shenzhe Zhu,Shu Yang,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究"推理诱导错位"(RIM)现象——在包含数学、代码等链式思维推理数据上微调LLM时，即使数据不含有害内容，也会诱发模型的有害行为。作者从表征空间几何角度分析了RIM的底层机制，发现推理能力方向与安全行为方向在激活空间上耦合：提升推理的微调会移动安全表征。基于此提出安全方向惩罚(SDP)方法，在推理微调时惩罚沿学习到的安全方向的移动，在Qwen2.5-3B/7B上既恢复安全性又保持推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIM揭示了LLM推理安全性面临的严峻挑战——在看似无害的推理数据（数学、代码、问题求解）上微调就会诱导有害行为。已有工作仅将RIM归因于神经元级别的纠缠，但未能识别其底层的表征空间几何结构，也未能提出训练时的修复方案。作者旨在填补这一空白，从表征空间几何层面理解RIM并提供训练时修复手段。

Method: 作者首先进行表征空间分析，提取两个激活空间方向：一个编码推理能力，另一个编码安全行为。通过跨架构、跨规模、跨数据集验证确认RIM并非普遍出现。利用CKA距离比和探针技术定位安全决策层。基于分析发现推理方向与安全方向的耦合规律，设计Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP)方法——在推理微调时惩罚沿学习到的安全方向的移动。通过层定位设定初始惩罚范围，当初始范围导致超出惩罚层的补偿性偏移时，使用相同诊断手段迭代扩展范围。

Result: 实验在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上进行。SDP成功恢复模型安全性，同时保持了基准推理性能。表征分析证明了推理方向与安全方向在激活空间中的耦合关系：微调提升推理时会移动安全表征，且提示中位移越大，安全退化越严重。

Conclusion: 本文不仅从表征空间几何层面揭示了RIM的底层机制（推理方向与安全方向的耦合），还提供了训练时修复方案SDP，实现了安全性与推理性能的兼得。该工作对LLM推理安全性提供了重要的理论洞察和实用解决方案。

Abstract: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.

</details>


### [512] [EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23525)
*Zhiqing Cui,Xinxiang Yin,Yihong Tang,Xinglang Zhang,Yuanzhe Hu,Siru Zhong,Weidong Tang,Yuxuan Liang,Weijia Li,Ming Jin,Shirui Pan,Yuhao Kang,Dingyi Zhuang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EarthVerse基准，通过405个可复现任务、199个记录事件和19类灾害族评估科学智能体在地球系统分析中的端到端可靠性。最佳系统平均答案单元准确率84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅为34.81%，揭示当前智能体在跨证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释的一致性链条上存在明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球系统分析需要从来源、尺度、时间和模态各异的观测中重建变化的物理过程，而自然灾害场景下证据不完整会直接影响严重程度、暴露程度和机制的评估。现有科学智能体缺乏一个能够以可复现方式评估其端到端科学可靠性的基准。

Method: EarthVerse使用包级（package-scoped）调查范式：智能体需检查异构事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、调和来源差异并在最终回答中保留溯源信息。提供可执行的细粒度答案单元作为ground truth，并结合任务特定评分细则评估研究过程而非仅看结果，允许多条有效路径。在受控工具使用协议下评估25种模型与智能体系统，并通过受控研究定位证据获取、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互和科学执行等环节的失败点。

Result: 最佳系统平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅为34.81%，两者之间的巨大差距表明当前智能体虽能完成单个步骤，却无法在证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释之间维持一致的推理链条。受控研究进一步将失败精确定位到证据访问、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互和科学执行六个维度。

Conclusion: EarthVerse为动态地球系统中测量端到端科学可靠性提供了可复现的基础，揭示了现有科学智能体在跨步骤一致性维持上的系统性短板，为推动其科学严谨性提升设定了明确基准。

Abstract: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.

</details>


### [513] [Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23526)
*Richard Bao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨世界模型是否真正学习并保持物理动力学不变量。通过标签无关搜索，发现DreamerV3在摆锤视频上确实学到近似守恒的能量标量，但在阻尼模型中找不到类似不变量。然而在自主推断时该量发生漂移，将潜状态投影回初始水平集可降低三个保守模型的推断误差，而随机约束通常增加误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型可以从像素中预测视频，但不清楚它们是否真正学习并遵循环保物理规律的动力学不变量（如能量守恒）。理解模型是否仅解码出相关特征还是真正掌握动力学约束，对于可靠部署世界模型至关重要。

Method: 使用冻结的DreamerV3仅在摆锤视频上训练，通过标签无关搜索寻找其潜状态转移中被近似守恒的标量。对比匹配的保守模型（无阻尼）与阻尼模型，评估该守恒量在自主推断（rollout）中的漂移情况，并通过将潜状态投影回初始水平集与随机约束进行对比实验。

Result: 标签无关搜索在多个独立训练的保守模型中找到相同能量类不变量，但在阻尼模型中找不到。自主推断时该量漂移。将潜状态投影回初始水平集降低所有三个保守模型的推断误差，而随机约束通常增加误差。

Conclusion: 这些结果区分了动力学上有意义的不变量与仅是可解码的相关特征，揭示了一个具体的失败模式：世界模型可以从像素中学到物理约束，但在想象前向（自主推断）时却违反该约束。

Abstract: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.

</details>


### [514] [How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23543)
*Shang Wu,Catarina G Belem,Shuyuan Fu,Mark Steyvers,Padhraic Smyth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过控制逻辑谜题实验研究AI辅助对长期技能发展的影响，发现低成本AI辅助会促使更频繁的AI使用，但使用AI的参与者在移除辅助后任务表现更差，且其后续能力会被早期辅助表现所高估。贝叶斯潜在能力模型表明独立推理努力与技能增长正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI辅助研究大多关注短期任务表现提升，但对长期技能发展的负面影响缺乏系统的因果证据。作者希望探讨：当AI以按需形式提供帮助时，是否会因替代独立推理而削弱技能习得，以及如何量化这种影响。

Method: 采用控制实验设计，参与者在AI可用前、使用期间和移除后三个阶段完成逻辑谜题任务；通过实验操纵AI请求成本（高/低成本）来影响AI使用频率；使用贝叶斯潜在能力模型，分离初始能力、AI后能力及参与者特定的技能变化，同时估计AI可用阶段独立推理对技能发展的贡献。

Result: 低成本AI辅助导致更频繁的AI使用；使用AI的参与者在移除辅助后表现更差；从早期AI辅助表现预测后期无辅助表现时存在系统性高估；独立问题解决努力与潜在能力的更大增益相关。

Conclusion: 研究表明AI辅助可能通过替代独立推理而削弱长期技能发展，即使短期表现有所提升。这提示在设计AI辅助系统时需考虑其对人类学习能力的长期影响，而非仅关注即时绩效改善。

Abstract: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.

</details>


### [515] [Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23552)
*Seth Karten,Alex L. Zhang,Kevin Thomas,Sebastian Müller,Elie Bakouch,Daniel Auras,Mika Senghaas,Fares Obeid,Konstantin Dunas,Johannes Hagemann,Sami Jaghouar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Prime Agent是一个开源长时程智能体评测与编码工作流框架，通过持久化IPython REPL和持续化Harness机制，将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升至95.5%，并在多项长上下文任务上超越现有主流框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型本质上是顺序处理器，但长时程智能体任务（如复杂编码、资源管理、持续学习）需要超越模型权重和活跃上下文的外部信息与计算支持。现有的评测和代理框架无法充分释放模型真实能力，需要一个标准化的执行环境来区分"模型失败"与"框架失败"。

Method: Prime Agent采用三项核心技术：(1) 持久化IPython REPL遵循Recursive Language Model抽象，实现程序化上下文处理与测试时计算；(2) Continual Harness跨轨迹持续保存历史、记忆、技能、提示和子代理规格；(3) 递归子代理通过直接代理间通信协调，并配备Agents View供人类监督daemon后台会话。框架标准化了执行、恢复、验证和资源核算，同时将策略构建完全留给模型。

Result: Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%显著提升至95.5%；在长上下文编码、GPU内核生成、模拟器构建和自主nanoGPT加速等任务上达到或超越原生及主流框架；在Factorio环境中，精细化迭代支持持续技术进步，专职子代理实现了并行化工作。

Conclusion: Prime Agent证明了低摩擦、高表达力的"膜"式harness设计能够有效防止框架故障转化为模型故障，使模型评测更趋近其真实的最大底层能力，为长时程智能体评测提供了一个开源标准化基础设施。

Abstract: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

</details>


### [516] [ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23565)
*Zhifei Chen,Luozhou Wang,Guibao Shen,Dongyu Yan,Shuai Yang,Tianshuo Xu,Yihua Du,Wei Wang,Tianyi Gui,Lianghua Huang,Yingcong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReWorld是一个交互式世界模型，通过训练阶段分离控制与记忆、推理阶段利用有界KV缓存（pose索引地标库）解决交互式建模中控制（短视界）与记忆（无界历史）之间的结构性矛盾，在动作跟随、长时程记忆和视频质量上优于六个现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型面临根本性矛盾：控制需要短期视界以快速响应动作，而记忆需要无界历史以回忆已展示的场景。两者在结构上相互冲突，现有方法要么牺牲控制精度要么牺牲记忆能力，需要一种新的架构方案来同时满足实时响应和长时间记忆的需求。

Method: 方法包括三个核心部分：（1）训练阶段采用混合逐头注意力窗口，大部分头关注近期，少量全局头关注全历史，配合随机头路由和随机块丢弃使两种能力解耦并让稀疏历史成为分布内数据；（2）推理阶段采用有界KV缓存，由pose索引的地标库支撑，模型检索靠近当前姿态的最近地标；（3）度量尺度对齐的数据引擎整合八种数据源，通过回文轨迹提供重访证据，并使用分布匹配蒸馏（仅限LoRA适配器）压缩采样至四步，实现单骨干网络支持多步高质量模式和实时交互模式。

Result: 在动作跟随、长时程回忆和视频质量三个维度的评估中，ReWorld在六个近期交互式世界模型中达到最佳控制保真度（旋转误差11.95°，相机运动一致性最佳）和最佳生成质量。在64秒、384个潜变量的长往返rollout中，固定12块缓存仍能重建起始视图，而此时滑动窗口已驱逐证据、全KV注意力已内存耗尽。

Conclusion: ReWorld通过解耦控制和记忆（训练时分开、推理时有界）成功解决了交互式世界模型的结构性矛盾，证明了固定预算下的有界KV缓存配合地标检索可以维持分钟级的长时程记忆，同时保持实时交互能力和高质量生成。

Abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [517] [DySCo: Dynamically consistent data-driven downscaling of extremes in climate projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21998)
*S. Stamatelopoulos,M. Wang,I. Lopez-Gomez,L. Zepeda-Nunez,Z. Y. Wan,R. Carver,F. Sha,T. P. Sapsis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DySCo框架，一种非侵入式的动力与统计一致降尺度方法，通过数据驱动的nudging技术构建动态配对的训练轨迹，在保持与粗分辨率GCM动力学一致性的同时，实现高分辨率气候降尺度，并在LENS2数据集上验证了其卓越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区域气候风险评估（如基础设施设计、灾害预报、保险资源分配）需要高空间分辨率数据，但直接用全球气候模型（GCM）估算区域风险计算代价过高。现有降尺度方法虽能提高分辨率并校正统计偏差，但难以保持动力一致性——自由演化的GCM轨迹无法跟踪用于训练校正算子的观测数据，这对因果极端事件分析（如基于故事线的风险归因）尤为关键。

Method: DySCo采用数据驱动的nudging（牛顿松弛）方法重构，在不侵入性修改GCM的前提下创建动力配对的训练轨迹；利用这些配对轨迹训练一个两阶段的动力与统计一致算子，实现从粗分辨率GCM输出到高分辨率气候场的一致性降尺度。

Result: 在Community Earth System Model v2 Large Ensemble（LENS2）上，将时间与空间维度向历史再分析数据降尺度。结果表明DySCo在动力一致性上远超现有方法，对GCM施加最小化的因果校正，同时保持了与最先进无监督模型相当的最高统计性能。

Conclusion: DySCo成功解决了降尺度中动力一致性与统计性能之间的权衡问题，为非侵入式、动力和统计双重一致的高分辨率气候投影提供了可行路径，特别适用于罕见极端事件的长期回归期统计及其因果分析。

Abstract: Regional climate risk assessment is critical for applications such as infrastructure design, disaster forecasting, and insurance resource allocation. However, estimating regional (i.e., high-spatial-resolution) risk with global climate models (GCMs) remains computationally prohibitive, which has driven the development of downscaling methods for coarse GCM outputs. Downscaling is vital for rare events, since quantifying their extreme properties requires high spatial resolution and very long GCM simulations. These methods non-intrusively increase GCM resolution while correcting statistical biases from unresolved fine-scale processes, thereby improving the accuracy of extreme event statistics with long return periods. A key challenge is preserving dynamical consistency, as freely evolving GCM trajectories are not expected to track the observational dataset used for training the correction operator. This is critical for causal extreme event analyses, where storyline-based risk assessment, i.e., extreme event catalogs, is necessary for effective planning. We address this challenge by introducing Dynamically and Statistically Consistent downscaling (DySCo), a non-intrusive framework yielding high-resolution climate projections consistent with coarse GCM dynamics. DySCo relies on a data-driven reformulation of nudging to create dynamically paired training trajectories without intrusive GCM modifications. Using these paired trajectories, we train a dynamically and statistically consistent, two-stage operator. We evaluate the method by downscaling the Community Earth System Model v2 Large Ensemble (LENS2) in time and space towards historical reanalysis. Results show DySCo achieves superior dynamical consistency with the coarse GCM trajectories, essentially applying a minimal, causal correction to the GCM, preserving top statistical performance comparable to state-of-the-art unsupervised models.

</details>


### [518] [Blockwise Stabilized Adaptive Cubic Regularization with Subsolvers via Recurrence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22129)
*Rodion Podorozhny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种分块自适应三次正则化牛顿优化器（ARC-φ₁），按张量划分参数块，每块使用独立自适应三次常数M_b并配合单调守卫。小块用显式Hessian的lazy exact cubic步骤，大张量用矩阵自由的Chebyshev有界Krylov子空间（Lanczos过程）。该方案保持O(ε^{-3/2})全局速率，在隐式神经表示（FINER约199k参数、ViSIR 91.4M参数）上显著超越Adam（133.5 dB vs 78.2 dB PSNR）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三次正则化牛顿方法具有最优的O(ε^{-3/2})全局收敛速率和自动鞍点逃逸机制，但其子问题求解通常依赖完整特征分解，严重限制了可处理的模型规模。现有方法无法在大规模参数模型上高效应用这一理论优势。

Method: 提出分块优化器：1) 按张量划分参数块，每块独立最小化带自适应三次常数M_b的三次模型；2) 每块步骤通过基于全损失的单调守卫决定接受或拒绝；3) 子问题求解器按块大小选择——小块用显式Hessian的lazy exact cubic步骤，超大张量用Lanczos过程构建的Chebyshev有界Krylov子空间；4) 三次位移使得移位算子半正定并约束所需多项式度，同时允许不精确子问题求解保持O(ε^{-3/2})速率。

Result: 在FINER INR（约199k参数）上ARC-φ₁收敛到133.5 dB PSNR，而调优后的Adam在相同扩展预算下仅达到78.2 dB；在Adam达到峰值的约70分钟内ARC-φ₁已达到95.6 dB。在91.4M参数的ViSIR INR上，每个块（含88.5M参数的decoder张量，占模型97%）的三次步骤在三次模型意义上均保持精确。

Conclusion: 分块自适应三次正则化牛顿方法能在保持理论最优收敛速率的同时扩展到超大模型，在隐式神经表示任务上大幅超越Adam，且块间单调下降保证了算法的稳定性。配套报告进一步分析了Adam在损失景观上的行为成因。

Abstract: Cubic-regularized Newton methods have the optimal $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3/2})$ global rate and an automatic saddle-escape mechanism, but their subproblem is most often solved by a full eigendecomposition, limiting feasible model size. We introduce a blockwise optimizer that partitions parameters by tensor, minimizes an independent cubic model with an adaptive cubic constant $M_b$ per block, and accepts or rejects each block step against a monotone guard on the full loss. The subproblem solver is chosen by block size: small blocks use lazy exact cubic steps from explicitly formed per-block Hessians; arbitrarily large tensors use a matrix-free Chebyshev-bounded Krylov subspace built by the Lanczos process. The cubic shift bounds the required polynomial degree whenever the gradient-driven shift dominates negative curvature, renders the shifted operator positive semidefinite before any polynomial is applied, and preserves the $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3/2})$ rate under inexact subproblem solves. We prove these claims, and the blockwise scheme carries a monotone per-block descent guarantee. Experiments cover FINER INRs (about 199k parameters) and a 91.4M-parameter ViSIR INR, where the blockwise cubic step remains exact in the cubic-model sense on every block, including the 88.5M-parameter decoder tensor (97\% of the model). Run to full convergence on FINER, the ARC-$\varphi_1$ optimizer reaches 133.5 dB PSNR while tuned Adam plateaus at 78.2 dB at the same extended budget; in the roughly 70 minutes Adam takes to reach its peak, ARC-$\varphi_1$ reaches 95.6 dB. A companion report isolates the loss-landscape features responsible for Adam's behavior.

</details>


### [519] [Loss Landscape Features That Make Adam Stall: Definitions, Estimators, and the Preconditioned Hessian View](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22145)
*Rodion Podorozhny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了Adam优化器在隐式神经表示（INR）训练中面对病态损失曲面时的表现，定义了用于判定Adam能否缓解病态性的度量指标（Hessian条件数、Adam预条件Hessian条件数、对角质量、负谱质量、梯度能量分数等），并通过2×2示例和FINER图像拟合案例论证了对角预条件只能消除轴对齐的病态性而无法处理交叉耦合病态性的原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam虽经过精细调参（尤其是学习率扫描）在病态损失曲面上可能达到很低损失，但也可能停滞在远高于二阶方法的平台上。现有研究缺乏对Adam能否缓解病态性的系统判据，因此需要定义可测量的指标来预测和解释Adam在不同病态类型下的行为。

Method: 提出一套损失曲面分析框架：从Adam更新规则推导预条件Hessian D^{-1/2}HD^{-1/2}及其条件数；引入对角质量ρ区分轴对齐与交叉耦合病态性；用随机Lanczos求积估计负谱质量；计算曲率带上的梯度能量分数（含指示Adam停滞的平坦分数）。通过2×2解析示例和FINER架构案例验证。

Result: 证实对角预条件（Adam）能通过重缩放消除轴对齐病态性，但无法消除交叉耦合病态性。FINER案例中，Adam在鞍点处停滞，PSNR仅达到调优基线水平，而分块二阶方法达到120–134 dB，误差图显示显著精度差距。

Conclusion: 所定义的指标能有效判定Adam在给定损失曲面上能否缓解病态性；当存在交叉耦合或负谱质量过大时需依赖二阶方法；FINER图像拟合的高精度（120+ dB PSNR）在实践中具有显著价值。

Abstract: Across implicit-neural-representation (INR) architectures and analytic benchmarks we observe that a thoroughly tuned Adam (especially its learning rate (lr), e.g. in a hyperparameter sweep from $lr = 0.05$ to $10^{-8}$) can potentially reach a very low loss even on ill-conditioned loss landscape or converge at a plateau far above the loss attained by second-order methods. This report defines the measured metrics that help determine if Adam can mitigate the ill-conditioning on a given loss landscape. We provide the indicators by which each outcome is determined, that are: the condition number of the Hessian and of the Adam-preconditioned Hessian $D^{-1/2}HD^{-1/2}$ (with the derivation from Adam's update rule), the diagonal mass $ρ$ that distinguishes axis-aligned from cross-coupled ill-conditioning, the negative spectral mass estimated by stochastic Lanczos quadrature, and the gradient energy fractions over curvature bands, including the flat fraction that indicates the Adam stall. A worked out $2\times 2$ example and an illustration show the reasons why a diagonal preconditioning by Adam can remove axis-aligned ill-conditioning by rescaling and why it cannot do the same if the ill-conditioning is cross coupled. In addition, we present a case study of FINER image fitting architecture that goes over the whole loss landscape analysis framework: the fitting architecture description, reasons due to which its landscape stalls Adam at saddles, the measured PSNR values through our tuned baselines to the $120$--$134$\,dB results of the blockwise second order methods, the error maps behind those numbers, and description of the benefits such image fitting accuracy gives in practice.

</details>


### [520] [Model of Models: When Does Emitting a Specialist Beat Attending, Adapting, or Tuning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21386)
*John C. Howell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了四种少样本任务专化机制（零样本、上下文注意力、测试时梯度适应、超网络发射专家权重），在六类任务上进行了严格的四向对比。发现"发射"机制在匹配质量下最具成本优势（如在临床分类上持平TabPFN，在正弦回归上比MAML低2-3个数量级），但在高维序列建模上无法媲美上下文注意力（LTB适配器仅恢复14%的上下文增益），且存在部分容量极限。论文最后提出了一个可证伪的、通过任务分辨率度量来界定各机制适用边界的命题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然零样本、上下文注意力、测试时梯度适应和超网络发射专家权重这四种机制均已存在，但"发射"（emission）机制的运行区间（operating regime）很少被系统映射。作者希望在统一实验设置下（固定专家、上下文和训练预算）进行严格对比，以明确各机制在何种任务和条件下更优。

Method: 作者在六个任务（回归、生成、语言建模、强化学习、临床分类、基因组分类）上运行完全相同的四机制对比实验，并保持专家模型、上下文和使用场景下训练预算的一致性固定。主要实验包括：发射机制与TabPFN在表格少样本分类上的对比、与MAML在正弦回归上的对比、与上下文注意力在高维序列建模（LTB适配器）上的对比，以及LoRA秩扫描和机制消融实验。最后提出一个以任务分辨率度量来界定各机制偏好的可证伪命题。

Result: 发射机制在匹配质量下成本显著更低：在临床少样本分类上持平TabPFN（且发射可复用的专家而非逐查询重算支持集），在形状生成上以132个浮点的逐实例程序达到噪声下限，在正弦回归上零测试时梯度步数下比MAML低2-3个数量级（预算均等化后仍保持约30倍差距）。但在高维序列建模中，发射无法匹敌上下文注意力——5M预算时仅恢复14.0±0.9%、15M时11.2±0.5%的上下文增益；LoRA秩扫描显示这是部分容量极限（秩增大从5%升至21%但仍远低于完全恢复）。机制消融确认发射的专家是真正任务条件化的而非记忆先验，且专家权重在权重空间可组合（插值两个专家的权重可追踪对应功能的混合）。

Conclusion: 发射机制在低维/低成本场景下是极具吸引力的替代方案，但在高维序列建模中受容量限制显著。论文以任务分辨率作为核心度量，提出了一个可证伪的命题来界定四种机制各自的偏好区间，为实际选择任务专化机制提供了原则性指导。

Abstract: Given a task described by a few examples, how should a model be specialized to it? Four mechanisms are available -- zero-shot, in-context attention, test-time gradient adaptation, and emitting specialist weights from a hypernetwork -- yet the operating regime of the last is rarely mapped. We run the identical four-way comparison across six tasks spanning regression, generation, language modeling, reinforcement learning, and clinical and genomic classification, holding the specialist, the context, and (where we can) the training budget fixed. The clearest wins for emission are about cost at matched quality: it ties the state-of-the-art amortized tabular model (TabPFN) on clinical few-shot classification while emitting a reusable specialist instead of re-attending the support set per query, and reaches noise-floor shape generation with a $132$-float per-instance program. On few-shot sinusoid regression it is $2$--$3$ orders of magnitude below MAML at zero test-time gradient steps -- a margin that narrows to $\sim$$30\times$ but persists once training budgets are equalized. Emission cannot match in-context attention on high-dimensional sequence modeling: under matched-budget pre-training a one-pass adapter recovers only a minority of the in-context gain ($14.0\pm0.9\%$ at $5$M, $11.2\pm0.5\%$ at $15$M), and a LoRA-rank sweep shows this shortfall is a partial capacity limit -- capture climbs from $5\%$ to $21\%$ as rank grows but plateaus far below full recovery. Mechanism ablations confirm the emitted specialist is genuinely task-conditioned, not a memorized prior; and, more speculatively, emitted specialists compose in weight space -- interpolating two of them tracks the corresponding blend of their functions. We close with a falsifiable thesis, operationalized through a per-task resolution measure, bounding when each conditioning mechanism should be preferred.

</details>


### [521] [Gaussian process learning with flow map refinement for parameter estimation in dynamical systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22324)
*Yue Hao,Dongwei Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于高斯过程学习与流形映射精修（GPL-FMR）的两阶段参数估计框架，解决梯度匹配方法在稀疏且有噪声观测下全局不一致的问题，通过将高斯过程后验作为信息先验传递给流图精修阶段，利用全局动力学约束优化参数估计，在多个数值系统中验证了精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯过程的梯度/导数匹配方法虽然避免了重复数值积分并强制局部导数一致性，但在观测数据稀疏且有噪声时，局部匹配可能导致与真实控制流图的全局不一致，从而降低参数估计精度。

Method: 提出GPL-FMR两阶段框架：第一阶段使用高斯过程学习算法，将获得的参数后验作为信息先验传递至第二阶段；第二阶段基于全局动力学约束（流图精修）进行优化，进一步改进参数估计。

Result: 在Van der Pol振荡器、Lotka-Volterra模型和Lorenz-63系统等多个数值示例上的实验表明，该框架持续提升参数估计精度，尤其在观测稀疏且带有噪声的情况下效果显著。

Conclusion: GPL-FMR框架通过结合高斯过程局部学习和全局流图精修，有效弥补了传统梯度匹配方法的全局一致性缺陷，是一种在处理稀疏与噪声数据场景下更可靠的动力系统参数估计方法。

Abstract: Parameter estimation is a central task in data-driven learning of dynamical systems. It aims to recover the underlying physical parameters from observed time-series data, thereby providing interpretable insights into the physical mechanisms governing the system. Gradient/derivative matching methods based on Gaussian process provide an efficient way to perform parameter estimation. Those methods avoid repeated numerical integration and enforce local derivative consistency. However, such local matching may result in global inconsistency with the governing flow map, particularly under scarce and noisy observations. To address this limitation, we propose a framework based on Gaussian process learning with flow map refinement (GPL-FMR), a two-stage parameter estimation framework. The first stage is based on Gaussian process learning algorithm and the posterior obtained from which is transferred as an informative prior to the second stage based on flow-map refinement. The second stage further improves the parameter estimation via optimisation based on global dynamical constraints. We demonstrate and analyse its performance on multiple numerical examples, including the Van der Pol oscillator, the Lotka-Volterra model, and the Lorenz-63 system. The results show that the proposed framework consistently improves parameter estimation accuracy, particularly under scarce and noisy observations.

</details>


### [522] [Runtime Action Interference for AI Control of AlphaStar in StarCraft II](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21398)
*Jaymari Chua,Chen Wang,Liming Zhu,Lina Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出运行时动作干扰（RAI）机制，在推理后通过冷却条件与内容检测器调控强化学习策略的动作节奏与过滤，并在星际争霸II人类实验中验证了能力披露对公平感、信任与毒性感知的显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练好的强化学习策略并不能完全决定用户所遇到的行为，部署代码仍会调度、接纳、抑制或替换其建议动作。现有研究缺乏对推理后运行时控制机制及其对用户体验影响的系统分析。

Method: 定义RAI机制：保留策略参数，在推理后通过冷却条件控制动作发放频率，并用内容检测器过滤特定毒性行为（如对工人单位的骚扰）；将RAI实现于AlphaStar actor.py的复现版本，并在星际争霸II中开展人类参与者实验，对比同一高能力限速对手在能力声明被隐瞒与披露两种呈现下的用户体验。

Result: 隐瞒能力声明时公平感、信任、毒性均值分别为3.90、3.50、2.00；披露时分别为2.62、4.31、2.85。披露降低了各专业水平组的感知公平感并提高了感知毒性，而信任在新手与专家中上升、在中等水平参与者中下降。

Conclusion: 人机评估必须将执行栈内的控制与能力披露分离，并将公平、信任与毒性作为人类体验的不同维度分别评测；即使配置的控制保持恒定，能力信息的呈现方式也会显著改变用户对受RAI控制的对手的感知。

Abstract: A trained reinforcement learning policy does not determine the complete behavior that users encounter: deployment code still schedules, admits, suppresses, or replaces its proposed actions. We contribute \emph{runtime action interference} (RAI), an AI control mechanism that preserves policy parameters while regulating action pacing and filtering configured action patterns after inference. RAI releases a proposed action only when its cooldown condition is satisfied and its content detector does not flag the action; otherwise, it dispatches a no-op. The detector covers specified toxic behaviors, including worker-unit harassment, while the cooldown controls action rate. We implement RAI in a replication of AlphaStar actor.py and make the implementation and reproducibility materials available through an open source code repository. We deployed RAI in a \textit{StarCraft~II} human participant study that compared two presentations of the same opponent with high capability and rate limited actions; we withheld its capability claim in one presentation and disclosed it in the other. On response scales from 1 to 5, we observed pooled fairness, trust, and toxicity means of 3.90, 3.50, and 2.00 under claim withholding, compared with 2.62, 4.31, and 2.85 under disclosure. Disclosure corresponded with lower perceived fairness and higher perceived toxicity across every expertise group, whereas trust increased among novices and experts but decreased among intermediate participants. Our human evaluation therefore shows that perceptions of an opponent controlled through RAI can vary substantially with the capability information presented to users, even when the configured control remains constant. We conclude that human-computer evaluations must separate control within the execution stack from capability disclosure and assess fairness, trust, and toxicity as distinct dimensions of human experience.

</details>


### [523] [Federated Ensemble Forecasting Under Supply-Chain Market Volatility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21399)
*Shunmukha Sagar Puppala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FEF NCL，一种面向供应链预测的联邦集成负相关学习框架，在合成数据集上将加权MAPE从13.9%降至12.4%，延迟风险宏F1从0.755提升至0.801，并显著降低高波动场景下的误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 供应链预测系统面临市场冲击、非独立同分布的区域需求分布，以及企业不愿集中共享商业数据等现实约束。传统集中式预测方法无法在数据孤岛和分布漂移条件下有效运作，需要一种既尊重数据隐私又能捕捉区域异质性的分布式预测框架。

Method: FEF NCL将负相关学习（NCL）引入联邦学习框架：各客户端节点训练专门化的预测专家，通过负相关学习惩罚机制抑制冗余模型误差；框架包含时间特征编码器、客户端级漂移评分、可靠性加权聚合，以及可解释性层以揭示影响预测的关键市场与供应商变量。在含有12.48万条周度观测的合成数据集（覆盖10个区域客户端、60个产品族、40个供应商、5个商品组，并含2021-2024年价格冲击机制）上进行评估。

Result: 在合成测试集上，FEF NCL将加权平均绝对百分比误差从最佳联邦基线（SCAFFOLD等）的13.9%降至12.4%；延迟风险宏F1从0.755提升到0.801；高波动五分位误差相对SCAFFOLD降低2.1个百分点。

Conclusion: 负相关专门化在客户端面临不同供应商、货运和商品条件时具有明显优势，但真实部署仍需加强隐私分析、实时漂移监控和运维校准。鉴于数据集为合成数据，结果应视为内部控制一致性的受控证据而非真实世界验证。

Abstract: Supply chain forecasting systems increasingly operate under market shocks, non-identically distributed regional demand, and limited willingness to centralize commercial data. This work proposes Federated Ensemble Forecasting with Negative-Correlation Learning (FEF NCL), a distributed method that trains specialized forecasting experts across client nodes while discouraging redundant model errors. The framework combines temporal feature encoders, client level drift scoring, reliability-weighted aggregation, and an explain ability layer that exposes the market and supplier variables most responsible for each forecast. A single synthetic dataset is used to evaluate the design. It contains 124,800 weekly SKU region observations from ten regional client nodes, 60 product families, 40 suppliers, five commodity groups, and a 2021-2024 volatility profile with explicit price-shock regimes. Because the dataset is synthetic, the reported results should be interpreted as controlled evidence of internal consistency rather than real-world validation. Across the synthetic test split, FEF NCL reduces weighted mean absolute percentage error from 13.9% for the best federated baseline to 12.4%, improves delay-risk macro-F1 from 0.755 to 0.801, and lowers the high volatility quintile error by 2.1 percentage points relative to SCAFFOLD. The analysis suggests that negative-correlation specialization is useful when clients face different supplier, freight, and commodity conditions, although deployment would require stronger privacy analysis, live drift monitoring, and operational calibration. Index Terms federated learning, ensemble learning, negative correlation learning, supply chain forecasting, market volatility, data drift, demand planning, risk governance

</details>


### [524] [Class-Conditioned Gaussian Mixture Modeling for Imbalanced Time Series Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21473)
*Md Shahriar Kabir,Mayesha Maliha R. Mithila,Anne H. H. Ngu,Mylène C. Q. Farias,Byron Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CC-GMNet-TS，一种用于不平衡时间序列数据的类别条件高斯混合量化器，结合Transformer特征提取器与每类专属潜在混合模型，在三个基准数据集上优于传统聚合器和现有深度量化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在不平衡时间序列数据中估算类别先验概率（即量化任务）对生物信号监测、跌倒检测和活动识别等领域至关重要，而现有基于混合模型的量化器对所有类别共享单个高斯混合，难以捕获罕见但有信息量的模式。

Method: CC-GMNet-TS采用Transformer特征提取器提取时间序列片段嵌入，为每个类别分配独立的紧凑高斯混合模型于有界潜在空间中，通过将片段嵌入与类别专属分量进行评分来构造包级别表示，突出稀有但信息丰富的模式。训练时使用Artificial Prevalence Protocol（APP）和prior shift bag sampling（PShift）构建包，并以量化导向的损失函数进行端到端训练。

Result: 在EMG Data for Gestures、SmartFallMM和UCI-HAR三个基准数据集上，CC-GMNet-TS相比传统聚合器和近期深度量化方法取得更低的量化误差，消融实验验证了Transformer骨干网络和类别条件混合模型在PShift情境下的贡献。

Conclusion: 类别条件化的混合建模策略相较于共享混合模型能更有效地处理不平衡时间序列数据中的量化任务，结合Transformer特征提取能够显著提升稀有类别的先验概率估计精度。

Abstract: Quantification, estimating class prevalences in bags of unlabeled instances is vital in domains where aggregate statistics are more important than individual instance labels, such as biosignal monitoring, fall detection, and activity recognition. We investigate this issue in the challenging setting of imbalanced time series data and develop CC-GMNet-TS, a class-conditioned Gaussian mixture quantifier that combines a Transformer-based feature extractor with per-class latent mixtures. Unlike previous mixture-based quantifiers, which use a single Gaussian mixture shared by all classes, CC-GMNet-TS assigns each class its own compact mixture in a bounded latent space and scores segment embeddings against these class-specific components to create bag-level representations that emphasize rare but informative patterns. Bags are constructed from labeled pools using the Artificial Prevalence Protocol (APP) and prior shift bag sampling (PShift) to cover a wide range of class prevalence scenarios, and the model is trained end-to-end with a quantification-oriented loss. Experiments on three benchmarks: EMG Data for Gestures, SmartFallMM, and UCI-HAR show that CC-GMNet-TS achieves lower error across the three benchmarks compared to traditional aggregators and recent deep quantifiers, while ablations confirm the contributions of both the Transformer backbone and class-conditioned mixtures during PShift.

</details>


### [525] [Congruence Decomposition with Neural Block Solvers for Large-Scale PCI Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21485)
*Yeqing Qiu,Chengpiao Huang,Ye Xue,Akang Wang,Fan Xu,Zhipeng Jiang,Dong Zhang,Ruoyu Sun,Qingjiang Shi,Zhi-Quan Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于同余分解框架和神经块求解器的大规模物理小区标识（PCI）分配方法，通过将多个模干扰目标分解为块级Min-k-Partition子问题并结合图神经网络进行高效优化，在合成蜂窝图与真实5G网络上优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在密集5G网络中，PCI分配对干扰管理至关重要。随着网络规模扩大，PCI重用不可避免，会引发碰撞、混淆及多种模干扰。这些问题联合缓解构成大规模多目标组合优化难题，难以在实际网络规模下高效求解。

Method: 提出同余分解（congruence decomposition）框架，利用PCI值的算术结构将多个模干扰目标解耦为一系列块级Min-k-Partition子问题，随后通过图着色过程解决PCI冲突。对NP难的Min-k-Partition子问题，开发神经块求解器，用图神经网络参数化其松弛二次规划形式，实现大规模高效优化；通过条件期望舍入恢复离散分配，并给出理论保证。

Result: 在合成蜂窝图和真实5G网络上，所提方法在模干扰降低、冲突消除和计算效率方面一致优于现有的模干扰感知基线方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于同余分解与神经块求解器的PCI分配框架能够高效解决大规模多目标组合优化问题，在干扰抑制与冲突消除上均表现优越，具备实际应用价值。

Abstract: Physical Cell Identity (PCI) assignment is essential for interference management in dense 5G networks. As cellular networks scale, PCI reuse becomes unavoidable, which may cause collisions, confusions, and multiple forms of modular interference. Jointly mitigating these effects gives rise to a large-scale, multi-objective combinatorial optimization problem that is difficult to solve efficiently at practical network scales. In this work, we propose a congruence decomposition framework with neural block solvers for large-scale PCI assignment. The proposed decomposition exploits the arithmetic structure of PCI values to decouple multiple modular interference objectives into a collection of blockwise Min-$k$-Partition subproblems, followed by a graph coloring procedure to resolve PCI conflicts. For the resulting NP-hard Min-$k$-Partition subproblems, we develop neural block solvers by parameterizing their relaxed quadratic formulations with graph neural networks, enabling efficient optimization at large scales. Discrete assignments are recovered through conditional expectation rounding with theoretical guarantees. Experiments on synthetic cellular graphs and real-world 5G networks show that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing modular-interference-aware baselines in modular interference reduction, conflict elimination, and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [526] [Read, Write, Relax: Why Neural PDE Surrogates Need Both Global and Local Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21677)
*Anuj Kumar,Heiko Zimmermann,Josiah Bjorgaard,Jacan Chaplais,Nikolaos Bouklas,Matteo Salvador,Alexander Lavin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的神经网络求解器框架Read-Write-Relax (RWR)，将全局潜在注意力与局部消息传递相结合，弥补了两大类网格模拟神经代理模型（全局模型与局部模型）在工业级大规模/高维问题上各自的局限，实现全频谱误差校正，取得了最先进的精度、数据效率和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网格模拟的神经代理模型分为两类：全局模型（通过少量潜在token路由信息）和局部模型（跨网格边进行消息传递）。然而这两类方法都无法胜任工业界所面临的高维、大规模或复杂网格模拟场景。作者通过理论分析发现，全局模型中的潜在注意力等价于空间低通滤波器，而局部消息传递缺乏传播远距离信息所需的全局可达性，二者在误差谱上恰好互补但各自孤立时都无法独立解决完整问题。

Method: 作者通过将潜在注意力视为低频误差校正器、消息传递视为高频误差校正器，建立了二者的统一理论框架，指出两者联合起来恰好构成一个多重网格（multigrid）循环的两半。基于此洞察，提出Read-Write-Relax (RWR)架构：在统一公式下交错执行潜在注意力（负责低频误差校正）与消息传递松弛（负责高频误差校正），使整个误差谱上的误差均能被有效降低。

Result: 在工业和公开基准测试中，RWR在几乎所有的对比中都取得了最高的精度；在数据稀缺场景下具有显著的数据效率优势；在工程关心的物理量上保持准确；并且能够将全场预测扩展到具有挑战性的大规模问题。

Conclusion: 该工作不仅从理论上揭示了现有全局与局部神经模拟器的本质局限（分别作为低通与高通误差滤波器），而且通过多网格启发式的统一框架证明了二者的互补性，RWR作为融合两类操作的架构在精度、数据效率和可扩展性上全面超越基线，为工业级大规模网格模拟提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Recent mesh-based simulation advances have, in no small part, relied on neural surrogates of two distinct families: global models that route information through a small set of latent tokens, and local models that perform message passing across mesh edges. Consistent with both classes is the inability to perform beyond low-dimensional problems and small-scale or oversimplified meshes, the simulation regimes where industrial problems reside. Our work shows this explicitly and presents a unified formulation. In global approaches, latent-token attention acts as a spatial low-pass filter, while local message passing lacks the global reach necessary to propagate information across large mesh spaces. Viewed through the error, the two operators are the halves of a multigrid cycle: one corrects errors at the lower end of the spectrum, the other at the higher end, and neither can do the other's job. We introduce Read-Write-Relax (RWR), which interleaves latent attention with message-passing relaxation under a unified formulation. The interleaved processor lowers error across the entire spectrum, making RWR the most accurate model in nearly every comparison across our industrial and public benchmarks. It is also markedly data-efficient in the scarce-data regimes, accurate on the engineering quantities of interest, and scales full-field predictions to challenging, large-scale problems.

</details>


### [527] [KAN-Robust-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21488)
*Mohammad Meymani,Roozbeh Razavi-Far*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了不同Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）架构在强对抗性逃逸攻击下的认证鲁棒性和经验鲁棒性，使用随机平滑和区间边界传播提供数学基础，并系统评估了FGSM、PGD和C&W攻击下各种防御与非防御KAN模型的鲁棒性，以寻找最优防御策略和架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在面对对抗性威胁时表现出严重漏洞，其中逃逸攻击最为突出，攻击者通过生成人眼难以察觉的扰动样本即可高置信度地欺骗模型，构成严重的安全威胁。因此需要研究不同模型架构在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性，特别是新兴的KAN架构。

Method: 首先为随机平滑（randomized smoothing）和区间边界传播（interval bound propagation）提供数学基础，并报告模型在随机平滑下的ℓ2认证鲁棒性；随后系统性地在FGSM、PGD和C&W三种强对抗攻击下评估各种有防御和无防御KAN模型的鲁棒性，以确定最优的防御策略和架构。

Result: 报告了KAN模型在随机平滑下的ℓ2认证鲁棒性结果，并通过FGSM、PGD和C&W攻击下的系统性评估，得出了不同KAN架构在各种防御条件下的经验鲁棒性表现。

Conclusion: 通过比较不同防御策略和KAN网络架构的鲁棒性表现，找到了针对KAN模型的最优防御策略和网络架构，为提升KAN模型在对抗性环境中的安全性提供了指导。

Abstract: While machine learning models have demonstrated strong performance in many domains, these models have shown profound vulnerabilities when they are exposed to adversarial threats. While adversarial attacks fall into various categories, the most prominent category in research studies is evasion. In evasion attacks, the adversary generates perturbed versions of samples, which might not be observable by human eyes. These samples generally fool the machine learning models with high confidence. This phenomenon poses a significant security violation against machine learning models. In this paper, we investigate the certified and empirical robustness of various Kolmogorov-Arnold network architectures against strong evasion attacks. At first, we provide the mathematical foundations for randomized smoothing and interval bound propagation, and report the $\ell_2$-certified robustness of the models under randomized smoothing. After that, we systematically evaluate the robustness of various defended and undefended KAN models under FGSM, PGD, and C&W attacks in order to find out the optimal defense strategies and architectures.

</details>


### [528] [The geometry of AI validation: Exact certification limits for iid best-of-N search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21496)
*Ricardo Fitas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将AI系统的验证与部署视为可靠性曲面上的核（kernel），其跨度几何可区分复制（降低采样噪声）与新干预方向（降低结构盲区）。对iid best-of-N搜索，在标量排序、随机平局、最大选择、有界二元真值和稳定排序-真值关系的假设下，证明了从$n=m$处观测可靠性到$n=N$的精确模糊宽度为$B_{m,N}=1+2\sum_{r=1}^{m}(-1)^r\cos^{2N}\{r\pi/[2(m+1)]\}$，并推导出主导尺度为$m^2/N$。由此提出"两个门控"的审计规则：先建立结构覆盖，再添加独立任务以提升精度。实证分析表明基于82个发现任务冻结的分数尾部审计规则能显著降低保留集的误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统越来越多地生成备选方案、检查证据并部署选定的输出，因此验证是相对于目标的：证据仅在由产生它的干预方法所解决的方向上证明部署的有效性。现有方法未能精确刻画这种目标相对性，缺乏对不同干预方向（复制vs新干预）效果的严格数学框架。作者希望建立一种形式化的验证与部署规则表示，能精确区分降低采样噪声的复制与降低结构盲区的新干预方向，并为审计规则提供理论边界。

Method: 作者将验证和部署规则表示为可靠性曲面上的核（kernels），利用其跨度几何来分析验证的模糊性。对于iid best-of-N搜索，在标量排序、随机平局、最大选择、有界二元真值和稳定排序-真值关系的条件下，推导出精确的模糊宽度$B_{m,N}$的闭式表达式。通过显式构造有界世界达到整个区间证明其紧性，并利用单调性得到精确的均匀逼近前沿、利用Lipschitz界得到精确的带尾对偶和$L/m^2$量级的模糊度。基于这些理论结果设计了两门控审计规则（先结构覆盖后精度），并在数学推理和代码选择任务上进行回顾性实证。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 精确的模糊宽度公式$B_{m,N}=1+2\sum_{r=1}^{m}(-1)^r\cos^{2N}\{r\pi/[2(m+1)]\}$；(2) 显式有界世界可达到整个区间，完整前缀是限于$n\le m$的可靠性均值审计中信息最大化的；(3) 主导尺度为$m^2/N$，当$m$与$\sqrt{N}$成比例时模糊度约为0.83，模糊宽度达到$\varepsilon$需要$m$为$\sqrt{N\log(1/\varepsilon)}$的量级；(4) 单调性给出精确均匀逼近前沿，Lipschitz界给出精确带尾对偶和$L/m^2$量级模糊度；(5) 在数学推理和代码选择的回顾性研究中，分数尾部审计规则在82个发现任务上冻结能显著降低保留集误差。

Conclusion: 该框架表明验证本质上受干预方向所限：复制减少采样噪声但不减少结构盲区，只有新的干预方向才能减少结构盲区。两门控审计规则（先建立结构覆盖、再独立任务提精度）提供了实用的审计路径。但作者明确指出，对于iid搜索之外的情形，该几何仅适用于已知或独立估计的核；实证分析仅是说明性的而非前瞻性干预。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly generate alternatives, inspect evidence, and deploy a selected output. Validation is therefore target-relative: evidence certifies deployment only in directions resolved by the interventions that produced it. We represent validation and deployment rules as kernels over a reliability surface. Their span geometry separates replication, which reduces sampling noise, from new intervention directions, which reduce structural blindness. We make this principle exact for iid best-of-$N$ search. Under scalar ranking, randomized ties, maximum selection, bounded binary truth, and a stable rank-truth relation, knowing best-of-$n$ reliability through $n=m$ leaves exact ambiguity width $B_{m,N}=1+2\sum_{r=1}^{m}(-1)^r\cos^{2N}{rπ/[2(m+1)]}$. Explicit bounded worlds attain the entire interval, and the complete prefix is information-maximal among reliability-mean audits confined to $n\le m$. The governing scale is $m^2/N$: when $m$ is proportional to $\sqrt{N}$, ambiguity remains about 0.83, while width $\varepsilon$ requires $m$ of order $\sqrt{N\log(1/\varepsilon)}$. Monotonicity gives an exact uniform-approximation frontier; a Lipschitz bound gives an exact capped-tail dual and order-sharp $L/m^2$ ambiguity. These results yield a two-gate audit rule: establish structural coverage, then add independent tasks for precision. Retrospective studies of mathematical reasoning and code selection construct compatible deployment values with wide separation and show that a score-tail audit rule frozen on 82 discovery tasks substantially reduces held-out error. Beyond iid search, the geometry applies only to known or independently estimated kernels; the empirical analyses are illustrative rather than prospective interventions.

</details>


### [529] [Selection of Heart Sound Segments for Synchronous Classification of Multi-channel Heart Sounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21499)
*Marcelo Nogueira,Jorge H. Oliveira,Carlos F. Ferreira,Miguel T. Coimbra,Alípio M. Jorge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于同步多通道心音分析的分类方法，通过从四个听诊区域选择最优心音片段并输入多输入CNN进行同步分析，在735名患者的CirCor DigiScope数据集上达到96.5%的总体准确率，相比单通道和异步多通道方法提升9.1%，并证实了片段选择策略的统计显著性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心脏听诊是心血管疾病最具成本效益的筛查手段，医生通常在四个主要听诊部位进行听诊。然而，现有的自动心音分析算法要么使用单通道心音分类，要么在多通道时逐通道独立分析，没有模仿医生同步分析多通道心音的做法。作者希望通过研究同步多通道分析是否能优于单通道和异步多通道方法，以捕捉通道间的干扰现象。

Method: 提出一个片段选择算法，从四个听诊位置中识别最优心音片段；然后将选出的四个心音片段同步输入一个多输入CNN进行分类。该同步方法将片段选择与多输入CNN相结合，实现多通道心音的联合分析。

Result: 所提出的同步方法达到96.5%的总体准确率，相比最佳单通道及异步多通道方法有9.1%的提升。片段选择策略相对于随机选择的优势经配对统计显著性检验确认（p=0.003）。结果基于CirCor DigiScope数据集中735名具有完整四个听诊位置录音的患者。

Conclusion: 同步多通道心音分析显著优于单通道和异步多通道方法，验证了模仿医生听诊流程的可行性。片段选择算法的有效性也得到了统计验证。作者同时讨论了研究结果的适用范围和泛化性限制。

Abstract: Cardiac auscultation remains the most cost-effective screening procedure for cardiovascular diseases, and requires listening at the four main auscultation spots. Despite this, automatic heart sound analysis algorithms mostly classify patients using a single heart sound (single-channel), or, when using more than one (multi-channel), analyze each channel individually. To our knowledge, no prior work classifies patients through the synchronous analysis of multi-channel heart sounds, following the procedure used by physicians. This motivates us to study whether synchronous multi-channel analysis outperforms single-channel approaches, and whether it holds an advantage over asynchronous multi-channel methods that analyze channels one by one, potentially by capturing inter-channel interference phenomena. To answer these questions, we introduce a selection algorithm that identifies optimal heart sound segments from each of the four auscultation spots, which are then fed into a multi-input CNN that classifies patients by analyzing the four selected sounds simultaneously. Our synchronous approach, combining the proposed selection algorithm with a multi-input CNN, achieves a superior overall accuracy of 96.5\%, a 9.1\% gain over the best-performing single-channel and asynchronous multi-channel methods. The benefit of the proposed segment selection strategy over random selection is confirmed by a paired statistical significance test ($p = 0.003$). These results were obtained on 735 patients from the CirCor DigiScope dataset with complete recordings from all four spots, and their scope and generalizability are discussed in light of this and other methodological considerations.

</details>


### [530] [ChemDIRT: A Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark for Robust Chemistry-LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21504)
*Eric Inae,Tim Gunn,Chris Bond,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ChemDIRT，一个用于评估大语言模型化学推理鲁棒性的综合基准框架，通过变换指令、分子表示和覆盖八类化学任务来系统衡量模型的准确性和一致性，发现现有模型存在显著的提示敏感性和表示依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有化学基准仅聚焦有限任务集，忽略了模型对问题表述和化学表示变化的鲁棒性，导致报告的性能可能高估模型在真实场景中的推理能力。

Method: ChemDIRT框架系统性地在指令和分子表征两个维度引入变化，覆盖八类化学任务类别，从准确性和一致性两个角度评估LLMs的化学推理鲁棒性。

Result: 对多种开源和闭源LLMs进行基准测试，发现模型存在显著的提示敏感性、表示依赖性，以及在不同任务族之间的表现不均匀。

Conclusion: ChemDIRT相比传统单格式基准能提供更可靠的模型化学推理能力评估，揭示现有模型在鲁棒性方面的不足。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has led to increasing interest in their application to scientific domains such as chemistry. However, existing chemistry benchmarks often provide only a narrow view of model capability, focusing on limited task sets while overlooking robustness to variations in problem formulation and chemical representation. As a result, reported performance may overestimate a model's true ability to reason consistently across realistic settings. To address this challenge, we introduce ChemDIRT (Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark), a comprehensive evaluation framework designed to assess the robustness of chemical reasoning in LLMs. ChemDIRT systematically measures model performance across variations in instructions and molecular representations while spanning eight categories of chemistry tasks. By evaluating both accuracy and consistency under these controlled perturbations, ChemDIRT provides a more reliable assessment of model reasoning capabilities than conventional single-format benchmarks. We benchmark a diverse set of open- and closed-source LLMs, revealing substantial prompt sensitivity, representation dependence, and uneven performance across task families.

</details>


### [531] [Multimodal Injury Risk and Performance Prediction in Tennis Using Weighted Ensemble Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21530)
*Weihao Qu,Dongyang Wang,Ling Zheng,Francisco E. Alvarez,Shobharani Polasa,Jiacun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个名为PART（Predictive Athlete Readiness for Tennis）的多模态加权集成学习框架，用于监测网球运动员的健康状况并估计近期受伤风险。该框架整合了生理指标、训练与比赛数据、可穿戴设备睡眠数据、自我报告问卷、垂直跳跃评估和比赛视频动作分析等多种模态，通过四个专门模型提取运动员特征，并采用监督加权集成策略组合预测结果。在九名大学网球运动员的数据上评估显示其性能良好，且对业余爱好者也有应用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的运动员表现与受伤风险预测主要依赖主观观察或专家评估，数据可用性有限。虽然足球、篮球、摔跤等项目已开始整合可穿戴设备等异构数据源，但网球领域的多模态方法仍未被充分探索，因此需要开发针对网球的多模态预测框架。

Method: PART框架包含多模态数据采集（生理指标、训练比赛数据、睡眠信息、自我报告问卷、垂直跳跃和视频动作分析），通过专用机器学习和深度学习模型独立提取四项运动员特征（整体健康状况、受伤风险、身体能力、打法风格），最后采用监督加权集成策略，根据每个模型的可靠性自适应分配权重进行组合预测。

Result: 在九名大学网球运动员的多模态数据评估中，PART在监测运动员健康状况和估计近期受伤易感性方面表现出强劲性能。该框架还被证明对休闲网球运动员具有应用前景。

Conclusion: PART展示了多模态加权集成学习在网球运动员健康和受伤风险监测中的有效性，不仅适用于大学运动员，也能为休闲网球运动员提供个性化洞察以降低受伤风险并优化表现。

Abstract: Machine learning has had a positive impact on the sports industry, with one of its most promising applications being the prediction of athlete performance and injury risk. Recent advances have employed state-of-the-art models to improve prediction accuracy, yet progress remains limited by data availability and the reliance on subjective observations or expert assessments. To address these limitations, researchers in sports such as soccer, basketball, and wrestling have begun integrating heterogeneous data sources, such as wearable device readings, with traditional subjective assessments. However, similar multimodal approaches remain underexplored in tennis. In this work, we propose a multimodal weighted ensemble learning framework, Predictive Athlete Readiness for Tennis (PART), to monitor athlete wellness and estimate near-term injury risk in tennis players. PART processes a wide range of inputs, including physiological metrics, training and match data, sleep information from wearable devices, self-reported questionnaires, vertical jump assessments, and motion analysis from match-play videos. From these modalities, specialized machine learning and deep learning models independently extract four athlete-specific characteristics: overall wellness, injury risk, physical capability, and playing style. To overcome the complexity of combining these diverse modalities, PART employs a supervised weighted ensemble integration strategy, assigning adaptive weights to each predictive model based on its reliability. Evaluation of multimodal data collected from nine collegiate tennis players demonstrates that PART achieves strong performance in monitoring athlete wellness and estimating near-term injury susceptibility. Beyond collegiate athletes, the framework also shows promise for recreational tennis players, offering personalized insights to mitigate injury risk and optimize performance.

</details>


### [532] [Federated Continual Learning as a Distributed Drift-Plus-Penalty Control Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21539)
*Nazreen Shah,Naveen Kumar Reddy Somireddy,Zubair Shaban,Ranjitha Prasad,B. N. Bharath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedQCL框架，将联邦持续学习（FCL）建模为随机控制问题，通过Lyapunov漂移加惩罚（DPP）优化和虚拟队列机制显式调控跨任务和跨客户的遗忘累积，在不增加通信开销和无需梯度投影的前提下，实现稳定性-可塑性权衡的可解释、可调节控制，并在Split-CIFAR-10/100和Split-TinyImageNet基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FCL方法将持续学习视为每个客户端上局部应用的逐任务优化问题序列，通过重放、正则化或基于投影的约束等启发式机制耦合聚合。但FCL中的遗忘本质上是长期、分布式的现象，源于时间维度的任务演化和跨客户端数据异质性的交互作用，现有方法未对其显式调控。

Method: 将FCL形式化为随机控制问题，提出基于Lyapunov漂移加惩罚（DPP）优化的FedQCL框架。引入虚拟队列追踪遗忘在任务和客户端间的累积，通过优化DPP目标在提升当前任务性能的同时，利用队列机制提供单一参数即可解释、可调节的稳定性-塑性权衡控制，无需梯度投影或额外通信开销。

Result: 在Split-CIFAR-10、Split-CIFAR-100和Split-TinyImageNet标准基准上的实证评估表明，FedQCL在异质数据分布下相比最先进的基线方法在准确率上表现更优，同时显著降低了遗忘。

Conclusion: FedQCL通过将FCL重新表述为随机控制问题并利用Lyapunov优化理论，实现了对遗忘累积的显式、可解释控制，为联邦持续学习中的稳定性-塑性权衡提供了理论支撑和实用的单参数调控机制，在准确性和抗遗忘性两方面均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Federated Continual Learning (FCL) is fundamental to real-world distributed learning systems, requiring models to adapt to sequential, non-IID data across clients while mitigating catastrophic forgetting and client drift. Existing approaches formulate continual learning (CL) as a sequence of per-task optimization problems, applied locally at each client and coupled through aggregation, using heuristic mechanisms such as replay, regularization, or projection-based constraints. However, forgetting in FCL is inherently a long-term, distributed phenomenon, arising from the interaction of temporal task evolution and cross-client heterogeneity, which is not explicitly regulated. In this work, we cast FCL as a stochastic control problem and propose Federated Queue-regulated Continual Learning (FedQCL), a framework based on Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty (DPP) optimization. FedQCL introduces virtual queues to track the accumulation of forgetting across tasks and clients, enabling explicit control of the stability-plasticity trade-off. By optimizing a DPP objective, the method jointly improves current-task performance while the queue-based formulation provides an interpretable and tunable mechanism to balance adaptation and retention through a single parameter, without requiring gradient projection or additional communication overhead. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks, including Split-CIFAR-10, Split-CIFAR-100, and Split-TinyImageNet, demonstrate that FedQCL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with respect to accuracy while significantly reducing forgetting under heterogeneous data distributions.

</details>


### [533] [Beyond Sparse Weights: When Is Attention Compressible?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21541)
*Chiwun Yang,Xiaoyu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出KV缓存压缩仅以注意力图稀疏性为依据是不充分的，提出需要从全局分数差距、遗漏值加权和与未来查询/任务的交互三个维度判断可压缩性，并据此提出训练免费的压缩器CertKV，在多项基准上取得领先效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法通常以注意力图存在少数大权重（稀疏性）作为压缩依据，但这一论据不完整：大权重未必占据大部分质量；被省略的值可能相互抵消；即使保留了注意力输出也不一定能保留下游任务性能。作者认为需要将这些不同的问题分离分析。

Method: 提出三个关键洞察：(1) 全局分数差距而非阈值计数决定保留目标质量所需的token数量；(2) 对给定行，被省略值的加权和是精确的缺失统计量；(3) 引入受控的"检索-聚合"模型解释截断何时有效、何时有害。基于这些分析提出CertKV，一种无需训练的压缩器：每个头部保留一个尾部和（tail-summary）槽位，其余槽位按值分散度（value dispersion）分配。

Result: 在相同预算下，CertKV在LongBench-v2的九个设置中有七个进入前二；在128K RULER上保持在领先压缩层级；在Llama原型中实现了十倍的缓存预算压缩。

Conclusion: 可压缩性取决于质量分布、值信息、未来查询和任务本身，而非仅凭注意力图外观上的稀疏性即可判断；基于此理解的CertKV证明了分离这些因素能带来更有效的压缩。

Abstract: KV-cache compression is often justified by attention maps with a few large weights. This is incomplete: large weights may not contain most of the mass, omitted values can cancel, and preserving the attention output may not preserve the task. We separate these questions. Global score gaps -- not threshold counts -- determine how many tokens are needed to retain a target mass. For a realized row, the weighted sum of omitted values is the exact missing statistic. A controlled retrieval--aggregation model explains when truncation helps and when it hurts. These results motivate CertKV, a training-free compressor that reserves one tail-summary slot per head and allocates the rest by value dispersion. Under matched budgets, CertKV is top-two in seven of nine LongBench-v2 settings, remains in the leading compressed tier on 128K RULER, and realizes a ten-fold cache budget in a packed Llama prototype. Compressibility depends on the mass, values, future queries, and task -- not on a sparse-looking map alone.

</details>


### [534] [Loss-Parameterized Fisher Width Along Learning Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21561)
*Vu Khac Ky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Fisher宽度在训练轨迹中的演化，探索训练损失能否作为其有效坐标。作者推导了精确的迹-形状分解和确定性稳定性界，在群体高斯教师逻辑回归模型中证明了教师对齐态在损失低于log 2时是极值点，并证明群体梯度流渐近地选择该分支。最终得到了Fisher宽度与损失平方根的显式极限比例，并通过实验支持"分支性而非普适性"的损失参数化观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Fisher宽度衡量探测集在局部Fisher几何形变下的高斯宽度，但其沿学习轨迹的演化规律尚不清楚。作者希望回答训练损失能否作为Fisher宽度的一个有效坐标，从而建立可预测的动力学描述。

Method: 1) 推导固定紧致探测集的精确迹-形状分解与确定性稳定性界；2) 在群体高斯教师逻辑回归模型中分析教师对齐态在不同损失水平下的极值性质（最小参数范数、最大化Fisher迹和欧氏球Fisher宽度）；3) 证明群体梯度流渐近收敛到该分支并给出对齐与正交坐标的显式收敛速率；4) 通过全Fisher数值实验、非线性MLP中对角模型Fisher近似的GD/SGD/Adam对比实验进行验证。

Result: 对d≥2维空间，得到Fisher宽度与损失平方根之比渐近收敛到(√6/π)E[χ_{d-1}]的显式常数。全Fisher实验支持匹配合的损失分支和群体预测。在MLP实验中，GD与SGD在匹配损失下保持接近，而Adam明显偏离；固定探测集的时间形状高度相似。这些结果表明Fisher宽度应采用分支性而非普适性的损失参数化。

Conclusion: 训练损失可以作为Fisher宽度的有效坐标，但这种参数化是分支依赖的而非普适的：不同优化算法（如Adam）可能沿不同的损失-宽度分支演化，因此需要按分支进行校准和预测。

Abstract: Fisher width measures the Gaussian width of a probe set after deformation by the local Fisher geometry. We study its evolution along learning trajectories and ask when training loss can serve as an effective coordinate for this quantity.
  We first derive an exact trace--shape factorization and a deterministic stability bound for fixed compact probes. In a population Gaussian-teacher logistic model, the teacher-aligned state is extremal on every loss level below $\log 2$: it has minimal parameter norm and maximizes both Fisher trace and Euclidean-ball Fisher width. We then show that population gradient flow asymptotically selects this branch, with explicit rates for the aligned and orthogonal coordinates. This yields, for $d\geq2$, \[
  \frac{w_F(B_2^d;θ(t))}
  {\sqrt{L(θ(t))}}
  \longrightarrow
  \frac{\sqrt6}π\mathbb E[χ_{d-1}]. \] Controlled full-Fisher experiments support the matched-loss branch and the population predictions. In a nonlinear MLP with a diagonal model-Fisher approximation, GD and SGD remain close at matched loss, whereas Adam follows a substantially displaced branch; the fixed probes tested retain highly similar temporal shapes. These results support a branchwise, rather than universal, loss parametrization of Fisher width.

</details>


### [535] [Anchoring Bias: A Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack against MLLMs under Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21577)
*Yuyang Luo,Kai Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PFBA（持久公平性后门攻击），首次研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中由后门引发的公平性违规能否在持续学习（CL）过程中存活。PFBA通过潜在空间公平性强化和持续学习模拟两种机制，向MLLM注入持久的、针对特定群体的歧视性行为，实验证明其能跨越持续学习轮次持续存在并规避标准后门防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在高风险领域部署时公平性是关键安全要求，且模型在实践中不断通过持续学习更新。已有研究表明后门攻击可操纵MLLM响应，但植入的后门在后续CL更新中会退化。目前尚不清楚后门引发的公平性违规能否在CL中存活，两个关键问题未解：（1）后门能否可靠地在MLLM中引发公平性违规；（2）此类公平性定向后门能否在持续学习中持久存在。

Method: 提出的PFBA包含两个新颖机制：（1）潜在空间公平性强化（Latent Space Fairness Reinforcement）——重塑模型的深层特征几何结构，锚定特权群体表示以保持效用，同时排斥并聚拢目标群体表示以维持歧视；（2）持续学习模拟（Continual Learning Simulation）——针对模拟的参数漂移迭代优化触发器，确保后门在未来更新中持久存在。

Result: 大量实验表明，PFBA能诱导严重的公平性差距，这些差距在持续学习轮次中持续存在，并且能够规避标准的后门防御机制。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了后门攻击与公平性在持续学习交叉领域的研究空白，证明了MLLM在持续更新过程中仍可能遭受持久性公平性后门攻击，对MLLM的安全部署提出了新的警示。数据和代码已公开。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains where fairness is a critical safety requirement. In practice, these models are continually updated through continual learning (CL) to adapt to evolving tasks and data distributions. Prior work has shown that backdoor attacks can manipulate MLLM responses through hidden triggers, but naively implanted backdoors degrade as models undergo subsequent updates of CL. Although fairness has emerged as a central concern for MLLM deployment, whether backdoor-induced fairness violations can survive CL remains unexplored, leaving two critical questions unanswered: (1) whether a backdoor can reliably induce fairness violations in MLLMs, and (2) whether such fairness-targeted backdoors can persist through continual learning. We bridge this gap by proposing Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack (PFBA) to inject persistent and group-specific discrimination into MLLMs. Specifically, PFBA achieves this through two novel mechanisms. The Latent Space Fairness Reinforcement reshapes the model's deep feature geometry by anchoring privileged-group representations to preserve utility while repelling and clustering targeted-group representations to sustain discrimination, and the Continual Learning Simulation iteratively optimizes the trigger against simulated parameter drift to ensure backdoor persistence across future updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PFBA induces severe fairness disparities that persist across continual learning rounds, evading standard backdoor defenses. The data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/lyygua/PFBA.

</details>


### [536] [Posterior Information Dynamics of Diffusion Models for Linear Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21709)
*Xiangming Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过"平滑似然力"（smoothed likelihood force）——即精确后验与先验score之差——系统研究了扩散模型在求解线性逆问题中测量信息的注入过程，建立了信息增益与去噪误差之间的I-MMSE恒等式，并通过可解模型与实验验证了信息在不同噪声水平下的分配规律及其对逆问题求解质量的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型常被用作线性逆问题的先验，但现有研究仅关注重建结果的质量，并未揭示测量信息何时进入反向去噪过程、以及这些信息如何沿信号方向分配。理解这一信息注入的动态过程对改进逆问题求解策略具有重要意义。

Method: 定义平滑似然力为精确后验score与先验score之差，分析其期望平方范数的性质。对固定测量，该量同时给出后验-先验相对熵耗散与反向路径相对熵增长；对测量取平均可导出I-MMSE恒等式。利用有限二阶矩假设，分析高噪声下力能量及与先验score能量比值随噪声核信号系数的二次衰减行为。通过可解模型验证理论预测，并在FFHQ冻结模型上比较不同光谱遮罩的零空间轨迹统计。

Result: 推导出信息增益与去噪误差之间的I-MMSE恒等式；证明在高噪声下力能量及其与先验score能量之比随噪声核信号系数二次衰减；可解模型表明：条件化会移除已被测量解释的类别分离，将n个经验样本上的均匀指标熵从log n降至H(I|r)，且即使奇异值相同，信息同化也依赖于算子与先验的对齐程度；FFHQ实验中相同光谱但不同遮罩产生不同的先验归一化零空间轨迹统计。

Conclusion: 平滑似然力提供了一个统一的框架来量化扩散模型求解逆问题时测量信息的注入时机与方向分配，揭示了信息同化不仅取决于奇异值谱，还取决于算子与先验的结构对齐，为设计更高效的逆问题求解策略提供了理论依据。
