We propose DSSM-CRF, an audio-only architecture that explicitly separates these processes. Bidirectional state-space models encode fused self-supervised speech representations at frame and dialogue scales, so each utterance representation captures local prosody and context from all speakers. The decoder then orders each speaker's utterances into an independent dynamic conditional random field chain. Consecutive utterances in a speaker's chain form a transition pair whose score combines a corpus-level transition matrix with a residual predicted from the two contextualized utterances. An auxiliary objective supervises whether each pair changes emotion but does not participate in Viterbi inference. Thus, interlocutor turns affect contextual emotion scores without being treated as transitions in another speaker's emotion trajectory. DSSM-CRF achieves 75.81% UA and 74.90% WA on IEMOCAP, and 54.72% WA and 49.31% WF1 on MELD. Matched controls demonstrate complementary gains from speaker-wise factorization and CRF modeling.

</details>


### [604] [Geometric Structures on Graphs: a Holonomy-Based Discretization of Curvature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22453)
*Hao Li,Yuhan Peng,Junwen Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于和乐（holonomy）的图曲率离散化框架。每个顶点带有局部对称正定（SPD）度规，每条有向边带有可逆且度量兼容的传输算子。围绕有向三角环的有序乘积给出和乐，其归一化对数作为有限环曲率观测。由于该曲率观测位于正交李代数中而非SPD度规的速度空间，作者引入两种聚合机制（对称响应矩阵的交换子、曲率诱导边通量的协变散度）以生成对称的Ricci型度量响应，并支持保持正定性的指数更新。此外还给出了可参数化的可逆度量兼容边传输，以及球面上的已知几何校准实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图上的曲率离散化往往将和乐视为启发式特征，缺乏与几何原理（无穷小和乐由曲率控制）的直接联系。本文旨在建立一种严格基于和乐原理的图曲率框架，使离散化的曲率观测与连续几何中的曲率-和乐关系保持一致，从而更忠实于底层的微分几何结构。

Method: （1）为图的每个顶点赋予SPD纤维度规g_i，每条有向边赋予可逆度量兼容传输F_ij；（2）沿有向三角环计算有序乘积得到和乐H_C，取其归一化对数Ω_C=-s_C^{-1}Log(H_C)作为有限环曲率观测；（3）由于Ω_C位于g_i-正交李代数（非SPD速度空间），引入两种聚合机制：与对称响应矩阵的交换子得到对称Ricci型响应，以及曲率诱导边通量的协变散度；（4）响应具有局部正交规范等变性，通过指数更新保持正定性；（5）提出可逆度量兼容的边传输参数化，使正交边因子、环尺度、权重和响应矩阵可学习。

Result: 在单位球面上的已知几何校准中验证了：和乐-曲率关系的正确性、非平凡局部度量表示下曲率的保持性，以及从局部观测中经验性地恢复边传输的能力。

Conclusion: 该框架成功将微分几何中"无穷小和乐由曲率控制"的核心原理离散化到图上，通过规范等变的聚合机制将正交李代数中的曲率观测转化为SPD度规的对称响应，既保持了几何保真度又具有可学习性，为图上的几何深度学习提供了一种理论根基扎实的曲率构造。

Abstract: We propose a holonomy-based framework for discretizing curvature on graphs equipped with local symmetric positive-definite metrics. Each vertex carries a fibre metric \(g_i\), and each directed edge carries a reversible metric-compatible transport \(F_{ij}\). The ordered product around an oriented triangular loop \(\mathcal C\) gives a holonomy \(H_{\mathcal C}\), whose normalized logarithm \(Ω_{\mathcal C}=-s_{\mathcal C}^{-1}\operatorname{Log}(H_{\mathcal C})\) is used as a finite-loop curvature observation. Thus the construction discretizes the geometric principle that infinitesimal holonomy is controlled by curvature, rather than treating holonomy as a heuristic feature. Since \(Ω_{\mathcal C}\) lies in the \(g_i\)-orthogonal Lie algebra, it is not itself a velocity of an SPD metric. We therefore introduce two aggregation mechanisms: a commutator with a symmetric response matrix, producing symmetric Ricci-type metric responses, and an incidence-aware covariant divergence of curvature-induced edge fluxes, reflecting the relation between trace and covariant divergence. The resulting responses are locally orthogonal-gauge equivariant and can drive exponential updates that preserve positive definiteness. We also give a reversible metric-compatible parametrization of edge transports, allowing orthogonal edge factors, loop scales, weights, and response matrices to be learned while respecting the graph geometry. Known-geometry calibrations on the unit sphere test the holonomy--curvature relation, curvature preservation under nontrivial local metric representations, and the empirical recovery of edge transports from local observations.

</details>


### [605] [KPI-Conditioned Generative Design of Automotive Hood Inner Panels: A Two-Stage Retrieval-Generation Pipeline with Surrogate-Based Performance Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22457)
*Sudeep Chavare*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段逆设计流水线：可及性阶段判断哪些拓扑族能满足给定性能需求，条件变分自编码器生成点云几何，神经算子代理评估候选设计性能。流水线完全基于公开数据和免费算力构建，并部署为交互式工具。研究发现代理模型在聚合层面准确，但其误差与需区分的类内性能差异相当，这一比值决定了此类流水线的可行性边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业零件设计中，正向映射（几何到性能）已通过机器学习代理变得快速常规；但逆向映射（从需求生成几何）对于设计空间按离散拓扑族而非连续参数组织的问题尚未得到有效解决。

Method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 可及性阶段——判断哪些拓扑族能够满足给定的需求向量；(2) 条件变分自编码器（CVAE）在选定族内生成点云几何，再由神经算子代理估计每个候选的性能。全部基于公开数据和免费算力构建，并部署为交互式工具。

Result: 流水线可行，但存在关键限制：代理模型在聚合统计上准确，然而其误差与需要区分的性能差异处于同一量级，这限制了对任何单个生成设计所能做出的性能声明。

Conclusion: 代理误差与类内信号之比是决定此类流水线能否有效工作的关键量，本文将此限定性发现作为主要结论而非附属说明提出，为该领域后续研究提供了重要的评价准则。

Abstract: An inner hood panel must meet a deflection target, stay below a stress limit, and hit a mass target. Machine-learned surrogates have made the forward direction, geometry to performance, fast and routine. The inverse direction, producing geometry from a stated requirement, remains largely unaddressed for industrial parts whose design space is organized into discrete topology families rather than a continuous parameterization. This work presents a two-stage pipeline for that inverse problem. A reachability stage determines which topology families can satisfy a given requirement vector. A conditional variational autoencoder then generates point-cloud geometry within a selected family, and a neural-operator surrogate estimates the performance of each candidate. The pipeline is built entirely from public data and freely available compute, and is deployed as an interactive tool. The pipeline works, with qualifications that are reported as primary findings rather than caveats. The surrogate is accurate in aggregate, but its error is comparable to the performance differences it is asked to discriminate, which bounds what can be claimed for any individual generated design. That ratio of surrogate error to within-class signal is argued to be the quantity that determines whether a pipeline of this kind can work at all.

</details>


### [606] [MASH-Bench: Diagnosing Cross-Source Failure in Mass-Shooting Risk Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22460)
*Neha Sharma,Ritesh Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MASH-Bench，一个由4个美国公共大规模枪击数据库（共6,968起事件）整合而成的基准数据集，用于跨数据源风险分类研究。通过留一数据集评估发现，树模型在精选源上表现良好，但在GVA上泛化极差（召回率跌至0.20，精确率仅0.0004）。特征遮蔽消融实验证明特征不完整是跨源失效的主因；DANN领域自适应仅部分改善，标签侧修正（先验平移重校准）无效；审计还发现与媒体归因心理健康标签相关的明显不平等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共大规模枪击数据库在覆盖范围、特征可用性和报告惯例上存在显著差异，这给需要跨数据源泛化的机器学习模型带来挑战。当前缺乏一个统一的基准环境来系统地诊断和评估跨源泛化失败的根本原因。

Method: 构建MASH-Bench（整合Kaggle、Mother Jones、Stanford MSA和GVA四个数据库的6,968起事件），采用留一数据集（LODO）评估策略测试Random Forest、XGBoost和LightGBM。通过受控特征遮蔽消融实验移除缺失于GVA的五个特征，并评估三种领域自适应方法（DANN、CORAL、重要性加权）以及Oracle先验平移重校准，同时进行按群体细分审计。

Result: 树模型在精选源上实现VeryHigh风险召回率0.68-0.89，但在GVA上平均召回率降至0.20、精确率降至0.0004。特征遮蔽使召回率归零，证明特征不完整性是主因。DANN在GVA上将VeryHigh风险召回率提升0.282（p=0.003），但精确率仍低；CORAL和重要性加权召回率为零；Oracle先验平移重校准也未能恢复预测。审计发现与媒体归因精神健康标签相关的显著差异。

Conclusion: 在MASH-Bench中，跨源泛化受限主要源于特征不完整和标签患病率差异，而非分类器选择本身。该基准为跨源风险分类中诊断这些效应提供了受控实验环境。

Abstract: Public mass-shooting databases differ substantially in coverage, feature availability, and reporting practices, creating challenges for machine-learning models that must generalize across data sources. We introduce MASH-Bench, a harmonized benchmark of 6,968 incidents from four U.S. databases: Kaggle, Mother Jones, Stanford MSA, and the Gun Violence Archive (GVA). We evaluate cross-source risk classification using leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation. Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM achieve VeryHigh-risk recall of 0.68-0.89 on the curated sources but generalize poorly to GVA, where mean recall drops to 0.20 and precision to 0.0004. To investigate the source of this degradation, we conduct a controlled feature-masking ablation that removes the five features unavailable in GVA from the curated sources. The resulting recall collapse to zero provides evidence that feature completeness is a major contributor to the observed cross-source failure. We further evaluate three domain-adaptation approaches: DANN, CORAL, and importance weighting. DANN improves VeryHigh-risk recall on GVA by 0.282 (95% CI [0.11, 0.47], p = 0.003), although precision remains low, whereas CORAL and importance weighting yield zero recall. Oracle prior-shift recalibration likewise fails to recover VeryHigh-risk predictions, indicating that label-side correction alone is insufficient under the observed feature deficiencies. A per-group audit further identifies substantial disparities associated with media-attributed mental-health labels. Overall, these results indicate that, in MASH-Bench, cross-source generalization is constrained more by feature completeness and label prevalence than by classifier choice. The benchmark provides a controlled setting for diagnosing these effects in cross-source risk classification.

</details>


### [607] [Functional compatibility as a determinant of persistent neural learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22462)
*Hossein Javidnia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"功能兼容性"（functional compatibility）这一概念，通过受控实验证明它是持续学习（persistent learning）的因果决定因素，并表明该效应在多种架构、模态和种子下具有普适性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工神经网络在持续学习新能力时往往会破坏已有能力（即稳定性-可塑性困境）。已有的重放（replay）、正则化（regularization）和约束更新（constrained-update）方法虽然能缓解遗忘，但尚未明确：新学习的某种固有属性本身是否决定了哪些内容可以在不破坏受保护行为的前提下被保留。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过受控实验设计，将"功能兼容性"作为自变量进行系统性操纵：从匹配的神经状态出发，人为改变新学习与待保留行为之间的兼容程度，并在统一的保留需求条件下测量持续学习效果。实验覆盖了独立的学習方向、卷积网络与Transformer架构、视觉与文本任务以及多种随机种子，并比较了不同学习规则对兼容性的利用效率。

Result: 功能兼容性是持续学习的因果决定因素；该效应在多种架构、模态和种子下泛化成立。不同学习规则对可用兼容性的利用效率存在差异，而保留约束限制了可存储的量。在较大的有限更新幅度下，非线性几何会改变可用的学习机会，最终使匹配的兼容性连续谱无法实现。

Conclusion: 功能兼容性是一个可实验调控的持续神经学习原则。研究将问题从"如何防止遗忘"转向"如何识别新学习中的哪些成分可以安全地成为永久性知识"。

Abstract: Artificial neural networks can acquire new capabilities but often damage existing ones when they continue to learn. This stability-plasticity problem has motivated replay, regularization and constrained-update methods, yet it remains unclear whether a property of incoming learning itself determines what can be retained without disrupting protected behaviour. Here we show that functional compatibility, the extent to which new learning can coexist with behaviour that must be preserved, is a causal determinant of persistent learning. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled causal demonstration in which compatibility is deliberately changed from matched neural states and persistent learning is measured under a common retention requirement. The effect generalizes across independent learning directions, convolutional and transformer architectures, vision and text, and additional seeds. Learning rules differ in how efficiently they exploit available compatibility, while retention constraints limit how much can be stored. At larger finite updates, nonlinear geometry changes the available learning opportunity and ultimately prevents the matched compatibility continuum from being realized. These results establish functional compatibility as an experimentally controllable principle of persistent neural learning, shifting the problem from preventing forgetting towards identifying which components of new learning can safely become permanent.

</details>


### [608] [The Variance of Thought: Policy Variance, Critical Forks, and Local Credit Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22467)
*Yingru Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过策略方差σ²_π(s)=Var_{a~π}[Q_π(s,a)]分析长程语言模型任务（多步推理与工具智能体）中的信用分配问题。在确定性MDP中，策略方差是回报方差的唯一来源，并在称为"关键分叉"的状态处以离散脉冲形式注入。作者提出三个结果：(i)策略方差是发现预算，观测优势为c的动作需要Ω(c²/σ²_π(s))次采样，该界在经典两点分叉上紧致；(ii)策略方差受策略Gini离散度约束σ²_π(s)≤1−‖π(·|s)‖²₂，提供了仅凭logits即可计算的无rollout关键性必要条件；(iii)剩余视界决定估计成本，在下游成功概率为P的分叉处，蒙特卡洛优势估计的信噪比阶为√P，样本成本按1/P缩放（分支采样亦如此）。自举法通过将生存概率乘积转化为加和来消除该成本，前提是值表示具有乘法精度，这支持对数值参数化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程语言模型任务（包括多步推理和工具智能体）受困于信用分配问题——即如何准确地将长期回报归因于中间状态的动作选择。作者试图从策略方差的角度系统地理解这一问题的本质和结构。

Method: 作者将信用分配问题形式化到确定性MDP框架中，重点分析策略方差σ²_π(s)。推导了策略方差作为"发现预算"的采样复杂度下界；利用Gini离散度建立策略方差的上界（基于logits即可计算）；分析蒙特卡洛自举法在关键分叉处的信噪比和样本复杂度，并论证对数值参数化的合理性。

Result: 得到三个主要定理性结果：观测优势为c的动作需要Ω(c²/σ²_π(s))次采样；策略方差受Gini系数约束且可从logits直接计算；蒙特卡洛估计的优势估计信噪比随下游成功概率P的平方根衰减，样本成本为1/P，而自举法可通过将生存概率乘积转为加和来消除该成本（需要乘法精度值表示）。

Conclusion: 长程信用分配的困难源于关键分叉处的策略方差脉冲注入。利用Gini离散度可作为无需rollout的关键性筛选条件，而采用对数值参数化的自举方法能够将乘法传播的成本转化为加法结构，从根本上克服长视界的估计难题。

Abstract: Long-horizon language-model tasks --- multi-step reasoning and tool-using agents alike --- are limited by credit assignment. We analyze it through the policy variance $σ_π^2(s)=\operatorname{Var}_{a\simπ}[Q_π(s,a)]$, which in a deterministic MDP is the sole source of return variance and is injected in discrete pulses at states we call critical forks. Three results follow. (i) Policy variance is a discovery budget: observing an action of advantage $c$ requires $Ω(c^2/σ_π^2(s))$ draws, a bound that is exact on the canonical two-point fork. (ii) Policy variance is bounded by the policy's Gini dispersion, $σ_π^2(s)\le 1-\|π(\cdot|s)\|_2^2$, a rollout-free necessary condition for criticality computable from logits alone. (iii) The remaining horizon sets the estimation cost: at a fork whose downstream success probability is $P$, the Monte Carlo advantage estimate has signal-to-noise ratio of order $\sqrt{P}$, so its sample cost scales as $1/P$ --- a cost that branched sampling shares. Bootstrapping removes it by converting a product of survival probabilities into a sum, provided the value representation is multiplicatively accurate, which argues for log-value parameterization.

</details>


### [609] [Quantum-Inspired Hybrid Neural Networks for Neural Decoding: A Controlled Ablation Study of Learnable Quantum Sidecar Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22475)
*Diana Legziel Levy,Menachem Finkelstein,Peter Chin,Eilon Vaadia,Sarel Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在ResNet-50骨干网络中集成参数化量子电路（PQC）作为残差副模块，用于31类神经群体解码（想象手写分类）。在严格控制条件下比较四种模型变体，发现骨干梯度训练的量子副模块在3/4种子中提升准确率（+0.19%），并一致降低与基线特征的线性CKA相似度（Δ=-0.025，4/4种子），表明表征发生了真实的结构性重组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索参数化量子电路与经典深度学习架构的混合集成方式，研究量子副模块是否能在神经解码任务中对经典骨干网络的表征学习产生有意义的、可量化的结构影响，而非仅追求量子优势宣传。

Method: 在ResNet-50骨干上集成PQC残差副模块，设计四种模型变体：基线、固定输入投影的量子副模块、基于骨干梯度训练的投影量子副模块、以及将角度编码与测量结果对齐的测量引导变体。使用固定数据划分、种子和优化器进行严格控制，采用无误噪态矢量模拟（4量子比特），并进行九变体消融实验。评估指标包括准确率和线性CKA表征相似度。

Result: 骨干梯度变体在3/4种子中准确率提升（平均+0.19%，95% CI [-1.10%, +1.48%]），且在4/4种子中一致降低与基线的线性CKA相似度（Δ=-0.025）。九变体消融显示浅层简单架构最有效且可复现。测量引导训练在不降低准确率的前提下持续改善表征几何结构。

Conclusion: 量子残差副模块可引发经典骨干网络表征的真实结构重组，但提升幅度有限且无量子计算优势声明。浅层架构与测量引导策略是当前可行的设计选择，该工作定位为在近景超导硬件约束下的务实探索。

Abstract: We study parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) integrated as residual sidecar modules within a ResNet-50 backbone for 31-class neural population decoding---imagined handwriting classification from multi-neuron spike rasters. Under strictly controlled conditions (fixed data splits, seeds, and optimizer), we compare four model variants: baseline, quantum sidecar with frozen input projection, quantum sidecar with backbone-gradient-trained projection, and a measurement-guided variant that aligns angle encodings with circuit measurement outcomes. The backbone-gradient variant improves accuracy in 3/4 seeds (+0.19% mean, 95% CI [-1.10%, +1.48%]) and consistently reduces Linear CKA similarity to baseline features ($Δ=-0.025$, 4/4 seeds), indicating genuine structural reorganization of representations. A nine-variant ablation identifies simple shallow architectures as the most effective and reproducible configuration. Measurement-guided training consistently improves representation geometry without reducing accuracy. All results use noiseless statevector simulation on 4 qubits, a regime chosen to reflect the practical constraints of current near-term superconducting hardware; no quantum computational advantage over classical methods is claimed.

</details>


### [610] [From Symmetry to Invariance: Learning Galois Equivalent Representations in Finite Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22513)
*Zheng Zhang,Na Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了神经网络能否将有限域上的乘法运算从训练所用的基表示迁移到同一数学运算的其他等价表示上。通过伽罗瓦作用将基表示组织为轨道，提出了一种通过学习伽罗瓦作用来构造每个轨道的规范代表（canonical representative）的方法，从而实现跨基表示的乘法迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络可以从有限样本中学习代数运算，但尚不清楚这种能力是否能迁移到同一运算在不同基表示下的等价形式。理解这种迁移能力对于评估模型的泛化能力以及是否真正学到了数学结构而非表面模式至关重要。

Method: 利用有限域乘法在基变换下的伽罗瓦作用，将基表示划分为轨道（同轨道内的基诱导相同的坐标乘法映射）。核心方法是通过训练模型预测基表示之间的伽罗瓦作用，然后反复应用学习到的变换来构造每个轨道的规范代表，通过精确的规范匹配（canonical matching）在未参与训练的基上支持乘法运算。

Result: 所提出的方法能够将学习到的代数对称性转化为不变的表示，从而在未训练的基表示上实现乘法运算的迁移，为学习代数运算的跨表示泛化提供了具体机制。

Conclusion: 通过伽罗瓦作用学习并构造规范代表，可以有效实现有限域乘法在不同基表示之间的迁移，展示了将学习到的代数对称性转化为可迁移的不变表示的实际可行性。

Abstract: Neural networks can learn algebraic operations from finite examples, but it remains unclear whether this ability transfers across mathematically equivalent representations of the same operation. We study this question through multiplication in finite fields under changes of basis. The Galois action organizes basis representations into orbits, and bases in the same orbit induce the same coordinate multiplication map. This structure allows us to separate learning multiplication from transferring it to basis representations that are not used for training. We examine several ways of providing or recovering the relevant orbit structure, including invariant labels, basis matrices, orbit recognition, and algebraic decomposition. Our main approach trains a model to predict the Galois action between basis representations. Repeated applications of the learned transformation are then used to construct a canonical representative for each orbit, which supports multiplication on held-out bases through exact canonical matching. This provides a concrete mechanism for converting a learned algebraic symmetry into an invariant representation that can be used for transfer.

</details>


### [611] [From Detrimental to Beneficial: Dynamic Influence-based Valuation and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22522)
*Adrian Nyakairu,Hongfu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DIVE是一个新颖且高效的数据价值评估框架，在批级别动态估计样本价值，并通过在优化层面反转有害样本的梯度方向而非丢弃或降权，将有害数据转化为有益贡献，从而提升分类性能、最大化数据效率并稳定优化过程，且能泛化到大型语言模型微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据价值评估研究主要集中于设计算法将训练样本分为有益或有害，但对基于评估结果进行后续数据干预的探索不足。传统方法往往直接丢弃或降低有害样本的权重，未能充分利用可用数据资源。

Method: DIVE框架在批级别动态估计样本价值，不修改原始数据，而是在优化层面通过对训练过程中的有害样本战略性地反转其梯度方向来实现数据编辑，确保与标准学习流程无缝集成且开销极小。

Result: 大量经验评估表明，DIVE持续提升分类性能、最大化数据效率、稳定优化过程，并能有效泛化到大型语言模型的微调任务中。

Conclusion: DIVE提出了一种全新的数据干预范式，通过梯度反转策略将有害样本转化为有益贡献，相较于传统丢弃或降权方法更充分地利用了数据资源，并在多个任务上展示了普适性。

Abstract: Data valuation is a cornerstone of data-centric learning, where prior efforts primarily focus on designing algorithms to classify training samples as either beneficial or detrimental for the learning task. However, leveraging these valuation estimates for subsequent data intervention remains underexplored; conventional approaches typically discard or downweight harmful samples, thereby underutilizing available data resources. In this paper, we present Dynamic Influence-based Valuation and Editing (DIVE), a novel and efficient framework that dynamically estimates sample values at the batch level and transforms detrimental data into beneficial contributions. Rather than altering the raw data, DIVE operates at the optimization level by strategically reversing the gradient directions of harmful samples during training, ensuring seamless integration with standard learning procedures with minimal overhead. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that DIVE consistently improves classification performance, maximizes data efficiency, stabilizes optimization, and effectively generalizes to large language model fine-tuning.

</details>


### [612] [Stress Testing Unlearning Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22527)
*Noam Diamant,Ethan Fetaya,Neta Glazer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WMDP++是一个扩展的基准测试，通过引入针对性的未学习信息提取测试和边界问题上的性能保持评估，弥补了现有LLM机器遗忘基准的两个关键缺陷：未能主动测试遗忘信息是否仍可被强制提取，以及未评估与遗忘内容语义相近的正常查询上的性能保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型中的机器遗忘面临输入输出模糊性的挑战，需要严格的评估来同时衡量安全性和实用性。现有基准存在两个关键不足：一是没有主动测试已遗忘的信息是否仍可被强制提取出来；二是没有评估模型在与遗忘内容语义接近的边界问题上是否保持正常性能。

Method: WMDP++作为WMDP的扩展，从两个方面补齐现有基准的空白：(1)加入针对未学习信息的定向提取测试，主动尝试从已遗忘的模型中强制恢复被移除的信息；(2)系统性地构建边界问题集（与未学习内容语义相近的正常查询），评估遗忘过程中模型性能是否得到保持。

Result: WMDP++提供了一个更严格且更具信息量的基准，用于评估LLMs中的机器遗忘效果，能够更全面地衡量遗忘方法的实际效果，包括被遗忘信息是否真正不可恢复以及模型在相关边界问题上的表现是否受影响。

Conclusion: WMDP++通过针对性的提取攻击测试和边界问题评估，为LLM机器遗忘研究提供了更严格、更全面的评估基准，有助于推动遗忘方法的发展和安全性的提升。

Abstract: Recently, machine unlearning, the removal of specific training data influence from a model, has gained increasing attention. In large language models (LLMs), unlearning is particularly challenging due to the ambiguity of inputs and outputs. Con- sequently, rigorous evaluation is critical for assessing both safety and utility, and for driving progress in unlearning meth- ods. We identify two key shortcomings in existing unlearning benchmarks: (1) they do not actively test whether unlearned information can still be forcibly extracted, and (2) they fail to evaluate performance preservation on boundary questions, be- nign queries that are semantically close to the unlearned con- tent. Here we introduce WMDP++, an extension of WMDP that addresses these gaps by incorporating targeted extrac- tion of unlearned information and systematic evaluation on boundary questions. WMDP++ provides a more stringent and informative benchmark for evaluating unlearning in LLMs.

</details>


### [613] [BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22557)
*Md Toufikuzzaman,Ahmad Mousavi,Dongwon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BLADE是一个基于约束双层优化的LLM遗忘(unlearning)框架，通过三种机制（截断熵遗忘损失、非对称增广拉格朗日、限定在LoRA适配器上的双层结构）实现对优化景观的平滑可控调节，在TOFU、MUSE Books和KnowUndo上分别比最强基线提升6%、9%和7%，并在4倍规模扩展和4次连续遗忘步骤下保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法在鲁棒性上存在三大缺陷：无界遗忘损失会破坏模型连贯性；固定权重平衡无法适应训练中保留难度变化；以及在基准上有效的方法在规模扩展或重复应用下失效。作者希望提出一个在各种条件下都稳定可控的遗忘框架。

Method: BLADE采用约束双层优化框架，核心包含三个机制：(1) 截断熵(clamped-entropy)遗忘损失，当token达到足够不确定性时梯度精确归零；(2) 非对称增广拉格朗日(asymmetric augmented Lagrangian)，在保留能力被违反后永久性地"棘轮"提升保留保护；(3) 双层结构限定在LoRA适配器内，在每次遗忘步骤前先修复保留损伤。

Result: BLADE在三个基准家族上全面占优：在TOFU上平均复合分数比最强基线提升6%、MUSE Books提升9%、KnowUndo提升7%。在MUSE News上，BLADE在4倍规模扩展和4次连续遗忘步骤下保持稳定，而最佳竞争方法在此条件下完全崩溃。

Conclusion: 通过将遗忘损失的梯度截断、动态而非固定权重的保留保护机制、以及在LoRA低秩空间内执行双层优化，BLADE实现了遗忘效果与模型保留能力之间的稳健平衡，解决了现有方法在规模扩展和重复遗忘场景下的崩溃问题。

Abstract: Existing LLM unlearning methods struggle with robustness: unbounded forget losses degrade model coherence, fixed-weight balancing cannot adapt as retain difficulty shifts mid-training, and methods that work on one benchmark falter under scaling or repeated application. We propose BLADE, a constrained bilevel framework whose three mechanisms give smooth, predictable control over the optimization landscape: a clamped-entropy forget loss whose gradient is exactly zero once a token reaches sufficient uncertainty; an asymmetric augmented Lagrangian that permanently ratchets retain protection after any violation; and a bilevel structure confined to LoRA adapters that repairs retain damage before each forgetting step. BLADE dominates across three benchmark families, improving average composite scores over the strongest baselines by $6$% on TOFU, $9$% on MUSE Books, and $7$% on KnowUndo, and it remains stable under $4\times$ scaling and $4$ sequential unlearning steps on MUSE News where the best competing method collapses entirely.

</details>


### [614] [Clinical Graph-JEPA: Predictive Patient-State Knowledge Graphs for Cognitive Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22583)
*Kushagra Yadav,Nalin Prabhath,Amit Lamba,Goeun Han,Yining Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个临床知识图谱构建与精炼框架，将临床知识图谱视为预测性患者状态表征而非静态提取产物，结合多智能体关系提议、本体感知归一化、确定性证据评分和JEPA潜在精炼，在MIMIC-IV数据上通过无泄漏的边恢复任务验证了注入真实出院记录表征可将整体leave-one-out MRR相对提升31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床记录中蕴含丰富的患者状态证据，但将其转换为可靠的结构化知识图谱面临诸多挑战，包括抽取错误、本体不匹配、关系缺失和时间歧义等问题，这些问题会在下游系统中传播放大。现有方法将知识图谱视为静态抽取产物，忽略了其作为患者状态动态表征的潜力。

Method: 提出一个结合多智能体关系提议（multi-agent relation proposal）、本体感知归一化（ontology-aware normalization）、确定性证据评分（deterministic evidence scoring）和基于JEPA的潜在精炼（JEPA-based latent refinement）的临床知识图谱构建与精炼框架。系统从结构化MIMIC-IV记录和推断的临床交叉链接中构建证据评分图谱，然后学习从观测到的图谱上下文中恢复被保留的临床关系。为了隔离出院记录上下文的贡献，比较了无笔记嵌入配置与注入了真实出院记录表示的笔记增强配置。

Result: 使用无泄漏的leave-one-out边恢复（MRR和Hits@k）以及保留批次掩码评估（AUC和MRR）进行评估。在相同队列和评估协议下，实体接地笔记注入使整体leave-one-out MRR实现31%的相对提升。

Conclusion: 将临床知识图谱作为预测性患者状态表征进行精炼是有效的，出院记录文本中实体级上下文的注入能够显著提升临床关系恢复性能，验证了多模态证据融合在临床知识图谱构建中的价值。

Abstract: Clinical records contain rich evidence about patient state, but converting that evidence into reliable, structured knowledge graphs remains difficult because extraction errors, ontology mismatch, missing relations, and temporal ambiguity can propagate into downstream systems. We propose a clinical knowledge graph construction and refinement framework that combines multi-agent relation proposal, ontology-aware normalization, deterministic evidence scoring, and JEPA-based latent refinement. Rather than treating a clinical knowledge graph as a static extraction artifact, we treat it as a predictive patient-state representation. For each admission, the system constructs an evidence-scored graph from structured MIMIC-IV records and inferred clinical cross-links, then learns to recover held-out clinical relations from the observed graph context. We evaluate the refiner with leakage-free leave-one-out edge recovery (MRR and Hits@k) and held-out batch-mask evaluation (AUC and MRR). To isolate the contribution of discharge-note context, we compare a note-embedding-free configuration with a note-augmented configuration that injects real discharge-note representations only into note-grounded entities. Under the same cohort and evaluation protocol, entity-grounded note injection improves overall leave-one-out MRR by 31% relative improvement.

</details>


### [615] [GCA: Global Centroid Alignment in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22593)
*Jong-Ik Park,Harry Jiang,Logan Blakely,Georgios Fragkos,Shamina Hossain-McKenzie,Carlee Joe-Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于自编码器的联邦学习新协议GCA（全局质心对齐），通过交换潜在编码而非模型参数来实现客户端协同，在不传输AE参数或梯度的前提下，显著降低通信开销（最高99.15%）并增强对训练数据提取攻击的防御能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于自编码器的联邦学习需要交换AE参数或梯度，存在两大问题：一是通信开销大，二是由于AE本就以重构输入为目标，交换参数极易泄露客户端训练数据信息，安全性不足。

Method: GCA采用潜在编码中介的联邦学习协议：(1)客户端先用重构损失训练本地AE，并上传少量编码器的潜在编码子集；(2)服务器汇集这些编码，拟合聚类模型，仅广播全局潜在质心及其支持计数；(3)客户端通过将本地潜在编码与最近质心进行逆计数加权对齐来更新编码器。三个步骤在各通信轮次间循环，全程不传输AE参数或梯度。

Result: 在5个表格基准和2个视觉基准上，GCA在全部21项对比中取得更高的重构误差（即更强的数据提取防御），在20/21项比较中取得更低的余弦相似度，优于FedAvg、FedProx和FedNova。相比FedAvg测试准确率最高提升5.76%，防御效果与DP-FedAvg相当，在DP-FedAvg失效的场景下仍有效，且每轮通信开销最高降低99.15%。

Conclusion: GCA证明了通过交换潜在编码和质心统计而非模型参数即可实现有效的联邦协同训练，在保护训练数据隐私和降低通信开销方面均优于传统方法，为联邦异常检测提供了一种更安全高效的替代方案。

Abstract: Autoencoder (AE)-based federated learning (FL) is attractive for anomaly detection when clients have limited local data. However, conventional FL exchanges AE parameters or gradients, incurring substantial communication overhead and potentially exposing input training data information, since AEs are explicitly optimized to reconstruct their inputs. We introduce \emph{Global Centroid Alignment (GCA)}, a latent-code-mediated FL protocol that coordinates clients without transmitting AE parameters or gradients. In each round, (1) clients first train their local AEs using a \emph{reconstruction} update and upload a small subset of encoder latent codes to the FL server. (2) The server pools these codes, fits a clustering model, and broadcasts only \emph{global latent centroids and their support counts}. (3) Each client then updates its encoder by aligning its local latent codes with the \emph{nearest} centroid using \emph{inverse-count} weighting to emphasize globally underrepresented patterns. Steps (1)--(3) repeat over communication rounds. Because GCA exchanges only sampled latent codes and centroid statistics, its communication cost depends on latent dimensionality and the numbers of uploaded codes and returned centroids rather than on AE model size. Across five tabular and two vision benchmarks, GCA yields higher reconstruction error under a server-side client data extraction attack in all 21 comparisons and clearly lower cosine similarity in 20 of 21 comparisons with FedAvg, FedProx, and FedNova, showing its ability to protect training data. It even improves test accuracy over FedAvg by up to $5.76\%$. GCA achieves extraction defense comparable to DP-FedAvg, remains effective when DP-FedAvg does not reduce target resemblance, and lowers per-round communication by up to $99.15\%$.

</details>


### [616] [Tabular foundation models for non-tabular tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22594)
*Goran Nakerst,John Brennan,Wouter Beugeling,Masudul Haque*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨Tabular Foundation Models（TFMs）是否能够超越传统表格任务，通过使用TabPFN v3处理三种非表格分类问题（MNIST手写数字识别、法语/德语单词语言识别、Tiny ImageNet图像分类），将原始数据表示为表格行并预测缺失标签，结果表明在无额外训练的情况下，TabPFN v3在某些场景下能达到与专门模型相当甚至接近的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）已在表格数据机器学习中展现出跨数据集泛化的潜力。由于许多机器学习数据集都可以表示为表格形式，研究者希望探究TFM的能力是否不仅限于传统表格任务，而是能够扩展到图像、文本等通常不被视为表格的领域中。

Method: 使用TabPFN v3模型处理三个非表格分类任务：MNIST手写数字识别、法语和德语单词的语言识别、Tiny ImageNet图像分类。每个任务中，原始数据被表示为表格行，分类被形式化为缺失标签的预测。通过改变提供给预训练模型的上下文样本数量来评估性能，且不进行任何额外的训练或微调。

Result: 尽管TabPFN v3没有显式访问数据的空间或序列结构信息，但在某些情况下，其准确率可与针对相应任务专门设计的模型或方法相媲美。

Conclusion: 表格基础模型的零样本能力可能比预期更广泛，能够在不显式利用数据结构先验的情况下，在某种程度上处理图像和文本等非传统表格任务。这揭示了TFM作为一种通用学习范式的潜在可能性。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for machine learning on tabular data, offering the ability to generalize across datasets without task-specific training. Since many machine learning datasets can be represented as tables, this raises the question: does TFM capability extend beyond tasks traditionally regarded as tabular? We address this question by using TabPFN v3 on three non-tabular classification problems: handwritten digit recognition on MNIST, language identification of French and German words, and image classification on Tiny ImageNet. In each case, the original data are represented as rows of a table and classification is formulated as prediction of a missing label. We evaluate performance as a function of the number of context samples provided to the pretrained model, with no additional training or fine-tuning. Despite having no explicit access to the spatial or sequential structure characterizing the data, TabPFN v3 in some cases achieves accuracies comparable with that of models or methods geared specifically toward the corresponding tasks.

</details>


### [617] [Adversarial Agents on Topology Optimization: Understanding the Fragility and Robustness of Deep Learning-based and Physics-Based Design Models under Adversarial Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22606)
*Hoang Anh Nguyen,Yuan Hong,Hongyi Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对拓扑优化中深度学习代理模型的脆弱性展开研究，提出了一个基于力学原理的可靠性评估框架，通过对抗性扰动（仅修改初始密度通道）系统性地揭示了代理模型在输入扰动下的灾难性失效问题，并证明物理在环的恢复策略（以扰动拓扑初始化经典SIMP优化器）可以有效缓解性能退化，最终建议学习代理应作为物理验证的初始化器而非完全替代物理求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习代理模型因其在线设计生成的快速性在智能制造系统中被广泛采用，但其在输入扰动下的鲁棒性尚未被充分研究。作者希望揭示这些代理模型在对抗性输入扰动下的脆弱性，并探索可靠的缓解策略，以保障网络制造系统的韧性与安全性。

Method: 提出了一个力学基础的可靠性评估框架，构建了针对生成式设计模型的对抗智能体。采用严格非侵入式威胁模型，仅在初始密度通道施加有界扰动，同时保持物理边界条件、柔度梯度通道、网络架构和求解器流程不变。在U-Net、卷积和生成式架构等多种代理模型上，以不同物理梯度调节深度进行系统评估；同时采用物理在环恢复策略，用扰动后的拓扑初始化经典SIMP优化器。

Result: 有界初始化噪声可导致灾难性的机械失效，通过断裂的载荷路径和断开的支撑使柔度增加多个数量级。研究发现更丰富的物理梯度调节并不能保证跨代理族的一致性鲁棒性提升。物理在环恢复策略显示，用扰动拓扑初始化经典SIMP优化器能在测试实例中以高概率将柔度恢复到接近基线的水平。

Conclusion: 学习代理模型应作为物理验证过的初始化器使用，而非完全替代基于物理的求解器，以构建有韧性的网络制造系统。所提出的对抗智能体为未来训练对噪声和定向扰动鲁棒的生成式设计代理奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: Topology optimization, using both physic-based approaches and deep learning surrogates, serves as a cornerstone for generative design agents in cyber-manufacturing systems. While deep learning surrogates have gained widespread adoption due to their speed in online design generation, this work demonstrates their vulnerability under input perturbations. In this work, we present a mechanics-grounded reliability evaluation framework that formulates an adversarial agent targeting the generative design models. We investigate a strictly non-intrusive threat model where bounded perturbations are introduced exclusively to the initial-density channel, while physical boundary conditions, compliance-gradient channels, network architectures, and solver routines remain intact. Evaluating surrogate models across U-Net, convolutional, and generative architectures with varying physics-gradient conditioning depths demonstrates that bounded initialization noise can cause catastrophic mechanical failure, increasing compliance by multiple orders of magnitude through severed load paths and disconnected supports. Furthermore, we discover that incorporating richer physics-gradient conditioning in the deep learning surrogates does not guarantee monotonic robustness across surrogate families. Finally, physics-in-the-loop recovery demonstrates that initializing the classical SIMP optimizer with perturbed topologies mitigates design performance degradation, having a high probability of restoring compliance to near-baseline levels across tested instances. These findings demonstrate that learned surrogates should serve as physics-verified initializers instead of replacing physics-based solvers entirely in a resilient cyber-manufacturing system. Moreover, the proposed adversarial agent provides a foundation for future training generative design agents robust against noise and targeted perturbations.

</details>


### [618] [Mitigating Explanation Leakage in Financial Fraud Detection Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22607)
*Muhammad Waleed Gul,Elaheh Homayounvala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了DP-FedSHAP架构，在联邦学习环境中仅对post-hoc TreeSHAP解释向量应用客户端级差分隐私，以在保持模型可解释性的同时防御成员推断攻击，并在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上对比了权重级DP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融欺诈检测依赖集中式机器学习模型存在数据隐私风险；联邦学习虽能去中心化数据处理，但金融法规要求模型透明需使用XAI工具（如TreeSHAP）；然而近期研究表明共享高保真度SHAP解释会使联邦网络暴露于成员推断攻击之下，因此需要在解释保真度与隐私保护之间寻求平衡。

Method: 提出DP-FedSHAP架构：仅在post-hoc TreeSHAP解释向量上应用客户端级差分隐私，而非扰动训练后的模型本身。并将其与权重级DP基线（直接扰动训练模型）进行对比实验。实验使用高度不平衡的IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集。

Result: 在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上，测量了解释保真度、隐私保护与模型AUPRC（精确率-召回率曲线下面积）三者之间的权衡关系，并对比了DP-FedSHAP与权重级DP基线的表现。

Conclusion: DP-FedSHAP通过仅在解释层面施加客户端级差分隐私，可在保留模型可解释性的同时缓解成员推断攻击风险，为金融欺诈检测领域的联邦可解释AI提供了可行的隐私保护方案。

Abstract: Financial fraud detection relies heavily on centralized machine learning models. This creates serious data privacy risks. Federated Learning (FL) decentralizes data processing, but financial regulations still require models to be transparent. This means using Explainable AI (XAI) tools such as TreeSHAP. Recent cybersecurity research shows a problem with this approach. Sharing high-fidelity SHAP explanations exposes the federated network to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs). This dissertation proposes and evaluates DP-FedSHAP. It is a new architecture that applies client-level differential privacy only to post-hoc TreeSHAP vectors. It is compared against a Weight-Level DP baseline, which perturbs the trained model directly instead. Using the highly imbalanced IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset, this study measures the trade-off between explanation fidelity, privacy preservation, and the model's Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC).

</details>


### [619] [What AstroPT knows about galaxies, and what that can teach us about LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22614)
*UniverseTBD,:,Kshitij Duraphe,Aman Kumar,Michael J. Smith,Shashwat Sourav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用天文领域的真实物理标签作为可解释性研究的校准测试平台。通过在数百万张星系图像上训练的类LLM模型（AstroPT），研究发现星系属性在训练过程中以固定的顺序涌现——与已知的物理难度排序一致，且该顺序对训练目标、模型规模等因素具有不变性。线性探针的方向还能恢复星系属性间的真实物理结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释性研究常探讨概念何时在训练中涌现、线性探针是否恢复真实结构，但在语言模型中难以验证这些主张，因为语言缺乏概念的ground-truth排序及概念间关系的真实基准。需要一种具有已知、可验证的结构化先验知识的领域来作为校准测试平台。

Method: 训练AstroPT——一个在数百万个星系图像上训练的Transformer模型（类LLM架构）。对冻结表示进行跨checkpoint、层、模型规模和训练目标的线性探测，观察不同星系属性（如星等、红移、特定恒星形成率等）的可解码性随时间与深度的涌现模式。同时分析线性探针方向是否恢复已知的物理结构关系。

Result: 星系属性以固定顺序涌现，该顺序追踪其已知物理难度：直接体现在像素中的量（如波段星等）在训练早期及浅层网络中即可解码，而基于多波段/光谱及推断的量（如红移和特定恒星形成率）则在后期及深层涌现。该顺序对训练目标不变，随容量规模扩展但不改变序列。线性探针方向恢复了星系属性之间的已知物理结构。

Conclusion: 天文学提供了一个可控的沙盒环境来校准应用于LLM的机制可解释性方法，弥补了语言领域中缺乏ground-truth概念结构验证的不足。该方法可以用于验证和校准我们原本在语言模型上盲目应用的机制解释工具。

Abstract: Interpretability research increasingly asks when concepts emerge during training and whether linear probes recover real structure, but in language models these claims are hard to validate because language offers little ground-truth ordering of concepts or relationships among them. We propose the use of astronomical ground truth through AstroPT, a transformer trained on millions of galaxy images, as a calibration testbed. AstroPT is an LLM-like model trained within a domain where the difficulty ordering of concepts and the relations among them are known in advance. Probing frozen representations across checkpoints, layers, model sizes, and objective choices, we find that galaxy properties emerge in a fixed order that tracks their known difficulty---quantities written almost directly into the pixels (band magnitude) become decodable early in training and shallow in the network, while multiband/spectra based and inferred quantities (such as redshift and specific star formation rate) emerge later and deeper. This order is invariant to our tested training objectives, and scales in magnitude but not in sequence with capacity. Our linear probe directions further recover the known physical structure among galaxy properties. Our findings suggest that astronomy offers a controlled sandbox for calibrating mechanistic interpretability methods we otherwise apply to LLMs blind.

</details>


### [620] [KMGen: A Skill-based Approach for Synthetic Individual Patient Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22618)
*Jalen Jiang,Chufan Gao,Ethan Rasmussen,Stephen Z. Xie,Jimeng Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KMGen是首个端到端框架，既能全自动提取Kaplan-Meier曲线（IAE达0.0151），又能从公共临床试验注册记录生成合成个体患者数据（含不良事件时间序列），在三个肿瘤学试验中实现了KM差异≤0.051、人口统计JSD≤0.013、恢复≥71%的top-15不良事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床试验的个体患者数据（IPD）是生存建模、元分析和安全性研究的基石，但由于隐私等原因极少公开发布。以往工作仅解决了部分问题：从已发表的图中重建KM曲线（通常需人工数字化或人在环路校正），却无法生成患者记录的另一半——不良事件（AE）流。这构成了IPD重建中的关键空白。

Method: KMGen包含两个阶段：(1) 提取阶段为全自动agentic流水线，agent生成代码逐步提取KM曲线各步骤；(2) IPD生成阶段将患者原型提取与统计采样解耦——LLM将试验记录提炼为分臂统计量、不良事件、患者人口统计和风险乘数，机制化采样器通过临床原型、bootstrap秩相关耦合并行KM曲线（精确保持边际生存分布）、基于周期的不良事件调度（含诱导/维持分治）生成患者事件。

Result: 在32图基准（涵盖干净、边缘和对抗条件）上提取IAE均值0.0151；在三个留出肿瘤学试验上（队列规模跨一个数量级、每试验30次独立再生成），KMGen实现KM积分绝对差异≤0.051，性别/ECOG JSD≤0.013（6个人口统计槽位中5个达标），且在单套固定参数下精确MedDRA术语恢复≥71%的top-15不良事件。

Conclusion: KMGen证明了端到端自动化合成个体患者数据（含生存曲线和不良事件轨迹）的可行性，且精度可与人工引导工具竞争，代码已开源发布。这项工作填补了IPD重建中AE流生成的空白。

Abstract: Individual patient data (IPD) from clinical trials is the substrate for survival modeling, meta-analysis, and safety research, yet IPD is rarely released. Prior work has addressed only half of this gap: reconstructing Kaplan-Meier (KM) curves from published plots -- typically requiring manual digitization or human-in-the-loop correction -- while offering no mechanism for generating the adverse-event (AE) streams that constitute the other half of a patient record. We introduce KMGen, the first end-to-end framework that (i) fully automates KM curve extraction at accuracy competitive with human-guided tools, and (ii) generates synthetic per-patient AE trajectories from public trial registry records. The extraction stage is a fully automated agentic pipeline -- an agent generates code to extract each step in the KM curve -- achieving a mean Integrated Absolute Error (IAE) of 0.0151 on a 32-plot benchmark spanning clean, edge-case, and adversarial conditions. The IPD generation stage decouples patient archetype extraction from statistical sampling: an LLM distills the trial record into arm-specific statistics, adverse events, patient demographics, and risk multipliers. A mechanistic sampler generates patient events via clinical archetypes, bootstrap rank-correlation coupling to the empirical KM curve (preserving the marginal survival distribution exactly), and cycle-based AE scheduling with an induction/maintenance split. Across three held-out oncology trials spanning an order of magnitude in cohort size and 30 independent regenerations per trial, KMGen achieves mean integrated KM absolute difference $Δ_{\text{KM}}\,{\leq}\,0.051$, sex/ECOG JSD ${\leq}\,0.013$ on 5 of 6 demographic slots, and recovers ${\geq}\,71\%$ of the top-15 AEs by exact MedDRA term under a single fixed parameter set. The pipeline is released as open source at https://github.com/chufangao/kmgen.

</details>


### [621] [Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22631)
*Yihang Yao,Bo Pang,Xuan Phi Nguyen,Ding Zhao,Shafiq Joty,Semih Yavuz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic组合泛化假说，认为RL主要通过塑造高层决策行为、组合预训练和SFT阶段获得的低层技能来提升终端智能体能力，而非从头教授领域特定技能。基于此提出River训练方案，通过过滤低质量环境和增加过程级行为正则化来提升奖励质量，在多个终端智能体基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体（terminal agents）是LLM的重要应用场景，RL是提升其能力的关键技术，但可扩展的训练环境是核心挑战。由于真实用户交互数据稀缺，合成环境虽可替代但常存在领域差距和保真度不足的问题。现有工作主要关注扩大合成环境的数量与多样性，而奖励信号质量和泛化机制未被充分探索。

Method: 1. 提出Agentic组合泛化假说：RL主要塑造高层决策行为，组合并路由预训练和SFT阶段已获得的低层技能。2. 基于该假说提出River训练方案，包含两个组件：过滤低质量环境以提升奖励质量；在结果奖励基础上增加过程级行为正则化，实现过程层面的行为约束。

Result: River训练得到的RL智能体在四个终端智能体基准上达到评估的开放源码RL训练8B模型中最佳性能。River在不同模型家族、规模、智能体框架和RL目标下均具有泛化能力。使用不到TMax 30%的训练环境，River在Terminal-Bench-Lite和Terminal-Bench-v2.1上分别将RL增益平均提升106%和30%（覆盖2B到27B的模型）。

Conclusion: 验证了Agentic组合泛化假说：对于终端智能体，RL的核心作用是强化高层决策的组合与路由能力，而非获取新技能。奖励信号质量（验证器质量）比单纯增加环境数量或多样性更为重要，这为终端智能体的RL训练提供了新的指导原则。

Abstract: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work mainly scales the quantity and diversity of synthetic environments, while reward-signal quality and the mechanisms governing generalization remain under-explored. We study how RL improves terminal agents and propose the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis: rather than teaching new domain-specific skills from scratch, RL primarily shapes high-level decision-making behaviors that compose and route low-level skills acquired during pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). This account is consistent with our empirical results and suggests that verifier quality, which determines which behaviors are reinforced, is more important than simply increasing environment quantity or diversity. Motivated by this insight, we propose River, a simple training recipe that improves reward quality by filtering low-quality environments and augmenting outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization. Using this recipe, our RL-trained agent achieves the best performance among evaluated open-source RL-trained 8B models across four terminal-agent benchmarks. River also generalizes across model families, scales, agent harnesses, and RL objectives. Using fewer than 30% of the TMax training environments, River improves RL gains by 106% and 30% on average for models ranging from 2B to 27B on Terminal-Bench-Lite and Terminal-Bench-v2.1, respectively.

</details>


### [622] [Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22636)
*Shengbo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种稳定的无限维线性函数逼近框架用于Q-learning，从单条马尔可夫行为策略轨迹中学习。通过重建算子和压缩算子的设计，在紧凑度量空间上建立收缩的潜在Bellman映射，并提出两种随机逼近算法，达到Õ(n^{-1/2})的sup范数收敛界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于线性函数逼近的Q-learning可能因任意逼近架构无法保持Bellman收缩而导致不稳定。现有方法在处理此问题时受限于有限维表示，无法有效刻画统计难度背后的结构，需要一种能够保证稳定性并适应数据平滑性与几何结构的无限维框架。

Method: 在紧凑潜在度量空间(𝕃,ρ)上定义系数场θ∈C(𝕃)作为学习变量；构造映射到连续Q函数的重建算子，以及将Bellman更新压缩回潜在坐标的压缩算子；通过两者的非扩张性保证潜在Bellman映射在C(𝕃)上的收缩性。进一步利用压缩映射在ρ下的平滑性通过覆盖数控制一致估计误差，并设计两种对ρ选择无感知的随机逼近算法。

Result: 建立了两种SA算法的sup范数收敛界，首项阶为Õ(n^{-1/2})。平滑性与几何结构通过覆盖数而非C(𝕃)维度自动适应，避免了维度灾难。算法对ρ的选择具有自适应性，并在Q-measure学习和冻结预训练网络的输出层权重训练两个场景中进行了验证。

Conclusion: 该无限维框架为Q-learning的不稳定性和统计难度的结构来源提供了抽象理解，证明通过算子非扩张性的合理设计可以恢复收缩性，同时算法在实际中无需显式选择度量即可自动适应数据的内在平滑性和几何特征。

Abstract: Q-learning with linear function approximation can be unstable because an arbitrary approximation architecture need not preserve the Bellman contraction. We develop a stable infinite-dimensional linear function approximation framework for Q-learning from a single Markovian behavior-policy trajectory. The learning variable is a coefficient field $θ\in C(\mathbb L)$ on a compact latent metric space $(\mathbb L,ρ)$. The framework uses a reconstruction operator that maps $θ$ to a continuous Q-function and a compression operator that maps Bellman updates back to latent coordinates. Nonexpansiveness of both operators induces a contractive latent Bellman map on $C(\mathbb L)$, with a unique fixed point $θ^*$ whose reconstruction approximates the optimal Q-function up to representation error. We propose two stochastic approximation (SA) algorithms and establish their sup-norm convergence bounds with a leading term of order $\widetilde O(n^{-1/2})$. The infinite-dimensional formulation provides a powerful abstraction for identifying the structures that govern statistical difficulty. Smoothness of the compression map in $ρ$ is inherited by $θ^*$ and the SA iterates, allowing uniform estimation errors to be controlled through covering numbers of $(\mathbb L,ρ)$ rather than the dimension of $C(\mathbb L)$. Remarkably, the SA algorithms we propose are agnostic to the choice of $ρ$, and thus can automatically adapt to both the smoothness and the geometry. We further illustrate the framework through Q-measure-learning with linear density approximation and output-layer neural weight training under a frozen pretrained network.

</details>


### [623] [Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22642)
*Florian Rottach,Sebastian Schieferdecker,William Rudman,Randall Balestriero,Carsten Eickhoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Mol-JEPA是一个可扩展的分子世界模型学习框架，通过模态掩码而非传统的分子扰动策略，利用分子结构、细胞表型、结合亲和力、ADMET特征、量子化学模拟等多种药物发现数据，在潜在空间中进行预测，从而获得更强的分子表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分子基础模型存在化学无效增强、模态坍缩以及对生化环境表示不完整等问题，需要一种更优的框架来克服这些局限性。

Method: 采用模态掩码（modality masking）机制替代次优的分子扰动方法，综合利用多种药物发现数据模态，通过潜在空间预测（latent space prediction）来学习分子世界模型。

Result: 在多个基准测试中，Mol-JEPA学到的表示展现出强劲的性能，验证了通过潜在空间预测引入生化上下文的价值。

Conclusion: Mol-JEPA成功克服了现有分子基础模型的局限性，证明将多模态生化上下文融入潜在空间预测可以显著提升分子表示学习的质量。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in molecular foundation models, several limitations remain, such as chemically invalid augmentations, modality collapse, and incomplete representation of biochemical environments. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{Mol-JEPA}, a scalable framework for learning molecular world models. Rather than relying on suboptimal molecular perturbations, our model uses modality masking to exploit information from molecular structures, cellular phenotypes, binding affinities, ADMET profiles, quantum chemistry simulations and other drug discovery data. Across various benchmarks, we show that the representations learned by Mol-JEPA deliver strong performance, demonstrating the value of incorporating biochemical context through latent space prediction.

</details>


### [624] [Maximum-distance nonnegative matrix factorization for unmixing highly mixed grain-size distribution data: A generalization of AnalySize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22681)
*Qianqian Qi,Zhongming Chen,Peter G. M. van der Heijden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种最大距离非负矩阵分解（max-distance NMF）方法，用于解决高度混合的粒度分布数据端元分解问题，克服了现有AnalySize方法在数据高度混合时性能下降的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AnalySize方法基于NMF对粒度分布数据进行端元分解，在数据低度混合时表现良好，但当数据高度混合（没有观测样本接近真实端元）时性能显著下降，需要一种新方法来解决这一局限性。

Method: 提出最大距离NMF（maximum-distance NMF），通过鼓励估计的端元尽可能彼此不同（最大化端元间距离）来改善分解效果，并开发了层次交替最小二乘（hierarchical alternating least squares）算法进行优化。该方法是AnalySize的推广形式：AnalySize最小化端元间距离，而所提方法最大化端元间距离。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够有效分解高度混合的粒度分布数据，优于传统AnalySize方法在该场景下的表现。

Conclusion: 最大距离NMF通过最大化端元间距离的策略，成功解决了高度混合数据下的端元分解难题，为该类问题提供了一种有效的通用化解决方案。

Abstract: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) decomposes a nonnegative matrix into the product of two nonnegative matrices. This property makes NMF well suited for unmixing grain-size distribution data, which are inherently nonnegative and have row sums equal to one. Previous studies have shown that AnalySize, an NMF-based method, performs well on poorly mixed grain-size distribution data but struggles when the data is highly mixed, where no observed samples are close to the true end members. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a maximum-distance NMF that encourages the estimated end members to be as distinct as possible and develop a hierarchical alternating least squares algorithm for optimization. The proposed formulation can be regarded as a generalization of AnalySize, where AnalySize minimizes the distance among end members while the proposed method maximizes it. Experimental results demonstrate that the method effectively decomposes highly mixed grain-size distribution data.

</details>


### [625] [Spiking Neural Networks for Continuous Control: Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning in Conventional Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22729)
*Jessica Hunter,Md Maruf Hossain Shuvo,Krishna Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SANSAC，一种将脉冲神经网络（SNN）作为actor网络替换传统神经网络的Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）变体，在传统硬件上系统验证了SNN在连续控制任务中的可行性，证明其与传统SAC性能几乎相当，为未来神经形态硬件上的强化学习研究建立了基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习算法在多种任务中取得了显著进展，但在神经形态硬件上的部署（尤其是连续控制任务）仍缺乏系统性验证。现有研究不清楚在硬件特定优势显现之前，用SNN替换传统actor网络会对智能体性能产生何种影响，因此需要一个基准来指导未来的神经形态RL研究。

Method: 提出Spiking Actor Network Soft Actor Critic（SANSAC），将传统SAC中的actor网络替换为脉冲神经网络（SNN），构建一个可在神经形态硬件上实现的最小化、神经形态兼容的框架。在传统计算机上对SANSAC与传统SAC进行系统对比，并考察隐藏维度对性能的影响。

Result: SANSAC与传统SAC在连续控制任务中表现出几乎等同的性能，同时揭示了隐藏维度对模型性能的影响。结果显示基于SNN的算法在复杂连续环境中具有可行性，在传统计算机上也能达到与传统神经网络具有竞争力的表现。

Conclusion: SANSAC验证了SNN在连续控制RL框架中的实用性，证明了SNN算法在连续环境中与传统神经网络性能相当，为后续在神经形态硬件上探索SNN在连续RL框架中的应用提供了坚实的理论基础和实验基线。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have made strides over the past decade applying them to a wide range of problems and control tasks. However, the deployment of RL on neuromorphic hardware for continuous control tasks remains under-validated. Namely it is unclear whether replacing a conventional actor network with a spiking neural network (SNN) affects the performance of an agent before any hardware-specific benefits manifest. We provide a systematic validation of a minimal, neuromorphically viable spiking actor variant of Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) on conventional hardware, establishing a baseline for future neuromorphic RL research. In this paper, we propose the Spiking Actor Network Soft Actor Critic (SANSAC) to address the use of RL frameworks in continuous environments, designed as a framework that can be implemented on neuromorphic hardware. We compare a traditional Soft Actor Critic (SAC) network to SANSAC in a traditional computer. We demonstrate the near equivalent performance of SANSAC and SAC, while addressing the impact of hidden dimensions. Our results demonstrate the viability of SNN based algorithms in complex continuous environments, as well as competitive performance to traditional neural networks in traditional computers, providing a basis to continue exploring the use of SNNs in continuous RL frameworks.

</details>


### [626] [MOSH-WM: Mask-Grounded Soft-Hamiltonian Dynamics for Object-Centric World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22750)
*Zhekai Wang,Haoxiang Huang,Xiang Liu,Zhikang Chen,Yueqing Sun,Qi Gu,Shiji Zhou,Miao Liu,Sen Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于掩码的软哈密顿世界模型（mask-grounded soft-Hamiltonian world model），通过将位置状态显式依赖槽拥有的图像支持，并利用哈密顿动力学传播状态，显著提升了对象中心世界模型的视频预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的对象中心世界模型通过演化一组实体槽来预测未来视频，但这些接收动力学监督的变量通常是无约束的视觉特征，缺乏明确的物理意义和结构约束，导致预测精度有限。

Method: 使用冻结的视频槽编码器生成槽和掩码；通过掩码拥有的空间矩形成位置状态Q，时间差形成动量P；学习能量函数提供软方向偏置到有界的学习增量中；解码器相关的外观和身份信息存储在因果视觉上下文中；门控合成器和有界残差结合上下文与传播的相位状态来重建解码器兼容的槽。

Result: 在OBJ3D数据集上，给定6个观察帧并评估后续30帧，相对最强对象中心基线LPIPS降低25.0%，空间MSE降低33.7%。在CLEVRER数据集上，给定6个观察帧并评估后续10帧，LPIPS降低14.5%，空间MSE降低18.7%。完整模型在30帧闭环rollout中误差累积更慢。

Conclusion: 所提出的掩码接地软哈密顿世界模型通过引入物理启发的动力学约束和显式的空间状态表示，在对象中心视频预测任务上取得了显著优于基线的方法，验证了结合结构先验和物理动力学建模的有效性。

Abstract: Object-centric world models forecast future videos by evolving a set of entity slots, but the variables receiving dynamics supervision are often unconstrained visual features. We introduce \method{}, a mask-grounded soft-Hamiltonian world model that makes its position-like state explicitly depend on slot-owned image support. A frozen video-slot encoder produces slots and masks; spatial moments of mask-owned support form a canonical state $Q$, temporal differences form $P$, and a learned energy supplies a soft directional bias to a bounded learned increment. Decoder-relevant appearance and identity are stored separately in a causal visual context. A gated composer and bounded residual then combine this context with the propagated phase state to reconstruct decoder-compatible slots. On OBJ3D, given six observed frames and evaluated over the following 30 frames, \method{} reduces LPIPS by 25.0\% and spatial MSE by 33.7\% relative to the strongest object-centric baseline. On CLEVRER, given six observed frames and evaluated over the following ten frames, the corresponding reductions are 14.5\% and 18.7\%. Horizon-resolved visual and object-state measurements show that the complete model accumulates error more slowly throughout the 30-frame closed-loop rollout. Project page:https://github.com/moshwm-anon/-moshwm-anon.github.io.

</details>


### [627] [LpWM: A Case for Sparse Representations in World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22764)
*Yilun Kuang,Yash Dagade,Quentin Le Lidec,Lucas Maes,Randall Balestriero,Yann LeCun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LpWorldModel（LpWM），一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的稀疏表示世界模型。作者证明在足够高维的one-hot潜空间中，非线性Lipschitz动力学可以被动作条件线性动力学任意近似，并以此激励稀疏表示作为one-hot稀疏性的实际松弛。LpWM通过Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization（RDMReg）约束编码器特征匹配Rectified Generalized Gaussian分布，产生非负稀疏码。实验表明，稀疏表示可显著降低规划所需的预测器复杂度，在PushT任务上中间预测器容量下较稠密LeWM提升达57%，且优势泛化到多个预测器家族；学习到的稀疏表示具有模式分解特性，支持集编码离散动力学模态，特征幅度编码连续状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JEPA架构通过匹配最大熵分布（如各向同性高斯）获得稠密表示来避免表示坍缩，但稠密表示是否是最利于动力学建模的几何结构尚不明确。作者质疑稠密表示的默认选择，探索稀疏表示是否能使动作条件的潜动力学更易于建模，以及这类表示会涌现出何种动力学结构。

Method: 1) 理论部分：证明非线性Lipschitz动力学可在足够高维one-hot潜空间中被动作条件线性动力学任意好地近似，回滚误差随维度增加而消失；2) 实践部分：提出LpWM，用RDMReg正则化使编码器特征匹配Rectified Generalized Gaussian分布，获得非负稀疏码作为one-hot稀疏性的松弛。

Result: 在PushT任务中，稀疏LpWM在中间预测器容量下比稠密LeWM规划成功率提升高达57%；与稠密VICReg表示相比，优势在多个预测器家族上保持一致。此外，发现的稀疏表示是模式分解的：支持集编码离散动力学机制，特征幅度编码连续的机制内状态。

Conclusion: 稀疏表示能够降低控制所需的预测器复杂度，同时揭示可解释的动力学结构，表明稀疏性是一种比稠密表示更有利于潜动力学建模与规划的成功几何选择。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn latent dynamics for planning and avoid representation collapse by matching features to maximum-entropy distributions such as isotropic Gaussians, yielding dense representations. However, it is unclear whether dense representations are the most favorable geometry for modeling dynamics. In this work, we ask whether a different geometry, sparse representations, can make action-conditioned latent dynamics easier to model, and what dynamical structure emerges from such representations. We first show that nonlinear Lipschitz dynamics can be approximated arbitrarily well by action-conditioned linear dynamics in a sufficiently high-dimensional one-hot latent space, with rollout error vanishing as the dimension grows. This motivates distributed sparse representations as a practical relaxation of one-hot sparsity. We introduce LpWorldModel (LpWM), a JEPA model regularized with Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization (RDMReg) to match encoder features to a Rectified Generalized Gaussian distribution, yielding non-negative sparse codes. Empirically, sparsity lowers the predictor complexity required for successful planning: on PushT, sparse LpWM outperforms dense LeWM by up to 57% in planning success at intermediate predictor capacities. This advantage also extends beyond Gaussian distribution matching, with LpWM outperforming dense VICReg representations across multiple predictor families. We further find that the learned sparse representations are mode-factored, with support encoding discrete dynamical regimes and feature magnitudes capturing continuous within-regime state. Together, these results suggest that sparse representations can reduce the predictor complexity required for control while revealing interpretable structure.

</details>


### [628] [Learning to Control Coupled-Dynamics Environments with Joint Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22765)
*Ege C. Kaya,Aliasghar Pourghani,Mahsa Ghasemi,Vijay Gupta,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对联合马尔可夫决策过程（JMDP）框架，提出了最优控制方法。定义了非参数分布贝尔曼最优性算子，并证明当诱导边缘MDP具有唯一最优策略时，该算子的迭代在Wasserstein距离下收敛到最优联合回报分布；对于前两阶矩，在更弱的条件下也建立了收敛性，并导出了用于神经逼近的采样目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耦合动力学环境暴露了多个反事实动作在共同外生随机性实现下的一步结果，而普通MDP形式仅能处理每个动作的边缘分布，忽略了这些反事实结果之间的依赖关系。JMDP形式保留了这种依赖，但已有工作仅解决了固定策略下的联合矩评估问题，缺乏最优控制方法。

Method: 定义了非参数分布贝尔曼最优性算子；证明其迭代在边缘MDP具有唯一最优策略时以Wasserstein距离收敛到最优联合回报分布；在前两阶矩层面，在允许多个均值最优动作存在但共享二阶矩固定点的更弱条件下建立收敛性；推导了适用于神经逼近的采样目标。

Result: 证明了分布贝尔曼最优性算子在Wasserstein距离下的收敛性（唯一最优策略情形）；在前两阶矩上建立了在更弱条件下的收敛结果；提供了可用于神经网络的采样目标。

Conclusion: 本文首次为JMDP框架建立了最优控制理论，将最优控制从MDP推广到保留反事实依赖关系的JMDP，并为其在实际算法中通过神经逼近实现提供了理论支撑和采样目标。

Abstract: Coupled-dynamics environments expose the one-step outcomes that would follow from several possible counterfactual actions under a common realization of exogenous randomness. The ordinary Markov decision process formalism allows one to reason about the marginal law of each action but discards dependence across these counterfactual outcomes. The Joint Markov decision process (JMDP) formalism preserves that dependence. Prior work established the formalism and solved the fixed-policy joint moment evaluation problem in JMDPs. This paper develops optimal-control methods. We define a nonparametric distributional Bellman optimality operator for JMDPs, and prove that when the induced marginal MDP has a unique optimal policy, its iterates converge in Wasserstein distance to the optimal joint return law. For the first two moments, we establish convergence under a weaker condition that permits several mean-optimal actions as long as their tie resolutions share a second-moment fixed point. We also derive sampled targets for neural approximation.

</details>


### [629] [Neural Operator based Multi-Field Reconstruction of Inner Solar Boundary State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22782)
*Vignesh Kumar Pandian Sathia,Reza Mansouri,Dustin J. Kempton,Pete Riley,Rafal A. Angryk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究利用局部神经算子（LocalNO）从径向速度和径向磁场两个可直接观测变量中重建太阳风在30个太阳半径处的多场多尺度磁流体力学状态，包括非径向速度/磁场分量、电流密度、热力学密度和压力等变量，为内日球层建模提供完整的边界条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太阳风建模需要完整的内边界条件，但实际应用中往往只能直接获取部分多场变量的子集。为了进行全面的太阳风预测和下游磁流体力学模拟，需要从有限的可用变量中重建完整的多场边界状态。

Method: 采用局部神经算子（LocalNO）学习输入与输出函数空间之间的映射，该算子保留了局部性和分辨率感知能力，适合处理高度非线性、空间耦合且多尺度的场到场变换问题。给定径向速度和径向磁场，重建非径向速度、非径向磁场、电流密度、密度和压力分量。

Result: 生成的预测结果与输入变量一起，旨在作为未来内日球层建模管道的边界条件变量，为下游磁流体力学模拟提供完整且必要的初始/边界状态。

Conclusion: 神经算子相比传统回归模型和自编码器模型更适合学习物理系统产生的结构化场到场变换，LocalNO框架有望为太阳风预测和内日球层建模提供准确且完整的多场边界条件重建方案。

Abstract: The Solar wind is a continuous flow of charged particles emanating from the solar surface and governed by complex, interacting magnetohydrodynamic processes. Accurate specification of inner-boundary conditions is essential for heliospheric modeling and solar-wind prediction. In many practical applications, only a subset of interacting multi-field variables is directly available, but for a comprehensive view of solar wind prediction and downstream magnetohydrodynamic simulations, a more complete boundary state is required. In this work, we study the problem of learning the multi-field multi-scale solar magnetohydrodynamic state at 30 solar radii ($R_\odot$) using operator learning. Specifically, given the radial velocity and radial magnetic field, we aim to reconstruct the non-radial velocity and magnetic field components, radial and non-radial current density, thermodynamic density, and pressure components. This mapping is highly nonlinear, spatially coupled, and multi-scale, making it a challenging task for data-driven scientific machine learning.
  To address this problem, we employ a Local Neural Operator (LocalNO) that learns mappings between input and output function spaces while retaining locality and resolution-awareness. Unlike conventional regression models and autoencoder models, neural operators are better suited for learning structured field-to-field transformations arising from physical systems. The resulting predictions along with inputs are intended to serve as boundary condition variables for future inner-heliospheric modeling pipelines.

</details>


### [630] [ReCoG: Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22786)
*Rui Xue,Tianfu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReCoG，一种端到端互惠共演化的多模态图学习范式，通过联合优化图结构学习与多模态表示学习，克服了现有方法将两者解耦的局限，在多模态节点分类和链接预测任务上显著优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态图学习方法存在根本性缺陷：多模态GNN仅关注在共享嵌入空间中对齐模态，而使用固定或弱适应的图结构；图结构学习方法则仅从单模态节点表示推断拓扑，未考虑多模态交互。这种解耦设计限制了GNN捕捉多模态场景中语义关系的能力，而实际中的观测边往往存在噪声、不完整或与底层语义错位的问题。

Method: ReCoG包含两个核心组件：(i) 多模态图精炼器，利用跨模态语义证据推断和纠正边；(ii) 耦合的跨模态消息传递机制，在精炼后的图上执行联合的模态内和模态间信息传播。两个组件通过端到端互惠交互紧密耦合，实现图拓扑与表示学习的动态交互，而非传统的两阶段或解耦式设计。

Result: 在节点分类和链接预测的多个基准数据集上，ReCoG一致性地优于包括图基础模型在内的强多模态图结构学习基线，验证了结构-语义互惠共演化对多模态图学习的重要性。

Conclusion: 拓扑学与表示学习之间的互惠共演化对于有效的多模态图学习至关重要，该研究挑战了当前将两者分离的主流范式，为多模态图学习提供了新的统一框架。

Abstract: Multimodal graph learning requires jointly training over graph structure and heterogeneous node attributes, yet existing methods largely decouple these processes: prior multimodal graph neural networks (GNNs) focus on aligning modalities in a shared embedding space while operating on fixed or weakly adapted graph structures, and graph structure learning approaches infer topology from unimodal node representations without accounting for multimodal interactions. This separation fundamentally limits the ability of GNNs to capture semantically meaningful relationships in multimodal settings, where observed edges are often noisy, incomplete, or misaligned with underlying semantics. We propose ReCoG (Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning), a new learning paradigm that tightly couples graph structure learning and multimodal representation learning through end-to-end reciprocal interaction. Concretely, ReCoG integrates (i) a multimodal graph refiner that infers and corrects edges using cross-modal semantic evidence, and (ii) a coupled cross-modal message passing mechanism that performs joint intra- and inter-modality propagation over the refined graph. This unified design yields greater expressiveness than decoupled or two-stage formulations and allows dynamic interaction between topology and representation learning. Across diverse benchmarks for node classification and link prediction, ReCoG consistently outperforms strong multimodal graph structure learning baselines, including graph foundation models. Our results demonstrate that reciprocal co-evolution of structure and semantics is important for effective multimodal graph learning, challenging the prevailing separation between topology and representation learning.

</details>


### [631] [Contrastive Representation-Guided Genetic Minority Oversampling for Imbalanced Time-Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22804)
*Wenbin Pei,Yunrong Hao,Zhen Liu,Guan Wang,Bing Xue,Yiu-Ming Cheung,Qiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FreMGP，一种基于频域表示引导的多树遗传编程过采样方法，用于解决不平衡时间序列分类中的少数类样本生成问题，通过对比学习的频域类别判别表示模块引导进化搜索，在多个数据集上优于现有过采样方法并持续提升不同分类器的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的时间序列分类任务常存在严重的类别不平衡问题，而过采样是最流行的预处理技术之一。然而，由于时间序列复杂的时序依赖性和少数类样本稀缺，现有的插值过采样方法和深度生成模型在生成新样本时往往面临泛化能力有限和多样性不足的问题。

Method: FreMGP采用多树遗传编程框架，每个个体表示一组少数类的合成样本；同时开发了基于对比学习的频域类别判别表示模块，用于引导进化搜索朝向高质量的合成时间序列样本方向进行。

Result: 在不平衡时间序列数据集上的实验表明，FreMGP优于现有的过采样方法，并且能够持续提升不同分类器（包括通用机器学习和深度学习模型）的性能。

Conclusion: FreMGP通过结合频域表示学习和遗传编程进化搜索，有效解决了不平衡时间序列过采样中的泛化与多样性问题，是一种通用的、分类器无关的过采样方案。

Abstract: Real-world time-series classification tasks often exhibit class imbalance, which can be extremely severe in some applications. To avoid training biased classifiers on imbalanced data, sampling is one of the most popular data pre-processing techniques because of its classifier-agnostic nature. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies in original time-series data and the scarcity of minority-class samples, existing sampling methods, including interpolation-based oversampling methods and deep learning-based generative models, usually suffer from limited generalization and poor diversity when generating new time-series samples. This paper proposes a Frequency-domain representation-guided Multi-tree Genetic Programming-based oversampling approach (FreMGP) to imbalanced time-series classification, where each individual represents a set of synthetic samples for the minority class. A frequency-domain class-discriminative representation module based on contrastive learning is also developed, guiding the evolutionary search toward high-quality synthetic time-series samples. Experiments on imbalanced time-series datasets demonstrate that FreMGP outperforms existing oversampling methods and consistently improves the performance of different classifiers, including both general machine learning and deep learning models.

</details>


### [632] [Change Detection in Probability Flow ODE: Online Testing in Diffusion Latent Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22807)
*Artem Kraevskiy,Artem Prokhorov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需参数假设的序贯变点检测方法，利用条件扩散模型和概率流ODE将观测映射到高斯潜变量空间，以MMD作为检验统计量，结合Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序实现任意分布漂移（包括协方差旋转和高阶结构断裂）的检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多序贯数据任务（如金融趋势反转识别、视频音频自动分段、运动传感器方向变化检测）需要检测时序数据的分布漂移。然而当变点前后的条件密度均无闭式表达式时，经典似然比统计量不可用，需要一种无需参数假设的变点检测方法。

Method: 该方法包含三个关键步骤：(1) 用变点前数据训练条件扩散模型，通过概率流ODE定义确定性双射，将变点前观测映射为标准高斯潜变量；(2) 将变点后观测通过同一冻结映射，用最大均值差异（MMD）作为检验统计量，推导其在高斯零假设下各分量的闭式表达式，并建立其作为退化U-统计量的渐近分布；(3) 将所得统计量应用于Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序，实现精确阈值校准。

Result: 该方法能够检测任意分布漂移，包括协方差旋转和高阶结构断裂，且无需对任一状态（变点前或变点后）做参数假设。基于高斯零假设导出了MMD分量的闭式表达式，并确立了退化U-统计量的渐近分布。

Conclusion: 通过条件扩散模型结合MMD检验统计量和Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测框架，成功实现了无需参数假设的任意分布漂移检测，克服了经典似然比方法无法应用于非闭式密度场景的局限。

Abstract: A rapidly growing range of sequential data tasks, such as identifying trend reversals in financial markets, auto-segmenting video and audio recordings, detecting changes in movement direction from motion sensors cannot be fully addressed without detection of distributional shifts in time-ordered data. We consider a sequential change-point detection problem where the conditional density switches at an unknown time, yet neither the pre- nor post-change distribution admits a closed-form. Classical likelihood-ratio statistics are inapplicable in this settings.
  A conditional diffusion model, trained on pre-change-point data with a frozen context encoder, defines a deterministic bijection via the probability flow ODE. Pre-change observations are mapped onto standard Gaussian latent variables. Post-change observations, processed through the same frozen map, deviate from this reference. We employ the Maximum Mean Discrepancy as the test statistic, derive closed-form expressions for its components under the Gaussian null, and establish its asymptotic distribution as a degenerate U-statistic. Afterwards we apply an online detection procedure of Shiryaev--Roberts to the resulting statistic with exact threshold calibration.
  The method detects arbitrary distributional shifts, including covariance rotations and higher-order structural breaks, without parametric assumptions on either regime.

</details>


### [633] [CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22808)
*Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CatchBench 是一个代理失败审计基准，在三种信息状态下（运行前配置PRE、运行中轨迹前缀LIVE、完整轨迹POST）评估72个审计系统/模型，覆盖1187个声明配置和1162个记录运行。研究发现多数参赛者无法有效排序，且一个忽视所有名称和权限的简单规则在特定配置源上达到完美F1，表明基准分数可能反映语料构建方式而非方法推理能力。论文强调审计结果的可解释性依赖于标签过程的公开与测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有审计基准要么固定单一信息状态要么仅变化遥测手段，没有在统一的"任务-方法"接口下同时评估代理失败审计的三种信息状态。由于代理失败审计受限于记录而非方法，需要一个跨状态、可复现的基准来公平评估不同审计方法的真实能力。

Method: CatchBench设计了七个任务契约（四个证据型、三个Gold派生的机制诊断型），每个契约有自己的标签和度量标准而非单一排行榜。在PRE、LIVE、POST三种信息状态下统一评估72个参赛者（包括规则扫描器、结构模型和11个LLM裁判，覆盖9个模型家族）。关键创新在于对注入基底进行可接纳性审查，并公开所有预测结果以允许无模型调用的重排序。

Result: 47/118个预先声明的对比能够分离，其余作为未解决项公布而非排序。最尖锐的发现：一个忽略所有名称和权限、仅标记第一个声明之后每个能力的简单规则，在六个配置源之一上达到完美F1，揭示基准分数可能反映语料构建偏差而非方法推理能力。可接纳性审查拒绝了一个注入基底并扣留了另一个的证据状态。

Conclusion: 基准数字只有在标签生成过程被公开并针对可能存在的捷径进行测试后才可解释。CatchBench同时报告过程和结果，并从头发布预测以支持完全可复现的重排序。

Abstract: When can an agent failure be caught? An audit is usually limited by the record rather than by the method. CatchBench therefore puts one auditor's question to three information states: the declared configuration before a run (PRE), a growing prefix of its trace (LIVE), and the finished trace (POST). Prior benchmarks fix one of these states or vary the telemetry; to our knowledge none scores all three under one task-method interface. Each state admits different questions, so seven task contracts carry their own labels and metrics rather than one leaderboard. Four are evidential; three are Gold-derived mechanism diagnostics.
  The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs. Most of the arena does not order: 47 of 118 pre-declared contrasts separate, and the rest are published unresolved rather than ranked. The two sharpest results cut against our own data. One rule ignores every name and permission; it flags each capability declared after the first. On one of six configuration sources it reaches a perfect F1, so a score there measures how the corpus was built rather than how well a method reasons. Our admissibility bar then rejected one injected substrate and withheld evidential status from the other. A benchmark number is therefore not interpretable until the process behind its labels is published and tested for the shortcut it may leave. We report both, and regenerate every ordering from released predictions with no model call.

</details>


### [634] [SAGE: Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble Feature Selection for Explainable Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22809)
*Md. Rokon Islam Emon,Syed Shariar Alam Shuvo,Shahriar Siddique Ayon,Abdullah Al Mamun,Ahnaf Atef Choudhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE系统，一种基于稳定性感知图集成特征选择方法，结合局部可解释AI与遗传算法优化的人工神经网络（GA-ANN），用于产后抑郁症（PPD）早期预测。在766名产后女性的队列中，SAGE使用16个特征达到87.96%准确率、86.32% F1分数和0.88 AUC，优于基线及其他特征选择方法，并通过LIME提供可实例化解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 产后抑郁症对母婴健康构成重大负担，尤其在低中收入国家患病率超过19%。现有机器学习方法存在三个主要局限：全局解释不透明缺乏临床实用性、特征选择不稳定、在类别不平衡下泛化能力差。亟需一种兼具稳定性、可解释性和高性能的预测工具。

Method: SAGE系统包含三个关键组件：(1) 结合信息论相关性（信息论相关性）、PCA结构（PCA结构）和图交互（图交互）的特征选择框架，并采用bootstrap稳定性加权识别稳健且非冗余的预测因子；(2) 遗传算法优化的人工神经网络（GA-ANN），通过GA优化架构并使用GAN过采样处理类别不平衡；(3) 基于LIME的局部解释机制，提供实例级别的特征洞察，支持个性化风险评估。

Result: 基于766名产后妇女的主要队列，SAGE仅用16个特征即实现87.96%准确率、86.32% F1分数和0.88 AUC，表现优于基线模型和其他特征选择方法。主要预测因素为心理和社会经济因素（EPDS评分、PHQ-9评分、对母职的感受、虐待史），而人口统计学因素影响较小。

Conclusion: SAGE被证实是一种可扩展、可解释且具临床实用性的工具，适用于医疗资源有限环境下PPD的早期识别。结合稳定性特征选择、遗传优化网络和局部可解释AI，SAGE为个性化产后抑郁风险评估提供了新范式。

Abstract: Postpartum depression (PPD) poses a major burden on maternal and child health, especially in low- and middle-income countries where prevalence exceeds 19%. Despite advancements in machine learning for PPD prediction, current approaches are limited by opaque global explanations that lack clinical usefulness at the patient level, unstable feature selection, and poor generalization under class imbalance. We propose SAGE, a Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble feature selection system that incorporates both local explainable AI and a genetically optimized artificial neural network (GA-ANN). Using a primary cohort of 766 postpartum women, SAGE combines information-theoretic relevance, PCA-based structure, and graph-based interactions with bootstrap stability weighting to identify robust and non-redundant predictors. The GA-ANN architecture, optimized using a genetic algorithm and enhanced with GAN based oversampling, achieved strong performance with 87.96% accuracy, 86.32% F1 score, and 0.88 AUC using only 16 features, outperforming baseline and other feature selection methods. Psychological and socioeconomic factors such as EPDS score, PHQ-9 score, feelings about motherhood, and abuse history are the main predictors, while demographic factors have less influence. The LIME-based explanations allow instance-based insight into selected features from the graph, enabling personalized risk assessment. The findings make SAGE a scalable, interpretable, and clinical tool for early identification of PPD in health-care limited resources.

</details>


### [635] [Fairness-Aware Mixture-of-Experts via Subgroup Reweighting and Gate Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22820)
*Sunhee Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端的Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）框架来解决深度学习模型中的群体公平性问题，通过识别并纠正"路由诱导偏差"（routing-induced bias），采用子群重加权和门控熵正则化来平衡专家利用率，在提升公平性的同时保持预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型常因训练数据中对敏感属性（如性别、年龄）的分布不均衡而产生跨群体的性能差异。现有方法分为单阶段和两阶段两类：单阶段方法学习共享表示但难以应对异质子群分布；两阶段方法将表示学习与下游任务分离，导致公平目标与预测任务错位。因此需要一种既能处理子群异质性又能保持端到端对齐的公平性方法。

Method: 提出MoE框架，核心包含三个组件：(1) 识别路由诱导偏差——即子群不平衡导致门控网络将子群路由到少数专家上的失败模式；(2) 子群重加权——纠正训练数据中的类别不平衡；(3) 门控熵正则化——防止路由坍缩到子群属性上，保持专家利用率平衡且可解释。该框架是端到端的，使公平目标与下游预测对齐。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法在提升公平性的同时保持了具有竞争力的预测性能。此外，路由分布提供了子群在专家间分配的可解释视图，有助于理解模型的决策模式。

Conclusion: MoE框架通过端到端方式同时解决数据不平衡和路由坍缩问题，实现了公平性与预测性能的平衡，并提供了可解释的子群分配视图，为公平深度学习的架构设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Deep learning models often produce performance disparities across demographic groups, due to the training data imbalance with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender or age. To address this problem, existing work has explored fair representation learning, data re-sampling, and adversarial training, which can be broadly categorized into two main approaches. Single-stage methods typically learn a shared representation for fairness, but often struggle to handle heterogeneous subgroup distributions. Two-stage methods learn representations separately from the final prediction task, which can lead to misalignment between fairness objectives and downstream predictions. We identify routing-induced bias, a failure mode in which subgroup imbalance drives the gating network to route subgroups onto a few experts, and propose an end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that corrects it. Specifically, we apply subgroup reweighting to correct data imbalance, and introduce gate entropy regularization to prevent routing from collapsing onto subgroup attributes, keeping expert utilization both balanced and interpretable. Beyond improving fairness, the routing distribution offers an interpretable view of how subgroups are allocated across experts. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach improves fairness while maintaining competitive predictive performance.

</details>


### [636] [DIME: Query-Efficient Framework for Membership Inference on Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22824)
*Tue Do,Daniel Alabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DIME（Denoiser Ideal Membership Error），一个理论上严谨且查询高效的扩散模型成员推断攻击框架。DIME基于有限训练集下最优扩散去噪器的精确刻画，将成员泄露分解为偏置项和局部拥挤项两个互补信号，仅需两次查询即可实现高效攻击，在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对扩散模型的成员推断攻击大多基于启发式方法，且需要大量的查询预算，缺乏理论依据。作者希望从理论层面精确刻画扩散模型中的成员泄露机制，并设计一种查询高效的攻击方法。

Method: 作者首先对有限训练集下的最优扩散去噪器进行精确刻画，发现成员泄露由去噪器的隐式重构误差主导。该误差分解为两个互补信号：偏置项（反映重构精度）和局部拥挤项（反映附近训练样本的几何结构）。两者均可通过仅使用模型查询的高效估计器来近似，形成只需两次查询的实用攻击方法DIME。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL10-U、CelebA和ImageNet等数据集上，DIME在相同或更低的查询成本下持续优于现有攻击方法，在1% FPR下的TPR最多提升3倍；其两次查询的变体甚至能超越现有需要30次查询的基线方法。作者还评估了针对这类强大成员测试的具体防御措施。

Conclusion: DIME证明了基于理论推导的成员推断攻击可以同时实现高精度和极低的查询成本，揭示了扩散模型成员泄露的双源机制（偏置与局部拥挤），并为防御此类攻击提供了新的研究方向。

Abstract: Membership inference attacks expose whether individual records were used to train a model, yet existing attacks on diffusion models are largely heuristic and can require substantial query budgets. We introduce DIME (Denoiser Ideal Membership Error), a theoretically grounded and query-efficient framework for membership inference on diffusion models. Our starting point is an exact characterization of the optimal diffusion denoiser for a finite training set, which reveals that membership leakage is governed by the denoiser's implicit reconstruction error. This error decomposes into two complementary signals: a bias term, capturing reconstruction accuracy, and a previously unexplored local crowding term, capturing the geometry of nearby training examples. Both admit efficient estimators using only model queries, yielding a practical attack with as few as two queries. Across CIFAR-10/100, STL10-U, CelebA, and ImageNet, DIME consistently outperforms prior attacks at comparable or substantially lower query cost, improving TPR at 1% FPR by up to $3\times$; remarkably, its two-query variant can outperform existing 30-query baselines. Finally, we suggest, discuss, and evaluate specific defenses to counteract such powerful membership tests.

</details>


### [637] [Hierarchy-Aware Supervised Uncertainty Estimation for Black-box LLM Taxonomic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22839)
*Shuting Xie,Nathaniel Lesperance,Graham W. Taylor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究黑盒大语言模型在长尾生物多样性监测流水线中生成层级分类学推理时的置信度估计问题。利用开源工具LLM提取的代理特征，训练带层级感知监督的轻量级监督估计器来预测秩级正确性。在三个工具LLM上，监督估计器一致优于token似然基线，将微平均AUROC从0.57提升至0.75-0.80，其中秩特定多头设计（H3）效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于科学决策支持，但在黑盒设置下可靠的置信度估计仍然困难。生物多样性监测中的分类学推理具有长尾分布和层级结构等独特挑战，而现有的置信度估计方法（如token似然）在此场景下表现不足，需要更有效的黑盒不确定性估计方法。

Method: 使用开源工具LLM提取代理特征，训练轻量级监督估计器，并加入层级感知监督（hierarchy-aware supervision）来预测秩级正确性。设计了一种秩特定多头设计（rank-specific multi-head design，简称H3），对分类学层级中的每个秩分别进行正确性预测，以考虑层级输出结构。

Result: 在三个工具LLM上进行评估，监督估计器一致优于token似然基线。在单一全局拒绝阈值下，微平均AUROC从基线的0.57提升至0.75-0.80。秩特定多头设计（H3）取得了最佳性能，表明在需要统一弃权规则时，考虑层级输出结构对不确定性估计很关键。

Conclusion: 层级感知的监督式不确定性估计方法能有效提升黑盒LLM在分类学推理任务中的置信度估计质量，特别是引入秩特定的多头结构有助于在统一拒绝阈值设置下获得更好的选择性预测性能。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific decision support, yet reliable confidence estimation remains difficult in black-box settings. We study uncertainty estimation for hierarchical taxonomic reasoning generated by a black-box LLM in a long-tailed biodiversity monitoring pipeline. Using proxy features extracted by an open-source tool LLM, we train lightweight supervised estimators with hierarchy-aware supervision to predict rank-wise correctness. Across three tool LLMs, the supervised estimators consistently outperform a token-likelihood baseline for micro discrimination and selective prediction under a single global rejection threshold, improving micro AUROC from 0.57 to 0.75--0.80. The best results are achieved by a rank-specific multi-head design (H3), suggesting that accounting for hierarchical output structure is important when a unified abstention rule is required. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/uoguelph-mlrg/hierarchy-aware-llm-uq

</details>
