### [638] [RIBOSPAN: A Long-Context RNA Foundation Model for Versatile RNA Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22849)
*Ziyuan Wang,Bohao Tang,Fei Zhang,Shuo Han,Pengfei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RIBOSPAN是一个16.1亿参数的双向RNA基础模型，原生预训练支持长达10,240个核苷酸的上下文窗口，通过单核苷酸token化和注意力隔离序列打包实现完整长RNA的高分辨率建模，并在长RNA表示质量及全长mRNA生成方面达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的RNA基础模型预训练上下文长度通常短于全长RNA（特别是mRNA）的实际长度，限制了在单核苷酸分辨率下对完整转录本的建模能力。作者旨在解决这一长上下文建模的瓶颈，实现对完整长RNA的高保真表示学习。

Method: RIBOSPAN采用密集双向自注意力、单核苷酸token化以及注意力隔离序列打包的组合策略，原生预训练上下文长度达10,240核苷酸（约含30B token预训练）。在拼接预训练基础上额外使用40%掩码率进行持续预训练以增强对重度损坏的恢复能力。此外，评估了YaRN推理时长度外推策略对短上下文模型的影响。同时开发了一个多维度条件的离散扩散框架，用于全长mRNA生成和密码子重设计。

Result: 原生10K预训练在10,240 token下保持强重建能力；40%掩码率持续预训练在重度损坏下改善恢复同时保持表示质量。长上下文基准显示原生10K模型保持强上下文响应和上下文特定表示分离，且扰动引起的表示变化高度局部化。YaRN缩放恢复了直接外推短上下文模型丢失的大部分上下文组织，但导致更大的远端表示扩散。冻结表示评估中RIBOSPAN在多种RNA类型上取得最强整体表现，尤其在长RNA上具有明显优势。

Conclusion: RIBOSPAN建立了强大的长上下文RNA基础模型，为可迁移的RNA表示学习和全长转录本mRNA设计提供了新基线，验证了原生长上下文预训练相对于事后长度外推的优越性。

Abstract: Full-length RNAs, particularly messenger RNAs, often exceed the context lengths used to pretrain existing RNA foundation models, limiting complete-transcript modeling at single-nucleotide resolution. We present RIBOSPAN, a 1.61-billion-parameter bidirectional RNA foundation model natively pretrained with context lengths up to 10,240 nt. RIBOSPAN combines dense bidirectional self-attention, single-nucleotide tokenization, and attention-isolated sequence packing to enable high-resolution modeling of complete long RNAs. We evaluate the model through nucleotide reconstruction, a controlled long-context representation benchmark, and frozen RNA-type representation analysis. Native 10K pretraining preserves strong reconstruction at 10,240 tokens, while continued pretraining with 40% masking improves recovery under heavy corruption while preserving representation quality. The long-context benchmark further shows that native 10K models maintain strong contextual responsiveness and context-specific representation separation while keeping perturbation-induced representation changes highly localized. Inference-time YaRN scaling recovers much of the contextual organization lost by direct extrapolation of short-context models, but induces substantially greater distal representation diffusion. Frozen-representation evaluations further demonstrate state-of-the-art RNA representation quality, with RIBOSPAN achieving the strongest overall performance across diverse RNA types and retaining a clear advantage on long RNAs. Building on the same backbone, we develop a multidimensionally conditioned discrete-diffusion framework for full-length mRNA generation and redesign, including synonymous-codon diffusion for protein-preserving CDS optimization. Together, RIBOSPAN establishes a powerful long-context foundation for transferable RNA representation learning and full-transcript mRNA design.

</details>


### [639] [Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22854)
*Yan Zhou,Sara Kangaslahti,Jonathan Geuter,Nihal V. Nayak,Marco Fumero,Francesco Locatello,David Alvarez-Melis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ADAPT框架通过单次蒸馏运行，在模型家族的大小和微调变体两个轴上同时摊销蒸馏成本，生成L×K个中间大小的后训练模型，并支持推理时的自适应模型尺寸选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型的实际部署需要多种后训练变体（指令微调、推理微调、对话风格）以及多尺度尺寸，但独立训练每个(变体, 尺寸)组合成本过高。现有Boomerang蒸馏只沿尺寸轴降低了基础模型的成本，仍将每个后训练变体视为独立优化对象，缺乏跨变体的共享蒸馏机制。

Method: ADAPT由两个组件构成：(1) 两阶段蒸馏流程——通过预训练对齐和指令微调蒸馏构建后训练学生模型，实现生成和推理任务上平滑的尺寸-性能插值；(2) 权重增量初始化——通过将蒸馏引起的权重变化从基础模型转移到从不同后训练变体初始化的学生模型上，近似实现跨变体的构建过程。

Result: 该方法能够在单次蒸馏运行中为L个插值尺寸和K个后训练变体生成L×K个模型，并形成连续的插值模型谱系，支持推理时自适应模型尺寸选择，在长形式推理任务上改善了计算-精度权衡。

Conclusion: ADAPT通过在模型家族的大小和后训练变体两个轴向上同时摊销蒸馏成本，显著降低了多变体多尺寸模型族的构建开销，并通过连续模型谱系赋能推理时的自适应尺寸选择，提升了计算效率与性能的平衡。

Abstract: Practical deployment of large language models (LLMs) requires families of post-trained variants---instruction-tuned, reasoning-tuned, and chat-style models---each at multiple sizes to meet diverse latency and memory budgets. Producing each (variant, size) pair independently is prohibitive, so model families typically span only a handful of coarse-grained sizes per post-trained variant. Boomerang distillation (Kangaslahti et al., 2026) reduces this cost along the size axis for base models. Through model size interpolation, it constructs models of intermediate sizes from a single teacher-student pair without additional training. However, it still treats each post-trained variant as a separate object of optimization. We introduce ADAPT---Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs---a framework for amortizing distillation across both axes of a model family: size and post-training variant, producing $L \times K$ models for $L$ interpolated sizes across $K$ post-trained variants with a single distillation run. ADAPT combines two components. First, a two-phase distillation procedure constructs post-trained students through pre-training alignment and supervised fine-tuning distillation, enabling smooth size--performance interpolation on generation and reasoning tasks. Second, weight-delta initialization approximates this construction across post-trained variants by transferring the distillation-induced weight change from the base model to students initialized from different post-trained variants. The resulting continuum of interpolated models also enables adaptive model-size selection at inference time, improving the compute--accuracy trade-off for long-form reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [640] [Mapping the Concept Landscape: Structural Perception of Global Distributions for Transparent Data Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22858)
*Dongyue Wu,Tao Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MCL框架，通过构建样本级知识图谱（实体、事件、属性）来表征语义概念，利用数据集级图刻画概念全局分布与稀有度，并通过贪心概念覆盖最大化算法进行数据剪枝，在效率与可解释性上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据剪枝方法依赖高维特征嵌入来衡量样本重要性，但压缩向量会掩盖细粒度语义交互，导致剪枝子集对稀有语义概念的覆盖不足。

Method: 1) 将每个图像-文本对表示为由实体、事件、属性构成的样本级显式图；2) 将个体图整合为数据集级图，刻画语义概念全局分布并量化稀有度；3) 设计贪心概念覆盖最大化算法，迭代选择样本以最大化高价值、未充分表示概念边际增益。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，相比最先进的剪枝方法取得了更优的剪枝效率，同时提供了透明可解释的样本选择审计轨迹。

Conclusion: MCL通过结构化的概念景观映射，在提升剪枝性能的同时赋予剪枝过程可解释性，验证了基于语义图结构进行数据选择的有效性。

Abstract: Existing data pruning methods predominantly rely on high-dimensional feature embeddings to measure sample importance. However, these compressed vectors often obscure fine-grained semantic interactions, leading to suboptimal coverage of rare semantic concepts in the pruned subsets. In this paper, we propose Mapping the Concept Landscape (MCL), a novel structural perception framework for transparent data pruning. Instead of abstract embeddings, we represent each image-caption pair as an explicit sample-level graph comprising entities, events, and attributes. By integrating these individual graphs into a comprehensive dataset-level graph, we characterize the global distribution of semantic concepts and quantify their rarity across the entire corpus. Based on this structured perception, we develop a greedy concept-coverage maximization algorithm that iteratively selects samples to maximize the marginal gain of high-value, under-represented concepts. Experimental results on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only achieves superior pruning efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods but also provides a transparent and interpretable audit trail for the selection process.

</details>


### [641] [Stochastic Separability of Embedding Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22874)
*Liqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对高维神经空间中对象嵌入流形（同类对象呈低维流形结构、异类流形线性可分）这一实验观察，缺乏严格理论证明的问题，提出了嵌入流形随机可分性定理。通过建立投影测度集中定理（两层测度集中分析技术，利用全期望定律统一两个估计界），证明了在数据集均值不同且总方差有界、投影方向满足非奇异条件下，两类样本以高概率线性可分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经生物学研究和表示学习实验观察到：高维神经空间中同一类别对象的表示具有低维对象流形特征，且不同对象流形在该空间中线性可分。然而这些经验现象至今缺乏严格的理论验证，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 本文提出了一种新的两层测度集中分析技术：首先在一般条件下建立嵌入流形的投影测度集中定理，通过全期望定律统一两个估计界，推导出测度集中不等式；然后基于该定理证明两个不同类别嵌入流形的随机可分性定理，要求数据集均值不同、总方差有界，且投影方向满足非奇异条件。

Result: 本文的主要贡献为：(1) 利用两层尾界不等式证明了高维空间中嵌入流形的投影集中性质；(2) 识别了嵌入流形之间随机可分的非奇异条件，并严格证明了随机投影可分性定理。

Conclusion: 该定理不仅揭示了对象嵌入流形的几何与统计特性，还为深度网络中的表示学习提供了新的理论机制。

Abstract: Neurobiological studies and representation learning have observed that representations of objects belonging to the same category in high-dimensional neural spaces exhibit low-dimensional object manifold characteristics, and different object manifolds are linearly separable in these neural spaces. However, these experimentally observed phenomena lack rigorous theoretical validation to date.
  This paper proposes a new stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. First, we establish a projection measure concentration theorem for embedding manifolds under general conditions. We develop a new two-layer measure concentration analysis technique, which unifies two estimation bounds via the law of total expectation to derive measure concentration inequalities.
  Based on the measure concentration theorem, we further prove a stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. If two datasets have distinct means and bounded total variances, their samples become linearly separable with high probability, provided that the projection direction satisfies a non-singularity condition.
  The main contributions of this paper are twofold:
  1. We prove the projection concentration properties of embedding manifolds in high-dimensional spaces by using two-lawyer tail-bound inequalities.
  2. We identify a non-singularity condition for the stochastic separability between embedding manifolds, and rigorously prove the stochastic projection separability theorem.
  The theorem not only uncovers geometric and statistical properties of the object embedding manifolds, but also provides a novel mechanism for representation learning in deep networks.

</details>


### [642] [The Mask Is Not the Model: Auditing Prefix Invariance in Attention, State-Space, and Hybrid Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22876)
*Taebong Kim,Youngsik Hong,Minsik Kim,Sunyoung Choi,Jaewon Jang,Minseo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了"前缀不变性"（前缀位置的表示不得依赖未来输入），并提出了一种轻量级审计方法——仅需两次前向传播、无需训练或梯度，即可精确定位因果关系失效的位置。实验表明，传统注意力掩码检查无法发现泄漏（192次注入故障中检出率为0），而所提审计方法能全部定位（192/192），并在Zamba2和Nemotron-H中发现了实际缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型中的因果性（causality）是其正确生成的关键保证，但现有的注意力掩码检查方式并不完备——泄漏可能通过扫描（scan）操作或归一化（normalization）等机制绕过掩码发生。因此需要一种能够精确、高效地审计模型因果性是否被违反的方法。

Method: 提出"前缀不变性"作为因果性约束的形式化定义；设计轻量级审计方法，通过两次前向传播（forward passes）构造对比，无需训练或梯度计算，即可精确锁定因果性破坏发生的具体位置。该方法可检测掩码检查无法发现的、经由扫描或归一化等路径产生的信息泄漏。

Result: 在8个检查点（checkpoints）上进行了192次注入故障（injected-fault）试验：传统注意力掩码检查未能发现任何故障（0/192），而所提出的审计方法成功定位了全部192处泄漏（192/192）；此外，该方法还在Zamba2和Nemotron-H模型中发现了真实的因果缺陷。

Conclusion: 注意力掩码检查不足以确保模型的因果性，前缀不变性审计是一种更可靠、轻量且精确的因果性验证方法，能够发现实际部署模型中存在的因果泄漏缺陷。

Abstract: We formalize prefix invariance: representations at position t must not depend on future inputs. We give a lightweight audit, two forward passes, no training or gradients, that localizes exactly where causality breaks. Attention-mask inspection is incomplete: leaks can occur via scans or normalization despite correct masks. Across 192 injected-fault trials on eight checkpoints, mask inspection found none, while our audit localized all 192/192, also finding a defect in Zamba2 and Nemotron-H.

</details>


### [643] [Safety Hacking in Constrained Best-of-$N$ Inference-time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22915)
*Akifumi Wachi,Takumi Tanabe,Youhei Akimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了推理时管线中“学习安全模型 + 奖励最大化”组合所带来的两阶段失效问题，定义了“安全劫持”（safety hacking）现象，并从理论上推导了约束Best-of-N采样下安全劫持的有限N上界，证明当不安全但可行的输出具有更重的奖励尾部时，随着N增大安全劫持会渐近必然发生，即使误报率和代理误差任意小也无法避免。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）常通过采样多个输出、用学习的安全模型过滤、再用奖励模型选择最高奖励输出来实现。但安全模型作为不完美的代理（proxy），其误差会在与奖励最大化组合时被放大，导致选中的输出违反真实安全标准。现有研究缺乏对这一组合失效机制的系统理论分析。

Method: 定义安全劫持（safety hacking）为通过学习约束但违反真实安全标准的输出选择。针对约束Best-of-N采样推导有限N下由安全/不安全输出在代理可行集内的联合上奖励尾部（joint upper reward tails）决定的安全劫持边界；证明当N增大时，若不可行输出具有更重尾部则安全劫持渐近确定。进一步证明与代理可行参考分布χ²散度有界的策略族具有N无关的安全劫持上界，并以约束悲观采样（constrained pessimistic sampling）实例化该覆盖控制原则。用玩具模型和语言模型实验验证污染与奖励尾部放大效应。

Result: 理论结果表明：即使虚假正样本质量（false-positive mass）、平均安全代理误差和奖励代理误差任意小，只要代理可行集内不安全输出具有更重的奖励上尾部，安全劫持的渐近概率就趋于1。覆盖控制（coverage control）能限制放大效应但无法修复被污染的可行集：被容忍的不安全输出仍可能被偏好，且正则化选择并不对所有奖励代理都严格优于约束Best-of-N。实验证实了污染与奖励尾部放大现象。

Conclusion: 推理时扩展配合学习安全模型存在内在困难：安全代理的不完美性会在奖励最大化组合中被系统性地放大，形成从可行集污染到奖励尾部放大的两阶段失效。仅靠覆盖控制类方法不足以根治问题，需要从根本上解决安全代理污染或重新设计安全-奖励组合机制。

Abstract: Inference-time pipelines often sample multiple outputs, filter them with a learned safety model, and return the proxy-feasible output with the highest learned reward. We show that this composition creates a two-stage failure: an imperfect safety proxy first contaminates the feasible set with unsafe outputs, and reward maximization can then amplify this residual contamination. We define \emph{safety hacking} as selecting an output that passes the learned constraint but violates the true safety criterion. For constrained Best-of-$N$ sampling, we derive finite-$N$ bounds governed by the joint upper reward tails of safe and unsafe outputs within the proxy-feasible set. If unsafe-but-feasible outputs have the heavier tail, safety hacking becomes asymptotically certain as $N$ grows, even when false-positive mass and average safety- and reward-proxy errors are arbitrarily small. We also show that policies within a bounded $χ^2$ divergence from the proxy-feasible reference distribution admit an $N$-independent safety-hacking bound, and instantiate this general coverage-control principle with constrained pessimistic sampling. Coverage control limits amplification but cannot repair a contaminated feasible set: admitted unsafe outputs may still be favored, and regularized selection is not necessarily safer than constrained Best-of-$N$ for every reward proxy. Toy and language-model experiments characterize both contamination and its reward-tail amplification, which exposes an inherent difficulty in inference-time scaling with learned safety models.

</details>


### [644] [A Momentum-Based Variance-Reduced Algorithm for Federated Multiobjective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22945)
*Yong Zhao,Chunlin You,Minh N. Dao,Zai-Yun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于动量的方差缩减算法（momentum-based variance-reduced algorithm）用于联邦多目标优化（FMOO），通过将动量驱动的梯度估计器融入局部更新来降低随机梯度的方差，实现了T^{-2/3}的帕累托平稳性收敛速率，优于现有FSMGDA和FedCMOO方法的T^{-1/2}速率，并通过数值实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习被建模为单目标优化问题，仅专注于最大化模型效用。然而真实应用中模型往往需要同时优化多个可能相互冲突的目标，这引出了联邦多目标优化（FMOO）这一自然框架。现有方法（如FSMGDA和FedCMOO）的收敛率有限，亟需更高效的算法。

Method: 提出一种动量驱动的方差缩减算法，在联邦学习的局部更新中引入动量梯度估计器来降低随机更新的方差，从而改善收敛速率。该算法在客户端本地更新阶段使用动量技术，同时结合方差缩减策略来稳定梯度估计。

Result: 理论分析显示，随机选中的输出迭代点的期望帕累托平稳性度量以O(T^{-2/3})的速率衰减，显著优于现有方法FSMGDA和FedCMOO所达到的O(T^{-1/2})速率。在联邦多目标优化基准上的数值实验验证了所提算法的有效性和竞争力。

Conclusion: 本文通过动量方差缩减技术显著提升了联邦多目标优化的收敛效率，在理论收敛速率上取得了从T^{-1/2}到T^{-2/3}的改进，并通过实验证明了其实际性能优势。

Abstract: Federated learning has traditionally been formulated as a single-objective optimization problem, primarily focused on maximizing model utility. In real-world applications, however, machine learning models often need to optimize multiple and potentially conflicting objectives simultaneously. This motivates federated multiobjective optimization (FMOO), which provides a natural framework for jointly handling multiple task-specific objectives in federated learning. In this paper, we propose a momentum-based variance-reduced algorithm for federated multiobjective optimization. The method incorporates a momentum-driven gradient estimator into the local updates to reduce the variance of stochastic updates, leading to an improved convergence rate. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that the expected Pareto stationarity measure of a randomly selected output iterate decays at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3})$, improving upon the $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ rates established for existing methods such as FSMGDA and FedCMOO. Numerical experiments on federated multiobjective optimization benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and competitive performance of the proposed algorithm.

</details>


### [645] [Stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22953)
*Nabil Kahalé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了带初始正则化的随机梯度下降（SGDIR）在平方损失下的期望超额风险，推导了无维度上界。在无噪声情形下，分别对平均化和非平均化SGDIR建立了新的界；在有噪声情形下，通过实例级比较证明了SGDIR的期望超额风险在多项式对数因子内不超过岭回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是机器学习中广泛使用的优化算法，但对其在正则化框架下的统计风险（而非优化收敛性）的理论理解仍不充分。特别是在高维或函数空间中，现有结果往往受维度限制，缺乏无维度（dimension-free）的刻画。此外，SGDIR与经典岭回归在统计风险上的对比关系也尚未被系统研究。

Method: 作者对SGDIR的迭代过程进行分析，在平方损失设定下，利用矩条件、源条件和容量假设刻画学习问题的结构。在无噪声情形下，分别推导平均化和非平均化SGDIR的期望超额风险上界，并建立匹配的下界（在某些区域上达到多项式对数因子）。在有噪声情形下，采用实例级（instance-based）比较方法，在一般假设及正则化参数的温和下界条件下，将SGDIR与岭回归的风险进行对比分析。

Result: 无噪声情形下：对特定源参数值，获得阶为O(m^{-2}log²m)的界（m为训练样本数）；对另一源参数值，在容量参数超过ε^{-1}时，对任意ε>0获得阶为O(m^{-3+ε})的界。建立的下界在特定区域与上界匹配至多项式对数因子。有噪声情形下：证明在一般假设下，SGDIR的期望超额风险不超过岭回归（至多项式对数因子）。数值实验与理论一致。

Conclusion: SGDIR在统计风险意义上是一种与岭回归相当甚至更优的方法，其无维度上界拓展了对SGD类算法泛化能力的理论理解。所建立的上下界刻画了SGDIR在不同源条件和容量条件下的最优收敛速率，具有理论完备性和实际指导价值。

Abstract: We analyze a variant of stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization (SGDIR) and derive dimension-free upper bounds on its expected excess risk for the squared loss. In the noiseless case, we obtain new bounds for both averaged and non-averaged SGDIR under moment, source, and capacity assumptions. For a particular value of the source parameter, these bounds are of order $m^{-2}\log^{2}m$, where the number of training samples is of order $m$. For another value of the source parameter, we obtain, for any $ε>0$, bounds of order $m^{-3+ε}$, provided that the capacity parameter exceeds $ε^{-1}$. We also establish a lower bound that matches our upper bounds in certain regimes up to a polylogarithmic factor. In the noisy case, we provide an instance-based comparison between SGDIR and ridge regression. Under general assumptions and a mild lower bound on the regularization parameter, we show that the expected excess risk of SGDIR is no larger than that of ridge regression, up to a polylogarithmic factor. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real data are consistent with our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [646] [Do Time-Series Foundation Models Pay Off for Industrial Monitoring? A Cost-Aware Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22968)
*Guan-Hua Wen,Kuan-Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在工业监控场景中的部署价值进行了协议感知的实证评估，涵盖C-MAPSS退化风险代理、MIMII异常声音检测和BDG2预测残差诊断三个场景。结果表明，在冻结和零样本设定下，经典轻量模型（TCN-AE、OCSVM）在大部分异常排名任务上优于TSFMs，而TSFMs仅在某些特定预测任务上表现占优，TSFMs应被视为任务相关的部署选项而非轻量模型的默认替代品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业监控模型需检测运维相关的偏差，同时满足目标特定的数据、校准和资源约束。尽管时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）承诺可复用表示和零样本预测能力，但在任务定义异构、轻量基线具有竞争力的条件下，其部署价值证据仍然混杂，缺乏系统性的协议感知实证评估。

Method: 作者在三个工业场景中设计了协议感知的实验：C-MAPSS退化风险代理（100台引擎，折外评估）、MIMII正常样本训练的异常声音检测（5个匹配泵评估）、BDG2预测残差诊断（固定12米面板，带合成目标扰动）。对比方法包括经典单类方法（OCSVM）、紧凑神经自编码器（TCN-AE）、残差预测器、MOMENT-small、Chronos-T5和TimesFM 2.5，从异常排名性能、风险水平敏感性、残差预测与扰动敏感性、本地部署成本（延迟、峰值VRAM、序列化状态字典大小）等维度进行评估。

Result: 在C-MAPSS上，TCN-AE达到折加权AUROC/AUPRC 0.9570/0.8960，显著优于MOMENT重建的0.7310/0.3080，配对引擎簇bootstrap置信区间排除零差异。在MIMII上，OCSVM在AUROC和AUPRC上均超过MOMENT重建。在BDG2固定面板上，TimesFM 2.5具有最低的对齐预测误差和最高的合成AUROC点估计，但合成AUPRC在TSFM和拟合残差模型间相似。同设备测量显示MOMENT的延迟、峰值分配VRAM和序列化状态字典大小均高于TCN-AE。

Conclusion: 在冻结和零样本设定下，TSFMs是任务相关的部署选项，而非拟合轻量模型的默认替代品。TSFMs的价值高度依赖具体任务类型和资源约束，轻量拟合模型在多数异常排名任务中仍具竞争力。

Abstract: Industrial monitoring models must detect operationally relevant deviations while satisfying target-specific data, calibration, and resource constraints. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) promise reusable representations and zero-shot forecasts, yet evidence for their deployment value remains mixed when task definitions are heterogeneous and lightweight baselines are competitive. This work presents a protocol-aware empirical assessment across three settings: a C-MAPSS degradation-risk proxy, normal-only training for anomalous-sound detection on MIMII, and BDG2 forecasting-residual diagnostics with synthetic target perturbations. We assess classical one-class methods, compact neural autoencoders, residual forecasters, MOMENT-small, Chronos-T5, and TimesFM 2.5 in terms of anomaly-ranking performance, risk-horizon sensitivity, residual forecasting and perturbation sensitivity, and local implementation cost. Across 100 C-MAPSS engines evaluated out of fold, TCN-AE reaches fold-weighted AUROC/AUPRC 0.9570/0.8960, compared with 0.7310/0.3080 for MOMENT reconstruction; paired engine-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero for both differences. Across five matched MIMII pump evaluations, OCSVM also exceeds MOMENT reconstruction in AUROC and AUPRC. On a fixed 12-meter BDG2 panel, TimesFM 2.5 has the lowest aligned forecast error and the highest synthetic AUROC point estimate, although synthetic AUPRC is similar across TSFM and fitted residual models. Same-device measurements show that MOMENT incurs higher latency, peak allocated VRAM, and serialized state-dictionary size than TCN-AE. Under the evaluated frozen and zero-shot settings, TSFMs are task-dependent deployment options rather than default replacements for fitted lightweight models.

</details>


### [647] [Hierarchy-Aware Semantic Losses for Knowledge Graph Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22981)
*Filip Kronström,Ross D. King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了基于box embedding的层级感知语义损失在知识图谱链接预测中的有效性，在AIFB、CoDEx和BioKG三个数据集上，该方法相比基线GNN模型分别提升了7.6%、2.4%和15.5%的MRR，且一致优于将子类关系作为图边加入的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识图谱常伴随本体类层级结构，蕴含丰富的语义信息，但现有链接预测方法要么忽略这类层级，要么仅通过额外图边间接引入。此前层级感知GNN在生物回归任务上表现良好，但其在知识图谱链接预测上的有效性尚未被验证。

Method: 将GNN编码器与基于box embedding的语义损失结合，通过语义损失鼓励学习到的表示更好地满足本体派生的类层级关系，并与标准链接预测模型及将子类关系作为图边纳入的模型进行比较。

Result: 在所有数据集上，层级感知语义损失显著提升了MRR，并在AIFB、CoDEx和BioKG上分别比基线GNN模型提升7.6%、2.4%和15.5%，且一致优于通过额外子类边增强图结构的方法。

Conclusion: 本体派生的类层级为图结构提供了互补信息，通过语义损失鼓励层级一致性是一种有效且参数相对高效的机制，可用于改进知识图谱链接预测。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs are often accompanied by ontological class hierarchies that encode valuable semantic information, yet many link prediction methods either ignore such hierarchies or incorporate them indirectly through additional graph edges. Recent work introduced hierarchy-aware graph neural networks (GNNs), which use semantic losses derived from box embeddings to encourage satisfaction of subclass relationships during GNN-based representation learning. While this approach has shown promise for biological regression tasks, its effectiveness for knowledge graph link prediction has not been investigated.
  In this paper we evaluate hierarchy-aware semantic losses on link prediction across three benchmark datasets: AIFB, CoDEx, and BioKG. We combine graph neural network encoders with box-embedding-based semantic losses that encourage learned representations to better satisfy ontology-derived class hierarchies, and compare this approach to both standard link prediction models and models incorporating subclass relations as graph edges. Across all datasets, hierarchy-aware semantic losses significantly improve mean reciprocal rank (MRR) and consistently outperform models that incorporate hierarchy information through additional subclass edges. Relative to the baseline GNN models, MRR improved by 7.6%, 2.4%, and 15.5% on AIFB, CoDEx, and BioKG, respectively. Furthermore, semantic losses consistently outperform the alternative of augmenting the graph with subclass edges.
  These results are consistent with ontology-derived class hierarchies providing complementary information to graph structure, and suggest that encouraging hierarchical consistency through semantic losses is an effective and comparatively parameter-efficient mechanism for improving knowledge graph link prediction.

</details>


### [648] [A Physical Response-and-Memory Model for Muon Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22994)
*Yinze Hu,Hongjun Xiang,Xingao Gong,Hongyu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Bi-Maxwell优化器，将权重矩阵建模为具有记忆的响应介质，从物理角度解释了Muon优化器中半正交化方向为何有效（它是输出侧安全预算下的最大耗散响应），以及动量应平均多长的历史（由介质内部应力的多时间尺度松弛决定）。仅将记忆核从单时间尺度替换为双时间尺度，就在公开LLM优化器基准上以更少步数达到目标损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练大型语言模型的计算成本高昂，优化器决定了每个梯度步骤转化为权重更新的方式，直接影响给定计算量下的最终损失。然而从SGD、AdamW到Muon，有效的更新规则大多由工程直觉塑造并经基准测试筛选，缺乏理论解释。Muon的半正交化动量方向持续打破公共训练基准纪录，但其为何有效、动量应平均多长历史这两个关键问题目前仅靠经验回答，缺乏理论基础。

Method: 本文将训练中的权重矩阵视为具有记忆的响应介质并建立物理模型。在该模型中：(1)半正交化方向被证明是输出侧安全预算下的最大耗散响应，由此解释其有效性；(2)动量被解释为介质内部累积的应力，其平均时长由应力松弛决定；真实介质在多于一个时间尺度上松弛，最简单形式为一个快时间尺度加一个慢时间尺度。基于此提出Bi-Maxwell优化器，将动量记忆核从单时间尺度替换为双时间尺度。此外，通过只读探针在8条独立训练轨迹上逐步测量最优记忆长度的代理量，验证了梯度方向变化早期快、后期慢的理论预测。

Result: (1) 物理模型成功推导出Muon半正交化方向为最大耗散响应，为经验有效的优化器提供了理论解释；(2) 框架推导出可检验的预言：梯度方向变化率随训练阶段下降，最优记忆长度应随训练进程增长，8条独立训练轨迹的逐步测量与之一致；(3) 仅将记忆核从单时间尺度替换为双时间尺度（Bi-Maxwell），在公共大型语言模型优化器基准上以显著更少的步数达到目标损失。

Conclusion: 该工作为优化器设计建立了物理视角的理论框架，统一解释了半正交化方向的有效性和动量的最优平均时长，并催生了性能更优的Bi-Maxwell优化器。这暗示优化器设计可以从物理原理出发而非依赖纯经验试错，为未来在更多时间尺度上扩展记忆核（如多Maxwell模型）指明了方向。

Abstract: Training large language models is costly. How low a loss the same compute can ultimately reach depends on how each step's gradient is converted into a weight update; the rule that performs this conversion is the optimizer. From SGD and AdamW to the recent Muon, effective update rules have mostly been shaped by engineering intuition and then selected on benchmarks. Muon semi-orthogonalizes the momentum matrix before applying the update and has kept breaking records on public training benchmarks; yet why the semi-orthogonalized direction works, and over how long a history the momentum should average, are two questions at present answered mainly by experience. Here we treat the weight matrix during training as a responsive medium with memory and build a physical model for it, in which both questions find answers: the semi-orthogonalized direction is the maximally dissipative response under an output-side safety budget, which explains why it works; momentum is the internal stress accumulated by the medium; how long it should average is set by the relaxation of this stress, and a real medium relaxes on more than one timescale, the simplest form being one fast and one slow. On this basis we propose the Bi-Maxwell optimizer. The framework further yields a testable consequence: gradient directions change fast early in training and more slowly later, so the optimal memory length should grow with training stage; step-by-step measurements of a proxy for it by a read-only probe across 8 independent training trajectories are consistent with this consequence. Replacing the memory kernel alone, from a single timescale to two, brings training to the target loss in noticeably fewer steps on a public large-language-model optimizer benchmark.

</details>


### [649] [SplitLite: Low-Rank Residual Compression for Split Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23018)
*Tao Li,Yulin Tang,Qi Guo,Xianhao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SplitLite是一种通信高效的拆分联邦LoRA微调方法，利用相邻训练轮次间激活和梯度残差的低有效秩结构，通过量化截断SVD传输残差因子，在GLUE基准上实现了最高93.5%的激活上行通信和83.7%的总通信成本降低，且不影响模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧设备上的联邦大语言模型微调面临显著的计算负担，拆分学习（SL）虽能将主要训练负载卸载到服务器，但需要在客户端与服务器之间交换高维激活和梯度，导致高昂的通信成本。

Method: SplitLite利用LoRA在参数空间使用秩r更新时，相邻训练轮次间同一数据样本的激活残差和梯度残差分别展现出有效秩-2r和秩-4r结构这一关键发现，仅传输量化后的截断奇异值分解（SVD）残差因子，从而显著减少激活上行和梯度下行流量。

Result: 在GLUE基准测试及一系列先进端侧大语言模型上的大量实验表明，该方法可将激活上行通信成本降低最多93.5%，总通信成本降低最多83.7%，且不产生性能退化。

Conclusion: 通过揭示并利用连续轮次间残差的内在低秩结构，SplitLite在不牺牲模型性能的前提下有效解决了拆分联邦LoRA微调中的通信瓶颈问题。

Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of on-device large language models (LLMs) faces a significant computing burden. To overcome this limitation, split learning (SL) has emerged as a promising solution, which offloads the primary training workload to a powerful server. However, SL requires exchanging high-dimensional activations and gradients between clients and the server, resulting in prohibitive communication costs. To overcome this challenge, we propose SplitLite, a communication-efficient split federated LoRA fine-tuning method that exploits the low effective rank structure of consecutive-epoch activation and gradient residuals. Our key finding is that, when LoRA uses rank $r$ updates in parameter space, the activation and gradient residuals of the same data sample between adjacent epochs also exhibit effective rank-$2r$ and rank-$4r$ structures, respectively. By revealing this property, SplitLite transmits only quantized truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) residual factors, thereby significantly reducing both activation uplink and gradient downlink traffic. Extensive experiments on the GLUE benchmark across a series of advanced on-device LLMs demonstrate that our method reduces activation uplink communication costs by up to 93.5\% and total communication costs by up to 83.7\%, without performance degradation.

</details>


### [650] [FedCC: Towards Addressing Label Distribution Skews in Distillation-Based Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23031)
*Wenxuan Ye,Onur Ayan,Xueli An,Georg Carle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedCC算法，通过允许客户端将模棱两可的样本标记为"未知"类并校准公共数据集上的伪标签，以缓解蒸馏式联邦学习中标签分布偏斜导致的客户端错误分类问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在蒸馏式联邦学习中，异构本地数据引入标签分布偏斜，使客户端模型偏向多数类并导致预测不准确。公共数据集缺少真实标签，服务器难以校准预测，最终损害整体性能。

Method: FedCC允许客户端不被迫对模糊样本进行分类，而是将其标记为"未知"类别；同时利用公共数据上的校准伪标签，在多数类置信度与少数类不确定性之间取得平衡。

Result: 实验表明FedCC显著优于现有方法，尤其在严重标签偏斜情况下。在极端场景中（每个客户端只持有十类中一个类别的样本），FedCC达到67.3%的准确率，而基线方法几乎退化为随机结果。

Conclusion: FedCC通过引入"未知"类标记和伪标签校准，有效缓解了蒸馏式联邦学习中标签分布偏斜带来的性能退化，在极端标签偏斜场景下仍能保持良好表现。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables distributed clients to collaboratively train models without sharing raw data, making it promising for leveraging massive devices in communication networks. In distillation-based FL, each client applies its local model on an unlabeled public dataset, and shares only prediction results with the server. While heterogeneous local data introduces label distribution skew, thus biasing client models toward majority classes and leading to potentially inaccurate predictions. The lack of ground-truth labels in the public dataset hampers the server's ability to calibrate predictions, which ultimately degrades overall performance. To address this, we propose FedCC, a simple and effective algorithm for mitigating client misclassification. Instead of being forced to classify and risking error propagation, clients are allowed to tag ambiguous samples as 'unknown'. This additional class, together with calibrated pseudo-labels on the public data, balances confidence in majority classes against uncertainty in under-represented ones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCC significantly outperforms existing methods, especially under severe label skew. In the extreme scenario where each client holds samples from only one of ten classes, FedCC achieves 67.3% accuracy, while baselines collapse to near-random results.

</details>


### [651] [ST$^2$U: Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via Restricted Knowledge Boundary Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23034)
*Xunlei Chen,Qinghui Gong,Ruini Xue,Yaodong Hu,Tian Lan,Wenhong Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ST²U（状态化测试时遗忘），将测试时遗忘建模为轨迹级边界控制，通过在低维可逆坐标中建模受限知识边界，并在推理过程中跨token传播历史修正状态，实现更持久的遗忘，同时保持非目标能力和控制推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活编辑方法仅应用孤立的逐点修正，忽略了自回归生成中隐藏状态会从提示、缓存和已生成前缀中持续重建的事实，导致局部修正成功后期状态仍可能返回受限知识区域，造成受限知识重新进入（knowledge re-entry）问题。

Method: ST²U首先在低维可逆坐标中建模受限知识边界，同时保持正交的非目标分量不变；推理时沿轨迹监控风险，应用带上下文锚定的最小边界修正，并在token间传播历史修正状态以缓解知识重入。将测试时遗忘形式化为轨迹级边界控制问题。

Result: 在三个基准和三个模型家族上，ST²U实现了最强的整体性能平衡：保留能力达到最佳或次佳，遗忘效果具有竞争力，受限知识重新进入显著低于测试时基线（13.76%-19.84%对比46.50%-59.10%）。

Conclusion: 轨迹级控制相比逐点修正能实现更持久的遗忘，同时保持非目标能力并限制推理开销，验证了将测试时遗忘视为轨迹级边界控制的有效性。

Abstract: Controlling restricted knowledge in large language models is essential for model alignment and safe deployment. Test-time unlearning avoids costly retraining and parameter updates by intervening only during inference. However, existing activation-editing methods apply isolated pointwise corrections, overlooking how autoregressive generation continually reconstructs hidden states from the prompt, cache, and generated prefix. Consequently, later states may return to restricted knowledge regions after a locally successful correction, causing restricted knowledge re-entry. In this work, we propose Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via restricted knowledge boundary control (ST$^2$U), which formulates test-time unlearning as trajectory-wide boundary control. ST$^2$U first models restricted knowledge boundaries in low-dimensional invertible coordinates while leaving orthogonal non-target components unchanged. During inference, ST$^2$U monitors risk along the trajectory, applies minimal boundary corrections with contextual anchoring, and propagates historical correction states across tokens to mitigate knowledge re-entry. This trajectory-wide control enables more persistent forgetting while preserving non-target capabilities and limiting inference overhead. Across three benchmarks and three model families, ST$^2$U delivers the strongest overall balance, combining best or second-best retention with competitive forgetting and substantially less restricted-knowledge re-entry than test-time baselines (13.76%-19.84% versus 46.50%-59.10%).

</details>


### [652] [Reservoir of Importance: Learning Semi-Structured Sparsity with Differentiable Subset Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23048)
*Ha Dinh,Xuan Duy Ta,Khoat Than,Khac-Hoai Nam Bui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RoI（Reservoir of Importance），一种轻量级半结构化N:M稀疏剪枝框架，通过差异化子集采样学习稀疏掩码，将可学习参数从组合复杂度降至O(M)，在Qwen2.5系列（0.5-7B）上实现竞争性能与显著的内存效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可学习掩码方法在建模N:M稀疏模式的全类别分布时引入了大量参数和内存开销，难以扩展到大型模型和激进稀疏率场景。因此需要一种兼顾效率与可扩展性的半结构化稀疏剪枝方法。

Method: RoI提出紧凑logit参数化（compact-logit parameterization）进行稀疏掩码学习，采用无放回采样（sampling without replacement）来选择掩码，将可训练参数从组合复杂度降低到O(M)，并保持与硬件友好的N:M稀疏模式完全对齐。

Result: 在Qwen2.5 LLM系列（0.5B-7B参数）上的广泛评估表明，RoI相比现有方法需要1.5-8.75倍更少的可学习参数和显著更低的内存成本，同时实现竞争性能，并展现出良好的稳定性及对更激进N:M稀疏模式的可扩展性。

Conclusion: RoI为大型语言模型的半结构化稀疏剪枝提供了一条实用路径，在保持硬件友好的稀疏模式的同时，实现了参数效率、内存效率与模型性能之间的良好平衡，有助于高效LLM部署。

Abstract: Semi-structured $N$:$M$ sparsity has emerged as a practical direction for accelerating large language models (LLMs). However, existing learnable-mask approaches incur substantial parameter and memory overhead, limiting their scalability to large models and aggressive sparsity regimes. In this work, we revisit semi-structured pruning from a perspective that reconciles efficiency with scalability. We propose Reservoir of Importance (RoI), a lightweight semi-structured pruning framework that learns sparsity masks through differentiable subset sampling. Unlike prior methods that model full categorical distributions over all feasible $N$:$M$ patterns, RoI introduces a compact-logit parameterization for sparsity mask learning and performs sampling without replacement to select masks, thereby reducing trainable parameters from combinatorial complexity to $\mathcal{O}({M})$. As a result, RoI requires 1.5-8.75$\times$ fewer learnable parameters and significantly lower memory cost, while remaining fully aligned with hardware-friendly sparsity patterns. Extensive evaluations across multiple scales of the Qwen2.5 LLM family (0.5-7B parameters) demonstrate that RoI achieves competitive performance with strong memory efficiency, stability, and scalability to more aggressive $N$:$M$ sparsity patterns, offering a practical path toward efficient LLM deployment.

</details>


### [653] [Graph Representation Learning of Lightweight IoT Ciphers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23054)
*Jonathan Cook,Sabih ur Rehman,M. Arif Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于机器学习引导的图表示学习框架，用于高效识别和可视化SIMON和SIMECK轻量级密码算法中的高概率差分簇。通过从部分差分分布表中提取四种差分属性进行特征工程，并构建三种ML引导的有向图（KNN、决策树、随机森林），所有模型在识别高概率差分时精确率达1.0，其中KNN在聚类分离度、F1分数和图构建时间上表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SIMON和SIMECK作为面向物联网的Feistel结构轻量级密码算法，易受差分密码分析攻击，需要严格的抗攻击性评估。现有最先进技术依赖启发式方法和采样来提升效率，但鲜有研究将机器学习引导的图表示学习应用于高效识别和可视化高概率差分簇，这一研究空白亟需填补。

Method: 提出一种高效特征工程策略，从部分差分分布表（pDDT）中提取四种差分属性，揭示原始差分数据中隐藏的结构信息。利用增强后的特征，分别使用K近邻（KNN）、决策树（DT）和随机森林（RF）三种机器学习模型，为SIMON32和SIMECK32构建ML引导的有向图。

Result: 三种模型在识别高概率差分方面均达到1.0的精确率（零假阳性）。KNN在聚类分离效果、F1分数和图构建时间（约2.3秒）上表现最佳，而DT和RF生成了近似完美回归的最优路径。结果在两种轻量级密码算法上保持一致。

Conclusion: 该框架首次实现了基于图的高概率差分聚类效应的可视化，证明了高概率单位比特差分在学习的嵌入空间中形成几何上接近的簇。其跨算法的一致性结果表明，这一框架可推广应用于其他AND-rotation类轻量级密码算法家族，为轻量级密码的安全性评估提供了新的高效工具。

Abstract: SIMON and SIMECK belong to a family of Lightweight Cryptographic Algorithms (LCAs) based on the Feistel block cipher, designed for Internet of Things (IoT) devices. As with all Feistel ciphers, they are susceptible to differential cryptanalysis, necessitating rigorous resilience evaluations. While state-of-the-art techniques leverage heuristics and sampling to improve efficiency, little work has applied Machine Learning (ML) guided Graph Representation Learning (GRL) to efficiently identify and visualise high-probability differential clusters. We address this gap by introducing an efficient feature engineering strategy that extracts four differential attributes from a partial Difference Distribution Table (pDDT), revealing structural information concealed in raw differential data. Utilising the enriched features, we construct and compare three ML-guided directed graphs for SIMON$32$ and SIMECK$32$ using K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Decision Trees (DT), and Random Forests (RF). To the best of our knowledge, our framework produces the first graph-based visualisation of the differential clustering effect, in which high-probability single-bit differentials form geometrically close clusters in the learned embedding. All three models achieve a precision of $1.0$ in identifying high-probability differentials, confirming zero false positives. KNN achieves the strongest cluster separation, the highest F1 score and the lowest graph construction time of approximately $2.3$ seconds, while DT and RF produce optimal paths with near-perfect regression. The results are consistent across both LCAs, demonstrating the applicability of the framework to other AND-rotation LCA families.

</details>


### [654] [Macro-Action Topological Navigation under Noisy Localization using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23055)
*Simon Hakenes,Tobias Glasmachers*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明在纯像素输入下，通过对象为中心的拓扑控制器结合扩展卡尔曼滤波的局部位姿估计，强化学习智能体可以在逼真的3D公寓中完成多目标顺序导航任务，无需完整SLAM，仅需局部一致的位姿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从原始像素在大规模逼真3D室内环境中进行强化学习导航通常被认为不可行，且现有方法依赖模拟器提供的真实位姿和物体检测信息，与实际机器人应用不符。

Method: 基于早期对象为中心的拓扑控制器框架，将模拟器提供的真实位姿替换为机载的对象中心位姿估计：为每个物体维护ORB特征的描述子库，当物体再次被观测时获得粗略位姿测量，并通过最小扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）与运动模型融合，即使执行动作存在噪声也能维持局部一致的位姿。

Result: 在逼真的Habitat模拟器中，智能体仅凭视觉输入即可依次到达目标物体，其位姿只需局部一致即可完成任务，无需完整SLAM。

Conclusion: 对象中心的局部位姿估计足以支撑纯视觉强化学习导航，这种更小巧的模型比完整SLAM更接近生物导航的工作机制。

Abstract: Navigating large, photorealistic 3D apartments from raw pixels is widely considered infeasible for plain reinforcement learning. We build an agent that does it anyway, estimating its own pose from the camera alone. The agent has to reach several target objects in sequence, and their positions change between episodes, so it must explore to find them. It builds on our earlier object-centric topological controller, which still read the agent's true pose and its object detections from the simulator. Here we replace that true pose with an onboard, object-centric estimate. For each object we keep a bank of ORB features that, when the object is seen again, yield a rough pose measurement, which a minimal Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) fuses with a motion model. As on a real robot, the executed motions are noisy. The estimate drifts, but the agent and the nearby objects drift together, so a locally consistent pose is enough to follow each short edge and then home in visually on the target, which lets us replace full SLAM with a much smaller model, closer to how biological navigation appears to work. In the photorealistic Habitat simulator, the agent reaches its target objects from vision alone, with a pose that only needs to be locally consistent.

</details>


### [655] [PolyChirp: Multi-Species Birdsong Classification Using TinyML on Low-Power Acoustic Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23101)
*Nathan Duboisset,Zhaolan Huang,Felix Bießmann,Roudy Dagher,Antoine Lavandier,Emmanuel Baccelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PolyChirp是一个结合生物学领域知识、自动化数据集构建、神经架构优化和NPU硬件加速的方法，在微控制器上实现多达10种鸟类的实时多类声学检测，同时保持单次充电可持续整个繁殖季节的低功耗资源预算，并在单物种二分类任务上超越现有最佳水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TinyML声学鸟类监测方案仅支持单一物种的二分类，而真实野外生物多样性监测往往需要同时识别多个物种。这一能力缺口限制了低功耗微控制器在实际生态监测部署中的应用价值。

Method: PolyChirp融合四条技术路线：领域（鸟类学）专业知识指导特征设计、自动化数据集构建流程、神经架构搜索/优化（NAS）、以及利用配备神经处理单元（NPU）的新型微控制器硬件进行加速推理。

Result: 在预测性能上，PolyChirp不仅超越了单物种二分类的现有最佳方法，还能实现对多达10种物种的鲁棒多类分类；在计算性能上，模型的内存占用、延迟和能耗均满足部署在野外且单次充电运行整个季节的传感器资源约束。

Conclusion: PolyChirp证明了在超低功耗边缘硬件上实现多类鸟类声学监测是可行的，填补了TinyML从二分类到多分类的空白，为实际生态监测部署提供了可落地的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent progress in the field of TinyML has demonstrated that low-power hardware based on microcontrollers can achieve bird species monitoring in real time based on acoustic sensor data for an entire breeding period on a single battery charge. However, the state of the art on low-power microcontrollers was so far limited to binary classification of a single species. In contrast, real fauna monitoring deployments often target multiple species simultaneously. To address this challenge we develop PolyChirp, an approach combining biological domain expertise, automated dataset curation, neural architecture optimization and novel hardware to achieve multiclass bird species detection in the wild. PolyChirp is based on newly designed tiny multiclass models that leverage recent microcontrollers and hardware acceleration with a neural processing unit (NPU). We evaluate the predictive performance of these models, and we measure their computational performance -- memory footprint, latency, energy consumption -- on common microcontroller hardware. Our results demonstrate that PolyChirp not only outperforms state-of-the-art on single species binary classification, but also achieves robust classification of up to 10 species simultaneously, while still fitting with the resource envelope of a sensor that must remain operational in the field for a full season on a single battery charge.

</details>


### [656] [DeMixPert: Decomposed Response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for OOD Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23114)
*Jiawen Liu,Xuechenxiao Cao,Yutong Li,Bing Liu,Jiaming Liang,Tinghe Zhang,Xiaoqi Sheng,Hongmin Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeMixPert是一种用于未见遗传扰动的单细胞转录组预测的新方法，通过将扰动诱导的变化分解为基态依赖的系统性响应、扰动特异性响应和群体水平变异三个部分，并使用高斯原型可逆网络建模群体变异分布，实现了对未见扰动的单细胞异质性响应的准确预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法常将确定性响应结构与随机群体水平变异纠缠在一起，导致主导共享模式掩盖较弱的扰动特异性信号，并损害分布建模能力，难以准确预测未见遗传扰动的转录组响应。

Method: DeMixPert将扰动变化分解为三个部分：基态依赖的系统性响应（从对照细胞表达的基态编码中获得）、扰动特异性响应（从预训练靶标嵌入推断以支持未见靶标泛化）、群体水平变异（通过高斯原型可逆网络建模）。该方法根据基态和扰动条件自适应组合可复用的高斯原型，生成条件特异性变异分布，将采样变异与系统性及扰动特异性成分整合，并结合基态进行联合解码以重建扰动细胞的基因表达。

Result: 实验结果表明，DeMixPert有效捕获了异质性单细胞扰动响应，在未见扰动设置下取得了优于现有方法的性能。

Conclusion: 通过解耦确定性响应结构与随机群体变异，DeMixPert解决了扰动特异性信号被掩盖和分布建模受损的问题，为未见遗传扰动的单细胞响应预测提供了更有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Predicting transcriptome-wide responses to unseen genetic perturbations remains a major computational challenge because accurate prediction requires recovering both perturbation-specific transcriptional shifts and heterogeneous cellular responses. Existing methods often entangle deterministic response structure with stochastic population-level variation, causing dominant shared patterns to mask weaker perturbation-specific signals and impair distributional modeling. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{DeMixPert}, an approach for Decomposed response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) single-cell Perturbation prediction. DeMixPert decomposes perturbation-induced changes into a basal-state-dependent systematic response, a perturbation-specific response, and population-level variation. The systematic component is derived from the basal state encoded from control-cell expression, whereas the perturbation-specific component is inferred from pretrained target embeddings for unseen-target generalization. DeMixPert models population-level variation using a Gaussian prototype Invertible Network and adaptively combines reusable Gaussian prototypes according to the basal state and perturbation condition. The resulting mixture is mapped to a condition-specific variation distribution. Sampled variations are integrated with the systematic and perturbation-specific components, followed by joint decoding with the basal state to reconstruct perturbed-cell gene expression. Experimental results show that DeMixPert effectively captures heterogeneous single-cell perturbation responses and achieves superior performance across unseen-perturbation settings. The source code is made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [657] [Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding for Low-Bit LLM Weight Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23144)
*Zehao Liu,Chuangchuang Fang,Yang Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AWSRC是一种紧凑的残差修复编解码器，通过种子生成基向量编码量化残差，仅以每权重0.162位代价即可将INT4 RTN量化的Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型在PPL、KL和准确率方面与BF16的差距分别缩小88.2%、78.9%和71.3%，表现优于稀疏、低秩和向量量化等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低位权重量化能节省存储但引入误差，导致语言模型质量下降，需要一种高效的残差修复机制来弥补量化损失。

Method: AWSRC利用确定性种子生成的基向量对权重残差W-W0进行编码，边信息仅存储种子选择器、低位系数和缩放因子而非显式码本；采用激活统计信息优先编码影响层输出的误差。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上，INT4 RTN骨干添加0.162 scope-bits/权重后，闭合了与BF16之间88.2%的PPL差距、78.9%的KL差距和71.3%的准确率差距；使用49.25 MB（约BF16权重有效载荷的0.8%）的边信息即取得最佳困惑度和平均任务准确率，优于稀疏、低秩和向量量化编解码器。

Conclusion: AWSRC证明利用种子生成基和激活加权优先级的紧凑残差编码方法，可以以极小的存储开销有效修复低位量化模型的性能损失，是一种实用且高效的量化补偿方案。

Abstract: Low-bit weight quantization saves storage but leaves errors that degrade language-model quality. We introduce Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding (AWSRC), a compact repair codec for an existing quantization backbone. Given a reconstructed weight $W_0$, AWSRC encodes the residual $W-W_0$ using deterministic seed-generated bases. The sidecar stores seed selectors, low-bit coefficients, and scales rather than an explicit codebook. Activation statistics prioritize errors that affect layer outputs. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adding 0.162 scope-bits/weight to an INT4 RTN backbone closes 88.2%, 78.9%, and 71.3% of the matched PPL, KL, and accuracy gaps to BF16. Repairing a matched strong low-bit backbone also improves all measured quality metrics. With a matched 49.25 MB sidecar, about 0.8% of the BF16 model-weight payload, AWSRC gives the best perplexity and mean task accuracy among sparse, low-rank, and vector-quantized codecs.

</details>


### [658] [Conformal Risk Minimization for Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation via Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23153)
*Manos Giannopoulos,Yi Shen,Michael M. Zavlanos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个端到端框架，将一致性风险最小化（CRM）集成到半监督域自适应（SSDA）训练目标中，利用最优传输（OT）为未标注目标域数据生成伪标签，从而在目标域标签稀缺的情况下实现高效一致性预测，产出紧凑、覆盖率有效且支持领域特定约束的预测集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险医疗应用中，机器学习模型常面临分布偏移问题，SSDA虽能缓解但缺乏不确定性量化能力。传统的Conformal Prediction虽能提供覆盖率保证，但事后应用会产生过大的预测集；而CRM虽能将CP目标集成到训练中，却需要大量标注数据计算非一致性阈值，这恰恰是SSDA场景下最稀缺的资源。

Method: 提出一个端到端框架，将CRM集成到SSDA训练目标中。核心创新在于利用最优传输（OT）为未标注的目标域实例生成伪标签，为CRM提供额外的训练信号，使其仅需少量标注目标集即可运行。模型被联合优化以实现域不变性和一致性效率，产出紧凑、覆盖率有效的预测集，并支持领域特定约束（如排除皮肤病变分类中相互矛盾的诊断）。

Result: 所提出的框架能够生成紧凑且覆盖率有效的预测集，在目标域标签稀缺的场景下实现有效的CRM，同时支持域特定约束，如排除互斥诊断。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了CRM在全监督场景与SSDA场景之间的鸿沟，为高风险医疗应用中的端到端不确定性量化提供了一条可行的技术路径。

Abstract: In high-stakes healthcare applications, machine learning models are frequently trained on data from one patient population and deployed on another, creating a distribution shift that degrades both accuracy and reliability. Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation (SSDA) addresses this by leveraging labeled data from some source domain to improve model performance on a target domain where labels are scarce. However, existing SSDA methods optimize primarily for point-prediction accuracy and offer no principled uncertainty quantification --- a prerequisite for clinical trust. Conformal Prediction (CP) can address this limitation by providing prediction sets with rigorous, distribution-free coverage guarantees. However, applying CP post-hoc to a pre-trained model can yield prohibitively large prediction sets, as SSDA pre-training methods do not account for the nonconformity score geometry that determines conformal set size. Conformal Risk Minimization (CRM) has been used to resolve this issue in the fully supervised setting by integrating the CP objective directly into model training, but it requires a large labeled dataset to compute nonconformity thresholds during training, precisely the data that is scarce in the SSDA regime. We propose an end-to-end framework that integrates CRM into the SSDA training objective, enabling effective CRM in the limited-labeled-target-data regime. The key idea is to utilize Optimal Transport (OT) to generate pseudolabels for unlabeled target instances, providing the additional training signal needed by CRM to operate using only a small labeled target set. This results in a model jointly optimized for domain invariance and conformal efficiency, producing prediction sets that are compact, coverage-valid, and support domain-specific constraints such as excluding mutually contradictory diagnoses in skin lesion classification.

</details>


### [659] [When More Modalities Hurt: Modality Dropout for Heavy-Duty Vehicle Engine Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23161)
*Adeel Zafar,Slawomir Nowaczyk,Hamid Sarmadi,Saeed Gholami Shahbandi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究重型车辆诊断中三种异构数据模态（多语言非结构化工单文本、缺失率超80%的高维传感器遥测数据、诊断故障码DTC）的融合方法。在包含885个样本、五大发动机部件类别的专有数据集上，通过5折交叉验证发现：训练中随机整模态丢弃（modality dropout）的融合策略在文本+DTC组合上达到68.8%的准确率（加权F1: 0.67），较纯文本基线（65.3%）提升3.5个百分点，优于朴素融合、逻辑回归和梯度提升树。类别分析显示不同故障类型的主导模态各异：进排气故障传感器达93%、燃油系统故障通过融合几乎翻三倍（15%→38%）。这是工业车辆诊断中首次结合文本、传感器与故障码的三模态融合研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重型车辆诊断中产生的三类数据模态（非结构化多语言维修工单、缺失率超过80%的高维传感器数据、诊断故障码）长期被割裂使用，业界尚未系统验证融合这些模态能否提升发动机部件分类性能。

Method: 采用5折交叉验证，对比三种模型家族（包含神经网络、逻辑回归、梯度提升树）的多种配置；核心创新是训练时随机整模态丢弃（modality dropout），即在每个batch中随机禁用整个模态，迫使网络利用较弱但互补的输入信号。

Result: 朴素融合仅比纯文本（65.3%）略有提升；modality dropout在文本+DTC融合上达到68.8%准确率（加权F1: 0.67），提升3.5个百分点，为所有方法中的最佳结果。传感器单独在进排气故障上达93%（文本为80%）；燃油系统故障上融合将准确率从15%提升至38%。

Conclusion: 融合确实能提升工业车辆发动机部件分类性能，但融合方式至关重要——简单拼接效果有限，modality dropout能有效利用弱模态互补信息。不同故障类型主导模态不同，说明模态价值具有任务依赖性。这是首次将文本、传感器和故障码三维模态融合应用于工业车辆诊断。

Abstract: Heavy-duty vehicle diagnostics generate three disconnected data modalities: unstructured multi- lingual service complaints, high-dimensional sensor telemetry with over 80% missing values, and Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs). We investigate whether fusing these modalities improves engine component classification on a proprietary dataset from a major truck manufacturer. Through 5-fold cross-validation across multiple model configurations spanning three model families on five engine component classes (885 samples, the full cross-database matched population for this manufacturer), we find that naive fusion provides modest gains over text alone (65.3%). However, modality dropout during training, which randomly disables entire modalities per batch, forces the network to exploit weaker inputs and achieves 68.8% accuracy on text+DTC fusion (weighted F1: 0.67), a 3.5-point improvement over text-only (65.3%, weighted F1: 0.64) and the best result across all methods including logistic regression and gradient-boosted trees. Per-class analysis shows that the dominant modality varies by fault type: text describes symptoms, DTCs encode structured fault signals, and sensors measure physical state. On intake/exhaust faults, sensors alone reach 93% where text achieves 80%. On fuel system faults, fusion with modality dropout nearly triples accuracy from 15% to 38% over text alone. To our knowledge, this is the first application of three-way modality fusion combining text, sensors, and fault codes in industrial vehicle diagnostics.

</details>


### [660] [Counterfactual Transition Graphs: Evaluating Cross-Class Transition Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23164)
*Syed Muhammad Hamza Zaidi,Szymon Bobek,Grzegorz J. Nalepa,Myra Spiliopoulou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种反事实转换图（CGT）框架，将时间序列分类器的反事实可解释性从单样本层面提升到结构层面，用于揭示分类器类别之间的连接拓扑。在六类手部运动任务上，CGT展现出与传统混淆矩阵不一致的非平凡拓扑结构，表明反事实可达性与分类准确率呈负相关（ρ=-0.37），并且能够对替换式和梯度式反事实解释方法进行对比分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的反事实解释评估通常逐样本进行，只回答"哪些最小编辑能翻转这个窗口的预测"，但缺少一个更宏观的视角来理解分类器如何将其类别在结构上相互连接，这限制了基于反事实解释的诊断性洞察。

Method: 提出反事实转换图（CGT）框架：图中每个节点代表一个类别，每条边的权重表示在邻近感知检索扫描下，从一个原型到另一个原型的反事实可靠性。该框架是方法无关的，可适配任意反事实解释器。

Result: 在六类手部运动任务上，CGT揭示了非平凡的拓扑结构，且未被二元混淆矩阵所预测。反事实可达性与分类准确率不一致甚至相反（Spearman ρ=-0.37，基于15对类别）。对比发现梯度式方法可脱离数据流形到达几乎所有类别，而替换式方法停留在数据流形上，在刚性边界处失效。

Conclusion: 反事实转换图提供了一种结构化的诊断解释工具，能够揭示分类器类间连接模式。该方法暴露了分类器边界"刚性"的本质属性：最自信分离的类边界恰恰是最难以通过分布内编辑跨越的，这对理解模型行为和选择解释方法具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: Counterfactual (CF) explanations for time-series classifiers are usually evaluated one example at a time: what minimal edit flips this single window's prediction? We argue that the more informative question for diagnostic interpretability is structural: how does the classifier connect its own classes to each other?
  We propose a counterfactual transition graph (CGT) in which each node is a class and each edge weight is the CF reliability of the transition from one prototype to another under a proximity aware retrieval sweep. On a six-class hand-movement task, we induce a CGT that reveals a non-trivial topology, which is not predicted by the binary confusion matrix: it shows that counterfactual reachability does not align with classifier accuracy and even runs counter to it (Spearman $ρ=-0.37$ over the 15 pairs), i.e. the boundaries the classifier separates most confidently are among those an in-distribution edit can least often cross.
  Our framework is method agnostic, i.e. any CF-explainers can be used. Presently, we use it to juxtapose replacement-based CFs with gradient-based CFs; gradient-based methods reach almost any class by stepping off the data manifold, while replacement-based methods stay on it and fail on precisely the rigid boundaries.

</details>


### [661] [A Comparative Study of Label-free Representation Quality Metrics in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23182)
*Daniel Richards Arputharaj,Daniel Jönsson,Gabriel Eilertsen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对深度神经网络表示质量的无标签度量指标进行了系统性比较研究，将现有指标分为三个家族并建立族内联系，通过合成实验刻画谱度量的敏感性，并在260个视觉模型、6个数据集上评估所有指标与下游任务准确率的相关性。研究发现固有维度（ID）是最可靠的预测指标，但所有指标的可靠性都受架构类别和训练目标影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络中表示质量的评估对于理解模型性能和指导架构设计至关重要，但现有标签无关（label-free）的表示质量度量指标众多，缺乏系统的比较研究来理解这些指标在多样化配置下的可靠性和适用性。

Method: （1）将现有标签无关度量指标按构造方式分为三个家族，并进行族内的分析性联系推导；（2）通过受控合成实验刻画谱度量（spectral metrics）的敏感性特征；（3）在260个视觉模型、6个数据集（覆盖通用/细粒度分类、场景识别和地理空间任务）上进行大规模评估，将标签无关指标与下游任务精度对比，并按架构类别和训练目标分层分析结果。

Result: 固有维度（ID）在所有考虑的指标中是最可靠的预测器；然而所有指标（包括ID在内）的可靠性都会受到架构类别和训练目标的调节。

Conclusion: 研究为理解标签无关表示质量度量指标衡量了什么、何时可靠以及如何在实际中解读提供了更清晰的认识，有助于研究人员在实际应用中选择和解释合适的表示质量评估指标。

Abstract: We present a comparative study of label-free metrics for assessing the quality of representations in deep neural networks to understand their reliability under a wide variety of configurations. We group existing label-free metrics into three families based on their construction and analytically establish connections between metrics within the same family. We then characterise the sensitivity of spectral metrics through controlled synthetic experiments. Finally, all label-free metrics are evaluated against downstream task accuracy across a diverse set of 260 vision models on six datasets spanning generic object classification, fine-grained object classification, scene recognition and geospatial task, stratifying results by architecture class and training objective. We find that intrinsic dimensionality (ID) is the most reliable predictor among the metrics considered. However, the reliability of all metrics, including ID, is moderated by architecture class and training objective. Our results provide a clearer understanding of what label-free representation quality metrics measure, when they are reliable, and how to interpret them in practice.

</details>


### [662] [Leveraging Remote Traffic Data for Local Air Pollutant Estimation: A Scenario-Based Machine Learning Study Across London Monitoring Sites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23219)
*Valeria Legaria-Santiago,Amadeo Arguelles,Magdalena Saldana-Perez,Jocelyn Richardson,Marcella Bona*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了六种预测变量场景下四种可解释树模型（RF、Extra Trees、LightGBM、XGBoost）在伦敦多个站点估算NO₂、PM₁₀、PM₂.₅和O₃浓度的性能，发现远程获取的交通信息能显著改善空气污染预测精度，且在交通主导环境中交通变量的贡献可与邻近监测站测量值相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机动车交通是空气污染的主要来源，但远程获取的交通信息对本地机器学习空气污染模型的贡献尚未得到充分表征，因此需要系统评估交通信息在污染物浓度估算中的价值。

Method: 在伦敦多个站点，采用四种可解释的树模型（Random Forest、Extra Trees、LightGBM、XGBoost）与岭线性回归基线模型对比，设计六种预测变量场景（从仅含远程交通、气象、时间变量到逐步加入四个邻近监测站测量值），估算NO₂、PM₁₀、PM₂.₅和O₃浓度，并使用SHAP分析进行变量重要性解释，同时与空间插值方法和跨站点验证实验进行比较。

Result: 在不依赖邻近站数据建模时，NO₂的RMSE在无交通信息情况下为9.73–11.66 μg/m³，加入交通信息后降至8.72–11.52 μg/m³，表明交通信息能提升预测精度。SHAP分析显示在交通主导环境中，交通相关变量对NO₂的贡献水平可与邻近监测站的污染物测量值相当。

Conclusion: 远程获取的交通信息对本地ML空气污染模型具有显著贡献价值，尤其在交通主导环境中，其重要性可媲美甚至接近邻近监测站数据，可作为补充或替代邻近站测量的有效预测因子。

Abstract: Vehicular traffic is a major source of air pollution; however, the contribution of remotely acquired traffic information to local machine-learning (ML) air-pollution models remains insufficiently characterised. This study evaluates four interpretable tree-based ML models (Random Forest, Extra Trees, LightGBM, and XGBoost) under six predictor scenarios combining progressively larger predictor sets, ranging from remotely acquired traffic, meteorological, and temporal variables alone to the inclusion of measurements from one and four neighbouring monitoring stations, to estimate NO$_2$, PM$_{10}$, PM$_{2.5}$, and O$_3$ concentrations across several sites in London. ML model performance was compared with a ridge linear regression model as a baseline, with spatial interpolation methods and with a cross-site validation experiment. When modelling without data from neighbouring stations, the RMSE for NO$_2$ ranged from 9.73 to 11.66 $μ$g/m$^3$ without traffic information, compared with 8.72 to 11.52 $μ$g/m$^3$ when traffic information was included. Additionally, for NO$_2$, SHAP analyses indicate that traffic-related variables can contribute at levels comparable to pollutant measurements from neighbouring monitoring stations in traffic-dominated~environments.

</details>


### [663] [The Laws of Context Allocation: Causal Measurement and Closed-Loop Orchestration in Generative Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23252)
*Peiyang Liu,Xi Wang,Di Liang,Wei Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）中证据利用测量不准确与上下文预算分配不佳两个瓶颈，提出因果留一法探针替代标准相关性代理指标，并证明顺序迭代生成相比单片上下文扩展能带来16.7-20.5个绝对百分点的组合召回提升，最终统一为闭环子模调度器与归因引导对比解码器的架构，在32B规模模型下稳健扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG正向多样化组合生成演进，但面临两大瓶颈：一是标准相关性代理指标在硬负样本上严重失效，存在"诊断幻觉"问题，无法准确测量模型对证据的真实利用情况；二是当前单片上下文扩展（monolithic context widening）的分配策略是架构陷阱，受相关性衰减惩罚，导致组合召回受限。

Method: （1）提出高效因果留一法探针（causal leave-one-out probe），准确隔离生成依赖并形式化校准LLM注意力的结构稀释；（2）将因果探针部署在去混淆因子网格中，证明顺序多轮迭代生成优于单片上下文扩展；（3）将方案统一为闭环子模调度器，并引入归因引导的对比解码器以克服LLM注意力惯性，强制整合新证据。

Result: 顺序迭代分配计算资源在组合召回上取得16.7-20.5个绝对百分点的提升，且稳健扩展到32B参数规模模型；相比经典开环基线取得全面优势，验证了顺序、反馈驱动的编排是生成式搜索的确定性范式。

Conclusion: 顺序化、反馈驱动的编排应取代开环的单片上下文扩展，成为RAG多样化生成的新范式。因果测量工具是诊断证据利用的基础设施，未来工作可基于此进一步优化上下文预算分配与证据融合策略。

Abstract: As Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shifts toward diverse portfolio generation, it is stymied by two critical bottlenecks: flawed measurement of evidence utilization, and suboptimal context budget allocation. We resolve both sequentially.
  To resolve measurement, we expose a pervasive ``diagnostic illusion'': standard relevance proxies fail catastrophically on hard negatives. We replace them with an efficient causal leave-one-out probe that accurately isolates generative reliance and formally calibrates the structural dilution of LLM attention.
  To resolve allocation, we deploy this causal probe in a deconfounded factorial grid. We prove that the prevailing strategy of monolithic context widening is an architectural trap penalized by relevance decay. Instead, allocating compute iteratively across multiple sequential generations drives transformative portfolio recall gains of 16.7--20.5 absolute percentage points, scaling robustly up to 32B models.
  Finally, we unify these solutions into a deployable closed-loop submodular scheduler. Augmented by an attribution-steered contrastive decoder to override LLM attention inertia, our architecture systematically forces fresh evidence integration. By dominating classical open-loop baselines, we establish sequential, feedback-driven orchestration as the definitive paradigm for generative search. Our code, data, and causal measurement instruments are available at https://github.com/PeiYangLiu/ascp.

</details>


### [664] [From Multimodal Observation to Interpretable Suggestions: Counterfactual Time-Expanded Relational Modeling of Surgical Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23254)
*Vincenzo Marco De Luca,Antonio Longa,Giovanna Varni,Andrea Passerini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于时间扩展图的时序关系框架，用于从多模态观测中建模手术团队动态，并通过反事实程序生成可解释、可操作的建议来改善团队协作，推动手术AI从结果预测走向以团队为中心的可操作范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术AI方案主要聚焦于视觉工作流和技术执行，忽视了团队交互的建模，无法主动支持临床医生提升团队协作技能。患者安全不仅受技术问题威胁，也受团队合作不佳影响，因此需要建模团队动态并提供改进建议。

Method: 提出时序关系框架（Tempo-Relational Framework），利用时间扩展图同时捕获关系结构和时间演化，具有强表达能力且在小样本数据场景下保持稳健。通过反事实程序识别个体行为和交互模式的最小结构化改变来生成高效、可解释、可操作的建议。

Result: 在模拟手术程序实验中，该方法在多样化行为和交互目标上提升了预测性能，并提供了对团队动态的有意义洞察。

Conclusion: 这项工作将手术AI从结果驱动的预测推向社会化、以团队为中心且可操作的范式，有助于更好地理解和支持手术场景中团队技能的培养。

Abstract: In surgery, patient safety is threatened not only by technical issues but also by poor teamwork. However, existing surgical AI-based solutions focus mainly on visual workflow and technical execution, neglecting the modeling of team interactions and missing opportunities to actively support clinicians in improving their teamwork skills. To address this gap, we propose a tempo-relational framework for modeling surgical team dynamics from multimodal observations. By leveraging Time-Expanded graphs, the approach captures both relational structure and temporal evolution, achieving strong expressivity while remaining robust in the low-data regime typical of surgical settings. Beyond prediction, such modeling enables the generation of efficient, interpretable, and actionable suggestions for clinicians. More specifically, we generate suggestions via a counterfactual procedure that identifies minimal yet structured changes in individual behaviors and interaction patterns associated with improvements in team performance. Experiments with simulated surgical procedures show that our approach improves predictive performance in diverse behavioral and interaction goals while offering meaningful insights into team dynamics. This work advances surgical AI beyond outcome-driven prediction towards a socially grounded, team-centric, and actionable paradigm to better understand and support the development of team skills in surgical settings.

</details>


### [665] [A Multidimensional Data-Driven Hybrid Transformer Framework for Non-invasive Continuous Blood Pressure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23276)
*Yuexin Ma,Jingqi Hou,Yuxuan Kang,Zhaoying Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于ECG/PPG衍生特征序列的混合Transformer框架，用于无袖带连续血压估计，在MIMIC-III数据上实现DBP 0.41±3.74 mmHg、SBP -1.60±5.95 mmHg的误差，满足AAMI和BHS Grade A阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无袖带连续血压监测是医疗可穿戴设备的关键需求，但现有方法大多直接处理原始波形，难以有效建模多模态生理信号中的时序、非线性和表格化信息，血压估计精度仍有提升空间。

Method: 提出混合Transformer框架：1) 将ECG/PPG信号转换为10步序列的六个生理描述符和两个人口统计学协变量；2) 多源时序编码模块集成Transformer、Kolmogorov-Arnold网络和XGBoost三个分支，分别捕捉时序、非线性和表格信息；3) 动态条件融合解码器采用差分多头注意力、token加权聚合和门控残差校正；4) 鲁棒复合目标函数联合优化DBP和SBP。

Result: 基于MIMIC-III数据，源池含203名受试者28,486个波形片段，特征生成保留166名受试者53,621个观测。在2,431个段级测试窗口上，DBP误差为0.41±3.74 mmHg，SBP为-1.60±5.95 mmHg；95%一致性界限分别为[-6.93,7.74]和[-13.25,10.06] mmHg；10 mmHg内比例分别为98.48%和94.36%。在本地重训练的基线中标准差最低、一致性界限最窄。

Conclusion: 特征序列融合框架改善了与参考血压的一致性，且在该划分上达到AAMI和BHS Grade A数值阈值。但该研究为回顾性分析，尚需受试者独立和外部数据集验证方能用于临床。

Abstract: Objective. To develop and evaluate a cuffless continuous blood pressure (BP) estimator using temporal physiological and demographic features. We propose a hybrid Transformer framework to estimate diastolic and systolic BP from ECG/PPG-derived feature sequences. Approach. Rather than raw waveforms, the framework models 10-step sequences of six physiological descriptors and two demographic covariates. A Multi-Source Temporal Encoder Module combines Transformer, Kolmogorov-Arnold Network, and XGBoost branches to capture complementary temporal, nonlinear, and tabular information. A Dynamic Conditional Fusion-Decoder applies differential multi-head attention, token-weighted aggregation, and gated residual correction. A robust composite objective jointly optimizes DBP and SBP. Main results. Using the MIMIC-III Waveform and Clinical Databases, the source pool comprised 28,486 waveform segments from 203 subjects, and feature generation retained 53,621 observations from 166 subjects. On 2,431 segment-level held-out test windows, mean error +/- standard deviation was 0.41 +/- 3.74 mmHg for diastolic BP and -1.60 +/- 5.95 mmHg for systolic BP, with 95% limits of agreement of [-6.93, 7.74] and [-13.25, 10.06] mmHg, respectively. The proportions within 10 mmHg were 98.48% and 94.36%. The framework achieved the lowest standard deviations and narrowest limits of agreement among the locally retrained baselines. Significance. The feature-sequence fusion framework improved agreement with reference BP and fell within numerical AAMI and BHS Grade A thresholds on this split. This retrospective analysis is not formal device validation; subject-disjoint and external evaluation remain necessary before clinical use.

</details>


### [666] [How Much Regularization Survives Averaging? Update Masking in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23286)
*Wenhao Yan,Fu Kuroda,Yucheng Jin,Zhenke Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨了联邦学习中通过掩码噪声（masking noise）实现平坦极小值（flat minima）的方法。研究证明，在联邦平均（FedAvg）中，每个客户端使用独立掩码会使平坦区域的正则化效果被显著削弱（衰减因子恰好等于客户端数量），而所有客户端共享同一掩码则可通过梯度多样性的逆因子恢复效果。实验表明，在CIFAR-10上该恢复因子仅为1.19（理论上限为10），关闭小批量采样可将其提升至8.96，数据异构性变化对其影响极小，但保持正则化的配置训练效果过差而无法实际使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据下寻求平坦极小值以提升跨客户端泛化性能，已有方法借鉴了集中式训练中的锐度感知最小化（sharpness-aware minimization）。然而，还存在第二种到达平坦极小值的方式——通过对参数更新添加噪声来免费获得正则化，这种方法尚未被引入联邦学习场景。本文旨在探究其原因并分析可行性。

Method: 本文通过理论分析证明：当每个客户端各自绘制独立的掩码时，联邦平均操作会将掩码带来的平坦方向惩罚削弱为原来的1/客户端数量；当所有客户端使用相同掩码时，该惩罚可通过梯度多样性的逆因子得以恢复。作者在CIFAR-10上设计了实验来定量测量该恢复因子，并测试了小批量采样开关及数据异构性变化对因子的影响。

Result: 在CIFAR-10实验设置下，共享掩码带来的恢复因子仅为1.19（理论上限为客户端数10）。关闭小批量采样可将该因子提升至8.96；将数据异构性改变一百倍，因子仅在1.17到1.50之间波动。然而，能保持正则化效果的配置训练效果太差，无法实际应用。

Conclusion: 掩码噪声这种方法在联邦学习中实际上不可行：虽然理论上可通过共享掩码和关闭小批量采样来恢复正则化强度，但恢复效果有限，且能有效保持正则化的配置会导致训练效果过差，无法在实际中使用。这为联邦学习中通过噪声实现平坦极小值的方式提供了否定的结论。

Abstract: Federated learning on non-IID data seeks flat minima to generalize across clients, and existing methods borrow sharpness-aware minimization from centralized training. There is a second way to reach flat minima, in which the regularization comes for free from noise added to the parameter updates, and it has never been carried over to the federated setting. We show the reason. Masking charges the optimizer for moving in sharp directions. We prove that when each client draws its own mask, federated averaging weakens that charge by exactly the cohort size, and that giving every client the same mask brings it back by a factor equal to the inverse gradient diversity of the cohort. In our experiment setting on CIFAR-10, that factor is 1.19 out of a possible 10. Turning off minibatch sampling raises it to 8.96, while changing data heterogeneity a hundredfold leaves it between 1.17 and 1.50. The configurations keeping the regularization train far too poorly to use.

</details>


### [667] [Poisson Subspace Clustering: Focusing on the Essentials in Count Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23287)
*Collin Leiber,Kai Puolamäki,Heikki Mannila*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出3CPO，一种基于泊松和负二项分布等统计模型的计数数据聚类算法。它不仅输出聚类标签，还能识别相关的特征子集，提升结果可解释性。通过迭代最大化后验概率的算法，在基因表达、文本、经济学等多个领域的实验中表现出色，并公开了代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计数数据（如列联表、非负整数矩阵）在多个领域普遍存在。通用聚类算法未考虑此类数据的特殊分布性质，导致输出不可靠，因此需要专门针对计数数据统计特性的聚类方法。

Method: 3CPO基于泊松和负二项分布等成熟统计模型对计数数据进行建模；采用一个简单的迭代算法最大化后验概率以获得良好聚类解，同时识别相关特征的子集以增强可解释性。

Result: 大量实验表明，3CPO能在相关的子空间内为不同领域（基因表达、文本、经济学等）的数据定义高质量的聚类，证明了其作为计数数据聚类鲁棒方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 3CPO是一种在统计上可靠且具有可解释性的计数数据聚类解决方案，兼具特征选择能力和良好的聚类性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Count data represented as a matrix of non-negative integer values, such as contingency tables, are prevalent across diverse domains. When clustering such data sets, specific methods are required, as generic algorithms often fail to consider their unique distributional properties, leading to unreliable outputs. An effective strategy is to use well-established statistical models such as the Poisson and negative binomial distributions. We present 3CPO, a clustering algorithm based on statistically solid modeling of count data. In addition to the cluster labels, it identifies a subset of relevant columns, enhancing the interpretability of the results. We propose a simple iterative algorithm that maximizes the posterior probability to find good clustering solutions and discuss its properties. Extensive experiments demonstrate its ability to define high-quality clusters within associated subspaces for various data domains, ranging from gene expressions and texts to economics. Our findings suggest that 3CPO is a robust solution for clustering count data in a statistically sound and interpretable manner. Our code is available at https://github.com/collinleiber/3CPO.

</details>


### [668] [Sigmoid Attention as a Better Substrate for Learned KV Cache Eviction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23296)
*Isaac,Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过GPT-2规模Transformer在OpenWebText上的受控2×2×2对比实验，研究注意力类型（softmax vs sigmoid）、学习门控和位置编码如何影响KV-cache驱逐中"软到硬"的过渡，发现sigmoid注意力虽然作为稠密语言模型表现较差，但其学习到的硬驱逐能力更优，能删除KV条目且PPL变化可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型KV-cache驱逐存在软硬件失配问题：训练时微分门控只是衰减令牌贡献，而推理时只有物理删除KV条目才能节省内存。作者想知道注意力底层的归一化机制是否会影响这种从软门控到硬删除的迁移效果。

Method: 使用GPT-2规模Transformer在OpenWebText上训练，进行受控的2×2×2因子实验，比较维度包括：注意力类型（sigmoid vs softmax）、学习门控（有无）、位置编码（类型）。在匹配的live-cache协议下，对比sigmoid门控与H₂O、KeyDiff等后处理方法。

Result: sigmoid注意力虽然作为稠密语言模型时表现更差，但学习型硬驱逐改变了有效操作点：sigmoid门控模型删除KV条目时相对自身无驱逐基线PPL变化可忽略。在匹配的live-cache协议下，学习型sigmoid门控的PPL低于H₂O和KeyDiff实现，而softmax门控未能一致优于这些后处理方法。

Conclusion: 注意力归一化方式会显著影响训练期软门控能否干净地迁移到推理期的硬KV删除，sigmoid归一化与学习型门控的组合在这一迁移中表现更优。

Abstract: Learned KV-cache eviction often faces a soft-to-hard mismatch: during training, differentiable gates typically attenuate token contributions, whereas inference saves memory only when KV entries are physically removed. We ask whether the attention substrate affects this soft-to-hard transition. Using GPT-2-scale Transformers trained on OpenWebText, we run a controlled $2\times2\times2$ comparison over attention type, learned gating, and positional encoding. Although sigmoid attention is worse as a dense language model, learned hard eviction changes the useful operating points: sigmoid-gated models delete KV entries with negligible PPL change relative to their own no-eviction references. Under a matched live-cache protocol on the same dense backbones, learned sigmoid gates obtain lower PPL than our H$_2$O and KeyDiff implementations, whereas softmax gates do not uniformly beat these post-hoc methods. The results suggest that attention normalization can substantially affect whether a training-time soft gate transfers cleanly to hard KV deletion.

</details>


### [669] [Beyond Point Predictions: Uncertainty-Aware Satellite Poverty Mapping for Public Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23322)
*Markus B. Pettersson,James Bailie,Mohammad Kakooei,Eagon Meng,Adel Daoud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于不确定性感知的EO-ML（地球观测-机器学习）方法，用于非洲邻里级贫困制图。该方法结合同时分位数回归和一种新型共形预测，生成具有统计保证覆盖率预测区间的国际财富指数估计。虽然点预测性能达到当前最优水平（R²=0.75），但预测区间比预期更宽，表明即便高解释力下EO-ML也不能被天真地用于政策制定。为此，作者开发了一个融合地面调查数据与模型预测的援助分配程序，在保证排除合格邻里风险低于预设水平的前提下，显著提高每个合格受助者获得的援助量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非洲大部分地区缺乏高分辨率贫困数据，虽然EO-ML方法已经能通过地球观测图像预测贫困，但决策者需要对其预测误差有可靠的统计保证，以避免被预测错误误导。

Method: 开发基于同时分位数回归和新型共形预测的不确定性感知EO-ML方法；使用时空Transformer对Landsat和夜间灯光图像序列进行训练；并提出一种结合地面调查与模型预测的援助分配程序，确保排除合格邻里风险低于预设阈值。

Result: 点预测性能达到当前最优水平，R²为0.75；预测区间比预期更宽，说明即使高解释力下预测仍存在显著不确定性；所提出的援助分配程序在模拟中比其它策略为每个合格受助者提供了显著更多的援助。

Conclusion: EO-ML方法可以成为传统数据源的可依赖补充，但必须以不确定性感知的方式使用（结合统计保证的预测区间和适当的下游决策程序），而不能天真地依赖其点预测进行政策制定。

Abstract: Despite their critical importance for policy and research, high-resolution poverty data remain limited across much of Africa. Machine learning (ML) with earth observation (EO) imagery has recently emerged as a way to supplement these data by predicting (i.e., estimating) poverty where it has not been directly measured. Yet to be used reliably, decision-makers and analysts need assurances that they will not be misled by the errors in these predictions. To meet this need, we develop an uncertainty-aware EO-ML method for poverty mapping based on simultaneous quantile regression and a novel form of conformal prediction. Using a spatiotemporal transformer trained on sequences of Landsat and nighttime-light images, we produce prediction intervals for neighborhood-level International Wealth Index estimates across Africa which are statistically guaranteed to achieve their desired coverage rates. While our method's point-prediction performance matches the state of the art, its prediction intervals are wider than might be expected given its high $R^2$ of $0.75$. However, other models of similar accuracy likely suffer from comparable uncertainty, pointing to an inherent limitation: even with its remarkably high explanatory power, EO-ML cannot naively be relied upon for policy-making, such as when designing poverty-targeting programs. To handle this challenge, we develop a procedure to efficiently allocate aid using both ground-truth surveys and model predictions while provably ensuring the risk of excluding eligible neighborhoods remains below a prespecified level. In simulations, this approach delivers substantially more aid per eligible recipient than other strategies, thereby demonstrating that EO-ML can indeed be a reliable supplement to traditional data sources---as long as methods

</details>


### [670] [Towards Actionable Surgical Team Dynamics: from Teamwork to Counterfactual Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23344)
*Vincenzo Marco De Luca,Antonio Longa,Andrea Passerini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于真实手术室录音构建的多模态手术团队交互分析数据集。该数据集在现有语料基础上提供了说话人分离、转写文本、多层级标注（团队绩效、交互过程、个体特征）以及反事实标注，用于分析高风险环境中团队协作行为与绩效结果之间的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险环境（如手术室）中的团队交互建模对理解协调、沟通和个体行为如何影响团队绩效和安全至关重要。然而，现有数据集在模态、标注方案和格式上碎片化严重，难以支持对真实世界协作过程的综合分析。

Method: 从现有语料库出发，构建分析就绪版本的数据集，具体包括：(1) 说话人分离与转写；(2) 使用标准化手术团队评估协议评估团队绩效；(3) 通过结构化评分体系标注交互质量和个体非技术技能；(4) 引入反事实标注，描述在交互失败情况下可能出现的替代团队结果；(5) 提供结构化的时间与关系表示以支持计算建模。

Result: 产出的是一个统一的多模态扩增数据集，整合了团队绩效、交互过程与个体特征的多层标注，并通过反事实标注和时间/关系结构表示支撑团队协作行为的计算分析与AI辅助系统设计。

Conclusion: 该数据集为高保真领域中的协作行为研究提供了统一资源，有望支持个体行为、交互模式与团队层面过程如何共同影响手术团队结果的研究，并为AI辅助协作系统设计奠定数据基础。

Abstract: Modeling team interactions in high-stakes environments such as operating rooms is critical for understanding how coordination, communication, and individual behaviors shape team performance and safety outcomes. Existing datasets in this domain are often fragmented across modalities, annotation schemes, and formats, limiting their ability to support integrated analyses of real-world collaborative processes. We address this limitation by introducing an extended multimodal dataset for surgical team interaction analysis, built from real operating room recordings. Starting from an existing corpus, we construct an analysis-ready version of the data by providing speaker diarization, transcripts, and multi-level annotations capturing team performance, interaction processes, and individual characteristics. Team performance is assessed using a standardized surgical teamwork evaluation protocol, while interaction quality and individual attributes are annotated through structured rating schemes covering collaboration, group dynamics, and non-technical skills. To further support the study of coordination breakdowns and performance variability, we introduce counterfactual annotations that describe plausible alternative team outcomes in the presence of observed interaction failures, enabling analysis of how specific behavioral patterns may relate to different trajectories of team performance. In addition, we provide structured temporal and relational representations designed to support computational modeling of teamwork processes and the design of AI-assisted collaborative systems. The dataset is designed to support the study of how individual actions, interaction patterns, and team-level processes jointly contribute to team outcomes in surgical settings, providing a unified resource for analyzing collaborative behavior in high-stakes domains.

</details>


### [671] [Test-Time Adaptation for ECG Classification via SQI-Gated Self-Training and Beat-Rhythm Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23347)
*Wenhan Jiang,Zhipeng Deng,Jiale Zhou,Haolin Wang,Yafei Ou,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BeatRhythm-TTA，一个面向心电图的测试时自适应框架，通过信号质量指数（SQI）门控自适应机制过滤低质量信号，并利用双重一致性约束保留心跳形态和节律动态，解决跨域ECG分类中的性能退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习ECG分类模型在部署到未见过的领域（如不同采集设备和患者群体）时性能显著下降。现有的测试时自适应（TTA）方法直接用于ECG任务时表现不佳，因为朴素在线更新忽略了心脏周期的层次化节律-心跳结构，且容易受到信号伪影干扰，导致自适应不稳定和模型漂移。

Method: BeatRhythm-TTA包含两个核心组件：(1) SQI门控自适应方案，通过信号质量指数选择性过滤低质量信号，防止有害更新；(2) 双层一致性约束，使模型在适应域偏移的同时保留心跳形态（beat morphology）和节律动态（rhythm dynamics）的语义信息。

Result: 在三种自适应协议下的多标签ECG诊断实验中，以PTB-XL为源域、CPSC2018和Georgia为目标域，BeatRhythm-TTA相较最优对比方法在Macro-F1上平均提升+2.70%相对改进。

Conclusion: BeatRhythm-TTA通过显式建模ECG信号中的噪声观测和结构化节律-心跳语义，有效缓解了跨域ECG分类中的模型漂移问题，验证了针对特定医学信号领域定制TTA策略的必要性和有效性。

Abstract: Deep learning models for electrocardiogram (ECG) classification often suffer from significant performance degradation when deployed in unseen domains due to shifts in acquisition devices and patient populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical solution by adapting models using only unlabeled data at inference time. However, existing TTA methods often underperform on ECG tasks, since naive online updates ignore the hierarchical beat-rhythm structure of cardiac cycles and are vulnerable to signal artifacts, which leads to unstable adaptation and model drift. We propose BeatRhythm-TTA, an ECG-tailored TTA framework that explicitly accounts for ECG's noisy observations and structured beat-rhythm semantics under domain shift. First, to handle pervasive ECG artifacts, we introduce a Signal Quality Index (SQI)-gated adaptation scheme that selectively filters out low-quality signals to prevent harmful updates. Second, to leverage ECG's beat-rhythm semantics, we enforce dual-level consistency so the model preserves beat morphology and rhythm dynamics while adapting to shifted acquisition conditions.
